ingredients: 400g spaghetti or fettuccine, 3 tbsp butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 200g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 2 cups cooked chicken or turkey (diced), 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 1 can (400g) cream of chicken soup, 1 can (400g) cream of celery soup, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 2 1/2 cups cheddar cheese (shredded, divided), 1 cup frozen peas (optional), 1 jalape?o (minced, optional), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and butter a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish | Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente ? do not overcook as it will cook more in the oven | Drain pasta and transfer to a large bowl | Add heavy cream, all three canned soups, cooked chicken or turkey, sour cream, Parmesan cheese, 1 1/2 cups of the cheddar cheese, and frozen peas if using | Toss well to combine | In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat | Add sliced mushrooms and cook until all the liquid is released and evaporated, about 10 minutes | Add diced onions, minced garlic, and jalape?o if using | Saut? until onions are soft, about 5 minutes | Add the mushroom mixture to the pasta mixture | Using a wooden spoon, mix all ingredients together until well combined | Season with salt and pepper | Transfer to the prepared baking dish and spread evenly | Cover with foil and bake for 30-35 minutes until hot and bubbly | Uncover and sprinkle with the remaining 1 cup cheddar cheese | Return to oven and bake until cheese is melted, about 5-8 minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: 400g short pasta (fusilli or penne), 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp lemon zest, 2 cans (200g each) tuna in olive oil (drained and flaked), 1 can (400g) white beans (drained and rinsed), 1/4 cup fresh basil (torn), 1/4 cup red onion (thinly sliced), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente | Drain and rinse under cold water to cool, then drain well | In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, fresh lemon juice, and lemon zest until smooth | Add the cooled pasta, flaked tuna, white beans, torn basil, and sliced red onion | Toss gently to combine all ingredients evenly | Season with salt and black pepper to taste | Serve at room temperature or chilled

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 1 large egg (lightly beaten), 1/2 cup tomato sauce (plus extra for topping), 1/2 cup soda cracker crumbs, 1 medium onion (finely diced), 1/2 green bell pepper (finely diced), 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp ground black pepper, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | In a large bowl, beat egg slightly | Add 1/2 cup tomato sauce and combine | Add soda cracker crumbs and mix well | Add ground beef, diced onions, and diced bell pepper | Add seasonings (salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder) to taste | Combine everything well using your hands until evenly mixed | Form the mixture into a loaf shape | Spray a glass meatloaf pan or casserole dish with non-stick spray | Place the loaf in the prepared dish | Spread additional tomato sauce over the top if desired | Bake for about 1 hour until internal temperature reaches 160?F (71?C) | Let rest for 10 minutes before slicing | Serve with mashed potatoes and vegetables

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups wheat flour, 1/2 cup flax seed meal, 1/2 cup oat bran, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 cup grated carrot, 1/2 cup chocolate chips, 1/2 cup raisins, 3/4 cup milk, 1 large egg (beaten), 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and line a muffin tin with paper liners | In a large bowl, mix together all the dry ingredients: wheat flour, flax seed meal, oat bran, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon | Stir in grated carrot and raisins until evenly distributed | In a separate small bowl, combine milk, beaten egg, and vanilla extract | Pour the liquid ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix gently until just combined | Stir in chocolate chips and fold until all ingredients are incorporated ? do not overmix | Divide batter evenly among the muffin cups, filling each about 3/4 full | Bake for 15 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean | Let cool in the pan for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack | Serve warm or at room temperature

ingredients: 12 vanilla wafer cookies, 16 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp amaretto liqueur or 1 tsp almond extract, 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup mini chocolate chips, 1/2 cup white chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Line 12 medium muffin cups with paper baking cups | Place one vanilla wafer flat side down in the bottom of each cup | In a medium bowl, beat softened cream cheese and sugar with an electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy | Beat in amaretto liqueur or almond extract until combined | Beat in eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition | Fill each cup about 3/4 full with the cream cheese mixture | Sprinkle chocolate chips and white chocolate chips over the tops to your taste | Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the centers are set and firm | Immediately remove cheesecakes from the muffin pan to a wire rack | Cool for 15 minutes | Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before eating ? but no longer than 48 hours | Serve chilled

ingredients: For topping: 2 slices white bread (pulsed into crumbs), 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 cup crispy fried onions. For casserole: 800g green beans (trimmed and cut), 2 tbsp salt (for blanching water), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 250g white button mushrooms (sliced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 3/4 tsp salt, 1/8 tsp black pepper, 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 cups low-sodium chicken broth, 1 1/2 cups heavy cream
instructions: Make the topping: pulse bread, melted butter, salt, and pepper in a food processor until mixture resembles coarse crumbs, about ten 1-second pulses | Transfer to a large bowl and toss with crispy fried onions ? set aside | Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) and adjust oven rack to middle position | Fill a large bowl with ice water | Bring 4 quarts of water to a boil in a large Dutch oven | Add 2 tablespoons salt and green beans | Cook beans until bright green and crisp-tender, about 6 minutes | Drain beans in a colander and plunge immediately into the ice water to stop cooking | Spread beans on a paper towel-lined baking sheet to drain | Add butter to the now-empty Dutch oven and melt over medium-high heat until foaming subsides | Add sliced mushrooms, minced garlic, 3/4 teaspoon salt, and 1/8 teaspoon pepper | Cook until mushrooms release their moisture and the liquid evaporates, about 6 minutes | Add flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly | Stir in chicken broth and bring to a simmer, stirring constantly | Add heavy cream, reduce heat to medium, and simmer until sauce is thickened and reduced to about 3 1/2 cups, about 12 minutes | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Add green beans to the sauce and stir until evenly coated | Arrange in an even layer in a 3-quart or 13 x 9-inch baking dish | Sprinkle with the topping and bake until top is golden brown and sauce is bubbling around the edges, about 15 minutes | Serve immediately

ingredients: 3 cups sushi rice (short-grain Japanese rice), 3 1/3 cups cold water, 1/2 cup rice vinegar, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp powdered dashi (optional)
instructions: Rinse the rice: put the rice in a large bowl and add enough cold water to half fill the bowl | Swirl the water around with the rice, scrunching the rice gently with your hands | Drain and repeat the rinsing process 3 or 4 times until the water runs mostly clear | Transfer the rinsed rice to a large saucepan | Pour in 3 1/3 cups of cold water and leave to soak for at least 30 minutes ? the rice will become whiter and the water clear | Prepare the sushi vinegar: combine rice vinegar, sugar, salt, and powdered dashi (if using) in a small saucepan | Heat gently, stirring to dissolve the sugar and salt | Do not let the mixture boil as it will impair the flavor | Remove from heat and let cool completely | Cook the rice: place the lid securely on the saucepan and turn the heat to high | When the rice begins to boil, reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes ? do not lift the lid at any point | After 15 minutes, turn off the heat and leave the rice to stand covered for another 15 minutes | Transfer the hot rice into a large wooden or glass bowl | Pour the cooled sushi vinegar evenly over the rice | Use a flat spatula in a cutting motion to gently fold the mixture into the rice ? do not stir or mash | While folding, use your other hand to fan the rice to help it cool to room temperature | The finished rice should be shiny and sticky, with each grain separated | Use immediately or cover with a damp cloth to prevent it from drying out

ingredients: 400g penne pasta, 1 red bell pepper (diced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1 tbsp olive oil, 3 cups fresh spinach leaves, 4 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), 1/2 cup feta cheese (crumbled), 1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes in oil (drained and chopped), 1/4 cup olive oil, 2 tbsp cider vinegar, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp salt
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente | Meanwhile, in a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium heat | Saut? diced red pepper and onion for 3-4 minutes until tender | Drain pasta and place in a large serving bowl | Add the red pepper mixture, fresh spinach, crumbled bacon, feta cheese, and sun-dried tomatoes | In a jar with a tight-fitting lid, combine the 1/4 cup olive oil, cider vinegar, pepper, and salt ? shake well to emulsify | Drizzle the dressing over the pasta and spinach mixture | Toss everything together until well coated and the spinach begins to wilt slightly from the heat of the pasta | Serve immediately

ingredients: 150g dried pasta (any shape), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp light olive oil, 1/4 cup white wine, 1/4 cup chicken or vegetable broth, 1 cup broccoli florets, 2 tbsp Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 tbsp Romano cheese (grated), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain and set aside | In a skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat | Saut? diced onion and minced garlic until soft and fragrant, about 3-4 minutes | Add white wine and broth, then add broccoli florets | Cover and cook for 3 minutes until broccoli is bright green and tender-crisp | Add the cooked pasta to the skillet with the broccoli mixture | Toss everything together and cook until both are heated through, about 1-2 minutes | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Transfer to a serving plate and sprinkle generously with Parmesan and Romano cheeses | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4 ripe Hass avocados, 1/2 cup sweet onion (finely diced), 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves (chopped), 2 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tbsp sour cream, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 2 Roma tomatoes (diced), 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp ground cumin, 1/4 tsp chili powder, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp onion powder, 1/4 tsp sweet Hungarian paprika (plus extra for garnish), tortilla chips for serving
instructions: In a mortar and pestle or small bowl, grind together salt, black pepper, cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika | Cut avocados in half, remove pits, and scoop the flesh into a large bowl | Add the ground spice mixture to the avocados | Add diced onion, chopped cilantro, mayonnaise, sour cream, and fresh lime juice | Mash together partially with a fork, leaving at least half of the avocado in good-sized chunks for texture | Gently fold in diced Roma tomatoes | Cover tightly with plastic wrap pressed directly onto the surface of the guacamole to prevent browning | Refrigerate overnight to allow flavors to meld | Before serving, taste and adjust seasonings | Sprinkle with a bit more paprika and garnish with fresh cilantro leaves and diced red onion on top | Serve with tortilla chips

ingredients: 400g spaghetti or fettuccine, 3 tbsp butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 200g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 2 cups cooked chicken or turkey (diced), 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 1 can (400g) cream of chicken soup, 1 can (400g) cream of celery soup, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 2 1/2 cups cheddar cheese (shredded, divided), 1 cup frozen peas (optional), 1 jalape?o (minced, optional), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and butter a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish | Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente ? do not overcook as it will cook more in the oven | Drain pasta and transfer to a large bowl | Add heavy cream, all three canned soups, cooked chicken or turkey, sour cream, Parmesan cheese, 1 1/2 cups of the cheddar cheese, and frozen peas if using | Toss well to combine | In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat | Add sliced mushrooms and cook until all the liquid is released and evaporated, about 10 minutes | Add diced onions, minced garlic, and jalape?o if using | Saut? until onions are soft, about 5 minutes | Add the mushroom mixture to the pasta mixture | Using a wooden spoon, mix all ingredients together until well combined | Season with salt and pepper | Transfer to the prepared baking dish and spread evenly | Cover with foil and bake for 30-35 minutes until hot and bubbly | Uncover and sprinkle with the remaining 1 cup cheddar cheese | Return to oven and bake until cheese is melted, about 5-8 minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: 400g short pasta (fusilli or penne), 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp lemon zest, 2 cans (200g each) tuna in olive oil (drained and flaked), 1 can (400g) white beans (drained and rinsed), 1/4 cup fresh basil (torn), 1/4 cup red onion (thinly sliced), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente | Drain and rinse under cold water to cool, then drain well | In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, fresh lemon juice, and lemon zest until smooth | Add the cooled pasta, flaked tuna, white beans, torn basil, and sliced red onion | Toss gently to combine all ingredients evenly | Season with salt and black pepper to taste | Serve at room temperature or chilled

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 1 large egg (lightly beaten), 1/2 cup tomato sauce (plus extra for topping), 1/2 cup soda cracker crumbs, 1 medium onion (finely diced), 1/2 green bell pepper (finely diced), 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp ground black pepper, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | In a large bowl, beat egg slightly | Add 1/2 cup tomato sauce and combine | Add soda cracker crumbs and mix well | Add ground beef, diced onions, and diced bell pepper | Add seasonings (salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder) to taste | Combine everything well using your hands until evenly mixed | Form the mixture into a loaf shape | Spray a glass meatloaf pan or casserole dish with non-stick spray | Place the loaf in the prepared dish | Spread additional tomato sauce over the top if desired | Bake for about 1 hour until internal temperature reaches 160?F (71?C) | Let rest for 10 minutes before slicing | Serve with mashed potatoes and vegetables

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups wheat flour, 1/2 cup flax seed meal, 1/2 cup oat bran, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 cup grated carrot, 1/2 cup chocolate chips, 1/2 cup raisins, 3/4 cup milk, 1 large egg (beaten), 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and line a muffin tin with paper liners | In a large bowl, mix together all the dry ingredients: wheat flour, flax seed meal, oat bran, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon | Stir in grated carrot and raisins until evenly distributed | In a separate small bowl, combine milk, beaten egg, and vanilla extract | Pour the liquid ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix gently until just combined | Stir in chocolate chips and fold until all ingredients are incorporated ? do not overmix | Divide batter evenly among the muffin cups, filling each about 3/4 full | Bake for 15 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean | Let cool in the pan for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack | Serve warm or at room temperature

ingredients: 12 vanilla wafer cookies, 16 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp amaretto liqueur or 1 tsp almond extract, 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup mini chocolate chips, 1/2 cup white chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Line 12 medium muffin cups with paper baking cups | Place one vanilla wafer flat side down in the bottom of each cup | In a medium bowl, beat softened cream cheese and sugar with an electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy | Beat in amaretto liqueur or almond extract until combined | Beat in eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition | Fill each cup about 3/4 full with the cream cheese mixture | Sprinkle chocolate chips and white chocolate chips over the tops to your taste | Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the centers are set and firm | Immediately remove cheesecakes from the muffin pan to a wire rack | Cool for 15 minutes | Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before eating ? but no longer than 48 hours | Serve chilled

ingredients: For topping: 2 slices white bread (pulsed into crumbs), 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 cup crispy fried onions. For casserole: 800g green beans (trimmed and cut), 2 tbsp salt (for blanching water), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 250g white button mushrooms (sliced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 3/4 tsp salt, 1/8 tsp black pepper, 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 cups low-sodium chicken broth, 1 1/2 cups heavy cream
instructions: Make the topping: pulse bread, melted butter, salt, and pepper in a food processor until mixture resembles coarse crumbs, about ten 1-second pulses | Transfer to a large bowl and toss with crispy fried onions ? set aside | Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) and adjust oven rack to middle position | Fill a large bowl with ice water | Bring 4 quarts of water to a boil in a large Dutch oven | Add 2 tablespoons salt and green beans | Cook beans until bright green and crisp-tender, about 6 minutes | Drain beans in a colander and plunge immediately into the ice water to stop cooking | Spread beans on a paper towel-lined baking sheet to drain | Add butter to the now-empty Dutch oven and melt over medium-high heat until foaming subsides | Add sliced mushrooms, minced garlic, 3/4 teaspoon salt, and 1/8 teaspoon pepper | Cook until mushrooms release their moisture and the liquid evaporates, about 6 minutes | Add flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly | Stir in chicken broth and bring to a simmer, stirring constantly | Add heavy cream, reduce heat to medium, and simmer until sauce is thickened and reduced to about 3 1/2 cups, about 12 minutes | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Add green beans to the sauce and stir until evenly coated | Arrange in an even layer in a 3-quart or 13 x 9-inch baking dish | Sprinkle with the topping and bake until top is golden brown and sauce is bubbling around the edges, about 15 minutes | Serve immediately

ingredients: 3 cups sushi rice (short-grain Japanese rice), 3 1/3 cups cold water, 1/2 cup rice vinegar, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp powdered dashi (optional)
instructions: Rinse the rice: put the rice in a large bowl and add enough cold water to half fill the bowl | Swirl the water around with the rice, scrunching the rice gently with your hands | Drain and repeat the rinsing process 3 or 4 times until the water runs mostly clear | Transfer the rinsed rice to a large saucepan | Pour in 3 1/3 cups of cold water and leave to soak for at least 30 minutes ? the rice will become whiter and the water clear | Prepare the sushi vinegar: combine rice vinegar, sugar, salt, and powdered dashi (if using) in a small saucepan | Heat gently, stirring to dissolve the sugar and salt | Do not let the mixture boil as it will impair the flavor | Remove from heat and let cool completely | Cook the rice: place the lid securely on the saucepan and turn the heat to high | When the rice begins to boil, reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes ? do not lift the lid at any point | After 15 minutes, turn off the heat and leave the rice to stand covered for another 15 minutes | Transfer the hot rice into a large wooden or glass bowl | Pour the cooled sushi vinegar evenly over the rice | Use a flat spatula in a cutting motion to gently fold the mixture into the rice ? do not stir or mash | While folding, use your other hand to fan the rice to help it cool to room temperature | The finished rice should be shiny and sticky, with each grain separated | Use immediately or cover with a damp cloth to prevent it from drying out

ingredients: 400g penne pasta, 1 red bell pepper (diced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1 tbsp olive oil, 3 cups fresh spinach leaves, 4 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), 1/2 cup feta cheese (crumbled), 1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes in oil (drained and chopped), 1/4 cup olive oil, 2 tbsp cider vinegar, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp salt
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente | Meanwhile, in a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium heat | Saut? diced red pepper and onion for 3-4 minutes until tender | Drain pasta and place in a large serving bowl | Add the red pepper mixture, fresh spinach, crumbled bacon, feta cheese, and sun-dried tomatoes | In a jar with a tight-fitting lid, combine the 1/4 cup olive oil, cider vinegar, pepper, and salt ? shake well to emulsify | Drizzle the dressing over the pasta and spinach mixture | Toss everything together until well coated and the spinach begins to wilt slightly from the heat of the pasta | Serve immediately

instructions: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain and set aside | In a skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat | Saut? diced onion and minced garlic until soft and fragrant, about 3-4 minutes | Add white wine and broth, then add broccoli florets | Cover and cook for 3 minutes until broccoli is bright green and tender-crisp | Add the cooked pasta to the skillet with the broccoli mixture | Toss everything together and cook until both are heated through, about 1-2 minutes | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Transfer to a serving plate and sprinkle generously with Parmesan and Romano cheeses | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4 ripe Hass avocados, 1/2 cup sweet onion (finely diced), 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves (chopped), 2 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tbsp sour cream, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 2 Roma tomatoes (diced), 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp ground cumin, 1/4 tsp chili powder, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp onion powder, 1/4 tsp sweet Hungarian paprika (plus extra for garnish), tortilla chips for serving

ingredients: 500g frozen edamame in pods, 1 tbsp coarse sea salt, 2 tbsp reduced-sodium soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp honey, 1 clove garlic (minced), 2 scallions (thinly sliced)
instructions: Place the coarse sea salt into a small ungreased skillet | Set over medium heat and cook, tossing occasionally, until the salt turns tan-colored, about 6-7 minutes | Set aside to cool | Bring a pot of water to a boil | Add frozen edamame and cook until tender, about 4 minutes ? cook out the raw taste but do not let them get mushy | Immediately transfer edamame with a slotted spoon to a bowl of ice water to stop cooking | Drain well and pat completely dry with paper towels | Toss the edamame with the prepared toasted salt | Make the dipping sauce: whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, honey, minced garlic, and sliced scallions until well combined | Serve edamame in a bowl with the dipping sauce in a small bowl on the side

ingredients: For crust: 1 package (250g) Lorna Doone shortbread cookies (finely crushed), 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted). For filling: 4 packages (250g each) cream cheese (softened), 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 5 large eggs, 2 large egg yolks, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/4 cup heavy cream, 1 tsp orange zest (optional), 1 tsp lemon zest (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Make the crust: finely crush the entire package of cookies, then mix in melted butter ? this can be done in a food processor on pulse | Butter the sides of a 9-inch springform pan | Press the cookie mixture firmly into the bottom of the pan ? do not bake the crust | Make the filling: beat together softened cream cheese, sugar, flour, and zests (if using) until smooth | Add the 5 eggs and 2 egg yolks one at a time, beating well after each addition | Add vanilla to the heavy cream, then add the cream to the cheese mixture | Beat on low speed until all ingredients are incorporated ? do not overbeat | Place the springform pan in the center of a shallow baking pan to catch any drips | Pour filling into the crust ? it will be very full | Place in the middle of the oven and bake for 12 minutes at 400?F | Reduce oven temperature to 250?F (120?C) and continue baking for approximately 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes until the center is mostly firm but still has a slight jiggle | A slight jiggle is good ? overbaking causes cracks | After removing from oven, run a knife around the edge of the pan and cool on a wire rack for 6 hours | Remove the side of the springform pan and transfer to a flat plate | Refrigerate for up to 2 weeks, but best served after returning to room temperature

ingredients: 6 cups beef broth, 3 tbsp hoisin sauce, 2 tbsp barbecue sauce, 2 tbsp crushed peanuts, 1 stalk lemongrass (bruised and chopped), 2 tbsp tomato paste, 400g beef sirloin (thinly sliced), 1 English cucumber (julienned), 2 cups shredded cabbage, 1 cup bean sprouts, 3 green onions (sliced), 200g rice noodles, fresh cilantro and lime wedges for serving
instructions: In a large pot, combine beef broth, hoisin sauce, barbecue sauce, crushed peanuts, lemongrass, and tomato paste | Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes to allow flavors to meld | Add thinly sliced beef and cook for 2-3 minutes until just cooked through | Meanwhile, prepare the vegetables: toss together shredded cabbage, julienned cucumber, and bean sprouts | Cook rice noodles in hot water according to package directions, then drain | Divide the vegetable mixture among individual serving bowls | Place cooked noodles on top of the vegetables in each bowl | Ladle the hot soup with beef over the noodles and vegetables | Sprinkle with sliced green onions, fresh cilantro, and serve with lime wedges on the side

recipe_name: Pork Ribs with Red Wine Vinegar Sauce
ingredients: For sauce: 1/2 cup red wine vinegar, 1/3 cup ketchup, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp Tabasco sauce, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1/2 tsp chili powder. For ribs: 1.5 kg country-style pork ribs, 1 tsp kosher salt, 1/2 tsp fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Make the sauce: in a medium saucepan, combine red wine vinegar, ketchup, soy sauce, honey, minced garlic, dried thyme, Tabasco sauce, black pepper, and chili powder | Bring to a boil, then decrease heat and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally | Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature | Pour some of the sauce into a small bowl to use for basting the ribs | Let the ribs stand at room temperature for 20-30 minutes before grilling | Season ribs generously with kosher salt and black pepper | Prepare your grill for indirect medium heat (about 350?F / 175?C) | Grill ribs over indirect heat for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until the meat is tender, turning once halfway through grilling time | During the last 20 minutes of grilling, baste the ribs with the reserved small bowl of sauce, turning and basting several times | Serve warm with the remaining sauce on the side

ingredients: 400g rotini pasta, 1 1/2 cups milk, 1 jar (400g) Alfredo sauce, 3 tbsp fresh basil (chopped, divided), 1 1/2 cups provolone cheese (shredded), 1 cup cherry tomatoes (halved, divided), 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, 1/4 tsp fresh black pepper, 1/4 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 2-quart casserole dish | Cook rotini pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente, then drain | In a medium bowl, stir milk into Alfredo sauce until smooth | Stir in 2 tablespoons of the chopped basil, shredded provolone cheese, and 1 cup of the halved cherry tomatoes | Add the cooked pasta and toss well to combine | Pour the mixture into the prepared casserole dish and spread evenly | Sprinkle the remaining tomatoes on top | Bake uncovered for 30 to 35 minutes until hot and bubbly | In a small bowl, mix breadcrumbs with the remaining 1 tablespoon basil | Sprinkle over the top and serve immediately

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 2 cups salsa (red or green), 1 can (400g) black beans (drained and rinsed), 1 cup frozen corn (optional), 1 cup shredded Mexican blend cheese (optional), steamed white rice for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Place chicken breasts in a single layer in a baking dish | Pour salsa and drained black beans over the top of the chicken, spreading evenly | Add frozen corn if using | Cover with foil and bake for 45-60 minutes depending on the size of the chicken breasts, until chicken is cooked through and reaches 165?F (74?C) | If desired, uncover and sprinkle with cheese during the last 5 minutes of baking | Serve hot over steamed white rice with the salsa and bean sauce spooned over the top

ingredients: 4 cups whole milk, 2 tbsp brown sugar (divided), 2 tbsp Grand Marnier liqueur, peel of 2 oranges (removed in strips), 100g bittersweet chocolate (chopped), 1 tbsp instant espresso powder, 1 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Make the Grand Marnier whipped cream: whisk heavy cream, 1 tablespoon brown sugar, and Grand Marnier in a medium bowl until soft peaks form | Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve | Using a vegetable peeler, remove the peel from the oranges in strips, reserving the oranges for another use | Add orange peel strips and milk to a medium saucepan | Bring just to a simmer over medium heat ? do not boil | Add chopped chocolate, espresso powder, cocoa powder, and remaining 1 tablespoon brown sugar | Bring just back to a simmer, whisking constantly to melt the chocolate | Remove from heat and strain through a fine mesh sieve into a clean saucepan, discarding the orange peel | Reheat gently if needed | Ladle the hot mocha into 4 mugs | Top each with a generous dollop of the Grand Marnier whipped cream | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sorghum flour, 1/2 cup tapioca flour, 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp xanthan gum, 1/2 tsp guar gum, 1/2 tsp sea salt, 1/2 cup prunes, 1/2 cup boiling water, 1/3 cup coconut oil (melted), 3/4 cup maple syrup, 1/2 cup water, 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1 tsp vanilla extract. For frosting: 1/2 cup vegetable shortening, 2 tbsp arrowroot powder, 1/4 cup maple syrup, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease two 9-inch cake pans | In a medium bowl, combine sorghum flour, tapioca flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, xanthan gum, guar gum, and sea salt ? mix together well with a fork or wire whisk | Place prunes in a small bowl and pour the boiling water over them ? let stand for about 10 minutes to soften | Place the prunes and their soaking water into a blender | Add melted coconut oil, maple syrup, water, apple cider vinegar, and vanilla | Blend until very smooth | Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix well, being careful not to overmix | Immediately pour batter into the prepared pans, dividing evenly | Bake for about 25 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean | Let stand for a few minutes in the pans, then gently invert onto a wire rack to cool completely | Make the frosting: place shortening, arrowroot, maple syrup, and vanilla into a mixing bowl | Whip with an electric mixer until light and fluffy ? can be made a day ahead and re-whipped | Frost the cooled cake and serve

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 1/2 cup uncooked minute rice, 1/4 cup applesauce, 1/2 medium onion (finely diced), 1 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 cup ketchup, 1/2 cup water, steamed rice or mashed potatoes for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | In a large bowl, mix together ground beef, uncooked rice, applesauce, diced onion, salt, and pepper until well combined | Roll the mixture into 1 1/2-inch balls and place them in a single layer in a 9 x 13 baking dish | In a separate bowl, mix together ketchup and water until smooth | Pour the ketchup mixture evenly over the meatballs | Bake for 1 hour until meatballs are cooked through and rice is tender ? the rice will poke out like little porcupine quills | Serve hot with steamed rice or mashed potatoes and spoon the pan sauce over the top

ingredients: For crust: 1 1/2 cups crushed tortilla chips, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted). For filling: 3 packages (250g each) cream cheese (softened), 3 large eggs, 1 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/4 tsp salt, 3 green onions (minced), 1 cup cooked chicken (shredded), 1 can (200g) diced green chilies, 1 cup Monterey Jack cheese (shredded). For topping: 1 cup sour cream, 1/2 tsp seasoned salt, picante sauce for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Combine crushed tortilla chips and melted butter, mixing well | Press the mixture on the bottom and 1 inch up the sides of a 9-inch springform pan | Set aside | Beat softened cream cheese with an electric mixer at high speed until light and fluffy | Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition | Stir in chili powder, cumin, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and minced green onions | Pour half of the cream cheese mixture into the prepared crust | Sprinkle with shredded chicken, diced green chilies, and Monterey Jack cheese | Carefully pour the remaining cream cheese mixture on top | Bake for 10 minutes at 350?F, then reduce heat to 300?F (150?C) and bake for an additional hour or until set | Cool completely on a wire rack | Combine sour cream and seasoned salt, then spread evenly over the top of the cooled cheesecake | Cover and chill for at least 8 hours or overnight | Just before serving, slice and serve with picante sauce on the side

ingredients: 4 ripe bananas (sliced into rounds), 3 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 cup wheat germ or toasted cassava flour (farofa), salt to taste, fresh parsley (chopped, for garnish)
instructions: In a large skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat | Saut? the banana slices until they turn golden on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side ? remove with a slotted spoon and set aside | In the same oil, saut? the diced onion until translucent, about 4-5 minutes | Return the bananas to the pan with the onions | Reduce heat to medium-low and gently add the wheat germ (or farofa) to the mixture | Cook, stirring gently, until the wheat germ is lightly browned and toasted, about 3-4 minutes | If the mixture becomes noticeably dry, add a small amount of oil | Season with salt to taste | Garnish with fresh chopped parsley and serve hot as a side dish

ingredients: 1 large spaghetti squash, 500g boneless skinless chicken breasts (cut into 1/2-inch cubes), 1 tbsp cornstarch, 3 tbsp soy sauce (divided), 2 tbsp dry sherry, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes, 3 tbsp vegetable oil, 2 green onions (sliced), 1 leek (white part only, sliced), 1 tbsp gingerroot (grated), steamed rice for serving
instructions: Cut the spaghetti squash in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds | Place cut-side down on a baking sheet and bake at 375?F (190?C) for 35-40 minutes until the fibers are tender and separate easily when scraped with a fork | Cut chicken into 1/2-inch cubes and mix in a bowl with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and cornstarch to marinate for 10 minutes | In a small bowl, mix together the remaining 2 tablespoons soy sauce, dry sherry, sugar, and rice vinegar ? set aside | Heat oil in a wok over high heat (375?F if using a thermometer) | When hot, add red pepper flakes and stir until they turn dark, about 30 seconds | Add the marinated chicken and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until almost cooked through | Remove chicken with a strainer and set aside | Add green onions, sliced leek, and grated gingerroot to the wok ? stir-fry for about 1 minute | Return the chicken to the wok and stir-fry for another couple of minutes | Add the sherry-soy sauce mixture ? bring to a low boil for about a minute | Remove from heat and serve immediately over steamed rice or with the baked spaghetti squash strands

ingredients: 500g salmon fillets (cut into 20 squares, about 2 inches each), 20 round rice paper sheets, 20 fresh cilantro leaves, 4 cloves garlic, 1/4 cup cashews, 1 cup fresh cilantro, 1/4 cup fresh basil, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 tbsp olive oil, vegetable oil for frying
instructions: Make the pesto: put garlic, cashews, cilantro, basil, salt, and olive oil in a food processor ? process until a smooth paste forms | Cut salmon into 20 even squares, about 2 inches each | Fill a shallow bowl with warm water | Dip each rice paper wrapper into the warm water briefly to soften | Place a cilantro leaf in the center of each wrapper | Sandwich a piece of salmon with a small dollop of pesto | Place the salmon on top of the cilantro leaf | Fold the sides of the wrapper over to form a neat square packet, sealing the edges | Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat | Cook the packets in batches, sealed side down, for several minutes until golden brown on the bottom | Carefully flip and cook the other side until golden | Remove packets and place in a steamer ? steam for 4 to 6 minutes until the salmon is cooked through | May be assembled ahead of time and steamed just before serving

ingredients: 1/2 cup boiling water, 1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes (chopped), 2 tbsp butter, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1 cup Arborio rice, 3 cups chicken broth, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 can (100g) diced green chilies, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated)
instructions: Combine boiling water and sun-dried tomatoes in a small bowl ? cover and let stand for 10 minutes, then drain and set aside | Combine butter and olive oil in an 8-inch square microwave-safe baking dish ? microwave at HIGH for 2 minutes until melted | Stir in diced onion ? microwave at HIGH for 3 minutes until softened | Stir in Arborio rice ? microwave at HIGH for 2 minutes, stirring once | Stir in chicken broth, salt, and pepper ? microwave at HIGH for 9 minutes, stirring once halfway through | Stir in the reserved sun-dried tomatoes and diced green chilies ? microwave at HIGH for 8 minutes until rice is tender and creamy | Remove from microwave and stir in grated Parmesan cheese | Let stand for 2 minutes before serving

ingredients: 4 cups water (divided), 2 tbsp loose black tea leaves or 4 tea bags, 2 tbsp granulated sugar (divided), 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 6 fresh mint leaves (plus extra for garnish), 1 tbsp honey, ice cubes, lemon slices for garnish
instructions: Bring 2 cups of water to a boil in a small saucepan | Remove from heat and add tea leaves (or tea bags) and 2 teaspoons of the sugar | Cover and set aside to steep for 5 minutes | Strain the tea through a fine mesh sieve, discarding the tea leaves or bags | Add some cold water to the brew if needed to make about 3 cups | Add fresh lemon juice, mint leaves, honey, and the remaining sugar to taste | Stir until the sugar dissolves completely | Serve chilled in tall glasses over ice cubes | Garnish with lemon slices and a few fresh mint leaves

ingredients: For filling: 2 tbsp butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 carrots (diced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 2 cups cooked chicken (shredded), 1 cup frozen peas, 1/3 cup all-purpose flour, 2 cups chicken broth, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 1 tsp dried thyme, salt and pepper. For topping: 1 sheet puff pastry or double pie crust, 1 egg (beaten for egg wash)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat | Saut? diced onion, carrots, and celery for 6-8 minutes until softened | Sprinkle flour over the vegetables and stir for 1 minute | Gradually pour in chicken broth while stirring constantly | Add heavy cream and thyme, cooking until the sauce thickens, about 5 minutes | Stir in shredded chicken and frozen peas | Season with salt and pepper | Pour the filling into a 9-inch pie dish or casserole | Top with puff pastry or pie crust, crimping the edges and cutting several slits in the top to vent | Brush with beaten egg for a golden finish | Bake for 30-35 minutes until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbling | Let cool for 10 minutes before serving

ingredients: 12 large white mushrooms (stems removed, 4 stems reserved), 4 oz low-fat cream cheese (softened), 1/4 medium onion (finely diced), 3 slices bacon, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Remove stems from all mushrooms ? reserve 4 of the stems and finely chop them | Clean mushroom caps and set aside | Finely chop the onion and the 4 reserved mushroom stems | Cook bacon in a skillet until crisp, then remove and drain on paper towels, reserving the bacon grease | Cook the chopped onion and mushroom stems in the bacon grease until tender, about 4-5 minutes | Crumble the crisp bacon into the softened cream cheese | Stir in the saut?ed onion and stems until well combined | Season with salt and pepper | Scoop some of the mixture into each mushroom cap, mounding slightly | Place stuffed mushrooms on a baking sheet | Bake for about 10-15 minutes until mushrooms are tender | Switch to broil for the final 1-2 minutes to brown the tops | Serve warm

ingredients: 500g cleaned honeycomb tripe (cut into strips), 2 tbsp sunflower oil, 2 medium onions (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 2 carrots (diced), 1 celery root (diced), 1 bell pepper (diced), 100g bacon or pancetta (diced), 1 tbsp sweet red paprika, 2 tbsp tomato puree, 1 bay leaf, 2 cups beef broth, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), salt and pepper to taste, crusty bread for serving
instructions: In a large saucepan, heat sunflower oil over medium heat | Add diced onion, minced garlic, diced celery root, diced carrots, diced bell pepper, and diced bacon ? saut? for about 3 minutes until softened | Add the tripe strips, sweet red paprika, tomato puree, and bay leaf ? stir well to combine | Add beef broth, cover the pan, and bring to a boil | Lower the heat and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes until the tripe is tender | Remove the bay leaf and season with salt and pepper to taste | Serve hot in bowls sprinkled generously with grated Parmesan cheese | Serve with crusty bread on the side for dipping

ingredients: For steak: 500g flank steak, 3 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sugar. For dressing: 1/4 cup fresh lime juice, 2 tbsp water, 1 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes, 2 shallots (thinly sliced). For salad: 200g thin rice noodles, 2 Granny Smith apples (cut into matchsticks), 4 cups Asian salad greens, 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves, 1/4 cup roasted peanuts (chopped)
instructions: Marinate the steak: whisk together fish sauce, grated ginger, minced garlic, soy sauce, and sugar until sugar dissolves | Pour marinade into a large sealable plastic bag | Pat steak dry and place in the bag, then press out excess air and seal | Turn bag to coat meat, then refrigerate at least 4 hours and up to 8 hours | Bring steak to room temperature 30 minutes before grilling | Prepare a grill for medium-hot charcoal or moderate heat for gas | Remove steak from marinade, discarding the marinade, and pat dry with paper towels | Grill over direct heat, turning once, until medium-rare, about 12 to 14 minutes total | Transfer steak to a cutting board and let rest uncovered for about 15 minutes | Make the dressing: whisk together lime juice, water, sugar, fish sauce, and red pepper flakes until sugar dissolves, then stir in sliced shallots | Cook rice noodles in boiling salted water until just tender, 4 to 5 minutes ? drain, rinse under cold water, and drain well | Toss noodles with 1/2 cup of the dressing | Cut apple into thin matchsticks | Combine apples, Asian greens, and mint in a large bowl ? add 1/2 cup dressing and toss well | Thinly slice steak across the grain | Arrange noodles on a large platter, mound the greens on top, and arrange steak slices on the greens | Sprinkle with chopped peanuts | Serve at room temperature with remaining dressing on the side

ingredients: 6 large eggs, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 4 plum tomatoes (diced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, salt and black pepper to taste, fresh parsley for garnish
instructions: Hard-cook the eggs: place eggs in a saucepan and cover with cold water | Bring to a boil and cook for 10 minutes | Drain and rinse under cold water to make them easier to peel | Peel eggs and cut in half lengthwise | Remove yolks and place them in a small bowl | Combine yolks with melted butter and season with salt | Fill the egg white halves with the yolk mixture and place them in a baking dish | Place eggs in a 350?F (175?C) oven for 8 minutes until warmed through | Meanwhile, make the sauce: in a saucepan over medium heat, cook diced tomatoes and diced onion until the onion is tender and a rich tomato sauce forms, about 10-12 minutes | Season with salt, pepper, and a splash of red wine vinegar | Pour the tomato sauce over the warm eggs | Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately

ingredients: 1/4 cup water, 1/4 cup bourbon, 1/4 cup soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tsp dry mustard, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 4 sirloin steaks (about 200g each, 1-inch thick)
instructions: Prepare the marinade: pour water, bourbon, soy sauce, honey, dry mustard, and garlic powder into a large zip-top bag | Seal the bag and lay it flat on the counter | Massage the bag with your fingers to dissolve the mustard and garlic powder and mix all ingredients well | Add steaks to the bag and seal | Refrigerate overnight or for at least 6 hours, turning the bag occasionally | About an hour before grilling, remove the bag from the refrigerator and place it on the counter ? turn after 30 minutes | Remove steaks from the bag and discard the marinade | Preheat grill to medium-high heat | For 1-inch steaks, grill about 10 minutes per side or until internal temperature reaches 140-145?F (60-63?C) for medium | Remove from grill and cover steaks loosely with foil for about 10 minutes before serving | Serve as whole steaks or slice thinly across the grain before serving

ingredients: 500g ground beef, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 1 celery stalk (diced), 2 cans (400g each) chopped tomatoes, 1 can (400g) tomato sauce, 1 tsp celery salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 cup water, 400g spaghetti noodles, 2 tbsp butter or oil for saut?ing
instructions: Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks ? drain excess fat | In the same pan, saut? diced onions, bell pepper, and celery in butter or oil until softened, about 5-6 minutes | Return meat to the pan and add chopped tomatoes, tomato sauce, celery salt, pepper, and sugar | Add water last to thin the sauce to your preferred consistency | Stir everything together well | From here, you can either heat through and serve immediately, or simmer for about 45 minutes on the stove to meld the flavors, or transfer to a crockpot and simmer on low from morning until dinner time | While sauce simmers, cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain | Serve the sauce over the hot spaghetti

ingredients: 4 slices thick bread, 4 large eggs, 2 tbsp butter, 1/4 cup cheddar cheese (shredded, optional), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat a large square skillet or griddle over medium heat | Using a cookie cutter or a small glass, cut out the center of each slice of bread ? reserve the cutouts | Melt butter on the skillet and place the bread slices on the hot surface | Crack one egg directly into the cutout of each bread slice ? the egg will cook and attach to the toast | Cook for 1-2 minutes until the bottom is golden and the egg is set on the bottom | Carefully flip with a spatula and cook the other side for 1-2 minutes more, depending on how you like your eggs | If desired, top with a little shredded cheese after flipping | Toast the reserved bread cutouts in the pan alongside the eggs | Season with salt and pepper and serve immediately

ingredients: 1 large butternut squash (halved, seeds removed), 3 tbsp butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 tbsp dried shallots, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 medium russet potatoes (peeled and diced), 4 cups low-sodium chicken broth, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp ground allspice, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1/4 cup white wine, 1/2 cup water, salt to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Pour a thin layer of water into the bottom of a cookie sheet with sides or jelly roll pan | Place the squash halves cut-side down on the pan | Bake for 40 minutes until the squash is tender | Remove from oven, let cool slightly, then scoop out the flesh and cut into large pieces ? set aside | Melt butter in a large stock pot over medium heat | Add diced onion, dried shallots, and minced garlic ? saut? for 5 minutes until tender | Pour in chicken broth and add diced potatoes | Increase heat and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-high and boil for 20 minutes until potatoes are tender | Add the cooked squash and stir until well mixed | Using a handheld immersion blender, pur?e the soup until completely smooth ? or cool slightly and blend in batches in a food processor | Season the soup with cayenne pepper, allspice, nutmeg, ginger, and black pepper | Add apple cider vinegar, white wine, and water ? stir well | Taste and adjust seasoning with salt as needed | Ladle into bowls and serve hot

ingredients: For dough: 2 cups whole milk, 1/2 cup vegetable oil, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 9 cups all-purpose flour (divided), 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1 tsp salt. For filling: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted), 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp ground cinnamon. For glaze: 2 cups powdered sugar, 1 tsp maple extract, 1/2 cup whole milk, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted), 2 tbsp brewed coffee, pinch of salt
instructions: In a large soup pot, mix milk, vegetable oil, and sugar | Scald the mixture by heating until just before the boiling point ? turn off heat and let cool for 45 minutes to 1 hour | When the mixture is lukewarm to warm but NOT hot, sprinkle in the yeast | Let sit for a minute so the yeast gets warm and activated | Add 8 cups of all-purpose flour and stir together | Cover and let sit for at least an hour until the dough has risen | Add 1 more cup of flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt ? stir together | At this point the dough can be refrigerated overnight or used immediately | Sprinkle a work surface generously with flour | Take half the dough and form a rough rectangle, then roll thin while maintaining a rectangular shape | Drizzle melted butter generously over the dough | Sprinkle sugar over the butter, followed by a generous sprinkling of cinnamon | Starting at the opposite end, begin rolling the dough in a neat line toward you, keeping the roll relatively tight | Pinch the seam to seal | Spread 1 tablespoon melted butter in each of 7 round foil cake or pie pans | Cut rolls approximately 3/4 to 1 inch thick and place in the buttered pans | Repeat with remaining dough ? recipe makes approximately 7 pans (about 56 rolls) | Let rolls sit for 20 to 30 minutes to rise | Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) and bake for 15 to 18 minutes until light golden brown | Meanwhile, make the glaze: combine powdered sugar, maple extract, milk, melted butter, brewed coffee, and a pinch of salt ? stir until thick but pourable | Generously drizzle the glaze over warm rolls as soon as they come out of the oven | Serve warm

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 1/2 cups white sugar (divided), 1 cup all-purpose flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 3/4 cup whole milk, 1 can (825g) sliced peaches in juice (juice reserved), 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 2 tbsp brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) and butter an 8x8-inch baking dish | Cream softened butter with 1/2 cup of the white sugar until light and fluffy | In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking powder, and salt | Add the dry mixture to the creamed mixture alternately with the milk, mixing well until a smooth batter forms | Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and spread evenly | Top with peach slices, arranging them evenly over the batter | Pour all of the reserved peach juice evenly over the peaches | Sprinkle the remaining 1 cup white sugar, brown sugar, and cinnamon over the top | Bake for 45 minutes until the top is golden brown and the cobbler is bubbly | Let cool for 10 minutes before serving | Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream

ingredients: For cake: 3 ripe Bosc pears (peeled, halved, and cored), 3/4 cup unsalted butter (divided), 1/2 cup brown sugar, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 2/3 cup whole milk. For orange butter sauce: 1/2 cup orange juice, 1 tbsp cornstarch, 1/4 cup sugar, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/4 tsp ground ginger
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Peel, halve, and core the pears ? set aside | Place 1/4 cup of the butter into a 10 x 6-inch baking pan and put it in the oven as it preheats until the butter is melted | Remove from oven and sprinkle brown sugar evenly over the melted butter | Arrange the pear halves cut-side down in a single layer over the brown sugar | In a large bowl, cream the remaining 1/2 cup butter with the granulated sugar, egg, and vanilla until light and fluffy | Mix in the baking powder and salt | Add the flour alternately with the milk, mixing until the batter is smooth | Pour the batter evenly over the pears | Bake for 45 minutes or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean | While the cake bakes, make the orange butter sauce: combine orange juice, cornstarch, sugar, butter, and ginger in a small saucepan | Heat to boiling over medium-high heat, stirring constantly | Cook, stirring, until thickened ? remove from heat | When cake is done, invert while still warm onto a serving plate | Serve warm with the orange butter sauce drizzled over the top

ingredients: 30g dried mushrooms (porcini or mixed), 1 cup boiling water, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp butter, 1 large onion (diced), 500g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 4 cups chicken or vegetable stock, 1 tbsp dried parsley, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar (for drizzling)
instructions: In a medium bowl, cover the dried mushrooms with the boiling water and let soak for 30 minutes | In a large pot, heat olive oil over medium heat | Saut? diced onion for 5 minutes until softened but not browned | Add butter and fresh sliced mushrooms ? saut? for about 8 minutes until mushrooms release their liquid and begin to brown | Add the soaked dried mushrooms along with their soaking liquid (strain if sandy), chicken stock, and dried parsley | Bring the soup to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered for about 1 hour, allowing flavors to concentrate | Taste after 1 hour ? if the soup needs more depth, cook a bit longer to reduce further | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Pur?e the soup using an immersion blender, or cool slightly and blend in batches in a food processor or regular blender until smooth | Return to the pot and reheat if necessary | Ladle into individual bowls and drizzle each serving with a small amount of balsamic vinegar | Serve hot

ingredients: For stuffing: 1 whole pheasant (cleaned), 1 medium onion (diced), 2 tbsp butter, 1 carrot (diced), 1 celery stalk (diced), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), salt and pepper. For dough: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 2/3 cup shortening, 1/3 cup cold water. For serving: giblet gravy
instructions: Rinse the inside and outside of the pheasant several times with warm water and drain well | Salt the inside cavity | Cook giblets separately if desired for gravy | Make the stuffing: saut? diced onion in heated butter until softened, about 4-5 minutes | Add diced carrot, celery, and parsley ? toss to mix well | Fill the cavity of the pheasant with the stuffing and truss (tie legs together with kitchen twine) | Make the dough blanket: sift together flour and salt | Cut in shortening with a pastry blender or two knives until the mixture resembles rice grains | Add cold water gradually, stirring to make a dough soft enough to roll | Roll out on a lightly floured surface into a rectangle about 1/8 to 1/4 inch thick, about 15 by 10 inches in size | Wrap the dough around the stuffed pheasant, completely covering it | Moisten the edges of the dough with water and pinch together to seal | Place the dough-wrapped pheasant breast-side up on a trivet in a shallow roasting pan | Roast uncovered in a 350?F (175?C) oven for 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 hours until fully cooked | Remove from oven and let rest for 10 minutes | Break away the crusty golden brown dough blanket in pieces | Serve the pheasant with the stuffing, pieces of crust, and giblet gravy on the side

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup whole wheat flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp sea salt, 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped, divided), 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 3/4 cup brown sugar, 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup sourdough starter discard, 1/4 cup honey, 3 ripe bananas (mashed), 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tbsp lemon zest
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (176?C) and grease a 9 x 5-inch baking pan | In a large mixing bowl, combine all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, baking soda, and salt | In a small bowl, mix a handful of chopped walnuts with a few pinches of sugar ? set aside for topping | In another bowl or stand mixer, cream softened butter and brown sugar until fluffy | Add eggs one at a time, scraping down the sides of the bowl occasionally | Add sourdough starter discard, honey, mashed bananas, olive oil, and vanilla ? mix well | Slowly add the flour mixture, pausing to scrape down the sides if necessary | By hand, fold in the remaining walnuts (except the topping) and lemon zest | Pour batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top with a spatula | Sprinkle the reserved sugared walnuts over the top | Bake for 55-65 minutes until the internal temperature in the center reaches 200-205?F (93-96?C) | Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then gently remove onto a wire rack to cool completely

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce, 1/4 cup canola oil, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 cup raisins, 1 large egg, 1/4 cup milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a muffin tin | Mix all ingredients together in the order listed, stirring just until combined ? do not overbeat | Spoon batter into the greased muffin tins, filling each cup about 2/3 full | Bake for 19 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean | Let cool in the pan for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack | Serve warm or at room temperature

ingredients: 750ml bottle ros? wine, 1 cup fresh strawberries (hulled and sliced), 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 60ml lemon-flavored vodka, 1 tbsp grenadine, fresh strawberries and lemon slices for garnish
instructions: Pour the ros? wine into ice cube trays and freeze until solid, at least 8 hours or overnight | Combine fresh strawberries and sugar in a blender ? let sit at room temperature for about 10 minutes until the berries begin to release their juices | Add lemon vodka, grenadine, and the frozen ros? cubes to the blender | Blend on high until completely smooth and slushy | Pour into glasses and garnish with fresh strawberry slices and lemon slices | Serve immediately

ingredients: For batter: 2 large eggs, 3/4 cup whole milk, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt. For filling: 2 chicken breasts (diced), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 1/2 cups chicken stock
instructions: Blend the eggs, milk, and olive oil together, then add the flour, baking powder, and salt while continuing to blend ? refrigerate the batter for at least 30 minutes | Preheat oven to 200?C (400?F) | Toss diced chicken with 2 tablespoons flour until lightly coated | Heat olive oil in a skillet and stir-fry the chicken and diced onion until cooked through and browned | Place the cooked chicken and onion in a casserole dish and add just enough chicken stock to almost cover | Pour the chilled batter evenly over the chicken mixture | Bake for 30-40 minutes until the top is puffed and golden brown | Serve hot

ingredients: 300g soft silken tofu, 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp confectioners sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Combine softened tofu, honey, confectioners sugar, and vanilla extract in a blender | Blend on high until completely smooth and creamy | Transfer to a bowl, cover, and chill for several hours or overnight to allow flavors to blend | Serve as a dairy-free topping for fruit, desserts, or pancakes

ingredients: 1 can (400g) fire-roasted diced tomatoes, 1 can (400g) crushed tomatoes, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp chili powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 cans (400g each) black beans (drained and rinsed), 1 medium red onion (diced), 1 red bell pepper (diced), 2 cups butternut squash (peeled and cubed), fresh cilantro and sour cream for serving
instructions: Pour both types of tomatoes into a slow cooker | Add minced garlic, chili powder, cumin, and salt ? mix well | Add drained black beans, diced red onion, diced bell pepper, and cubed butternut squash ? gently stir to combine | Cover and cook on high for 3-4 hours or on low for 7-8 hours until the vegetables have softened | Serve hot topped with fresh cilantro or a dollop of light sour cream

recipe_name: Duck Magret with Blueberry Port Sauce
ingredients: For duck: 2 duck breasts (magret, skin scored), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp fresh thyme leaves, 1 tsp orange zest. For blueberry sauce: 1 cup port wine, 200g fresh blueberries (divided), 2 tbsp red currant jelly, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water. For spinach: 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 red onion (diced), 1 clove garlic (minced), 1 tbsp butter, 200g fresh spinach. For rosti: 1 tbsp butter, 1/2 onion (diced), 1 clove garlic (minced), 2 large potatoes (grated and squeezed dry)
instructions: Place duck breasts in a container with minced garlic, orange zest, and thyme leaves | Cover and refrigerate to infuse for a few hours | Cook duck breasts skin-side down in a cold pan over medium-high heat to render the fat and crisp the skin ? this will take 8-10 minutes, draining fat periodically | Transfer duck to an ovenproof dish on a wire rack and cook in a 180?C (350?F) oven for 20-25 minutes for medium-rare | For extra crispy skin, switch to grill setting for the last few minutes | Make the sauce: heat port, half the blueberries, and red currant jelly in a pan over medium-high heat | Simmer for 8-10 minutes until reduced to a thin sauce consistency | Add cornstarch slurry to thicken slightly, then whisk in Dijon mustard | Remove from heat and stir in the remaining blueberries | For spinach: heat olive oil in a pan, add onion and garlic, cook until softened | Melt butter, add spinach, and cook until wilted | For rosti: heat butter, cook onion and garlic until soft | Squeeze excess liquid from grated potatoes, add to pan, and cook until sticky | Press into egg rings and cook until browned and crisp on both sides | To serve: spoon sauce on a plate, place sliced duck breast on top, with spinach and rosti on the side

ingredients: 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup shortening, 1/2 cup sour cream, 2 large eggs, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp cream of tartar, 3 cups all-purpose flour (approximately)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | In a large mixing bowl, cream together sugar, shortening, sour cream, and eggs until smooth | Stir in baking soda, nutmeg, vanilla, salt, and cream of tartar ? do not add the flour yet | Chill the mixture for 1 to 24 hours | Gradually add flour to the chilled mixture until the dough is stiff enough to roll for cut-out cookies | On a generously floured work surface, roll out the dough a little at a time with a floured rolling pin until about 1/2-inch thick | Use flour-dipped cookie cutters to cut into desired shapes | Place cut-outs onto a lightly greased cookie sheet, spacing cookies about 2 inches apart | Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the tops are no longer shiny and the bottoms are lightly browned | Cool on a wire rack | Decorate with icing of your choice and store in an airtight container

ingredients: 4 large bell peppers (tops cut off and seeded), 1 cup cooked rice, 500g lean ground beef, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1/2 cup water, 1 tsp dried basil, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 cup shredded cheese, salt to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 450?F (230?C) | In a saucepan, saut? diced onion and rice for about 5 minutes until lightly browned | Add water, cover, and cook for about 10 minutes | In a large pan, fry ground beef with 1 tablespoon of the seasonings (garlic, chili powder, oregano, basil, paprika, pepper) until almost cooked through | Add diced tomatoes and the cooked rice mixture to the beef | Add the remaining seasonings (except garlic powder) and cook for 5 minutes | Gut the peppers and dust the insides lightly with garlic powder | Layer the rice and meat mixture with shredded cheese while stuffing each bell pepper | Place the tops back on the peppers and stand them upright on a baking sheet | Bake for 45 minutes or longer depending on how tender you want the peppers | Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1 ripe avocado (mashed), 2 tbsp low-fat mayonnaise, 1 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1 chipotle chili in adobo sauce (minced, plus 1 tsp sauce), 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp ground cumin, 1/4 tsp dried oregano, 4 large flour tortillas, 200g sliced deli ham or cooked pork, 1 cup shredded iceberg lettuce, 1/4 cup salsa
instructions: Combine mashed avocado, mayonnaise, lime juice, minced chipotle chili with adobo sauce, salt, cumin, and oregano in a bowl ? stir well | Warm tortillas according to package directions until pliable | Spread about 2 tablespoons of the avocado mixture over each tortilla, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges | Arrange sliced ham or pork down the center of each tortilla | Top each with 1/4 cup shredded lettuce and 1 tablespoon salsa | Fold in the sides and roll up tightly | Serve immediately or wrap in foil for a portable meal

ingredients: 3 large eggs, 2 tsp water, 1 tbsp butter, 2 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh dill (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1 small tomato (sliced), 60g Brie cheese (sliced), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Beat eggs, 2 teaspoons water, salt, and pepper in a bowl until frothy and light | Heat butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat until foaming | Pour beaten eggs into the pan and let cook undisturbed until the edges begin to set | Using a spatula, gently lift the edges and tilt the pan so uncooked egg flows underneath | When the surface is nearly set, lay out fresh herbs, tomato slices, and Brie cheese in that order over one half of the omelette | Fold the empty half over the filling | Add 1 teaspoon of water to the pan and cover ? the steam will help melt the cheese | Cook covered for 1 more minute until the cheese is melted and the omelette is just done | Slide onto a plate and serve immediately

ingredients: For rub: 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp ground allspice, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp dried thyme, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg. For pork: 2 kg pork shoulder roast, 1/4 cup dark rum, 2 tbsp canola oil. For mop: 1 cup water, 2 tbsp cider vinegar, 1 tbsp dark rum. For sauce: 1 ripe mango (diced), 1/2 onion (diced), 1/4 cup mango chutney, 1/2 cup chicken stock, 3 tbsp dark rum, 1/4 cup cream of coconut, 2 tbsp butter, salt to taste
instructions: The night before cooking, combine all rub ingredients in a small bowl | Massage the pork roast well with the dark rum, then coat generously with about half of the rub | Transfer pork to a plastic bag and refrigerate overnight | Prepare a smoker for barbecuing, bringing the temperature to 200-220?F (93-104?C) | Remove pork from refrigerator and pat down lightly with another coating of rub | Let the meat sit at room temperature for 30-40 minutes | If basting, stir any remaining rub with the mop ingredients in a saucepan and warm over low heat | Transfer pork to the smoker, fattier side up, and cook for 4-3/4 to 5 hours until internal temperature reaches 160?F (71?C) | Mop the meat every 40-45 minutes | While the roast cooks, make the sauce: pur?e mango, onion, and chutney in a food processor with a bit of stock if needed | Spoon into a heavy saucepan and add remaining stock, rum, cream of coconut, and any remaining dry rub | Warm over medium heat and simmer for about 20 minutes, then season with salt to balance | Add butter just before serving | Remove pork from smoker and let rest at room temperature for 10-15 minutes | Carve the roast and serve with the warm sauce

ingredients: 1 cup dark raisins, 1 cup golden raisins, 1/2 cup dried currants, 1/2 cup pitted dates (chopped), 1/4 cup dried peaches (chopped), 1/4 cup dried apricots (chopped), 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/2 tsp ground allspice, 1/4 tsp ground ginger, 1/2 cup dark corn syrup, 1/4 cup dark rum, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup apple cider syrup or apple juice concentrate, 1/4 cup apple juice, 3 tbsp unsalted butter
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine both raisins, currants, chopped dates, chopped peaches, and chopped apricots ? set aside | In a large nonreactive saucepan, combine cinnamon, nutmeg, allspice, and ginger | Stir in dark corn syrup, dark rum, brown sugar, apple cider syrup, and apple juice | Add butter and bring to a boil over medium heat ? boil for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally | Pour the hot liquid over the dried fruit mixture and stir well to combine | Cool to room temperature, stirring occasionally | When completely cooled, pour or spoon equal amounts into 3 clean quart glass jars | Seal tightly and refrigerate for up to 12 months | Use as a filling for mince pies, tarts, or as a festive topping

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 carrots (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 cup dried lentils (rinsed), 1 can (400g) tomato sauce, 1 tbsp dried parsley, 1 tsp dried thyme, salt and black pepper to taste, 4 large potatoes (peeled and cubed), 1/4 cup rice milk or plant-based milk, 2 tbsp vegan butter, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), 1 prepared vegan pie crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Prepare a pie plate with the pie crust | Put cubed potatoes in a large pot and cover with water ? bring to a boil and cook until tender | While potatoes are cooking, heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat | Cook diced onion, carrots, and minced garlic together for 5-10 minutes until soft | Add rinsed lentils, tomato sauce, parsley, thyme, salt, and pepper ? turn heat to low, cover, and let simmer for 10 minutes until lentils are tender | When potatoes are tender, drain and mash them, adding rice milk, vegan butter, garlic powder, chives, salt, and pepper until smooth and creamy | Fill the prepared pie crust with the lentil mixture and top evenly with the mashed potatoes | Bake for 30 minutes or until the pie crust is cooked and the top is lightly golden | Let cool for 5 minutes before serving

ingredients: 500g ground beef, 150g frozen chopped spinach (thawed and squeezed dry), 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 4 hamburger buns, lettuce, tomato, and condiments for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, well-drained spinach, mozzarella cheese, cheddar cheese, salt, pepper, and garlic powder ? mix until evenly combined | Shape the mixture into 8 patties | Grill or broil the patties over medium-high heat for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through and cheese is melted | Serve on toasted hamburger buns with your favorite toppings like lettuce, tomato, and condiments

ingredients: 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 1 1/2 cups warm water (110?F / 43?C), 2 cups cake flour, 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour (plus extra for dusting), 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp olive oil (plus extra for bowl)
instructions: Sprinkle yeast over warm water in a bowl ? let stand for 1 minute until the yeast is creamy, then stir until dissolved | In a large bowl, combine cake flour, 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, and salt | Add the yeast mixture to the flour and stir until a soft dough forms | Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead, adding more flour if necessary, until smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes | Lightly coat a large bowl with olive oil ? place the dough in the bowl, turning it to oil the top | Cover with plastic wrap and place in a warm, draft-free place to rise until doubled in size, about 1 1/2 hours | Flatten the dough with your fist | Cut the dough into 2 to 4 pieces and shape into balls ? dust the tops with flour | Place balls on a floured surface and cover each with plastic wrap, allowing room for expansion ? let rise for 60-90 minutes or until doubled | Shape and bake pizzas as directed at 475?F (245?C) for 10-12 minutes

ingredients: 500g boneless skinless chicken breasts (cut into 1-inch strips), 1 1/2 cups sweetened shredded coconut, 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 large eggs (beaten), 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), apricot preserves for dipping
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Combine shredded coconut, flour, salt, and pepper in a heavy-duty resealable plastic bag ? shake to mix | Cut chicken breasts into 1-inch wide strips | Dip each chicken strip into the beaten egg, letting excess drip off | Place egg-coated strips in the plastic bag with the coconut mixture and shake until the chicken is well coated | Place coated chicken strips in a shallow nonstick baking pan in a single layer | Drizzle melted butter evenly over the chicken | Bake for 25 minutes, turning once halfway through, until chicken is cooked through and golden brown | Serve immediately with apricot preserves as a dipping sauce

ingredients: 1 large egg, 1/4 cup milk, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, 500g ground beef or ground pork, For glaze: 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup ketchup, 1 tbsp white vinegar, 1 tsp prepared mustard
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) | In a medium bowl, beat the egg, then add milk, Worcestershire sauce, onion powder, pepper, and breadcrumbs ? mix well | Add ground beef or pork and mix thoroughly until well combined | Shape the mixture into two 5-inch x 2 1/2-inch individual loaves | Place loaves in a small baking pan | In a separate small bowl, combine brown sugar, ketchup, vinegar, and mustard to make the glaze | Pour the glaze evenly over the loaves | Bake uncovered at 325?F for 1 hour or until no longer pink in the center and internal temperature reaches 160?F (71?C) | Let rest for 5 minutes before serving

ingredients: 2 tbsp butter, 1 medium onion (sliced), 1 red bell pepper (sliced), 1 yellow bell pepper (sliced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts (cut into strips), 1 tsp dried tarragon leaves, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp fresh coarse ground black pepper, 1 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/2 cup half-and-half cream, 300g vermicelli or angel hair pasta
instructions: Melt butter in a 12-inch skillet until sizzling | Stir in sliced onion, bell peppers, and minced garlic ? cook over medium-high heat until peppers are crisply tender, about 2 to 3 minutes | Remove vegetables from skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside, reserving the juices in the pan | Add chicken strips, tarragon, salt, and pepper to the juices in the pan | Continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until chicken is lightly browned and no longer pink, about 7 to 9 minutes | Meanwhile, cook vermicelli according to package directions until al dente ? drain | Return vegetables to the skillet with the chicken | Add mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese, and half-and-half | Reduce heat to medium and cook until cheese is melted, about 3 to 5 minutes | Add the hot cooked vermicelli and toss gently to coat everything evenly | Serve immediately

ingredients: 3 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1 tbsp sugar, 3 cloves garlic, 3-5 seedless Thai bird's eye chilies (fresh or dried)
instructions: Chop the chilies and garlic, then pound them together in a mortar and pestle until a rough paste forms | Add fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar to the mortar | Pound gently just to mix all the ingredients together | Taste and adjust the balance of salty, sour, sweet, and spicy as desired | Serve as a dipping sauce for grilled meats, seafood, or rice dishes

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 500g kielbasa sausage (sliced into rounds), 1 medium onion (sliced), 1 green bell pepper (sliced), 1 red bell pepper (sliced), 2 cups prepared couscous or long grain wild rice, Parmesan cheese for serving (optional), ketchup for serving (optional)
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat | Add sliced onions and bell peppers ? stir-fry until tender, about 5-6 minutes | Add sliced kielbasa and continue to stir-fry until everything is golden and heated thoroughly, about 10-15 minutes | While kielbasa cooks, prepare couscous or long grain wild rice according to package directions | Serve the kielbasa and pepper mixture over the prepared couscous or rice | Garlic or Parmesan couscous varieties go especially well with this dish | Serve with ketchup on the side if desired

ingredients: For topping: 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped), 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 cup granulated sugar. For cake: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1 cup sour cream, 1 large apple (peeled, cored, and thinly sliced). For serving: whipped cream or sweetened sour cream
