instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Make the topping: combine chopped walnuts, cinnamon, and 1/2 cup sugar ? set aside | Grease and flour a 9-inch angel food or tube pan ? set aside | Beat softened butter until fluffy, then add remaining 1 cup sugar, beating well | Add eggs one at a time, beating after each addition | Add vanilla extract | Sift together flour, baking powder, salt, and baking soda ? add to the batter alternately with the sour cream, mixing just until combined | Spread half the batter in the prepared pan | Place sliced apples evenly over the batter | Top with half of the walnut mixture | Pour the remaining batter over the walnuts and spread gently | Sprinkle the remaining cinnamon-walnut mixture evenly over the top | Bake for 40 minutes until a tester inserted comes out clean | Cool on a wire rack for 30 minutes | Loosen from the pan, then cool completely | Serve with whipped cream or sour cream sweetened with a touch of maple syrup

recipe_name: Asparagus and Brie Wrapped in Prosciutto
ingredients: 12 asparagus spears (woody ends trimmed), 6 slices prosciutto (halved lengthwise), 100g Brie cheese (cut into 12 thin slices), olive oil for drizzling, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 180?C (350?F) | Cut the woody ends off the asparagus spears | Lay prosciutto slices flat on a baking tray | Top each prosciutto slice with an asparagus spear and a slice of Brie cheese | Wrap the prosciutto around the asparagus and Brie, rolling it up snugly | Place the wrapped bundles seam-side down on the baking tray | Drizzle lightly with olive oil and season with a pinch of salt and pepper | Place in the oven until the cheese starts to melt and the prosciutto is crisp, about 8-10 minutes | Serve immediately as an appetizer or side dish

ingredients: 400g rotini pasta, 4 tbsp extra virgin olive oil (divided), 500g mussels (scrubbed and debearded), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 medium zucchini (diced), 1/4 tsp black pepper, 200g shrimp (peeled and deveined), 200g scallops, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, season generously with salt, and cook rotini 1 minute less than the required cooking time | Drain and toss with 1 tablespoon olive oil, then spread on a sheet tray to cool | In a small pot, steam the mussels until they open, about 5-6 minutes ? discard any that do not open | Remove mussels from shells, discard shells, and set aside | Meanwhile, in a skillet, saut? minced garlic in 1 tablespoon olive oil until lightly golden | Add diced zucchini and saut? for 4 minutes, then season with salt and pepper to taste | In a separate skillet, saut? shrimp and scallops in 1 tablespoon olive oil until lightly golden and cooked through, about 3-4 minutes ? season and set aside to cool | Once everything has cooled, combine all the seafood with the pasta and zucchini in a large bowl | Toss to combine and add the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil, fresh lemon juice, and chopped parsley | Serve at room temperature or chilled

ingredients: 2 medium potatoes (peeled and diced), 1 cup broccoli florets (chopped), 1/4 cup onion (diced), 1/4 cup water, 6 large eggs, 1/4 cup milk, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/2 tsp dried tarragon
instructions: In a 10-inch omelet pan or skillet, stir together diced potatoes, chopped broccoli, diced onion, and water | Cover and cook over medium heat until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes | Uncover and, if necessary, continue cooking until any remaining water is evaporated | Reduce heat to low | In a medium bowl, beat together eggs, milk, salt, and pepper until well blended | Pour the egg mixture over the cooked vegetables | Cover and cook until eggs are almost set, about 15 minutes | Remove from heat | Sprinkle shredded cheese and dried tarragon over the top | Cover and let stand until eggs are completely set and cheese is melted, about 3 to 5 minutes | Cut into wedges and serve directly from the pan

ingredients: 2 cans (400g each) black beans (drained and rinsed), 1 can (200g) diced green chilies, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 cup water
instructions: Place all ingredients in a crock pot ? drained black beans, diced green chilies, cumin, garlic powder, salt, and water | Stir to combine | Cover and cook on low for 2 hours until heated through and flavors have melded | Serve as a side dish or on top of Cafe Rio-style pork

ingredients: 1 can (400g) sweetened condensed milk, 1 1/4 cups cold water, 2 packages instant vanilla pudding mix, 2 cups whipped topping (thawed, plus extra for garnish), 1 prepared pound cake or sponge cake (cut into 1-inch cubes), 2 tbsp orange juice, 1 cup fresh strawberries (sliced), 1/2 cup fresh raspberries, 1/3 cup kiwi (sliced), chocolate curls or cocoa powder for garnish
instructions: Bake one cake according to package directions in two 9-inch round cake pans ? cool and cut one cake into 1-inch cubes (freeze the other cake for future use) | In a medium bowl, combine sweetened condensed milk and cold water ? stir well | Add both packages of instant vanilla pudding mix and beat until blended ? chill for 5 minutes | Fold the 2 cups of whipped topping into the pudding mixture until smooth | In a trifle bowl, layer the ingredients as follows: spread 2 cups of pudding mixture covering the bottom of the bowl, layer cake cubes covering the pudding, sprinkle with orange juice, top with sliced strawberries, raspberries, and sliced kiwi | Repeat the layers once more and finish with a final layer of pudding on top | Garnish with extra fruit, chocolate curls, or a dusting of cocoa powder | Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 tbsp taco seasoning, 1 can (400g) pinto beans (undrained), 1 can (400g) kidney beans (undrained), 1 can (400g) yellow hominy (undrained), 1 can (400g) stewed tomatoes, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes with green chilies, 1 packet dry ranch dressing mix, tortilla chips for serving, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded)
instructions: Brown ground beef and diced onion in a large pot over medium-high heat ? drain excess fat | Add taco seasoning and mix thoroughly | Add all canned ingredients without draining: pinto beans, kidney beans, hominy, stewed tomatoes, and diced tomatoes with green chilies | Stir in the dry ranch dressing mix | Simmer over low heat until bubbly and heated through, about 15-20 minutes | To serve, place a handful of tortilla chips in each bowl, ladle the soup over the top, and sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese

recipe_name: Swiss Chard with Tomato and Bacon
ingredients: 1 large bunch Swiss chard (washed and roughly chopped into 2-3 inch pieces), 3 slices bacon (chopped), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup chicken stock, 2 medium tomatoes (sliced), 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
instructions: Wash and rinse Swiss chard thoroughly | Roughly chop the chard into 2-3 inch pieces, keeping the stalks and leaves separate | In a large skillet, add olive oil and chopped bacon ? cook until the fat has rendered and the bacon is crisp | Add the chard stalks, diced onion, and minced garlic ? cover and cook until wilted, about 4-5 minutes | Add salt and red pepper flakes | Uncover and as the water steams off, add chicken stock, adding more as needed so the pan does not burn | Lower heat to medium-low and continue to simmer until chard stalks and onion are tender, about 5 minutes | Add chard leaves and sliced tomatoes ? cook for another 3-5 minutes until leaves are wilted | Dress with balsamic vinegar to taste and serve immediately

ingredients: 1 kg pumpkin (peeled, seeded, and cut into wedges), 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp sea salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 cup plain yogurt, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/4 cup pine nuts (toasted), 1 red chili (sliced, optional), fresh coriander leaves for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 200?C (400?F) | Place pumpkin wedges in a large bowl with olive oil and cinnamon ? season with salt and pepper and toss to combine | Transfer the pumpkin mixture to a baking tray in a single layer | Bake for approximately 30 to 40 minutes until golden and cooked through | Arrange the roasted pumpkin on a serving platter | Drizzle with yogurt and fresh lemon juice | Scatter toasted pine nuts, sliced chili, and fresh coriander leaves over the top | Best served at room temperature when all the flavors have melded together

ingredients: 4 large eggs, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp butter, 1 small onion (diced), 1 green pepper (diced), 1 medium tomato (diced), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped, plus extra for garnish)
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk eggs well until frothy | Add salt and whisk again | In a frying pan, heat butter over medium heat and saut? the diced onion, green pepper, and tomato until almost done, about 5-6 minutes | Pour the beaten eggs over the saut?ed vegetables | Add more salt if required | Cook without stirring until the eggs are set on the bottom, then gently lift the edges to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath | When nearly set, garnish with additional fresh parsley | Serve hot directly from the pan

ingredients: 1/3 cup canola oil, 3/4 cup dark brown sugar, 1/2 cup pumpkin pur?e, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup rolled oats. For ganache: 1/2 cup dark chocolate chips, 2 tbsp soy creamer or heavy cream
instructions: Begin heating your waffle iron according to the manufacturer's instructions | In a large bowl, whisk together canola oil, brown sugar, pumpkin pur?e, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and vanilla until smooth | Sift together flour, baking powder, and salt ? stir into the wet ingredients, but be careful not to overbeat the batter ? a few lumps are fine | Fold in rolled oats just enough to distribute them evenly | Lightly grease the waffle iron before cooking each batch | Portion out batter into each waffle indent as you would for standard waffles and spread it lightly to fill evenly | Close the iron and cook for 2 to 5 minutes, depending on your waffle iron, until golden brown all over | Transfer hot waffle cookies to a wire rack to cool ? repeat with remaining batter | Once completely cool, prepare the ganache: microwave chocolate chips and soy creamer in a microwave-safe bowl in 30-second bursts, stirring thoroughly until smooth | Use a spoon or piping bag to drizzle ganache over the cooled waffle cookies | Let the ganache set before serving

ingredients: 2 cups granulated sugar, 3 large eggs, 1 can (425g) pumpkin pur?e, 3 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp salt, 2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg, 1 cup vegetable oil, 1/2 cup water, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup pecans (chopped). For glaze: 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup water, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease three loaf pans | Beat sugar and eggs together until fluffy ? add pumpkin pur?e and mix well | In another bowl, combine flour, salt, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda, and nutmeg | Stir dry ingredients into the pumpkin mixture alternately with vegetable oil and water ? add vanilla and mix well | Beat for 3 minutes until smooth ? fold in chopped pecans | Divide the batter evenly among the 3 greased loaf pans | Bake for 1 hour until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean | While loaves bake, make the glaze: combine sugar, water, and vanilla in a small saucepan ? bring to a boil and boil for 3 minutes | Brush the hot glaze over the tops of the warm loaves as soon as they come out of the oven | Let cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely

ingredients: 1 whole fryer chicken (cut into pieces), 2 medium onions (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 2 medium tomatoes (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 bay leaf, 2 cups chicken broth, 1 cup long grain white rice, 1/2 tsp saffron threads, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 cup baby green peas, 1/4 cup white wine (plus extra for finishing), roasted red peppers and asparagus tips for garnish
instructions: In a large skillet, saut? chicken pieces in heated olive oil until the skin is golden on all sides ? remove chicken and place in a casserole dish | In the same oil in the skillet, saut? diced onion, green pepper, tomatoes, and garlic for 5 minutes ? pour over the chicken in the casserole dish | In the same skillet, add chicken broth, white wine, saffron, salt, bay leaf, and rice | When the mixture begins to boil, pour it over the casserole | Cover and bake in oven at 350?F (175?C) for 20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through | Sprinkle with a splash of white wine and garnish with peas, roasted red peppers, and asparagus tips | Serve hot directly from the casserole

ingredients: 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp ground coriander, 1 tsp sweet paprika, 1/2 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 8 lamb loin chops, 1 tsp salt, 1/4 cup olive oil (plus extra for drizzling), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 3 shallots (thinly sliced), 400g fresh spinach leaves
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together cumin, coriander, paprika, black pepper, and cayenne | Season the lamb chops with salt and drizzle with olive oil | Coat both sides of the chops generously with the spice mixture | In a very large skillet, heat the 1/4 cup olive oil until shimmering | Add the chops and cook over moderate heat until browned and medium-rare, about 7 minutes per side ? remove and let rest | Meanwhile, in a large deep skillet, melt the butter | Add sliced shallots and cook over moderate heat until softened and golden, about 5 minutes | Add handfuls of spinach to the skillet and cook over moderate heat, stirring and adding more spinach after each batch wilts | Season spinach with salt | Mound the spinach on plates and serve with the lamb chops on top

ingredients: For chicken: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 2 stalks lemongrass (white part only, chopped), 4 cloves garlic, 1 tbsp lime zest, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1/2 tsp fresh ground white pepper. For slaw: 3 scallions (sliced), 1 red bell pepper (julienned), 1 cup jicama (julienned), 1 cup snow peas (julienned), 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp chili sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds. For serving: 200g rice noodles, 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, fresh cilantro
instructions: Make the chicken marinade: pur?e cilantro, fish sauce, soy sauce, lemongrass, garlic, lime zest, lime juice, and white pepper in a blender to a coarse paste | Coat chicken breasts with the mixture and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, turning and recoating after 15 minutes | Make the slaw: place sliced scallions, julienned bell pepper, jicama, and snow peas in a large mixing bowl | In a small bowl, whisk together sugar, fish sauce, chili sauce, sesame oil, and toasted sesame seeds | Pour the sauce over the vegetables and mix thoroughly ? cover and refrigerate until ready to serve | Prepare a grill to medium-high heat | Boil water for rice noodles | Grill chicken (with the marinade paste still on) until cooked through ? remove from heat, cover, and let rest | Add rice noodles to the boiling water and turn off the heat ? let soak until tender, then drain and toss with a dash of olive oil to prevent sticking | To serve, plate the noodles and top with the slaw | Slice the chicken and place on top ? garnish with fresh cilantro

ingredients: 4 chicken thighs (bone-in, skin-on), 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp curry powder, 2 tbsp olive oil (divided), 1 red bell pepper (sliced), 1 cup fresh pineapple (diced), 1 serrano pepper (minced), 1 cup unsweetened coconut milk, 1 tbsp brown sugar, steamed rice for serving
instructions: Sprinkle chicken thighs with salt and curry powder, coating evenly | In a 12-inch skillet, quickly brown chicken on both sides in 1 tablespoon hot olive oil over high heat | Reduce heat to medium-high and cook for 12 minutes until tender and no longer pink ? remove and keep warm | For the sauce: in a second skillet, cook sliced bell pepper in 1 tablespoon hot olive oil over medium-high heat for 3 minutes ? set aside | Add diced pineapple to the same skillet and cook for 5 minutes until lightly browned | Add minced serrano pepper and cook for 1 minute | Stir in coconut milk and brown sugar ? heat through until the sauce is warm and slightly thickened | Serve the sauce with peppers and pineapple over the chicken with steamed rice on the side

ingredients: 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp olive oil, 6 cups water, 1 cup basmati rice, 1/4 cup fresh basil (chopped), 1 medium zucchini (diced), 200g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 2 cups cooked chicken (shredded), 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper
instructions: In a large pot, saut? diced onion and minced garlic in olive oil until tender, about 5 minutes | Add water, basmati rice, chopped basil, diced zucchini, sliced mushrooms, and shredded chicken | Season with salt and pepper | Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 40 minutes or until the rice is fully cooked and the vegetables are tender | Taste and adjust seasoning | Serve hot in bowls

ingredients: 1 whole kutum fish or trout (cleaned and scaled, about 1 kg), 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped), 1 medium onion (diced), 2 tbsp butter, 1/4 cup sour cherries (dried, plumped in water), 1/4 cup sultana raisins (plumped in water), 1/2 tsp salt, aluminum foil for wrapping
instructions: Plump the raisins and dried cherries in warm water for 15 minutes, then drain | Clean and wash the fish thoroughly inside and out ? if kutum is not available, substitute trout or another freshwater white fish | Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Make the stuffing: in a bowl, combine diced onion, chopped walnuts, butter, drained cherries, and drained raisins ? mix well and add salt if needed | Stuff the fish cavity with the mixture, packing it evenly | Wrap the stuffed fish tightly in aluminum foil | Place on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily | Remove from foil and slice crosswise to serve

ingredients: 250g Philadelphia cream cheese (softened), 1 can (400g) sweetened condensed milk, 1 tsp lemon zest, 2 cups fresh strawberries (hulled and blended until smooth), 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Mix cream cheese, sweetened condensed milk, and lemon zest with an electric mixer until well blended and smooth | Pour into a freezer-safe container and freeze for 4 hours or until almost solid | Remove from freezer and beat the cream cheese mixture with a mixer until creamy | Blend fresh strawberries in a blender until smooth | Add the strawberry pur?e and graham cracker crumbs to the cream cheese mixture ? mix well | Return to the freezer and freeze for 8 hours or until firm | Remove from freezer 15 minutes before serving ? let stand at room temperature to soften slightly before scooping

ingredients: 2 salmon fillets (about 150g each), 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp dried dill, 1 tbsp olive oil, salt and black pepper to taste, fresh spinach or stir-fried vegetables for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 180?C (350?F) | Rub 2 sheets of aluminum foil with olive oil (about 1/2 tablespoon per sheet) | Slice each salmon fillet in half and place one piece on each sheet of foil | In a small bowl, mix lemon juice and dried dill together | Drizzle the lemon-dill mixture over the fillets | Season with salt and pepper | Wrap up the foil parcels tightly | Place on a baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes until the salmon flakes easily with a fork | Serve over fresh spinach leaves or with your favorite stir-fried vegetables

ingredients: 1 prepared sponge or pound cake (split into 2 layers), 1 package lemon pie filling, 2 cups heavy whipping cream, 2 tbsp powdered sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, lemon zest for garnish
instructions: Prepare the lemon pie filling according to package directions | Cover the surface directly with waxed paper to prevent a skin from forming and refrigerate until completely chilled | Spread half of the chilled lemon filling between the layers of the cake | Whip the heavy cream with powdered sugar and vanilla until stiff peaks form | Fold the remaining half of the lemon filling into the whipped cream until smooth | Spread the lemon cream mixture over the top and sides of the cake | Chill for at least 4 hours before serving | Garnish with lemon zest before slicing

ingredients: 2 cups cooked ham (diced), 6 cups water, 450g dried navy beans (rinsed), 3 celery stalks (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 2 carrots (diced), 1 tsp dried thyme, 1 tbsp liquid smoke, 1/4 cup fresh parsley (chopped), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the parsley in a crock pot ? diced ham, water, navy beans, celery, onion, carrots, dried thyme, and liquid smoke | Mix well, cover, and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours until the beans are tender and the stew is thick | Just before serving, stir in the chopped fresh parsley | Season with salt and black pepper to taste | Serve hot in bowls with crusty bread on the side

ingredients: 2 roasted garlic cloves (minced), 2 portabella mushrooms, 1 medium onion (sliced), 1 medium zucchini (sliced), 1 red bell pepper, 3 tbsp olive oil (for marinade), 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 1 tsp fresh rosemary (chopped), 500g fresh tortellini (cooked and cooled), 1 cup provolone cheese (cubed), 1/4 cup black olives (sliced). For dressing: 1 clove garlic, 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 1 tsp fresh rosemary
instructions: Place mushrooms, sliced onion, sliced zucchini, and bell pepper in a zip-lock bag with 3 tablespoons olive oil, balsamic vinegar, minced roasted garlic, and rosemary ? marinate for 1 hour | Grill the vegetables over medium-high heat until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side | Dice the grilled onions, peppers (charred skin removed), zucchini, and mushrooms | Make the dressing: in a blender, blend garlic, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and rosemary until smooth | In a large bowl, combine cooked tortellini, grilled vegetables, provolone cheese, and black olives | Toss with the dressing, adding more oil and vinegar if necessary | Serve at room temperature or chill and serve cold

ingredients: 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 tsp salt, 2 cups powdered sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips, 1 tbsp paraffin wax or coconut oil (for melting)
instructions: Mix peanut butter, softened butter, salt, powdered sugar, and vanilla in a bowl in the order listed until a smooth dough forms | Form the mixture into egg shapes and place on a parchment-lined baking sheet | Melt chocolate chips and paraffin wax (or coconut oil) in a double boiler over gentle heat, stirring until smooth | Dip each peanut butter egg into the melted chocolate, coating completely | Place on waxed paper until set | Decorate with decorator icing if desired | Store in the refrigerator

ingredients: 6 medium beets (trimmed, leaving root end intact), 3 green onions (thinly sliced, white and green parts separated), 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 tsp ground coriander, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tbsp orange zest, 1/4 cup fresh orange juice
instructions: Leaving the root end intact, trim the tops from the beets leaving about 1-inch of stem | In a saucepan of boiling salted water, cover and cook beets for 25 minutes or until fork-tender | Drain and let cool enough to handle | Slip off the skins and quarter the beets | Meanwhile, thinly slice green onions and set aside the light and dark green parts separately | In a shallow Dutch oven or saucepan, heat olive oil over medium heat | Cook the light green parts of the onions, minced garlic, coriander, salt, and pepper for about 2 minutes until softened | Stir in orange zest and orange juice ? boil for 30 seconds or until reduced by half | Stir in the quartered beets | Cover and cook, stirring once, for about 4 minutes until beets are heated through | Sprinkle with the dark green parts of the green onions and serve

ingredients: 1 jar maraschino cherries (drained, juice reserved, halved), 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 tsp cherry juice (from jar), 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips, 1/2 cup sweetened condensed milk
instructions: Drain cherries, reserving 3 teaspoons of the juice ? cut cherries in half | Beat butter and sugar at medium speed until creamy | Add egg, vanilla, and 2 teaspoons of the reserved cherry juice ? beat until blended | In a separate bowl, combine flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt | Gradually add the flour mixture to the butter mixture, beating until a dough forms | Shape dough into 1-inch balls and place on an ungreased cookie sheet | Make a thumb imprint in the center of each cookie | Place a cherry half in each indent | In a saucepan over low heat, melt chocolate chips and condensed milk together | Add the remaining 1 teaspoon cherry juice to the melted chocolate ? cool slightly | Spoon 1 teaspoon of the melted chocolate mixture over each cherry half | Bake at 350?F (175?C) for 10 minutes | Let cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack

ingredients: 2 tbsp butter, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp white sugar, 1/4 cup onion (diced), 1 cup sour cream, 2 cans (400g each) French-style green beans (drained), 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese, 1/2 cup crushed butter crackers, 1 tbsp butter (melted)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium heat | Stir in flour until smooth and cook for 1 minute | Stir in salt, sugar, onion, and sour cream ? mix until smooth | Add drained green beans and stir to coat evenly | Transfer the mixture to a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish | Spread shredded cheese over the top | In a small bowl, toss together crushed cracker crumbs and remaining melted butter ? sprinkle over the cheese | Bake for 30 minutes until the top is golden and the cheese is bubbly | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 stalks lemongrass (finely minced), 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 fresh chili peppers (minced), 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes, 1/2 tsp ground turmeric, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 400g firm tofu (pressed and cubed), 3 tbsp vegetable oil (divided), 1 yellow onion (sliced), 2 shallots (sliced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 cup roasted peanuts (chopped, divided), 1/4 cup Thai basil leaves, steamed rice for serving
instructions: Combine minced lemongrass, soy sauce, fresh chilies, red pepper flakes, turmeric, sugar, and salt in a bowl | Add the cubed tofu and turn gently to coat evenly ? marinate for 30 minutes | Heat half the oil in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over moderately high heat | Add sliced onion, shallots, and garlic and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute | Reduce heat to low and cook until the onions are soft, about 3 minutes ? transfer to a plate and keep warm | Wipe the pan clean and heat the remaining oil over moderate heat | Add the marinated tofu mixture and, using chopsticks or wooden spoons, turn so it cooks evenly, about 4 to 5 minutes | Add the onion mixture back to the pan and cook uncovered for another 2 to 3 minutes | Add half the chopped peanuts and all the basil leaves | Remove from heat and transfer to a serving plate | Garnish with the remaining peanuts and serve immediately with steamed rice

ingredients: 4 medium potatoes (peeled and cubed), 3 carrots (sliced), 3 celery ribs (sliced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 500g bratwurst sausages (sliced), 2 cups chicken broth, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 cup half-and-half cream, 2 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water
instructions: In a 5-quart slow cooker, combine cubed potatoes, sliced carrots, celery, diced onion, and diced green pepper | Top with sliced bratwurst | In a bowl, combine chicken broth, salt, basil, and pepper ? pour over the top | Cover and cook on low for 7 hours until vegetables are tender and sausage is no longer pink | Stir in the half-and-half cream | Combine cornstarch and cold water until smooth ? stir into the stew | Cover and cook on high for 30 minutes until the gravy is thickened | Serve hot in bowls

ingredients: 400g dried pasta (penne or fusilli), 3 tbsp olive oil (divided), 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 cups frozen broccoli florets, 2 cans (200g each) tuna in olive oil (drained and flaked), 4 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1/2 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1/4 cup dry white wine, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated)
instructions: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente ? drain and set aside | Meanwhile, heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat | Saut? diced onion and minced garlic until soft, about 4-5 minutes | Add frozen broccoli and flaked tuna ? cook until broccoli is tender, about 5-6 minutes | Add crumbled bacon, Italian seasoning, black pepper, and white wine ? heat through | Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss everything together | Drizzle with the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese | Toss gently and serve immediately

ingredients: 1/2 cup caster sugar (superfine sugar), 1 cup unsalted butter (softened), 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 300?F (150?C) and butter an 8-inch round pan | Cream softened butter and caster sugar together until no lumps remain | Add vanilla extract and salt ? blend until smooth | Add flour in increments, blending until a smooth dough forms | Pat the dough down evenly in the buttered 8-inch round pan | Chill in the refrigerator for 45 minutes | Bake on the lower rack of the oven for 45 minutes until light golden brown on top | Cut into 8 wedges while still hot using a sharp knife | Cool completely before serving ? it will fall apart if handled while hot | Store in an airtight container

ingredients: 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple with juice, 1 ripe banana, 1/2 cup plain yogurt, 1/4 cup pineapple juice, 1 cup fresh or frozen fruit (strawberries, mango, or berries), 1/2 cup ice cubes
instructions: Combine crushed pineapple with juice, banana, yogurt, pineapple juice, fresh or frozen fruit of your choice, and ice cubes in a blender or food processor | Cover and blend on high until completely smooth | Taste and add a little honey if additional sweetness is desired | Pour into glasses and serve immediately

ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry (thawed at room temperature for 30 minutes), 2 large eggs (divided), 1 tbsp water, 500g bulk pork sausage, 2 cups herb stuffing mix, 1/2 medium onion (diced), 100g mushrooms (diced)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Mix one egg with 1 tablespoon water ? set aside as egg wash | In a large bowl, mix together sausage, herb stuffing mix, the remaining egg, diced onion, and diced mushrooms until well combined | Unfold puff pastry onto a lightly floured baking sheet, creating 3 sections lengthwise ? do not separate the sections | Cut 9 strips in each of the two outer sections, about 1 inch apart, cutting just to the fold line in the pastry ? these strips will be criss-crossed over the stuffing | Spoon the sausage mixture down the center of the pastry | Starting at one end, fold the pastry strips over the sausage mixture, alternating sides to create a braided effect | Brush the top with the reserved egg wash | Bake for 35 minutes until golden brown | Slice and serve warm

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 3 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 1/4 cups whole milk, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1 large egg, vegetable oil for cooking, maple syrup and butter for serving
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt ? set aside | In a medium bowl, whisk together milk, melted butter, and egg | Add the dry ingredients to the milk mixture ? whisk until just moistened (do not overmix; a few small lumps are fine) | Heat a large nonstick skillet or griddle over medium heat | Fold a paper towel in half and moisten with oil ? carefully rub the skillet with the oiled paper towel | For each pancake, spoon 2 to 3 tablespoons of batter onto the skillet, using the back of the spoon to spread batter into a round | Cook until the surface of the pancakes has some bubbles and a few have burst, about 1 to 2 minutes | Flip carefully with a thin spatula and cook until browned on the underside, about 1 to 2 minutes more | Serve warm with butter and maple syrup or your favorite toppings

ingredients: For topping: 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream. For dough: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour (plus 1 1/2-2 cups for kneading), 3 tbsp granulated sugar, 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup warm water, 1 large egg, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted). For filling: 2 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 1/3 cup brown sugar, 1 tbsp ground cinnamon
instructions: Sprinkle brown sugar in the bottom of a greased 9x13-inch pan ? pour heavy cream over the top and set aside | In a large bowl, combine 1 1/2 cups flour, granulated sugar, yeast, and salt | Add warm water, egg, and melted butter ? beat at low speed until moistened | By hand, stir in an additional 1 1/2 to 2 cups flour to form a soft dough | Knead for 3 minutes, then let rest for 10 minutes | Roll the dough into a 7x15-inch rectangle | Spread with softened butter and sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon | Roll up tightly from the long side and seal the edges | Cut into 1-inch rolls and place in the prepared pan | Cover and let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes | Bake at 350?F (175?C) for 20-25 minutes until golden | Invert onto a serving plate so the caramel topping drips down over the rolls | Serve warm

ingredients: 2 shots espresso coffee (cooled), 2 cups vanilla ice cream, 1/4 cup milk, 2 tbsp mascarpone cheese, 1 tbsp cocoa powder (plus extra for dusting), 1 tbsp sugar (optional), whipped cream for topping
instructions: Brew 2 shots of espresso and let cool completely | In a blender, combine cooled espresso, vanilla ice cream, milk, mascarpone cheese, cocoa powder, and sugar if using | Blend on high until smooth and creamy | Pour into a tall glass | Top with a generous swirl of whipped cream | Dust with cocoa powder and serve immediately

ingredients: 500g carrots (peeled and sliced into rounds), 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil ? add sliced carrots and cook until tender, about 8-10 minutes | Drain carrots and return to the pot | Add honey, butter, salt, and cinnamon ? stir gently over low heat until the butter melts and the carrots are evenly glazed | Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with fresh chopped parsley | Serve hot as a side dish

ingredients: 1/4 cup plus 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil (divided), 4 medium red bliss potatoes (peeled and thinly sliced), 1 medium onion (thinly sliced), 6 large eggs, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup of olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium heat | Add the sliced potatoes and onion ? season with salt and pepper | Cook over moderate heat, stirring frequently, until the potatoes and onion are tender but not browned, about 15 minutes | In a large bowl, lightly beat the eggs and season with salt and pepper | Gently scrape the potato mixture into the bowl with the eggs, making sure not to leave any in the skillet | Return the empty skillet to the heat and add the remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil | Add the egg and potato mixture, spreading it out in an even layer | Cover and cook over low heat until the tortilla is set on the bottom and edges, about 10 minutes | Set a large plate over the skillet and carefully invert the tortilla onto the plate, then slide it back into the skillet to cook the other side for a few minutes until fully set | Slide onto a serving plate and let stand for 5 minutes | Cut into wedges and serve warm or at room temperature

ingredients: For cocktail sauce: 1/2 cup tomato sauce or ketchup, 2 tbsp prepared horseradish, 1 tbsp red wine or burgundy wine, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp salt. For serving: 2 whole fresh Dungeness crabs (cleaned and cracked), shredded iceberg lettuce, 2 fresh lemons (quartered)
instructions: Make the cocktail sauce: combine tomato sauce, horseradish, red wine, lemon juice, pepper, and salt in a bowl ? stir by hand until well mixed | Cover and chill thoroughly | Line a serving bowl with shredded iceberg lettuce | Arrange the cracked crab attractively on top of the lettuce | Garnish with lemon quarters | Serve the cocktail sauce in a separate bowl on the side | Serves 4

ingredients: 1/2 cup fontina cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup Gruy?re cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded), 2 tbsp cherry brandy, 2 tbsp dry white wine, 8 slices crusty bread, 2 tbsp olive oil (for brushing), 1 clove garlic (halved)
instructions: Combine the three shredded cheeses with cherry brandy and white wine in a large bowl ? mix well | Brush olive oil on one side of each bread slice and turn over | Spoon the cheese mixture evenly onto 4 of the 8 bread slices (on the un-oiled side) | Top with the remaining 4 bread slices, oiled side up | Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat for 2 minutes | Place the sandwiches in the skillet (in batches if necessary) | Cover and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the undersides are golden brown and the cheese has begun to melt | Uncover, flip the sandwiches with a spatula, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the other side is golden and the cheese has fully melted | Turn once more and cook for 30 seconds | Remove from pan and let cool for 3 to 5 minutes | Cut sandwiches in half | Rub the cut side of the garlic clove over the top of each sandwich and serve immediately

ingredients: 2 cups cooked long-grain rice, 3 tbsp olive oil, 200g pork (cubed), 200g chicken (cubed), 100g breakfast sausage (sliced), 200g shrimp (peeled and deveined), 12 clams (scrubbed), 2 medium tomatoes (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 2 medium onions (diced), 1/2 cup green beans (trimmed), 1/2 cup peas, 1 tsp saffron threads, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 red bell pepper (sliced), 1 green bell pepper (sliced), 100g chorizo (sliced), salt to taste
instructions: Separately, boil shrimp and clams in plenty of water until shrimp are pink and clams have opened ? discard any clams that do not open | Reserve the seafood water for cooking the rice | Heat olive oil in a paella pan over medium-high heat | Fry cubed pork and chicken until browned ? remove from pan | In the same pan, fry diced onions until softened, then add minced garlic and cook briefly | Fry diced tomatoes, then add green beans, peas, and bell peppers ? cook for 5 minutes | Return the pork and chicken to the pan | Add the cooked rice and reserved seafood water | Stir in saffron and paprika | Test for salt and adjust | Cover with a clean cloth and cook until the rice is done and has absorbed the liquid, about 20 minutes | Just before finishing, decorate the top with sliced chorizo and red bell pepper strips | Serve hot with Spanish red wine and crusty bread

ingredients: 3 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp salt, 3/4 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 cups granulated sugar, 3 large eggs, 2 cups mashed ripe bananas (about 4 bananas), 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple (undrained), 1 cup chopped pecans or walnuts, 1 cup sweetened shredded coconut. For frosting: cream cheese frosting
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Butter two 9-inch round cake pans and line the bottoms with parchment paper ? butter the paper and dust with flour | In a bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt ? set aside | In another bowl, stir together mashed bananas, crushed pineapple with juice, chopped nuts, and coconut | In a large bowl, cream butter, sugar, and vanilla until light and fluffy | Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition | Add the flour mixture to the butter mixture alternately with the banana-pineapple mixture, blending until just combined | Divide batter evenly between the prepared pans | Bake until golden brown, 30-40 minutes, rotating pans halfway through | Transfer pans to a wire rack to cool for 15 minutes before unmolding | Loosen sides with a knife and invert onto greased wire racks ? to prevent layers from splitting, invert again so the tops are up | Cool completely before frosting with cream cheese frosting | Decorate with dried pineapple flowers if desired: thinly slice a fresh peeled pineapple and dry in the oven at 225?F (110?C) for 30 minutes or until dry, then arrange on the frosted cake

ingredients: For salad: 4 ripe pears (peeled and cut into wedges), 4 cups romaine lettuce (chopped), 2 cups iceberg lettuce (chopped), 1/4 cup pecans (chopped). For cream cheese layer: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 2 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 cup gingersnap cookies (crushed, divided). For dressing: 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp orange juice, 1 small shallot (minced)
instructions: Crush gingersnap cookies: add all cookies to a plastic bag and crush with a rolling pin or meat mallet ? set aside (about 2/3 for the cream cheese and 1/3 for garnish) | Make the cream cheese mixture: in a small bowl, mix softened cream cheese and mayonnaise until smooth | Add 2/3 of the crushed gingersnaps and mix well ? set aside at room temperature | Make the dressing: whisk together honey, orange juice, and minced shallot ? set aside | Peel pears and cut into wedges | In a medium bowl, toss chopped iceberg and romaine lettuces with a couple tablespoons of the dressing | To plate: for each serving, add a portion of dressed lettuce, then top with one pear (about 8 slices) arranged in a spiral around the center of the plate | Place a spoonful of the cream cheese mixture in the center | Drizzle a little more dressing over the pears | Top with chopped pecans and the reserved crushed gingersnaps | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 ripe banana, 1 cup fresh pineapple chunks, 1 tbsp sugar (or honey), 1/2 cup coconut milk, 1/2 cup ice cubes, pineapple wedge for garnish
instructions: Place banana, pineapple chunks, sugar, coconut milk, and ice cubes in a blender or food processor | Process on high until blended thoroughly and smooth | Taste and add more sugar if desired | Pour into a tall glass and garnish with a pineapple wedge | Serve immediately

ingredients: 400g penne pasta, 4 Italian sausages (about 300g), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 cup dry white wine, 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1 cup tomato sauce, 1/4 cup fresh basil (torn), 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), salt to taste
instructions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook the sausages until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes | Slice sausages into 1/4-inch thick rounds | Return sliced sausage to the skillet and cook for about 7 minutes until no longer pink inside | Stir in minced garlic ? cook for 1 minute until golden | Add white wine, stirring to scrape up any brown bits from the skillet | Cook for 5 minutes until the liquid is almost absorbed | Add olive oil and tomato sauce | Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for about 5 minutes | Stir in torn basil | Meanwhile, cook penne in a large pot of salted boiling water until tender but firm (al dente) ? drain | In a large bowl, toss the pasta with the sausage sauce | Top generously with grated Parmesan cheese and serve immediately

ingredients: For apple layer: 2 medium apples (peeled and diced), 1/4 cup raisins, 1/4 cup light brown sugar, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 tbsp unsalted butter. For batter: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup light brown sugar, 3/4 cup buttermilk, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted), 1 large egg, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Butter or spray 12 muffin cups with nonstick spray or line with paper liners ? set aside | Make the apple layer: combine diced apples, raisins, brown sugar, and cinnamon in a small bowl ? stir until well blended | Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat and add the apple mixture | Cook, stirring over low heat, until the apples are tender, about 5 minutes ? let cool | Spoon a layer of the apple mixture into the bottom of each muffin cup, dividing evenly | Make the batter: combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl ? stir until well blended | Stir in the brown sugar until combined | In a separate bowl, whisk together buttermilk, melted butter, egg, and vanilla until smooth | Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients all at once ? fold just until evenly moistened (do not overmix) | Divide the batter evenly among the muffin cups over the apple layer | Bake until the tops are golden and a toothpick inserted in the centers comes out clean, about 20-22 minutes | Cool on a wire rack before removing from the pan

ingredients: 1.5 kg sirloin tip roast, salt and black pepper, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 2 medium onions (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 2 carrots (diced), 3 whole cloves, 1 tbsp orange zest, 1/4 cup brandy, 2 cups dark beer, 1 tsp whole peppercorns, 2 bay leaves, 2 sprigs fresh thyme, 15g dried porcini mushrooms, For sauce: 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tbsp cornstarch, 1 tbsp brown sugar, braised fennel and boiled new potatoes for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) | Season the beef generously with salt and pepper | Heat oil in a large skillet and brown the roast on all sides, approximately 5 minutes per side, until well browned | Transfer the roast to a roasting pan with a lid, just large enough to hold the beef and vegetables | Return the skillet to the heat and cook the diced onions, garlic, carrots, cloves, and orange zest for about 5 minutes | Use a slotted spoon to transfer the cooked vegetables to the roaster, surrounding the meat | Place the roaster over medium heat on the stovetop | Pour in the brandy | Using a long match or lighter, carefully set the brandy alight and allow the flames to die down | Add the dark beer, peppercorns, bay leaves, thyme, and dried porcini mushrooms ? bring to a boil | Cover the roaster with foil, then add the lid | Transfer to the oven and cook for 2 1/2 to 3 hours until the roast is tender | Transfer the beef and vegetables to a platter and keep warm ? reserve the juices in the roaster | For the sauce: mix red wine vinegar, cornstarch, and brown sugar in a small bowl until smooth | Add 2 tablespoons of the meat juices and mix well | Pour this mixture into the roaster with the remaining juices and cook over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring constantly | Carve the roast and serve with the sauce, braised fennel, and boiled new potatoes

ingredients: 1.5 kg boneless beef rump roast or tip roast, 3 cloves garlic (slivered), 3 tbsp prepared horseradish (divided), 1 packet brown gravy mix (divided), 4 carrots (cut into chunks), 4 potatoes (quartered), 2 celery ribs (cut into chunks), 1/2 cup water, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp fresh coarse ground black pepper, 2 tbsp cornstarch, 3 tbsp water
instructions: With the tip of a knife, make small cuts in the top of the beef roast and insert garlic slivers | Spread beef with 1 tablespoon of the horseradish | Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of the gravy mix | Place beef in a 3 1/2 to 4-quart slow cooker | Arrange carrots, potatoes, and celery around the beef | In a small bowl, combine 1/2 cup water, the remaining gravy mix, salt, and pepper ? mix until well blended | Pour over the vegetables | Cover and cook on low for 8 to 9 hours until the beef is tender | Just before serving, remove the beef and vegetables from the slow cooker ? place on a serving platter and cover to keep warm | In a medium saucepan, combine cornstarch, 3 tablespoons water, and the remaining 2 tablespoons horseradish ? blend well | Pour the juices from the slow cooker into the cornstarch mixture and mix well | Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring constantly, until the gravy thickens | Slice the beef and serve with the vegetables and horseradish gravy

ingredients: 1 package (85g) lemon gelatin, 1 cup boiling water, 1/2 cup raisins, 1/2 cup sultanas, 1/2 cup pitted prunes (cooked until soft, drained, and chopped), 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, pinch of salt, whipped cream, custard, or ice cream for serving
instructions: Dissolve lemon gelatin completely in boiling water, stirring well | Cook the prunes in a little water until softened, then drain and chop finely | Add the chopped prunes, raisins, sultanas, cinnamon, cloves, and salt to the gelatin mixture | Mix well until all ingredients are evenly distributed | Pour into a mold or serving dish | Refrigerate until fully set, at least 4 hours | Serve icy cold with whipped cream, custard, or ice cream

ingredients: 2 cups whole milk, 2 tbsp potato starch or cornstarch, 1 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tsp seasoning salt, 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Add all ingredients ? milk, potato starch, butter, seasoning salt, chicken bouillon, and black pepper ? to a blender | Blend on high until smooth and well combined | Transfer mixture to a saucepan and heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it thickens to a creamy soup consistency | Use immediately as a base for casseroles or creamy dishes, or serve as a simple soup | The mixture will thicken further with additional heating

ingredients: 2 cups plain yogurt, 1 cup fresh spinach (finely chopped or pur?ed), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp garlic paste, 1/2 tsp ginger paste, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp mustard seeds, 1/4 tsp red chili powder, 1 tbsp fresh green coriander (chopped)
instructions: Whisk yogurt in a bowl until it reaches a smooth and creamy consistency | Add the chopped spinach, salt, garlic paste, ginger paste, black pepper, and mustard seeds ? mix well until evenly combined | Transfer to a serving bowl | Garnish with a sprinkle of red chili powder and fresh chopped green coriander | Serve chilled as a cooling side dish

ingredients: 1 package (85g) unflavored gelatin, 1/4 cup cold water, 1 cup boiling water, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 cup cider vinegar, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/2 cup celery (diced), 1/2 cup green bell pepper (diced), 1 cup green cabbage (shredded), 1/2 cup cooked peas, 2 tbsp onion (finely diced), 1/4 cup maraschino cherries (halved)
instructions: Soak the gelatin in the cold water for 5 minutes to bloom | Dissolve the bloomed gelatin completely in the boiling water, stirring well | Add sugar, salt, cider vinegar, and lemon juice ? stir until dissolved | Let the mixture cool to room temperature | When the mixture begins to set and has a syrupy consistency, fold in the diced celery, bell pepper, shredded cabbage, peas, onion, and maraschino cherries | Pour into an oiled mold or serving dish | Refrigerate until fully set, at least 4 hours or overnight | To serve, unmold onto a serving plate or serve directly from the dish

ingredients: 2 sheets puff pastry (thawed), 6 slices bacon (diced), 100g mushrooms (sliced), 2 medium tomatoes (sliced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, 4 large eggs, 2 tbsp milk (for glazing)
instructions: Preheat oven to 190-200?C (375-400?F) | Line a 20cm pie dish with baking paper | Place 1 sheet of puff pastry over the paper and trim the edges | Place diced bacon, sliced mushrooms, tomato, and diced onion evenly in the pastry case | Season with black pepper | Crack the eggs over the filling, spacing them evenly | Top the pie with the remaining sheet of puff pastry | Trim and crimp the edges to seal | Glaze the top of the pie with milk | Cut a small vent in the center of the pie to allow steam to escape | Bake for 20-25 minutes until the pastry is golden brown | Let cool for 5 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1/2 cup bulgur wheat, 1 cup hot water, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes (with juice), 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 medium onions (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp ground cumin, 1 tbsp chili powder, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 2 green bell peppers (diced), 1 cup corn kernels (fresh or frozen), 1 can (400g) black beans (drained and rinsed), 1 can (400g) red kidney beans (drained and rinsed), 1 tsp salt, 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/4 cup fresh cilantro (chopped)
instructions: Place bulgur wheat, hot water, and about 1 cup of the juice from the canned tomatoes in a small saucepan | Cover and bring to a boil over high heat, then lower the heat and simmer gently until the bulgur is cooked but still chewy | Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat | Saut? diced onions, minced garlic, cumin, chili powder, and cayenne until the onions are soft | Stir in diced bell peppers and saut? for 2 to 3 minutes more | Chop the canned tomatoes if using whole, then add them to the pan with their remaining juice | Stir in corn, black beans, and kidney beans ? heat thoroughly on low heat | When the bulgur is cooked, add it to the pan with its liquid | Cover and simmer for a few minutes for the flavors to meld | Add salt to taste | Serve hot topped with shredded cheddar cheese and fresh cilantro

ingredients: 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 cup pineapple juice, 1 package (85g) lemon or unflavored gelatin, 1/4 cup cold water, 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple (drained), 1 cup cottage cheese, 1 cup whipped cream or whipped topping, 2 prepared graham cracker crusts (9-inch each)
instructions: Dissolve sugar in pineapple juice over low heat, stirring until fully dissolved | Soften gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes, then stir into the warm pineapple mixture until completely dissolved | Chill the mixture until partially set, about 1 hour | Fold in crushed pineapple, cottage cheese, and whipped cream until well combined | Pour the mixture evenly into the prepared graham cracker crusts | Chill overnight or until completely set | Slice and serve chilled

ingredients: 500g ground beef, 1 large egg, 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1/2 tsp seasoning salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 cup breadcrumbs, 2 tbsp olive oil. For sauce: 1/2 cup grape jelly, 1/2 cup plum jam, 1/2 cup chili sauce, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: Mix ground beef, egg, diced onion, seasoning salt, pepper, and breadcrumbs together | If the mixture falls apart easily, add more breadcrumbs; if too dry, add a bit of water | Form into walnut-sized balls (about 25 meatballs) | Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat | Saut? the meatballs, turning as needed, until browned on both sides and cooked through ? set aside | In a crock pot on high setting, combine grape jelly, plum jam, chili sauce, diced tomatoes, ginger, and pepper ? mix well | Add the meatballs to the sauce and simmer on high for at least 1 hour (more is better), stirring occasionally | Serve over white rice as a main dish or with toothpicks as an appetizer

ingredients: For batter: 3 large eggs, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 3 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup powdered sugar, 1/2 cup margarine, 1/4 cup shortening, pinch of salt. For filling: 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp margarine, 1 tsp vegetable oil, 2 tbsp pineapple juice, pinch of salt, 1 egg white. For topping: red sugar, peach gelatin powder, 1/4 cup vermouth
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Make the batter: mix all batter ingredients together except the flour ? beat well | Blend in the flour until a smooth dough forms | Shape dough into balls about 1 to 1 1/4 inches in size | Place on ungreased cookie sheets and bake until golden brown, about 8 to 10 minutes | Once completely cooled, use a very sharp paring knife to carefully scoop out the center of each cookie | Make the filling: beat together sugar, margarine, and oil until smooth | Beat in pineapple juice, salt, and egg white | Fill each cookie with the filling, slightly underfilling but leaving some filling on the edges to act as glue | Press two cookies of similar size together to form a peach shape | Pour vermouth into a small bowl | Mix together red sugar and peach gelatin powder on a plate | Dip each assembled cookie in vermouth briefly, then roll in the sugar mixture to coat | Let dry for 3 hours before serving

ingredients: 300g dried small white beans (cooked until tender), 1 carrot (diced), 2 cloves, 1 bouquet garni, 1 tsp paprika, 2 pimientos (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), For dressing: 2 red onions (diced), 10 cl chicken or vegetable broth, 1 pinch pimento, 1 tbsp Xeres vinegar, 2 tbsp olive oil. For tomato sauce: 2 fresh tomatoes (thinly sliced), salt and pepper, 1 pinch pimento, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1 shallot (minced), 1 tbsp olive oil. For duck: 2 confit duck legs (skin removed, meat shredded), 2 slices fresh foie gras, butter for frying, fresh parsley
instructions: Cook the white beans with diced carrot, cloves, bouquet garni, pepper, paprika, pimientos, and garlic until tender ? drain and remove aromatic herbs, reserving the beans | Make the dressing: in a jar, mix diced red onions with chicken or vegetable broth, pimento, Xeres vinegar, and olive oil ? set aside | Make the tomato sauce: place thinly sliced tomatoes on a plate and season with salt, pepper, pimento, minced garlic, shallot, and olive oil ? set aside | Remove skin from the confit duck legs and shred the meat | Poach the duck meat for 2 minutes in a small amount of water ? drain and set aside | Fry fresh slices of foie gras in butter for 1-2 minutes per side ? season with salt and pepper | Warm the white beans in their stock for about 2 minutes, then strain | Toss the beans with the fresh tomato mixture | Place the bean mixture in the center of each plate | Top with shredded duck meat and a slice of seared foie gras | Sprinkle with fresh parsley | Drizzle the red onion dressing around the plate

ingredients: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 2 medium onions (diced), 2 celery ribs (diced), 2 carrots (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 500g ground veal or beef, 250g ground pork, 100g pancetta or thick bacon (diced), 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1/2 cup whole milk, 1 cup dry white wine, 1 tbsp fresh thyme leaves, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a 6 to 8-quart heavy-bottomed pot, heat olive oil over medium heat until hot | Add diced onions, celery, carrots, and garlic ? cook until the vegetables are translucent but not browned, about 5 minutes | Add ground veal, ground pork, and diced pancetta | Increase heat to high and brown the meat, stirring frequently | Add tomato paste, milk, wine, and thyme | Bring just to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until thick and rich, stirring occasionally | Season with salt and pepper | Remove from heat and let cool if not using immediately | The sauce can be refrigerated for up to 2 days or frozen for up to 1 month | Serve over pasta with grated Parmesan

ingredients: For marinade: 3 tbsp canola oil, 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground pepper, 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), 2 green onions (sliced), 2 tbsp fresh lime juice. For fish: 4 swordfish steaks (about 150g each), 2 tbsp canola oil. For salsa: 1 cup mixed tropical fruit (mango, pineapple, papaya, diced), 2 tbsp red onion (diced), 1 tbsp fresh cilantro, 1 tbsp lime juice
instructions: Make the marinade: in a small bowl, whisk together canola oil, nutmeg, ginger, red pepper flakes, salt, pepper, cilantro, green onions, and lime juice | Pour into a large resealable plastic bag | Add the swordfish steaks, seal, and shake the bag to completely coat the fish | Refrigerate and marinate for at least 1 hour | Make the salsa: chop well-drained tropical fruit into small pieces | Combine fruit with red onion, cilantro, and lime juice in a bowl ? refrigerate to let flavors meld while fish marinates | Heat 2 tablespoons canola oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat | Remove fish from marinade and pat dry | Cook for 5 minutes on each side until the fish is opaque and flakes easily | Serve the fish with the tropical salsa either on top or on the side

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 200g marzipan (cut into 1-inch pieces), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 3/4 cup whole milk, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1/2 tsp almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) and spray a muffin tin with nonstick spray or line with paper cups | In a large bowl, whisk flour, baking powder, and salt until well mixed ? set aside | Place marzipan pieces in a food processor fitted with the chopping blade | Add sugar and pulse on and off until the mixture has a grainy consistency | Add the egg and process for 20 more seconds until the mixture forms a paste and then turns into a ball | With the machine running, pour milk in a slow stream through the feed tube, then add oil and almond extract | Process for 1 minute until a smooth, thick paste forms | Add the paste to the prepared flour mixture and stir just until the flour is incorporated ? do not overmix | Fill the prepared muffin tins three-quarters full | Bake for 16 minutes until the tops are smooth and lightly browned and a toothpick comes out with a few moist crumbs attached | Set the pan on a wire rack to cool for 10 minutes | Gently rock each muffin back and forth to release it from the tin | Cool for 30 minutes more on the rack before serving | Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 24 hours or freeze for up to 1 month

ingredients: 2 cups granulated sugar, 2 cups water, 3 cups fresh citrus juice (orange, lemon, lime, or a blend), 3 cups cold water, ice cubes, fresh mint leaves and lemon slices for garnish
instructions: In a large saucepan over high heat, bring water and sugar to a boil, stirring until the sugar dissolves completely | Boil for 3 minutes | Transfer the syrup to a bowl or container, cover, and chill until cold ? at least 3 hours but will keep for up to 1 week | In a large pitcher, mix together fresh citrus juices, 3 cups of the chilled syrup, and 3 cups cold water | Fill glasses with ice and pour the citrus cooler over | Garnish with fresh mint leaves and lemon slices | Leftover syrup is wonderful added to iced tea

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1 tsp chili powder, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 can (400g) stewed tomatoes, 1 cup water, 1 cup chicken broth, 1 cup long grain white rice, 1 tsp seasoning salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper
instructions: In a large skillet, cook ground beef with diced onion, green pepper, and red pepper flakes over medium-high heat until the meat is browned ? drain excess fat | Add minced garlic, thyme, basil, and chili powder ? continue to cook until the meat is fully browned, about 8 minutes | Stir in tomato paste, stewed tomatoes, water, chicken broth, rice, seasoning salt, and black pepper ? bring to a boil | Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender | Fluff with a fork and serve hot

ingredients: 6 slices rye bread (toasted), 2 tbsp hot mustard, 6 slices orange, 6 slices salami, 6 slices pickled beets, 6 slices brick cheese, 12 slices onion, 6 slices Canadian cheddar cheese, 12 anchovy fillets, 3 tbsp butter (softened), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), gherkins for garnish
instructions: Toast rye bread slices and spread each slice with hot mustard | On each slice of toast, arrange 2 slices of orange, 1 slice of salami, 2 slices of beets, 1 slice of brick cheese, 2 slices of onion, and 1 slice of cheddar cheese | Arrange 2 anchovy fillets diagonally on top of the cheese | Butter the remaining bread slices and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese | Arrange all bread slices on a baking sheet, open-faced | Broil until the cheese melts slightly ? remove from oven and slice each in half diagonally | Arrange on serving plates, placing Parmesan slices on each side of the anchovy slices | Garnish with gherkins and serve immediately

ingredients: 2 cans (400g each) condensed cream of potato or corn soup, 4 cups whole milk (plus extra if needed), 1 cup frozen corn kernels, 300g cooked baby shrimp, 1/2 tsp lemon pepper, 4 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), 2 tbsp dry sherry or Marsala wine, 2 tbsp fresh chives (chopped)
instructions: Combine condensed soup, 4 cups milk, corn, shrimp, lemon pepper, and crumbled bacon in a heavy-bottomed pot | Cook over medium-high heat until hot, stirring frequently | Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, adding more milk if the chowder becomes too thick | Stir in sherry or Marsala wine and simmer for 5 more minutes | Remove from heat, stir in fresh chives, and serve immediately

ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 1 tbsp curry powder, 1 tsp white vinegar, 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon, 2 tbsp onion (finely diced), 1/4 cup fresh parsley (chopped), 2 cups cooked chicken (diced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 1 cucumber (sliced, for garnish), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, curry powder, vinegar, onion, cinnamon, salt, and pepper until well combined | Add diced chicken and diced celery ? toss well to coat evenly | Chill for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld (can be refrigerated for up to 2 days) | Before serving, arrange cucumber slices around the edge of the serving dish | Serve chilled or at room temperature

ingredients: 400g spaghetti, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 3 tbsp butter (divided), 8 oz low-fat cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream, 1/2 cup milk, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1/4 tsp Cajun seasoning (optional), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions until al dente | In a saucepan, saut? minced garlic in 1 tablespoon butter over medium heat until tender | Add cream cheese, sour cream, milk, salt, onion powder, Cajun seasoning, white pepper, and the remaining 2 tablespoons butter | Cook and stir over low heat just until smooth ? do not boil | Remove from heat | Drain spaghetti and toss with the cream sauce until evenly coated | Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve immediately

ingredients: 400g extra firm tofu (pressed and sliced into 6-8 slices, then halved), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp Montreal steak grill seasoning
instructions: Heat a George Foreman grill or panini press | Press tofu to remove excess moisture, then slice into about 6-8 slices and halve them to make 12-16 pieces | Sprinkle one side of the tofu liberally with Montreal steak grill seasoning | Place the seasoned side down on the hot grill | Season the other side of the tofu and drizzle lightly with olive oil before closing the grill top | Cook for 2-4 minutes until grill marks appear | Flip the tofu and grill for an additional 1-2 minutes until desired crispiness is reached | Serve immediately as a main dish or on salads

ingredients: 1 can (300g) mandarin oranges (undrained), 4 large eggs, 1 box yellow cake mix, 1/2 cup vegetable oil. For topping: 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix, 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple (undrained), 2 cups non-dairy whipped topping (thawed)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 9 x 13-inch pan | Blend mandarin oranges with their juice, eggs, cake mix, and oil in a large bowl ? beat for 3 minutes until smooth | Pour batter into the prepared pan | Bake for 25-30 minutes until a toothpick inserted comes out clean | Cool thoroughly | Make the topping: mix dry pudding mix with crushed pineapple and its juice ? stir well | Fold in whipped topping until smooth | Spread over the cooled cake and refrigerate until ready to serve

ingredients: 1 bag (900g) frozen hash browns (thawed for 30 minutes), 8 slices bacon (cut into thin strips and fried until crispy), 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup, 1 cup light sour cream, 1/4 cup margarine (melted), 2 cups cheddar cheese (shredded), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) and lightly coat a 9 x 13-inch pan with cooking spray | Thaw hash browns for 30 minutes | While hash browns are thawing, use clean scissors to cut bacon into thin strips horizontally ? fry until crispy and set aside | In a large bowl, mix together soup, sour cream, salt, and pepper | Add melted margarine and mix well | Add shredded cheese and crispy bacon, then add the hash browns ? continue mixing until well combined | Spread the mixture evenly into the prepared pan | Bake for 1 hour until the top is golden brown and the casserole is bubbly | Serve hot

ingredients: 12 large cabbage leaves, 500g ground beef, 250g ground pork, 1 cup cooked rice, 1 large egg, 1/4 cup milk, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp dried sweet basil, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/4 cup onion (diced), 1/4 cup celery (diced), 1/4 cup carrot (diced), 2 cans (400g each) tomato sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil | Cut 12 large leaves off the cabbage head, cover with boiling water, and let stand until leaves are limp (2-3 minutes), then drain. Alternatively, core the cabbage head and boil until leaves are tender enough to remove easily (10-15 minutes) ? carefully peel off 12 large leaves | Mix ground beef, ground pork, cooked rice, egg, milk, salt, pepper, basil, garlic powder, paprika, diced onion, celery, and carrot in a large bowl until well combined | Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Place 1-4 tablespoons of the meat mixture (depending on the size of the leaf) in the center of each cabbage leaf | Tuck in the sides and roll to cover the meat completely ? roll any leftover filling into meatballs | Place cabbage rolls seam-side down in a baking dish | Mix tomato sauce with brown sugar and pour over the rolls | Cover and bake for 45-60 minutes until the meat is cooked through | Serve hot with the tomato sauce spooned over the top

ingredients: 6 slices bacon (diced), 1/2 red bell pepper (diced), 1/4 red onion (diced), 4 white mushrooms (sliced), 1 cup fresh spinach (chopped), 6 large eggs, 4 large egg whites, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | In a large skillet, cook diced bacon until crispy ? remove and set aside | Add diced bell pepper, onion, and mushrooms to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes until softened | Remove from the skillet and stir in chopped spinach | In a medium bowl, whisk together eggs, egg whites, salt, and pepper | Spray 8 standard muffin cups with nonstick cooking spray | Evenly divide the bacon and vegetable mixture among the prepared muffin cups | Sprinkle shredded cheese over the mixture | Evenly pour the egg mixture over the cheese in each muffin cup | Bake for 20-25 minutes until the tops are lightly browned and the centers are set | Cool in the pan for 5 minutes, then carefully remove and serve warm

ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets (about 150g each), 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 tsp paprika, 2 tbsp flat-leaf parsley (chopped), 2 tbsp olive oil, salt and black pepper to taste, 1 lemon (cut into wedges)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | In a shallow dish, combine grated Parmesan with paprika and chopped parsley ? season with salt and pepper | Drizzle the fish fillets with olive oil on both sides | Dredge each fillet in the cheese mixture, pressing gently to coat evenly | Place on a foil-lined baking sheet | Bake until the fish is opaque in the thickest part, about 10 to 12 minutes | Serve immediately with lemon wedges on the side

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 cup chicken broth, 1/2 cup whole milk, 1/2 cup Romano cheese (grated), 4 oz cream cheese (cut into small cubes), 1/4 cup heavy cream, cooked pasta for serving
instructions: Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat | Add flour and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until fragrant and nutty | Add chicken broth and simmer, whisking continuously, until nice and thick | Add milk, whisking constantly ? simmer until the sauce has re-thickened | Add grated Romano cheese and cream cheese | Drop cream cheese in by spoonfuls to make it easier to break up ? continue to whisk | If adding additional cooked ingredients like chicken and broccoli or crabmeat, add them now and simmer for a few minutes | When desired thickness is reached, remove from heat | Add heavy cream and whisk well until smooth and combined | Serve immediately over hot pasta

ingredients: 6 green bell peppers (tops cut off and seeded), 1 cup cooked rice, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 500g ground beef, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes (drained, juice reserved), 1 1/2 cups mozzarella cheese (shredded, divided), 1 tbsp dried parsley, 1/4 cup ketchup, salt and black pepper to taste, fresh parsley for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Bring a large pot of water to a boil and immerse prepared pepper shells in boiling water for 3 minutes ? remove and drain on paper towels, cut side up | Cook rice according to package directions (microwave packets work well at 90 seconds) | Heat olive oil over medium-high heat and saut? diced onion for about 5 minutes ? add chopped pepper trimmings if desired | Add ground beef and cook until browned, then add minced garlic and cook about 30 seconds more | In a large mixing bowl, combine rice, beef mixture, drained tomatoes, 1 cup mozzarella, dried parsley, salt, and pepper | Place peppers in a 9-inch square baking pan and fill each generously with the mixture | Mix ketchup with the reserved tomato juice and spoon over the top of the stuffed peppers | Sprinkle each with remaining mozzarella cheese and garnish with fresh parsley | Bake for 30 minutes until peppers are tender and cheese is melted | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 can frozen pink lemonade concentrate (thawed in the refrigerator), 1 can (355ml) vodka, 2 cans (355ml each) light beer, ice cubes for serving
instructions: Let the can of frozen pink lemonade thaw in the refrigerator ? this prevents the beer from foaming up too much from excessive stirring | In a large pitcher, combine the thawed lemonade concentrate, vodka, and beer | Stir gently (not too vigorously or it will foam) | Serve over ice in glasses

ingredients: 12 tbsp unsalted butter (divided), 3/4 cup brown sugar (packed), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 large egg plus 1 egg yolk, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: Adjust oven rack to upper-middle position and preheat to 375?F (190?C) | Melt 9 tablespoons butter in a 12-inch cast-iron skillet over medium heat | Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until butter is dark golden brown with a nutty aroma and bubbling subsides, about 5 minutes ? transfer to a large bowl | Stir the remaining 3 tablespoons butter into the hot butter until completely melted | Whisk brown sugar, granulated sugar, vanilla, and salt into the melted butter until smooth | Whisk in egg and yolk until smooth, about 30 seconds | Let the mixture sit for 3 minutes, then whisk for 30 seconds ? repeat this process of resting and whisking 2 more times until the mixture is thick, smooth, and shiny | In a separate bowl, whisk together flour and baking soda | Stir the flour mixture into the butter mixture until just combined, about 1 minute | Stir in chocolate chips, making sure no flour pockets remain | Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels | Transfer the dough to the now-empty skillet and press into an even layer with a spatula | Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake until the cookie is golden brown and the edges are set, about 20 minutes, rotating the skillet halfway through | Using potholders, transfer the skillet to a wire rack and let cool for 30 minutes | Slice into wedges and serve

ingredients: For seasoning mix: 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1/4 tsp dried basil, 1/4 tsp dried thyme. For dish: 6 slices bacon (diced), 4 cups onions (diced, divided), 2 cups bell peppers (diced, divided), 2 cups celery (diced, divided), 3 bay leaves, 500g dried black-eyed peas (divided), 2 tbsp fresh garlic (minced), 8 cups chicken stock (divided), 500g smoked sausage (sliced), 2 cups converted rice
instructions: Combine seasoning mix ingredients in a small bowl ? set aside | Place diced bacon in a large ovenproof pot and cook over high heat until bacon begins to brown, about 6 minutes | Stir in 2 cups onions, 1 cup peppers, 1 cup celery, 2 tablespoons plus 1 teaspoon seasoning mix, bay leaves, and half the black-eyed peas | Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes | Stir in minced garlic and 2 cups chicken stock ? scrape the bottom of the pot | Bring to a boil and cook, stirring occasionally, about 20 minutes | Add 1 cup stock and scrape the bottom of the pot again | Add sliced sausage, 6 cups stock, remaining onions, remaining peppers, remaining celery, remaining peas, and remaining seasoning mix | Cover and bring to a boil over high heat | Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until peas are tender, about 1 1/4 hours | Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Stir in rice and remaining stock | Bring to a boil over high heat | Cover the pot and bake in the oven for 15 minutes until the rice is tender | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 package vanilla pudding mix, 1 package strawberry gelatin dessert mix, 1 1/4 cups water, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 package whipped topping mix, 1/2 cup cold milk, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, 2 cups fresh strawberries (sliced), 1 prepared graham cracker pie crust, extra strawberries and whipped cream for garnish
instructions: In a saucepan, cook pudding mix, strawberry gelatin, water, and lemon juice over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it comes to a boil | Remove from heat and chill the mixture until thick, about 1-2 hours | Prepare the whipped topping mix with milk and vanilla according to package directions | Fold the whipped topping into the chilled gelatin mixture until smooth | Stir in sliced strawberries | Pour the filling into the prepared pie crust and refrigerate until set, at least 3 hours | Garnish with additional fresh strawberries and whipped cream before serving

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 cup plain yogurt, 1/2 cup milk, 1 large egg, butter or oil for cooking, maple syrup for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt ? stir well | In a separate bowl, whisk together yogurt, milk, and egg until smooth | Pour the wet ingredients into the dry mixture | Stir just until combined ? the batter should be slightly lumpy (do not overmix) | Heat a skillet or griddle over medium-high heat and lightly grease with butter or oil | Scoop 1/4 cup of batter onto the skillet for each pancake | Cook until bubbles appear on the surface, about 2-3 minutes | Flip and cook until golden brown on the other side | Serve warm with maple syrup
