ingredients: 400g rotini pasta, 2 cups cooked chicken (diced), 1 can (400g) condensed cream of celery soup, 1 cup half-and-half, 4 oz cream cheese (softened), 2 cups fresh spinach (chopped), 3 green onions (sliced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp dried parsley, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp dried tarragon, 1 1/2 cups mozzarella cheese (shredded)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a very large casserole dish | Cook rotini according to package directions until al dente ? drain, rinse, and set aside | Dice the chicken into bite-size chunks and set aside | Chop the spinach, slice green onions, and mince garlic ? place in a medium bowl | Add condensed cream of celery soup, half-and-half, cream cheese, salt, pepper, parsley, basil, and tarragon | Gently mash and combine everything together into a nice smooth sauce | In the prepared casserole dish, layer the pasta, then the chicken, then the sauce | Top generously with shredded mozzarella cheese | Bake for about 30 minutes until the cheese is just nicely browned on top | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 kg baby carrots, 6 cups water, 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp dried tarragon, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: Combine baby carrots and 6 cups water in a Dutch oven | Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes or until carrots are crisp-tender | Drain carrots and keep warm | Cook balsamic vinegar in a small saucepan over medium-high heat for 4 to 5 minutes or until the liquid is reduced by half | Stir in brown sugar and butter until smooth and fully melted | Pour the balsamic glaze over the warm carrots and toss to coat evenly | Stir in thyme, tarragon, salt, and pepper | Serve immediately

ingredients: 2 lemons, 4 salmon fillets (about 150g each, skin-on), 3 tbsp fresh dill (chopped, divided), 1 English cucumber (sliced paper-thin), 1/4 red onion (thinly sliced), 2 tbsp cider vinegar, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp kosher salt (plus extra), 2 tbsp olive oil (plus extra for brushing)
instructions: Zest the lemons to yield 2 tablespoons of zest ? set remaining zest and whole lemons aside | Sprinkle salmon fillets with 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon zest and 1 1/2 tablespoons dill, dividing evenly among fillets and patting to adhere | Wrap fillets in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours and up to overnight | Slice cucumber paper-thin using a mandoline or handheld slicer | Thinly slice the red onion | In a bowl, whisk together cider vinegar, sugar, and 1/2 teaspoon salt | Add cucumber, onion, remaining lemon zest, and remaining dill ? toss gently to coat and adjust seasoning if necessary | Prepare a grill for indirect heat (gas at 400?F or charcoal with coals mounded to one side) | Fold two 12 x 18-inch pieces of heavy-duty aluminum foil in half ? poke holes about 2 inches apart and widen each to the size of a dime | Grease foil with olive oil and set over direct heat for 2 minutes | Brush salmon skin with oil and place 2 fillets skin-side down on each foil rectangle | Cover the grill and cook until skin is light brown and sizzling, 5 to 6 minutes | Slide foil to indirect heat, cover, and cook until all but the top 1/4 inch is cooked, 3 to 8 minutes | Slide back over direct heat, cover, and cook until fish is cooked through and skin is browned and crisp, about 3 minutes | Transfer foil with salmon to a baking sheet and gently free fish from foil using a thin spatula | Season each fillet with salt and a few drops of lemon juice | Serve with cucumber salad

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 cup no-salt-added ketchup, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/4 cup onion (finely diced), 2 tbsp tarragon vinegar, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp Tabasco sauce, 1/4 cup brandy
instructions: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat | Add ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, diced onion, tarragon vinegar, garlic powder, and Tabasco sauce ? mix well | Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally | Add brandy and simmer for a further 5 minutes | Remove from heat and let cool | Serve as a dipping sauce or condiment for grilled meats

ingredients: 1 kg frying chicken pieces, 2 medium onions (chopped), 3 tbsp butter, 2 medium tomatoes (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 1/2 tsp Tabasco sauce, 2 tbsp sweet Hungarian paprika, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1/2 cup sour cream, cooked noodles, macaroni, or spaetzle for serving
instructions: Chop onions and brown them in butter in a large skillet over medium heat until golden | Add chicken pieces and brown on all sides, about 8-10 minutes | Add diced tomatoes and bell pepper | Season with salt, pepper, Tabasco, and paprika ? stir well | Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for half an hour until chicken is tender and cooked through | Remove from heat and stir in sour cream until smooth | Serve hot over macaroni, spaetzle, or egg noodles

ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes (sliced into 1/3-inch-thick fries), 8 tbsp extra virgin olive oil (divided), 1 whole roasting chicken (cut into 8 pieces, skin removed except wings), 1 large egg white, 1 cup breadcrumbs, 1/2 cup whole wheat flour, 1 tbsp Cajun seasoning, 1 tsp paprika, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) and position 2 racks in the upper and lower thirds | Slice potatoes into 1/3-inch-thick fries | Place on a baking sheet and drizzle with 2 tablespoons olive oil ? toss to coat and arrange evenly | Bake in the upper third of the oven until crisp and golden, about 40 minutes | Meanwhile, remove and discard skin from chicken pieces except for the wings | In a large bowl, beat the egg white until frothy | Add chicken pieces and toss to coat | Line a baking sheet with parchment paper | In a medium bowl, mix breadcrumbs, flour, Cajun seasoning, and paprika ? season with salt | Coat chicken pieces with the crumb mixture and transfer to the prepared baking sheet | In a large heavy skillet, heat 3 tablespoons olive oil over medium-high heat | Add 4 chicken pieces and cook, turning once, until golden, about 3 minutes | Transfer to a clean baking sheet and repeat with remaining 3 tablespoons oil and 4 pieces of chicken | On the bottom rack of the oven, bake the chicken until cooked through and crisp, about 22 minutes | Season fries with salt and serve with the chicken

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts (cut into 1-inch cubes), 1/4 cup olive oil, 3 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp dried oregano, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 red onion (cut into chunks), 1 green bell pepper (cut into chunks), pita bread, tzatziki sauce, tomatoes, and lettuce for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper | Add chicken cubes and toss to coat ? cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours | If using wooden skewers, soak in water for 30 minutes | Thread marinated chicken alternately with onion and bell pepper chunks onto skewers | Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat | Grill skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until chicken is golden and cooked through | Serve hot with warm pita bread, tzatziki sauce, sliced tomatoes, and lettuce

ingredients: 4 cups whole milk, 1 cup cake flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 3 tbsp margarine or butter (cold, rubbed into flour), cinnamon sugar for serving
instructions: Sift the flour and salt together into a bowl | Rub in cold margarine or butter with your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs | Bring the milk to a boil in a large saucepan over medium heat | Add the flour mixture to the boiling milk and beat continuously with a whisk | Lumps will form ? keep stirring well | When the mixture is lumpy, cover with a lid and simmer for 5-8 minutes until cooked through | Serve hot in bowls sprinkled generously with cinnamon sugar

ingredients: 5 habanero peppers (stems removed), 1/4 cup dark corn syrup, 2 tbsp yellow mustard, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup white vinegar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp ground cumin, 1/4 tsp cracked black pepper, 1/4 tsp ground coriander, 1/4 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp ground allspice, 1 ripe peach (peeled and diced)
instructions: Place habanero peppers, corn syrup, mustard, brown sugar, vinegar, and diced peach in a blender bowl | Pulse the blender 3-4 times to begin breaking down the ingredients | Add all the measured spices ? paprika, cumin, black pepper, coriander, ginger, allspice, and salt | Blend on high until completely liquefied and smooth | Pour into a quart jar, cover, and refrigerate overnight before using to allow the flavors to meld | Use as a hot sauce for meats, tacos, or eggs

ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp cornstarch, 2 tbsp nutritional yeast, 2 tbsp powdered sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp ground cinnamon (plus extra for dusting), 2 tbsp maple syrup, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 cups soy milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 6 slices bread (stale or fresh), 2 tbsp vegan butter for cooking
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients together thoroughly ? flour, cornstarch, nutritional yeast, powdered sugar, salt, and cinnamon | Add lemon juice to the soy milk and let it sit for 5 minutes to sour (this creates a vegan buttermilk) | Add maple syrup and vanilla to the soured milk mixture | Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and whisk until smooth | Heat a pan to medium and coat with about 1 teaspoon of vegan butter | Soak each slice of bread in the batter for about 1 minute per side | Cook for 1-2 minutes on the first side ? meanwhile, dust the face-up side with extra cinnamon | Flip and cook the other side until golden brown, about 1-2 minutes more | Serve warm with maple syrup

ingredients: 2 cups long grain white rice, 2 cups water, 1 can (355ml) beer, 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1 tbsp dried parsley, 1/2 tsp salt
instructions: Mix rice, water, beer, paprika, onion powder, oregano, parsley, and salt together in a pot | Bring to a boil over high heat | Stir once, cover, and reduce heat to low | Cook for 15 minutes ? do not lift the lid | Turn off the heat and allow to stand for 5 minutes without lifting the lid | Lift the lid and fluff the rice with a fork | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 head raw cauliflower (cut into small florets), 1/2 green bell pepper (diced), 2 tbsp pimiento (diced), 1/4 cup pitted black olives (sliced), 1/4 cup onion (diced), 1 shallot (minced). For marinade: 3 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp sugar, 3 tbsp olive oil
instructions: Whisk all marinade ingredients together ? lemon juice, red wine vinegar, salt, pepper, sugar, and olive oil ? until smooth and emulsified | Place cauliflower florets, diced bell pepper, pimiento, black olives, onion, and shallot in a medium bowl | Pour the marinade over the salad ingredients and toss well to coat | Cover and refrigerate overnight or for at least a few hours to allow the flavors to meld | Serve chilled

ingredients: 1 large napa cabbage, 1/3 cup sea salt (for soaking), 10 tbsp sea salt (for seasoning), 1/2 cup Korean chili powder (gochugaru), 6 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 2 tbsp sugar, 4 green onions (cut into 2-inch pieces), water for soaking
instructions: Wash the napa cabbage thoroughly | In a large bowl, dissolve 1/3 cup salt in enough water to cover the cabbage | Place the cabbage in the salted water and let stand overnight | The next day, squeeze the cabbage gently to remove most of the water | Slice the cabbage into bite-size pieces | Place cabbage slices in a large mixing bowl | Add the 10 tablespoons salt, chili powder, minced garlic, grated ginger, and sugar | Toss gently to combine | Add the green onions and toss until well mixed | Pack the kimchi into a large jar, cover, and leave at room temperature for 1 day | Refrigerate before serving

ingredients: 2 cups rotisserie chicken (shredded), 3 scallions (sliced), 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 1/2 tsp fresh coarse ground black pepper, 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1 lime (zest and juice), 2 tbsp tamari or soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, 3 cups napa cabbage (shredded), 1 tbsp vegetable oil
instructions: In a small saucepan, heat vegetable oil over medium heat | Add sliced scallions, grated ginger, black pepper, and red pepper flakes ? cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant | Whisk in lime zest and lime juice | Then whisk in tamari and honey to combine ? turn off heat | In a large bowl, toss the shredded chicken and shredded cabbage with the warm sauce until well combined | Serve immediately or chilled

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 3 cups cooked white rice, 2 cans (400g each) black beans (drained and rinsed), 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 cup salsa, 1/4 cup fresh cilantro (chopped), 2 green onions (sliced), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat | Saut? diced onion and minced garlic until softened, about 5 minutes | Add cumin and stir for 30 seconds | Add the black beans and salsa ? stir to combine and heat through | Add the cooked rice and mix everything together on the stove until heated through and well combined | Stir in fresh cilantro and green onions | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Serve hot as a side dish or main course

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1 tsp dried rosemary, 1 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 cup orange juice, salt to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Place chicken breasts in a shallow baking pan | Sprinkle diced onion, rosemary, paprika, and pepper over the chicken | In a small bowl, blend flour with orange juice until smooth | Pour the orange juice mixture over the chicken | Bake uncovered for 60 minutes, basting often with the pan juices, until the chicken is cooked through | Serve hot with the pan sauce spooned over the top

ingredients: 2 kg beef short ribs, 2 tbsp kosher salt, 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1 Spanish onion (diced), 2 celery ribs (diced), 2 carrots (diced), 4 cloves garlic, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 cup red wine, 2 cups water, 4 sprigs fresh thyme, 2 bay leaves
instructions: Season each short rib generously with salt | Coat a large heavy pot with olive oil and bring to high heat | Add the short ribs and brown very well, about 2 to 3 minutes per side ? do not overcrowd, cook in batches if necessary | Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | While short ribs are browning, pur?e onion, celery, carrots, and garlic in a food processor until it forms a coarse paste | When short ribs are very brown on all sides, remove them from the pan | Drain the fat, add fresh oil, and add the pur?ed vegetables | Season generously with salt and brown until very dark and a crust forms on the bottom of the pan, about 5 to 7 minutes | Scrape the crust and let it reform ? scrape again and add tomato paste | Brown the tomato paste for 4 to 5 minutes | Add red wine and scrape the bottom of the pan ? reduce the mixture by half | Return short ribs to the pan and add 2 cups water or until the meat is just about covered | Add thyme bundle and bay leaves | Cover and place in the preheated oven for 3 hours | Check periodically and add more water if needed ? turn ribs over halfway through | Remove lid during the last 20 minutes to let the sauce reduce | Serve with the braising liquid

ingredients: 1 medium red cabbage (cored and chopped), 2 red onions (peeled and sliced), 2 apples (peeled, cored, and finely chopped), 1/4 cup red wine vinegar, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 cup red wine, 2 tbsp demerara sugar, salt and black pepper to taste, water as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 170?C (340?F) | Core and chop the red cabbage | Peel and slice the red onions | Peel, core, and finely chop the apples | Combine cabbage, onions, apples, red wine vinegar, cinnamon, red wine, and demerara sugar in a large oven-safe pot | Cover and place in the preheated oven for 1.5 to 2 hours, stirring occasionally | Check to ensure it has enough moisture ? add a small amount of water if needed | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Serve hot

ingredients: 60ml raspberry vodka, 30ml limoncello, 20ml fresh lemon juice, 10ml simple syrup (optional), ice cubes, fresh raspberries and lemon twist for garnish
instructions: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice | Add raspberry vodka, limoncello, fresh lemon juice, and simple syrup if using | Shake vigorously for 15 seconds | Strain into a chilled martini glass | Garnish with fresh raspberries and a lemon twist | Serve immediately

ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles (uncooked), 3 cups tomato pasta sauce, 1 cup water, 2 bay leaves, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 400g firm tofu (crumbled), 2 cups mozzarella cheese (shredded), 1 cup cottage cheese, 1 cup ricotta cheese, 2 tbsp dried parsley, 3 cups fresh spinach, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Bring pasta sauce and water to a boil ? add bay leaves, oregano, salt, and pepper, then reduce heat to a simmer (sauce should still be a little runny when assembling) | While sauce simmers, combine crumbled tofu, mozzarella, cottage cheese, ricotta, and parsley in a large mixing bowl ? stir well | Spray the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch casserole pan with cooking spray and spoon in just enough sauce to cover the bottom | Place a layer of uncooked noodles on top of the sauce | Spread 1/4 of the cheese mixture evenly over the noodles | Sprinkle 1/4 of the spinach over the cheese | Pour 1/4 of the sauce evenly over the top | Repeat layers, ending with sauce, and top with Parmesan cheese | Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake for 1 hour | Let rest for 10 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach (thawed and squeezed dry), 1/2 cup feta cheese (crumbled), 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese (shredded), 3 scallions (sliced), 1 tsp dried dill weed, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 can refrigerated pizza dough, nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) and spray 15 muffin cups with nonstick cooking spray | Roll out pizza dough on a lightly floured surface to a 15 x 9-inch rectangle | Position dough so the long edge runs parallel to the edge of the work surface | Combine spinach, feta, Monterey Jack, green onions, dill, garlic powder, and pepper in a large bowl ? mix well | Sprinkle the spinach mixture over the dough within 1 inch of the long edges | Starting at the long edge, roll up snugly, pinching the seam closed | Place seam-side down and cut the roll with a serrated knife into 1-inch wide slices | Place slices cut-side up into the prepared muffin tins | Cover with plastic wrap and let stand 30 minutes in a warm place until rolls are slightly puffy | Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until golden | Serve warm or at room temperature

ingredients: 1 cup dried black beans (soaked overnight), 1 cup dried white beans (soaked overnight), 1 cup dried kidney beans (soaked overnight), 2 medium onions (diced), 2 medium zucchini (diced), 1 can (400g) tomato pur?e, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 2 tbsp chili powder, 3 cups water, shredded cheddar and rice for serving
instructions: Soak the dried beans in water overnight ? add 1 tsp baking soda to reduce stomach upset | Rinse beans and put in a crock pot | Add diced onions, diced zucchini, tomato pur?e, minced garlic, cumin, cayenne, red pepper flakes, black pepper, and chili powder | Add enough water to cover all contents | Cook on high for at least 8 hours ? can subsequently be turned to low for extended serving | Serve with rice and shredded cheddar cheese

ingredients: 1 cup mascarpone cheese, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 3 tbsp sherry wine, 3 tbsp caster sugar (superfine sugar), 2 cups fresh blackberries, 2 tbsp confectioners sugar, cassis liqueur for drizzling (optional)
instructions: Beat heavy cream, mascarpone, sherry, and caster sugar together until smooth and thick | Divide the mixture between 4 small serving dishes and smooth the tops | Arrange fresh blackberries on top of each dish | Dust lightly with confectioners sugar | Just before serving, drizzle with a fruit liqueur like cassis if desired | Serve chilled

ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 4 large eggs, 3 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup whole milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 tsp almond extract, 1/3 cup poppy seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 300?F (150?C) and grease and flour a loaf pan | Beat butter until very soft and shiny | Add sugar and beat for several minutes until light, fluffy, and whitish in color | In a small bowl, beat eggs and add vanilla and almond extracts | Add egg mixture to butter mixture and beat until fluffy | Alternately add flour and milk, mixing until combined | Stir in poppy seeds | Pour into the prepared loaf pan | Bake for approximately 1 hour and 40 minutes until a long toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean | Cool for 15 minutes before removing from pan

ingredients: 1 cup warm water, 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 3/4 cup warm milk, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp salt, 3 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 large eggs (plus 1 for egg wash), 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour, dates or raisins for decoration
instructions: Place warm water in a large warm bowl | Sprinkle in yeast and stir until dissolved | Add warm milk, butter, sugar, salt, and 2 cups all-purpose flour ? blend well | Stir in 2 eggs, whole wheat flour, and enough remaining all-purpose flour to make a stiff batter | Grease the top, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 2 to 24 hours | Remove from refrigerator and punch dough down | Remove dough to a lightly floured surface and divide into 4 equal portions | Shape 1 portion into a ball for the body ? place on a greased baking sheet and flatten slightly | Divide 1 portion in half ? break off a small piece for the nose and shape remaining into a ball for the head | Attach head to body and add nose | Divide remaining half into 6 pieces and attach as paws and ears | Press date pieces or raisins into dough for eyes and buttons | Repeat with remaining portions | Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 40 to 60 minutes | Beat remaining egg with 1 tablespoon water and brush over dough | Bake at 350?F (175?C) for 25 minutes until golden | Cool on wire racks

ingredients: For streusel: 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup rolled oats, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1/2 tsp cinnamon. For muffins: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp cinnamon, 1/8 tsp salt, 1 large egg, 3 ripe bananas (mashed), 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/3 cup vegetable oil, 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners | Make the streusel: combine brown sugar, flour, oats, melted butter, and cinnamon ? press together with a fork until crumbly and set aside | In a mixing bowl, combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt ? set aside | In another bowl, combine egg, mashed bananas, sugar, and oil ? mix well | Add wet mixture to flour mixture and stir until just moistened | Fold in chopped walnuts | Spoon batter into each muffin cup, about 2/3 full | Top each with streusel topping, enough to cover the batter | Bake for 20-25 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool in the pan for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack

ingredients: 4 slices bacon (diced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1/2 red bell pepper (diced), 1 jalape?o (minced), 2 cans (400g each) baked beans, 1/2 cup pineapple tidbits (drained), 1/4 cup brown sugar, 2 tbsp ketchup, 1 tsp dry mustard
instructions: Saut? bacon pieces in a skillet until crispy ? remove and drain on paper towels | In 1 tablespoon of the bacon grease, saut? diced onion, bell pepper, and jalape?o until tender | In a large mixing bowl, combine beans, pineapple, brown sugar, ketchup, and dry mustard | Stir in the bacon pieces and saut?ed vegetables | Pour into a large cast iron skillet | Place in a 250?F (120?C) smoker for 2 1/2 to 3 hours until hot and smoky | Serve hot

ingredients: 500g beef sirloin (thinly sliced), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 3 cups broccoli florets, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 can (400g) condensed cream of broccoli or mushroom soup, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, steamed rice for serving
instructions: Slice beef into very thin strips | Heat oil in a skillet or wok over high heat | Add beef and stir-fry until browned and cooked through, about 3-4 minutes | Add broccoli florets and minced garlic ? cook until broccoli is tender-crisp, about 3-4 minutes | Add soup, soy sauce, and vinegar ? heat and stir until boiling and well combined | Serve immediately over steamed rice

ingredients: 400g fettuccine pasta, 1 medium zucchini (julienned), 2 carrots (julienned), 3 ripe tomatoes (diced), 1/4 cup black olives (sliced), 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Cook fettuccine according to package directions ? after about 8 minutes of boiling, add julienned zucchini and carrots | Cook 2-4 more minutes until pasta is al dente and vegetables are tender | Meanwhile, combine diced tomatoes, olives, Parmesan cheese, garlic, olive oil, and black pepper in a large serving bowl | Drain pasta and vegetables, then add to the tomato mixture | Toss well to coat everything evenly | Serve warm or at room temperature

ingredients: 4 salmon steaks (about 150g each), 3 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 1 tbsp wasabi paste, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp sesame oil, steamed rice and stir-fried vegetables for serving
instructions: Mix ginger, wasabi paste, soy sauce, mirin, and sesame oil in a zip-lock bag | Add salmon steaks and marinate for 30 minutes | Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) | Place salmon and the marinade in a baking dish | Bake for 12 minutes or until salmon flakes easily with a fork, basting twice with the mixture every 5 minutes | Let rest for 5 minutes after baking | Serve with steamed rice and stir-fried vegetables

ingredients: 2 ripe bananas (peeled), 8 fresh strawberries, 200g chocolate melts or chocolate chips, 1 tsp coconut oil (optional)
instructions: Line an oven tray with baking paper | Place chocolate melts in a microwave-safe bowl ? microwave on medium-low for 1 minute | Remove bowl and stir chocolate, then return to microwave | Repeat cooking and stirring in 30-second intervals until chocolate is fully melted and smooth | Dip fruit into the chocolate to coat about three-quarters of each piece | Place coated fruit on the prepared tray | Refrigerate until set | Serve chilled

ingredients: For dough: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 3 tbsp milk, 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour. For frosting: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 cup confectioners sugar, 1 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, 1-2 tbsp milk
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy | Beat in egg, vanilla, and milk | Sift cocoa powder and flour together | Mix into butter mixture until thoroughly blended | Chill dough until firm enough to handle, about 30 minutes | Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease baking sheets | Using 2 teaspoons of dough, roll a rope about 12 inches long between your hands | Shape into a pretzel: make a loop about 1 1/2 inches in diameter by crossing the ends, leaving 1-inch tails ? flip the loop down over the crossed ends and press firmly | Place pretzels on greased baking sheets | Bake for about 10 minutes | Make the frosting: mix cocoa powder and confectioners sugar, then gradually stir in butter and vanilla ? thin with milk if needed | When pretzels are cool, spread with chocolate frosting

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 2 cans (400g each) condensed cream of chicken soup, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp black pepper, egg noodles or rice for serving
instructions: Place chicken breasts (thawed or frozen) in the crock pot | Cover with condensed soup ? the more soup, the richer the gravy | Add garlic powder and black pepper | Cook on low for 6-8 hours until chicken is tender and cooked through | Serve over egg noodles or rice with the gravy spooned over the top

ingredients: 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp gluten-free vanilla extract, 2 tbsp water, 1/2 cup gluten-free all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease an 8-inch square pan | Mix sugar, cocoa powder, salt, eggs, vanilla, water, and gluten-free flour together in a bowl until there are no lumps | Stir in chocolate chips | Pour into the prepared pan and spread evenly | Bake for 25 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean ? do not overbake | Cool completely before cutting into squares

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup buttermilk, 1 tbsp orange zest, 1 can (400g) whole berry cranberry sauce, 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped). For icing: 1 cup powdered sugar, 2 tbsp milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and coat a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with cooking spray | In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt | Using an electric mixer, beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes | Reduce mixer speed to low and gradually add the flour mixture, mixing just until incorporated | Spread half the batter into the prepared baking dish | Dollop half the can of cranberry sauce over the top and gently spread, swirling it into the batter | Top with remaining batter, then dollop with remaining cranberry sauce | Sprinkle walnuts over the top | Bake until golden brown and a toothpick comes out clean, about 45 to 50 minutes ? let cool for 5 minutes | Make the icing: whisk together powdered sugar and milk until smooth | Drizzle over the warm cake and let cool completely before serving

ingredients: For crust: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted), 1/4 cup granulated sugar. For cake: 1 box white cake mix, 1 cup boiling water, 1 box strawberry gelatin, 1/2 cup vegetable oil, 4 large eggs. For filling: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg. For topping: 1 carton frozen sweetened strawberries (thawed). For frosting: 1 can sweetened condensed milk, 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup sugar, 8 oz whipped topping (thawed)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Make the crust: combine graham cracker crumbs, melted butter, and sugar ? press into a 9 x 13-inch pan | Make the cake: mix together cake mix, boiling water, strawberry gelatin, oil, and eggs ? pour over the crust | Make the filling: beat softened cream cheese, sugar, and egg until smooth ? drop by spoonfuls into the cake mixture and swirl with a knife | Bake for 35-40 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Pour the thawed strawberries over the hot cake | Let cool completely | Make the frosting: beat sweetened condensed milk, cream cheese, and sugar together ? fold in whipped topping | Frost the cooled cake and refrigerate before serving

ingredients: For filling: 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp cornstarch, 2 cups fresh or frozen raspberries, 2 cups fresh or frozen blueberries, 2 cups fresh or frozen blackberries, 1 tbsp lemon juice. For topping: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/3 cup brown sugar, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/4 cup cold butter (cubed), 1/3 cup hot water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) and grease a 4-quart casserole dish | Mix sugar and cornstarch in a Dutch oven | Add berries and lemon juice ? toss until evenly coated | Heat to boiling and boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly | Spoon into the casserole dish | Mix flour, brown sugar, baking powder, salt, and nutmeg in a large bowl | Cut in cold butter until mixture looks like coarse crumbs | Stir in hot water until a soft dough forms | Spoon dough onto the berry mixture | Bake for 35 to 45 minutes until the top is golden brown | Serve warm with whipped cream

ingredients: 4 large corn tortillas, 2 cans (400g each) black beans (drained and rinsed), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 onion (diced), 1 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 cups mozzarella cheese (shredded), 2 cups cabbage (shredded), 1/4 cup fresh cilantro (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 450?F (230?C) | Add salt, pepper, garlic, onion, chili powder, and cumin to the beans ? warm gently in a saucepan | Roughly pur?e the beans in a blender or food processor with a little of the liquid until spreadable | Place tortillas on a baking sheet | Evenly spread each tortilla with the bean mixture, then top with shredded cheese | Bake for 5 minutes, then sprinkle with shredded cabbage and cilantro | Bake another 5 minutes until the topping is hot and the tortilla is crisp on the edges | Cut into wedges and serve immediately

ingredients: 1/2 cup sultanas, 1/2 cup raisins, 1/4 cup glac? ginger (chopped), 1 tbsp orange zest, 1/2 tsp mixed spice, 200g marzipan, 1 cup icing sugar, silver dragees for decoration, 2-3 tbsp orange juice
instructions: Put the sultanas, raisins, glac? ginger, orange zest, and mixed spice in a food processor ? chop finely | Add orange juice if the mixture is a little dry | Divide the mixture into eight and use your hands to shape them into small cakes, about 4cm square | Dust the work surface lightly with icing sugar and roll the marzipan out to a 16cm x 7.5cm rectangle | Cut out eight stars using a 4cm star cutter | Drape one star over each cake | Roll out the icing and do the same, draping the icing in the opposite direction to the marzipan on each cake | Decorate each icing star with six silver dragees | Store in an airtight box until needed

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 1 cup water, 2 cups fresh cranberries, 1/4 cup crystallized ginger (chopped), 1 cup fresh peaches (peeled and diced)
instructions: Stir sugar and 1 cup water in a heavy medium saucepan over high heat until the sugar dissolves and the syrup comes to a boil | Add cranberries and return mixture to a boil | Reduce heat to medium and simmer until cranberries burst and the sauce thickens slightly, about 10 minutes | Remove from heat and stir in chopped crystallized ginger ? let stand for 5 minutes | Mix in diced peaches | Cool completely | Chill at least 2 hours and up to 3 days | Freezes well in an airtight container for up to 3 months | Makes about 3 cups

ingredients: 6 chicken thighs (bone-in, skin-on), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp butter, 1 shallot (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 cup chicken broth, 1/4 cup hot water, 2 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tbsp dried parsley, salt and pepper to taste, steamed rice for serving
instructions: In a large skillet, heat oil and butter together until hot | Add chicken thighs and season with salt and pepper ? cook for about 3-4 minutes, then flip and season other side | Continue cooking on other side for about 3-5 minutes | Remove chicken from the pan onto a plate and reserve | Add another tablespoon of butter, then add diced shallot and minced garlic ? cook for about 2 minutes until shallots are soft and garlic is fragrant | Add chicken broth and hot water, stirring well with the shallots and garlic | Add mirin, fish sauce, oyster sauce, lime juice, lemon juice, and dried parsley ? taste and adjust to preference | Return chicken to the pan, including any juices from the plate | Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes, flipping the chicken a few times to incorporate the sauce | Serve over steamed rice

ingredients: 500g button mushrooms (cleaned and halved if large), 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil, 3 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp fresh parsley leaves (chopped), 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: Combine mushrooms, olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper in a bowl ? toss well | Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours and up to several days, tossing occasionally | Taste and adjust seasoning before serving | Garnish with fresh chopped parsley and serve at room temperature

ingredients: 1/2 cup olive oil, 3 tbsp white vinegar, 1 tsp hot paprika, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp Creole mustard, 2 tbsp celery (finely diced)
instructions: Pur?e all ingredients in a blender until smooth | Chill for at least 1 hour before serving | Serve cold with peel-and-eat shrimp

ingredients: 4 center-cut pork chops, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp butter, 1 medium onion (sliced), 1 apple (peeled and sliced), 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce, 1/4 cup apple juice, 1/2 cup beef broth, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp curry powder, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Season pork chops with salt and pepper ? brown both sides in a skillet with olive oil | Remove chops to a 9 x 13-inch baking dish | In the same skillet, melt butter over medium heat | Cook and stir sliced onions and apples in butter until caramelized, stirring up the browned bits | Stir in applesauce, apple juice, beef broth, minced garlic, and curry powder | Season to taste with salt and pepper ? simmer on low heat until slightly thickened | Pour the apple-onion mixture over the chops in the baking dish and cover with foil | Bake for 45 minutes until the pork is tender | Serve hot

ingredients: 400g wide egg noodles (cooked), 1 can (400g) condensed cream of mushroom soup, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 3 large eggs (separated), 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 tbsp lemon zest, 1/2 cup raisins, 1/4 cup sliced almonds, 1/4 tsp rum extract (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 2-quart shallow baking dish | Stir soup, cream, egg yolks, sugar, lemon zest, and rum extract in a large bowl until smooth | Stir in cooked noodles, raisins, and almonds | Beat egg whites in a large bowl until soft peaks form using an electric mixer at high speed | Gently fold egg whites into the noodle mixture | Spoon into the prepared baking dish | Bake for 40 minutes until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean | Let stand for 5 minutes before serving

ingredients: 4 yellow sweet peppers (quartered, seeds removed), 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp olive oil, 3 cups vegetable broth, 1 medium sweet potato (peeled and diced), 1/4 cup fresh basil (chopped), 1 tbsp white wine vinegar, grape tomatoes and fresh basil for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) | Quarter peppers and remove stems, seeds, and white membranes | Place peppers cut-side down on a foil-lined baking sheet | Roast until skins are blistered and dark, about 20 minutes | Remove from oven, enclose peppers in the foil, and let stand for 15 minutes | Pull skins off the peppers and discard ? set peppers aside | Cook diced onion and minced garlic in olive oil in a medium saucepan for 5 minutes until tender | Stir in roasted peppers, vegetable broth, and diced sweet potato | Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until sweet potato is tender | Cool slightly, then stir in basil and vinegar | Pur?e the soup in a blender in batches until smooth | Return to the saucepan and reheat | Ladle into small heatproof glasses and garnish with skewers threaded with tomato halves and basil leaves

ingredients: 1 kg beef stew meat (cubed), 2 medium potatoes (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 2 red bell peppers (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp chili powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp salt, 2 cups beef broth, warm tortillas for serving
instructions: Combine beef cubes, diced potatoes, onion, bell peppers, and garlic in a large bowl | In a small bowl, mix together flour, chili powder, cumin, and salt | Toss the beef mixture with the flour mixture until evenly coated | Transfer the mixture to a slow cooker and pour in enough beef broth to barely cover the meat ? if short, fill the rest with water | Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until the beef is tender | Serve hot with warm tortillas

ingredients: 12 jumbo shrimp (peeled and deveined, tails on), 12 fresh sage leaves, 12 thin slices pancetta, 2 tbsp olive oil, toothpicks for securing
instructions: Clean and devein shrimp, leaving tails intact | Stuff one sage leaf inside each shrimp (along the deveined cut) | Wrap each shrimp with a slice of pancetta | Secure with a toothpick | Drizzle olive oil over the wrapped shrimp | Grill on a grill pan over medium-high heat for about 4 minutes per side until shrimp is pink and cooked through | Remove toothpicks and serve immediately

ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, 2 1/2 cups water, 2 cans (400g each) black beans (drained and rinsed), 1 cup frozen corn, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes with green chilies, 1/2 cup salsa, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 cup red onion (diced), 1/4 cup black olives (sliced), 1/2 cup Mexican blend cheese (for topping)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | In a large saucepan, bring rice and water to a boil ? reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 35-40 minutes until tender | In a large bowl, combine cooked rice, black beans, corn, diced tomatoes with chilies, salsa, sour cream, cheddar cheese, and pepper | Transfer to a 2 1/2-quart baking dish coated with nonstick spray | Sprinkle diced onion and black olives over the top | Bake uncovered for 30 minutes | Sprinkle Mexican blend cheese over the top and bake 5-10 minutes longer until cheese is melted | Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

ingredients: For filling: 500g ground beef, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 tsp dry mustard, 1/2 cup beef gravy. For pastry: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 3/4 cup lard or shortening, 1 tbsp sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 large egg, 1 tbsp white vinegar, cold water
instructions: Make the filling: melt 2 tablespoons margarine in a skillet and cook diced onion for a few minutes | Add ground beef and cook slowly until all fat is melted ? drain off fat | Add gravy and simmer for 10 minutes | Make the pastry: mix flour, lard, sugar, salt, and baking powder until crumbly | Beat egg in a 1-cup measuring cup, add vinegar, and fill the cup with cold water ? add to the dry mixture | Mix as you would pie dough and roll out | Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Line small foil pie tins (4 1/2 inches across) with pastry | Half-fill with meat mixture and cover with pastry, crimping edges | Bake for 20 minutes until golden brown | Makes 24 pies ? freezes well

ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 cup cold butter (cubed), 3-4 tbsp ice water, 3 cups fresh blackberries, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup butter (for basting), 1/4 cup sugar (for basting), confectioners sugar for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a baking pan | Sift flour, baking powder, and salt into a large bowl ? cut in cold butter until crumbly | Add enough ice water to make a stiff dough | Let stand for a few minutes to rest | Clean blackberries and cover with sugar | Roll dough thinly on a floured board into an oblong sheet | Spread berries over the dough and roll up like a jelly roll | Place in the prepared pan and bake for 30 minutes | Mix basting butter and sugar together ? baste the roll and return to the oven | Continue basting every 5 minutes while the roll bakes an additional 30 minutes | Serve from the baking dish, sprinkled lightly with confectioners sugar

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp dry mustard, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp chipotle chili powder (optional), 1 cup whole milk, 1/2 cup evaporated milk, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/2 cup Asiago cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded), 2 tbsp tomato paste, 400g pasta (cooked al dente), 1 cup frozen peas (thawed)
instructions: In a medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat | Combine flour, dry mustard, chipotle chili powder, salt, and pepper ? whisk into the melted butter and cook for about 1 minute until bubbly | Slowly add evaporated milk, stirring to combine, then add regular milk while stirring | Cook over medium heat until the sauce begins to thicken | Add all three cheeses and reduce heat to low ? cook stirring frequently until the sauce is thick and smooth | Stir in tomato paste | Pour the cheese sauce over cooked pasta | Stir in peas | Serve immediately ? or optionally top with buttered breadcrumbs and bake at 350?F for 10-15 minutes to brown

ingredients: 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 cup whole wheat flour, 1 1/2 cups white bread flour (plus up to 1 cup extra for kneading), 1/4 cup vegetable oil, 1 cup warm water (130?F), melted butter for brushing
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) and grease a baking sheet | Heat oil and water together until warm (about 130?F) ? microwave for 90 seconds works well | Combine yeast, salt, sugar, whole wheat flour, and white flour in a large bowl ? stir until well mixed | Pour the warm water and oil into the flour mixture | Turn the dough onto a floured countertop and knead, adding up to 1 additional cup of flour until the dough is no longer sticky | Cut the dough into 8 pieces and shape into rolls or breadsticks | Brush with water and sprinkle with desired toppings | Bake for 20-25 minutes until rolls are browned and the crust is crunchy (10-15 minutes for breadsticks) | Serve hot with butter

ingredients: 3 cups cooked rice (cooled), 1 cup cooked ham (diced), 1/2 cup small cooked shrimp, 1/2 cup celery (diced), 2 green onions (sliced), 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp curry powder, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp celery seed, 1 tbsp white sugar, 1/2 tsp accent seasoning (MSG), 1/2 cup frozen peas (thawed), 1/4 cup vegetable oil
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions, being careful not to overcook ? both minute rice and long grain work well | In a large bowl, toss together cooled rice, ham, shrimp, celery, green onions, and peas | Refrigerate long enough to let the peas thaw completely | In a separate bowl, whisk together soy sauce, curry powder, vinegar, salt, celery seed, sugar, accent seasoning, and vegetable oil ? let the dressing sit for at least 1 hour at room temperature | Stir dressing well and pour over the salad just before serving ? toss well to combine | Serve cold

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp chili powder, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp sugar, 1 can (400g) tomato sauce, 1 cup water, 2 cans (400g each) dark red kidney beans (1 can blended into paste, 1 can drained), 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, sour cream, and Fritos for serving
instructions: Brown ground beef, diced onion, and minced garlic in a large pot over medium-high heat ? drain excess fat | In a blender, pur?e one can of kidney beans with a splash of water to make a paste | Return the beef mixture to the pot and add the bean paste, remaining whole kidney beans, chili powder, flour, salt, cumin, sugar, tomato sauce, water, and diced tomatoes | Stir well and simmer for at least 30 minutes, preferably 1 hour | Serve hot with shredded cheese, sour cream, Fritos, and diced onion on top

ingredients: 6 flour tortillas, 4 hot dogs (sliced into thin rounds), 1 1/2 cups shredded cheese (cheddar or Mexican blend), 3 tsp fresh chives (chopped), 1/2 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 2 tsp vegetable oil, salsa and sour cream for serving
instructions: Place 3 tortillas on a work surface | Divide cheese and hot dog slices evenly among the tortillas | Sprinkle each portion with chives, a large pinch of chili powder, and a pinch of cumin | Top each with the remaining tortillas | In a medium skillet, heat 1 teaspoon oil over medium heat | Place 1 quesadilla in the pan, then rest a small plate on top to weigh it down ? cook for about 2 minutes until golden underneath | Remove plate, flip quesadilla, weigh down with plate, and cook until cheese is melted and tortilla is crisp, about 2 minutes | Keep warm and repeat with remaining quesadillas | Cut each into 4 wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream

ingredients: 8 fresh peaches (peeled, pitted, and finely chopped), 2 cups granulated sugar, 1/2 cup peach nectar, 1/3 cup cider vinegar, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 habanero pepper (minced), 1/2 tsp salt, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 cup fresh raspberries
instructions: Wash, peel, and pit fresh peaches | Place half the peaches in a food processor or blender ? process until very finely chopped | Transfer to a 6-quart saucepan and repeat with remaining peaches | Add sugar, peach nectar, vinegar, lemon juice, habanero pepper, salt, and garlic to the pot | Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes until desired consistency, stirring occasionally | Remove from heat and stir in raspberries | Ladle hot sauce into prepared jars leaving 1/4-inch headspace | Process in a boiling water bath for 15 minutes | Serve with broiled, roasted, or grilled poultry, pork, or ham

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 1 ring smoked sausage (sliced), 3 medium new potatoes (cubed), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 red bell pepper (diced), 1 small head green cabbage (quartered and separated), 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper
instructions: In a very large skillet, place ground beef and sliced sausage | Top with cubed potatoes, diced bell pepper, diced onion, salt, and pepper | Quarter the cabbage and separate the leaves ? place on top of the other ingredients | Cover and cook over medium heat for about 30-40 minutes ? do not lift the lid for 30 minutes | Test potatoes for doneness ? add more time if needed | The drippings from the sausage and beef will steam and flavor the vegetables | Use a large slotted spoon to serve

ingredients: 1 cup ricotta cheese, 2 large eggs, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, vegetable oil for frying, powdered sugar for dusting
instructions: Mix ricotta, eggs, sugar, salt, and vanilla together in a bowl until smooth | Slowly incorporate the flour, mixing until a soft dough forms | Pick up small portions of dough and form into doughnut shapes | Heat vegetable oil in a deep pot to 350?F (175?C) | Fry doughnuts in batches until golden brown on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side | Drain on paper towels | Dust generously with powdered sugar and serve warm

ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter (melted), 2 cups granulated sugar, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, 4 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup pecans (chopped), 1/4 tsp salt, 2 cups mini marshmallows, 1 can chocolate frosting
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan in the oven | Mix sugar, flour, cocoa powder, eggs, vanilla, pecans, and salt together in a bowl | Add melted butter and stir well | Pour batter into the same 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 30 minutes | When done, place mini marshmallows on top of hot brownies about 2 inches apart and return to the oven until marshmallows are melted | Remove from oven and immediately spread frosting over the top, blending with the melted marshmallows until smooth | Cool before cutting into squares

ingredients: 2 large eggs, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/3 cup vegetable oil, 1 cup unsweetened applesauce, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup raisins, brown sugar for topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) and prepare muffin pans with paper liners | Beat eggs slightly, then add sugar, oil, and applesauce ? beat thoroughly | Add flour, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda, and salt ? blend until just combined | Stir in raisins | Spoon batter into prepared pans and sprinkle with brown sugar | Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool for 5 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1 can (400g) Rotel tomatoes with chilies, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes with basil, oregano, and garlic, 1/2 medium onion (roughly chopped), 1/2 green bell pepper (roughly chopped), fresh cilantro for garnish
instructions: Finely chop the onion and green pepper | Combine all ingredients in a blender | Blend on the slowest setting just to mix them together ? do not overblend | Transfer to a serving bowl and garnish with fresh cilantro | Serve with tortilla chips

ingredients: 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (very cold, cubed), 1/4 tsp salt, 3-4 tbsp ice water
instructions: Measure flour into a food processor with the regular blade attached | Add very cold cubed butter and salt | Pulse three times with three counts per pulse to lightly mix the ingredients | With the motor running, pour ice water into the work bowl just until the dough starts to get noticeably crumbly ? do not wait until it forms a clump | Stop the machine, dump the crumbly dough into a bowl, and gather into a ball with your hands ? squeeze a bit to make it stick together | If it won't form a ball, add a tiny bit more water | Wrap the dough ball in plastic wrap and chill for about 30 minutes | Roll out on a cool surface and follow your pie recipe for baking

ingredients: 1/2 cup water, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup light corn syrup, 100g unsweetened chocolate (chopped), 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: In a saucepan over low heat, melt chocolate with water ? stir for 2 minutes until thick | Remove from heat and gradually add sugar, corn syrup, and salt | Return to heat and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring often | Remove from heat and stir in vanilla | Serve hot or cold over ice cream

ingredients: 1/2 cup feta cheese (crumbled), 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tbsp fresh dill (chopped), 2 scallions (sliced), 1 can refrigerated biscuits (10 count), nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | In a small serving bowl, combine feta, lemon juice, dill, and scallions ? set aside | Spray ten 2-inch diameter muffin pan cups with nonstick cooking spray | Separate each biscuit into 2 thin layers of dough | Arrange 1 layer in the bottom of each sprayed cup, reserving the remaining layers | Place 1/10 of the cheese mixture over each biscuit in the cup | Top each with the remaining biscuit layer and press around the edges to seal | Bake until biscuits are golden brown, about 8 to 10 minutes | Remove to a wire rack and let cool

ingredients: 500g beef chuck (cubed), 6 cups water, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 parsnip (diced), 1 carrot (diced), 1 leek (sliced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 2 medium potatoes (cubed), 2 cups sorrel (chopped), 2 cups fresh spinach, 1 tsp sugar (if needed), sour cream for serving
instructions: Place beef in a large pot or Dutch oven | Add water, beef base, salt, and pepper | Cover, bring to a boil, and simmer for 1 hour | Add parsnip, carrot, leek, celery, and potatoes | Cover and simmer 30 minutes more until the meat is tender | Add sorrel and spinach and simmer until greens are tender, about 5-10 minutes | Taste and add sugar if it's too sour | Ladle into soup bowls and garnish with a dollop of sour cream

ingredients: 4 medium potatoes (boiled until tender, cooled, peeled, and cubed), 4 slices bacon (diced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1 tsp seasoning salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender ? allow to cool, then peel and cube them, set aside | Fry diced bacon and onion together in a large skillet over medium heat until bacon is crispy | Add cubed potatoes and seasonings ? cook until golden brown, stirring occasionally | Serve hot as a breakfast side

ingredients: 500g boneless skinless chicken breasts (cut into strips), 1 tsp chicken bouillon granules, 1/2 tsp dry mustard, 1/2 cup boiling water, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp paprika (plus extra for garnish)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Dissolve chicken bouillon granules and dry mustard in boiling water | Add minced garlic, Worcestershire sauce, oregano, and paprika ? stir well | Place chicken strips in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish | Pour the herb mixture over the chicken | Bake uncovered for 30-35 minutes until chicken is tender and cooked through | Drain excess liquid | Sprinkle with additional paprika before serving

ingredients: 2 slices bread, 2 tbsp Dijon mustard, 1 tbsp mayonnaise, 150g sliced turkey, 2 tbsp cranberry sauce, 1/4 cup alfalfa sprouts, 2 slices provolone cheese
instructions: Spread Dijon mustard on one slice of bread and mayonnaise on the other | Layer turkey generously on one slice, then top with cranberry sauce, alfalfa sprouts, and provolone cheese | Close with the other slice of bread | Slice in half and serve

ingredients: 1/4 cup granulated sugar (for topping), 1/4 cup chopped nuts, 2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 cup sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 180?C (350?F) and grease a 23cm square cake tin ? line with paper | Mix 1/4 cup sugar with chopped nuts and cinnamon ? set aside | Cream butter with the remaining 1 cup sugar until light and fluffy | Add eggs, vanilla, and lemon juice ? beat well | Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt together in a bowl | Add the flour mixture and sour cream to the butter mixture in alternating additions, beating lightly | Pour batter into the prepared pan and sprinkle with the reserved cinnamon-nut mixture | Bake for 35-40 minutes until a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean | Let sit in the pan for 10-15 minutes before turning out onto a cooling rack

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 3 ripe tomatoes (diced), 1/4 cup black olives (sliced), 1/2 cup feta cheese (crumbled), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 2 tbsp fresh basil (chopped), 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: Mix olive oil, minced garlic, diced tomatoes, black olives, crumbled feta, parsley, basil, and black pepper together in a small bowl | Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes to allow flavors to meld | Serve as a relish alongside grilled meats or on crusty bread

ingredients: For dressing: 1/2 cup vegetable oil, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 packet ramen noodle seasoning. For salad: 3 cups coleslaw mix, 1 package ramen noodles (crushed), 1 can (300g) mandarin oranges (drained), 1/4 cup sunflower seeds or sliced almonds, 2 green onions (sliced)
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together oil, vinegar, sugar, salt, and the seasoning packet from the ramen noodles to make the dressing | Add coleslaw mix, crushed ramen noodles, mandarin oranges, sunflower seeds, and green onions | Mix well until everything is coated | Serve immediately for maximum crunch

ingredients: 400g gemelli pasta, 2 cups sugar snap peas, 1 tbsp fresh tarragon (chopped), 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, 1 cup ricotta cheese, 1 tbsp lemon zest, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp olive oil
instructions: Cook gemelli pasta according to package directions | During the last 2 minutes of cooking, add the sugar snap peas to the pasta water | Drain, reserving 1/2 cup of the pasta water | Return pasta and peas to the pot | Add tarragon, salt, ricotta cheese, lemon zest, lemon juice, and olive oil ? toss gently to coat | Stir in just enough of the reserved pasta water to create a creamy sauce | Serve immediately

ingredients: For cake: 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1 large egg, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 2 ripe bananas (mashed), 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp baking soda. For frosting: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 2 cups confectioners sugar, 3 tbsp heavy cream, 1 tsp vanilla bean paste or extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) or 350?F if using a glass pan ? grease an 8 x 8-inch pan | Cream together sugar, sour cream, egg, and softened butter | Add mashed bananas and vanilla ? mix well | Add flour, salt, and baking soda ? mix until just combined | Pour into the prepared pan and bake for 20-25 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool completely before frosting | Make the frosting: cream butter and confectioners sugar together until smooth | Slowly add heavy cream, stirring until smooth | Stir in vanilla bean paste | Spread over the cooled cake

ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce (chopped), 1 cup celery (diced), 1 cup frozen peas (thawed and drained), 1 cup Miracle Whip or mayonnaise, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/4 cup bacon bits
instructions: Drain peas on paper towels or a strainer | Place chopped lettuce in the bottom of a large bowl | Layer diced celery and peas over the lettuce | Spread Miracle Whip about 1/4 inch thick over the peas and celery | Sprinkle sugar and cheddar cheese over the Miracle Whip | Top with Parmesan cheese and bacon bits | Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve ? do not toss

ingredients: 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup ketchup, 2 tbsp white vinegar, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1/4 cup onion (diced), 1/4 cup cold water, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: Combine all sauce ingredients in a saucepan ? brown sugar, ketchup, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, chili powder, garlic powder, minced garlic, onion, water, salt, and pepper | Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally | Pour over chops, wings, or ribs | Bake at 350?F (175?C) for 75 to 90 minutes until meat is tender and thoroughly cooked, basting occasionally and turning at least once | Skim excess fat before serving

ingredients: 1 unbaked 9-inch pie shell, 1 1/2 cups whole milk, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 cup sweetened shredded coconut, 3 large eggs, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and prepare the pastry shell in a pie plate | In a large bowl, combine milk, sugar, coconut, eggs, flour, melted butter, and vanilla ? stir until well combined | Pour into the prepared pie shell | Bake for 50 minutes until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean | Cool to room temperature | Refrigerate leftovers

ingredients: 4 large russet potatoes (peeled and cubed), 1/2 cup whole milk, 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese (shredded, divided), 1/2 cup silken tofu (blended until smooth), 1/2 cup sour cream, 4 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Boil potatoes until tender, then drain and mash | Add milk, blended tofu, sour cream, salt, and pepper ? mix until smooth and creamy | Stir in crumbled bacon and 1 cup of the shredded cheese | Transfer to a greased casserole dish | Top with the remaining 1/2 cup cheese | Bake for 20-30 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly | Serve hot

ingredients: 3 large eggs, 1 cup light brown sugar, 1/2 cup plain yogurt, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp pumpkin pie spice, 1 1/2 cups gluten-free baking mix, 1 cup sweetened flaked coconut, 1 1/2 cups carrots (grated), 1/4 cup golden raisins, 1/4 cup pecans (chopped). For frosting: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/4 cup butter (softened), 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 cups powdered sugar, 1 tsp lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 9-inch springform cake pan | In a mixing bowl, beat eggs ? add brown sugar and beat until smooth | Beat in yogurt, vanilla, cinnamon, and pumpkin pie spice | Add baking mix and beat until combined | Stir in coconut, grated carrots, raisins, and pecans with a wooden spoon | Spread batter evenly in the cake pan | Bake until the cake is firm and a wooden pick inserted into the center comes out clean, about 40-45 minutes | Cool on a wire rack | Make the frosting: beat cream cheese and butter until fluffy, add vanilla, then gradually add powdered sugar ? squeeze in lemon juice and beat until smooth | Frost the cooled cake

ingredients: 1/2 cup teriyaki sauce, 2 tbsp pineapple juice, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts (cut into chunks), 200g large shrimp (peeled and deveined), 1 cup pineapple chunks, 1 cup grape tomatoes, 1 red bell pepper (cut into chunks), 1 green bell pepper (cut into chunks), bamboo skewers (soaked in water)
instructions: Combine teriyaki sauce, pineapple juice, and oil ? pour over chicken and shrimp in a shallow glass dish | Refrigerate and marinate for 1 hour, turning occasionally | Thread meat onto skewers, alternating with pineapple chunks, tomatoes, and bell peppers | Discard the remaining marinade | Grill 4 to 5 inches from heat, turning skewers and brushing with additional fresh teriyaki sauce, about 15 minutes until cooked through | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (cold, cubed), 1 large egg yolk, 3 tbsp ice water
instructions: Sift flour with salt into a bowl | With a pastry blender or fingertips, blend cold butter into the flour mixture until crumbly | Stir in egg yolk and ice water | Form the pastry into a ball, wrap in wax paper, and chill for 2 hours | Knead the pastry for 1 minute until it holds together | Roll out on a lightly floured board and fit into a 9-inch pie plate | Use as directed in your pie recipe

ingredients: 4 sirloin steaks (about 200g each), 2 tbsp butter, 1 tbsp vegetable oil, 1/4 cup Irish whiskey, 1 cup heavy cream, 1 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1/2 tsp sea salt
instructions: Dry the steaks with paper towels and season generously with black pepper | Heat butter and oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat | Add steaks and cook to your preferred doneness, turning once halfway through | Remove steaks to a warm plate and pour off the fat from the pan | Return the pan to the stove and add whiskey ? stir, scraping up the drippings from the bottom | Reduce heat and add heavy cream | Simmer for a few minutes until the cream thickens | Season sauce with salt and pepper | Pour the sauce over the steaks and serve immediately

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth, 4 cloves garlic (thinly sliced), 2 tbsp fresh thyme (divided), 1/2 tsp sea salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1 kg Yukon Gold potatoes (peeled and very thinly sliced), 2 leeks (white and light green parts only, cleaned and thinly sliced), cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Place broth in a large saucepan with garlic, 1 1/2 teaspoons thyme, salt, and pepper | Trim the dark green parts off the leeks and discard ? split the white and light green parts lengthwise and rinse thoroughly to remove all dirt, then slice into thin half-discs | Add leeks and thinly sliced potatoes to the seasoned broth | Heat contents of the saucepan to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce to a simmer | Cook until potatoes are tooth-tender, about 5 minutes | Divide the mixture among 6 individual gratin dishes, pressing down to level | Garnish with remaining thyme | Set dishes on a baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes | Apply a quick spray of cooking spray to the tops and cook an additional 10 minutes until potatoes are done and tops are crispy golden brown | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 cup Old English sharp cheddar cheese spread, 200g crabmeat (drained and picked), 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 1/4 tsp salt, 3 English muffins (halved)
instructions: Mix cheese spread, crabmeat, garlic powder, butter, and salt together in a bowl | Spread the mixture over the 6 English muffin halves | Place coated muffins in the freezer until firm, about 30 minutes | Cut each muffin half into 12 approximately equal pieces | To cook: cover a cookie sheet with aluminum foil and place the pieces cheese-side up | Broil for 10-15 minutes until the top is brown and bubbly | Serve immediately

ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/3 cup granulated sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 large egg, 3/4 cup whole milk, 1/4 cup vegetable oil. Add-ins: 3/4 cup blueberries, 3/4 cup mashed banana, 3/4 cup chocolate chips, streusel topping (3 tbsp flour, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 1/4 tsp cinnamon, 2 tbsp butter)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) and grease a muffin pan or line with paper bake cups | In a medium bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt ? make a well in the center | In another bowl, combine egg, milk, and oil | Add egg mixture all at once to the flour mixture ? stir just until moistened | Stir in your choice of add-in: blueberries, mashed banana (reduce milk to 1/2 cup), or chocolate chips | Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups | If desired, sprinkle streusel topping over the batter | Bake for 18 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup raisins, 1/2 cup muesli, 1/2 cup wheat bran, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 cup plain yogurt, 1/2 cup milk, 1/4 cup vegetable oil, 2 tbsp molasses, 2 tbsp rolled oats (for topping)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) and grease or line a muffin tin | In a large bowl, mix together flour, raisins, muesli, bran, brown sugar, baking soda, and salt | In a separate bowl, whisk together yogurt, milk, oil, and molasses | Stir the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix just until moistened | Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups, filling to the top | Sprinkle rolled oats over each muffin | Bake for 20 minutes until the tops are firm to the touch | Cool for 5 minutes before serving

ingredients: 4 cups romaine lettuce (chopped), 1/2 cup shredded Parmesan or similar cheese, 1 cup croutons, 1/4 cup Caesar or Italian dressing
instructions: Chill salad plates in the freezer | Place chopped lettuce in a large bowl | Add cheese, croutons, and salad dressing | Toss well to combine | Serve on the chilled plates

ingredients: For mango mayonnaise: 1 ripe mango (diced), 2 egg yolks, 1 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1/2 tsp mustard powder, 1/2 cup vegetable oil, salt and pepper. For skewers: 500g large prawns (peeled and deveined), 2 stalks lemongrass (finely chopped), 4 kaffir lime leaves (finely sliced), 1 tbsp palm sugar, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated)
instructions: Make the mango mayonnaise: place mango, egg yolks, lime juice, and mustard powder in a food processor ? process until smooth | With the motor running, gradually add oil in a thin steady stream until the mixture is pale and creamy | Season with salt and pepper and refrigerate | Combine prawns, lemongrass, lime leaves, sugar, garlic, and ginger in a glass bowl | Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours to marinate | Thread prawns tail-end first onto pre-soaked bamboo skewers | Preheat a barbecue or chargrill to medium | Cook prawn skewers for 1-2 minutes each side until prawns change colour | Serve immediately with the mango mayonnaise

ingredients: 3 cups rolled oats, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/4 tsp sea salt, 1/2 cup honey, 1/4 cup coconut oil, 2 tbsp almond butter, 1/2 tsp stevia or 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup sliced almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper | Mix oats, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt in a large bowl | In a small pot over low-medium heat, combine honey, coconut oil, almond butter, stevia, and vanilla ? heat until thoroughly combined | Pour the liquid mixture over the dry ingredients and stir until everything is moist | Spread evenly over the parchment-lined baking sheet | Bake for 25-30 minutes to desired crunchiness, breaking up with a spatula halfway through | Remove from oven ? the granola will harden and become more crunchy as it cools | Serve with milk or yogurt

ingredients: 1 bay leaf, 1 tbsp dried parsley flakes, 1 tsp seasoning salt, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp celery seed, 1/2 tsp instant minced garlic, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 450g dried kidney beans (soaked overnight), 2 cups long grain rice, 3 cups water, 2 smoked ham hocks, 200g smoked sausage (sliced), 1 tsp salt, fresh parsley for garnish
instructions: Combine the first 10 seasoning ingredients and set aside | Drain soaked beans and place in a Dutch oven | Add water to cover by 2 inches, bring to a boil, and boil for 2 minutes | Remove from heat and let stand for 1 hour | Drain beans and return to the pan | Add seasoning mix, 2 1/2 cups water, and ham hocks | Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours | Remove ham hocks, cut meat into bite-sized pieces, and return to the pan | Add sliced sausage, cover, and simmer 30-40 minutes until beans are tender | Meanwhile, combine rice, salt, and remaining water in a saucepan ? bring to a boil, cover, and simmer 20 minutes | Spoon rice into bowls and top with bean mixture ? garnish with parsley

ingredients: 2 tbsp butter or olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 shallots (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 1 kg carrots (peeled and chopped), 2 tbsp tomato paste, 4 cups chicken or vegetable stock, 1 can (400ml) coconut cream, 1 tsp fresh lemon juice, salt and black pepper to taste, fresh parsley for garnish
instructions: Saut? diced onion and shallots in butter or olive oil over medium heat for 2 minutes | Add grated ginger and minced garlic ? saut? on low for an additional 2 minutes until translucent, not browned | Add chopped carrots and tomato paste ? mix well and saut? 1-2 minutes on low | Deglaze the pan with chicken or vegetable stock | Bring to a simmer and cook on medium-high to reduce liquids by about a third, about 25 minutes ? do not overcook | Carrots should be fork-tender | Transfer to a bowl and blend with an immersion blender or stand blender until smooth and thick | Add coconut cream and continue to blend | Return to the pot and reduce to desired thickness | Adjust salt and pepper to taste ? add lemon juice | Serve hot with sprinkled parsley on top

ingredients: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 200g porcini mushrooms (sliced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh Italian parsley (chopped), 1/2 cup dry white wine, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 400g dry penne pasta, 1/2 cup Parmigiano Reggiano cheese (grated, plus extra for serving), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat | Saut? sliced porcini mushrooms with garlic and parsley until tender, about 5 minutes ? season with salt and pepper | Add white wine and let it simmer until the wine evaporates, about 5-8 minutes | Add diced tomatoes and cook for 5 to 7 minutes (if using reconstituted dried porcini, add the reserved soaking liquid now) | Meanwhile, boil penne until al dente | Drain pasta and add to the sauce together with the grated Parmigiano | Let cook for 2 minutes at low heat | Taste and adjust seasoning | Serve piping hot with extra cheese on the side

ingredients: 1/3 cup barbecue sauce, 1 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tsp cider vinegar, 1 chipotle chili in adobo (minced), 2 large portobello mushroom caps (gills removed, diced), 2 tbsp canola oil (divided), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 4 whole wheat tortillas, 3/4 cup Monterey Jack cheese (shredded)
instructions: Combine barbecue sauce, tomato paste, vinegar, and chipotle in a medium bowl | Gently scrape off and discard the gills from the mushroom caps ? dice the caps | Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat | Add mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes | Add onion and cook until mushrooms and onion are beginning to brown, 5-7 minutes | Transfer to the bowl with the barbecue sauce ? stir to combine and wipe out the skillet | Place tortillas on a work surface ? spread cheese on half of each tortilla and top with 1/4 of the filling | Fold tortillas in half, pressing gently | Heat 1 teaspoon oil in the pan over medium heat ? add 2 quesadillas and cook, turning once, until golden on both sides, 3-4 minutes total | Repeat with remaining quesadillas | Cut into wedges and serve

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups white flour, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 1 large egg, 1/2 cup hot water, 1/4 cup raspberry jam, 3-4 fresh peaches (peeled and quartered). For syrup: 1 orange (juiced), 1/2 cup sugar, 1/2 cup water
instructions: Grease a 9-inch cake pan | Combine flour, sugar, salt, and yeast in a mixer bowl | Add softened butter and beat together for 2 minutes | Add the egg while the mixer is running, then slowly add the hot water | You'll have a very sticky dough ? use oil spray on your hands to press the dough into the bottom of the prepared pan, stretching to cover | Spread raspberry jam evenly on top of the cake | Arrange peach quarters on top, pressing lightly | Cover with plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour | Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) ? remove plastic wrap and bake for 25 minutes | While the cake bakes, juice the orange into a small saucepan ? add sugar and water, stir well, and cook over medium heat to reduce for 7 minutes | Remove cake from oven and brush the syrup mixture generously over the hot cake | Let cool for at least 30-45 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1 quart praline ice cream (softened), 1 prepared graham cracker or chocolate cookie crust, 1/4 cup caramel topping, 1/2 cup pecans (toasted in butter until aromatic), extra pecans for garnish
instructions: Allow ice cream to sit at room temperature just long enough to soften ? do not let it melt | Spread the softened ice cream evenly into the crust | Top with caramel topping and toasted pecans | For extra rich flavor, toast pecans in real butter until they become aromatic and slightly roasted | Freeze until firm, at least 2 hours | Slice and serve

ingredients: 3 large sweet potatoes (peeled and cubed), 1 Spanish onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 cup pecan halves, 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) | In a large bowl, combine sweet potatoes, diced onion, minced garlic, olive oil, and thyme ? toss well to coat | Pour vegetables into a shallow roasting or jelly roll pan | Bake, turning frequently, for about 40 to 45 minutes until vegetables are soft and golden brown | Add pecan halves during the last 10 minutes of roasting | Remove from oven and drizzle with balsamic vinegar | Season with salt and pepper and serve hot

ingredients: 2 1/4 cups warm water (110?F), 1/4 cup molasses, 3 tsp active dry yeast, 1 cup whole wheat flour, 1/2 cup semolina flour, 2 cups bread flour (plus extra as needed), 2 tbsp vital wheat gluten, 1/2 cup rolled oats, 2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp ground flax seeds, 2 tbsp whole flax seeds, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted)
