instructions: In a 4-cup measure, combine warm water, molasses, and yeast ? let proof for 5-10 minutes until foamy | In a large mixing bowl, combine whole wheat flour, semolina, bread flour, vital wheat gluten, rolled oats, salt, and flax seeds ? stir dry ingredients together well | Whisk melted butter into the proofed yeast mixture | Add wet ingredients to dry and stir until dough is shaggy ? add more bread flour if too wet, or a bit of water if too dry | Knead with a dough hook for about 7 minutes (10 minutes by hand) | Turn dough onto a floured board and knead by hand for a couple of minutes until elastic and not sticky | Place in a large buttered bowl, cover with a damp tea towel, and let rise in the oven with the light on for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until doubled | Punch down, divide in half, and form into two loaves | Let rise covered in the oven with the light on for 1 hour until doubled | Bake at 375?F (190?C) for 30 minutes until the loaves sound hollow when tapped | Remove from pans and cool on a rack

ingredients: 1.5 kg boneless pork roast, 2 tbsp fennel seed, 1 tsp lemon pepper, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) | Combine fennel seed, lemon pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, oregano, and salt together | Coat the roast evenly with the seasoning mixture | Place in a shallow roasting pan | Roast for 45 minutes to 1 hour until a meat thermometer reads 155?F (68?C) | Let the roast rest for 5 to 10 minutes before carving | Slice and serve

ingredients: 500g fresh green beans (trimmed), 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sugar, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, olive oil cooking spray, 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat | Combine soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and white pepper in a small bowl ? stir until sugar dissolves | Spray the pan with olive oil and add green beans | Saut? until bright green and brown in spots, about 10 minutes | Add minced garlic and red pepper flakes ? saut? for another minute | Add the soy sauce mixture and cook until reduced and the beans are glazed | Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and serve immediately

ingredients: 2 cans (200g each) tuna (drained and flaked), 2 hard-boiled eggs (chopped), 1/4 cup mayonnaise, 1 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh basil (chopped), 1/4 tsp onion powder, 8 slices bread (toasted), 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded)
instructions: In a small bowl, combine tuna, chopped eggs, mayonnaise, chives, parsley, basil, and onion powder ? mix well | Place 4 slices of toast on an ungreased baking sheet | Top with the tuna mixture and sprinkle with shredded cheese | Broil 3-4 inches from the heat for 1-2 minutes until cheese is melted | Remove from oven and top with the remaining 4 slices of toast | Serve immediately

ingredients: 500g asparagus spears (trimmed), 2 ripe tomatoes (halved, seeded, and diced), 1/4 cup olive oil, 2 tbsp white wine vinegar, 1 tbsp honey, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Bring 1 inch of water to a boil in a large pan ? generously salt the water | Add asparagus and cook until tender, about 3 to 5 minutes | While water is coming to a boil, cut tomatoes in half, squeeze out seeds, discard, and coarsely chop | In a small saucepan, heat olive oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper ? add chopped tomatoes and heat throughout so flavors meld, about 10 minutes | Drain asparagus, arrange on a platter, and top with the warm tomato mixture | Serve immediately

ingredients: For sauce: 1/2 cup fresh tarragon leaves, 1/3 cup fresh chives (chopped), 1 shallot (roughly chopped), 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard. For salmon: 1/2 cup dry white wine, 1 cup water, 6 salmon fillets (skin-on, about 150g each), salt and pepper. For serving: 200g fingerling potatoes (very thinly sliced), 1 cup sugar snap peas
instructions: Make the sauce: pur?e tarragon, chives, shallot, parsley, mayonnaise, vinegar, and mustard in a food processor until smooth ? season with salt and pepper | Refrigerate until needed, then bring to cool room temperature before serving | In a deep 10-inch skillet, bring wine and water to a simmer, covered | Cut salmon into 6 pieces and season with salt and pepper | Submerge 3 salmon pieces skin-side down in the simmering liquid ? add hot water if necessary to just cover | Poach at a bare simmer, covered, for 8 minutes until just cooked through | Transfer to a platter and repeat with remaining salmon | When cool enough, peel off the skin | Steam the thinly sliced potatoes until just tender, about 4 to 5 minutes | Spoon sauce onto 6 plates and arrange potatoes in a circle on top | Season potatoes with salt and arrange salmon on top | Garnish with sugar snap peas and serve

ingredients: 4 cups fresh or frozen blueberries, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1/2 cup water, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1 tbsp lemon zest, 3 tbsp cold unsalted butter (cubed), 1/2 cup whole milk, vanilla ice cream for serving
instructions: Combine blueberries, granulated sugar, brown sugar, lemon juice, and water in a large saucepan | Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer | Simmer for 5-10 minutes until the blueberries release their juices | Meanwhile, combine flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, and lemon zest in a bowl ? mix well | Cut in the cold butter until the mixture is crumbly and incorporated throughout | Stir in milk all at once and mix until just combined | Drop the dumpling mixture by spoonfuls into the simmering blueberry mixture (approximately 6 dumplings) | Cover and simmer for 15 minutes ? do not lift the lid during this time | Using a large spoon, transfer dumplings to bowls and cover with blueberry sauce | Serve warm with vanilla ice cream

ingredients: 12 large white mushrooms (stems removed, stems finely chopped), 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 2 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tbsp onion (finely diced), 1/2 tsp Tabasco sauce, 2 tbsp celery (finely diced), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/4 cup crabmeat (optional), salt to taste, water for baking dish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Remove stems from mushrooms and wipe the caps clean | Arrange caps upside down in a single layer in a glass baking dish | Rinse and finely chop the mushroom stems | In a mixing bowl, combine chopped stems with crabmeat (if using), diced onion, softened cream cheese, mayonnaise, and Tabasco | Add diced celery if desired | Salt to taste | Fill each mushroom cap generously with the mixture | Add enough water to cover the bottom of the baking dish | Sprinkle each cap with Parmesan cheese | Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until hot through and the cheese has browned | Serve immediately

ingredients: For muffins: 1 large egg, 1/2 cup low-fat milk, 1/3 cup margarine (melted), 1 1/2 cups unbleached all-purpose flour, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg. For coating: 1/3 cup margarine (melted), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) and lightly spray a muffin tin | Beat egg, then add 1/2 cup milk and 1/3 cup melted margarine ? mix well | Combine flour, 3/4 cup sugar, baking powder, salt, and nutmeg ? blend well with the egg mixture | Fill greased muffin tins 1/2 full | Bake for 15 minutes until browned | Immediately remove muffins from the pan and dip each in the remaining 1/3 cup melted margarine | Roll in the cinnamon-sugar-vanilla mixture until evenly coated | Serve warm

ingredients: 300g cod fillets (baked and broken into 1-inch pieces), 200g clams (cooked), 200g shrimp (cooked), 100g crabmeat, 300g radiatore pasta (cooked al dente), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 cups whole milk, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp olive oil, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 cup dry sherry, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with cooking spray | Bake cod fillets uncovered for 5 to 6 minutes until the fish flakes easily ? remove immediately to prevent overcooking | When cooled, break fillets in half lengthwise, then into approximately 1-inch pieces ? set aside | In a heavy non-aluminum 3-quart pot, melt butter, add flour, and cook on moderate heat for 3 minutes, stirring constantly with a wire whisk ? do not brown | Add milk and salt and bring to just below boiling, whisking constantly ? remove from heat and keep warm | Heat olive oil in a saut? pan over medium heat, then saut? minced garlic until white throughout ? add to the warm b?chamel sauce | Add sherry to the pan in which the garlic was saut?ed, simmer strongly for 1 minute, then add to the warmed sauce | Add cooked pasta to the sauce | Bring the saut? pan back to medium heat and dry saut? clams, shrimp, and crabmeat for 2-3 minutes ? add cod and saut? for 1 minute more | Add all seafood and chopped parsley to the warm b?chamel sauce and blend thoroughly | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 tbsp plus 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 1 cup lukewarm water, 3 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 3/4 cup buttermilk, 4 tbsp unsalted butter (melted, divided), 6 tbsp roasted garlic (divided), 1 can (400g) Rotel tomatoes with chilies, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, salt for sprinkling
instructions: Sprinkle 1 tablespoon sugar and the yeast into lukewarm water ? let stand until foamy, about 5 minutes | Using a standing mixer with a paddle attachment, combine flour, salt, and baking powder at low speed | In a medium bowl, stir together buttermilk and 2 tablespoons melted butter ? add to the dry ingredients along with the yeast mixture and 3 tablespoons roasted garlic | Mix at low speed until just combined, then switch to the dough hook and knead at medium speed until smooth, elastic, and slightly sticky, about 5 minutes | Grease a large bowl with 1 tablespoon melted butter and roll the dough in the butter to coat ? cover with plastic wrap and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour | Meanwhile, make the chutney: bring tomatoes, vinegar, remaining 1/4 cup sugar, and remaining roasted garlic to a boil, stirring constantly ? lower heat and simmer until thickened, about 15 minutes, then season with salt | Preheat a griddle or large heavy skillet over medium heat | Cut dough into 8 pieces, roll each into a 6-inch oval, and cook on the hot skillet, turning once, until puffed and golden, about 3 minutes total | Brush flatbreads with remaining melted butter and sprinkle with salt | Serve with the chutney

ingredients: 4 sole fillets or other white fish (about 150g each), 1/4 cup dry white wine, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 2 shallots (diced), 1 cup half-and-half, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup green seedless grapes (halved), salt and ground white pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Rinse fish, pat dry, and season with salt and pepper | Place fish in a baking pan and pour wine, lemon juice, and melted butter over the fish | Sprinkle with diced shallots | Cover the pan with foil and bake for 25 minutes until the fish is opaque | Pour the drippings from the fish into a saucepan and reduce slightly over medium heat | Add half-and-half and bring to a gentle simmer | Using a fork, cut together the flour and softened butter to form a paste (beurre mani?) | Add the flour-butter mixture to the fish drippings and stir until the sauce thickens | Remove the saucepan from heat and add the halved grapes | Pour the sauce with grapes over the fish and serve immediately

ingredients: 500g fresh green beans (ends trimmed), 1/2 cup water, 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/3 cup slivered almonds (toasted), 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice (optional)
instructions: Snap one or both ends off the beans, leaving them whole ? may cut in half if desired | In a large deep skillet, add water and bring to a boil | Add beans and quickly simmer, tossing frequently, for approximately 3-5 minutes until crisp-tender | Drain beans and remove water from the skillet | In the same skillet, melt butter and return the green beans | Cover the skillet, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook on low heat for approximately 6-7 minutes, turning beans occasionally | Drain off any excess butter | Add toasted slivered almonds and toss beans to combine | Lightly salt and add a squeeze of lemon juice if desired | Serve immediately

ingredients: 450g dried lima beans (soaked overnight in cold water), 8 cups fresh water, 1 medium onion (chopped), 1 carrot (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 vegetable bouillon cube, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 medium onion (finely diced, for saut?ing), kosher salt and fresh ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Soak lima beans in cold water overnight | Drain and rinse beans in several changes of water to float away as many loosened shells as possible | Place beans in a crockpot with 8 cups fresh water, chopped onion, diced carrot, minced garlic, and bouillon cube | Cover tightly and cook on low for 18 to 24 hours until beans are very tender | Remove from heat and let cool slightly | Meanwhile, heat butter in a skillet and saut? the finely diced onion until very brown and caramelized | Ladle soup in batches into a blender or food processor and pur?e until all soup is smooth | Return pur?ed soup to the pot and stir in the browned onions | Taste and season with salt and pepper | Serve hot

ingredients: For dough: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tbsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/3 cup cold unsalted butter (cubed), 1 large egg, 3/4 cup heavy cream. For filling: 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1/2 cup pecans (chopped), 1/3 cup dark brown sugar (packed), 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 2 tbsp sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) and prepare a baking sheet with parchment paper | In a small bowl, stir together flour, baking powder, salt, and 2 tablespoons sugar | Using a pastry blender or your fingertips, cut the cold butter into the dry ingredients until it resembles coarse cornmeal | In a small bowl, combine egg and cream, then add to the flour mixture ? mix until just blended together | Turn out the dough onto a lightly floured board and knead for 1 minute | Roll dough into a rectangle approximately 8 x 12 inches | Brush the dough with melted butter | Combine filling ingredients (pecans, brown sugar, cinnamon, and sour cream) and spread evenly on the dough | Roll up jelly-roll fashion and seal the long seam by pinching it together lightly with your fingers | Cut the roll into twelve 1-inch thick slices | Lay slices on the baking sheet and bake for 12 to 15 minutes until scones are golden | Serve warm

ingredients: 400g penne pasta, 3 tbsp olive oil, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 medium onion (diced), 2 anchovy fillets, 1 can (400g) plum tomatoes (crushed), 2 cans (200g each) tuna in olive oil (drained and flaked), 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: Cook penne in salted boiling water until al dente ? drain and set aside | Heat olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat | Add diced onions and saut? for 5 minutes | Add minced garlic and cook until onions start to brown | Add anchovy fillets and crush them with a spoon until they dissolve into the oil | Add crushed tomatoes and simmer covered to form a sauce, about 15 minutes | Drain the tuna and break into large flakes ? add tuna to the sauce with a little black pepper (the anchovies and tuna are already salty) | Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes until the juices evaporate and the sauce thickens | Toss the sauce with the cooked penne | Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve immediately

ingredients: 3 large leeks (halved lengthwise and sliced), 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1 bay leaf, 4 medium potatoes (peeled and thinly sliced), 6 cups chicken or vegetable stock, 2 cloves garlic (cracked), 4 slices thick slab bacon (cut into matchsticks), 2 cups bread cubes, 2 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), salt and fresh cracked black pepper to taste, olive oil for croutons
instructions: Cut leeks in half lengthwise and slice into 1/2-inch pieces ? place in a colander and clean under cold running water, then drain well | Heat a medium soup pot over medium-high heat with 2 tablespoons olive oil and the bay leaf | Add leeks and season with salt and pepper | Thinly slice potatoes, adding them to the pot as you go | Season potatoes with a little salt, add stock, cover, and bring to a boil | Uncover and simmer 12 to 15 minutes until potatoes are very tender ? break up potatoes to slightly thicken the soup, then remove bay leaf | While soup simmers, rub the inside of a large bowl with cracked garlic ? add bread cubes, drizzle generously with olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss | Spread on a baking sheet and toast in a 350?F oven until golden, about 6 to 8 minutes | Cook bacon matchsticks in a small nonstick pan over medium-high heat until crisp ? drain on paper towels | Ladle soup into bowls and top with bacon, croutons, chives, and cracked pepper | Serve with crusty bread

ingredients: 4 cups fresh or frozen rhubarb (chopped), 2 medium onions (diced), 1 cup cider vinegar, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup raisins, 1/4 cup dried currants, 2 tbsp crystallized ginger (chopped), 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, 1 tsp curry powder
instructions: In a large stainless steel saucepan, combine rhubarb, onions, vinegar, both sugars, raisins, currants, ginger, salt, cinnamon, cloves, and curry powder | Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer | Cook uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring frequently, until thickened | Remove from heat and allow to cool to room temperature ? makes about 8 cups | To freeze: allow to cool completely, spoon into containers, and freeze for up to 1 year | Serve as a condiment with roasted meats or cheese

ingredients: For biscuits: 2 cups Bisquick mix, 1/2 cup soy milk. For gravy: 3 tbsp vegan butter, 1/2 medium onion (diced), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 cups water, 1 tbsp vegetable bouillon, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1 tbsp Bragg's amino acids or soy sauce, 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water
instructions: Make the biscuits: combine Bisquick mix and soy milk ? stir until a soft dough forms | Bake at 450?F (230?C) for 8 minutes until golden | Meanwhile, melt vegan butter in a skillet and cook diced onion until translucent | While onion cooks, dissolve vegetable bouillon in water and add garlic powder, black pepper, and Bragg's ? set aside | When onion is done, stir in flour and gradually add the water mixture to form the gravy | Add the cornstarch slurry and stir until the gravy thickens | Pour gravy over warm biscuits and serve immediately

ingredients: 500g red snapper fillets (cut into bite-size pieces), 1 carrot (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 2 medium tomatoes (diced), 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp dried basil, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 cup chicken broth, 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1 cup couscous, 1 tbsp garlic butter
instructions: Saut? diced onions, carrots, and bell pepper in olive oil over medium-high heat for approximately 10 minutes | Cut snapper into bite-size pieces and add to the pan with diced tomatoes, salt, pepper, and basil | Stir well, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes | Prepare couscous: bring chicken broth, crushed red pepper flakes, and garlic butter to a boil in a saucepan ? add couscous, cover, and remove from heat | Let stand for 5 minutes | Fluff couscous with a fork and place on plates | Serve the snapper mixture over the couscous

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 3 ripe bananas (mashed)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease and flour a loaf pan | Cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy | Beat in the egg | Blend in the dry ingredients (baking soda, flour, baking powder, salt), then add the mashed bananas | Pour into the prepared loaf pan | Bake for about 55 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean from the center | A dark loaf pan works best | Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack

ingredients: 3 ripe plantains (yellow with black spots), cooking spray, pinch of salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 450?F (230?C) and coat a nonstick cookie sheet with cooking spray | Cut the ends off the plantains and peel | Slice each plantain on the diagonal into 1/2-inch thick slices | Arrange in a single layer on the prepared sheet and coat the tops with cooking spray | Bake, turning occasionally, for 10-15 minutes until plantains are golden brown and very tender | Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and serve hot

ingredients: 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 large yellow onion (diced), 6 cloves garlic (minced), 200g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 1 tbsp dried basil, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1 can (400g) crushed tomatoes, 1 can (400g) whole canned tomatoes, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes with green chilies, 3 tbsp tomato paste, 1/2 cup dry red wine
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large deep pot | Saut? diced onion, minced garlic, and sliced mushrooms until soft and slightly browned | Add basil, oregano, black pepper, salt, and crushed red pepper flakes ? saut? for an additional 10 minutes, stirring frequently | Add all canned tomatoes and tomato paste ? stir well and bring to a boil | Boil for about 10 minutes and use a potato masher to crush the whole tomatoes | Add red wine and continue to boil for another 2 minutes | Reduce to a low simmer and cook for at least 6 hours, partially covered for the first 3 hours and uncovered for the last 3 hours to reduce | The sauce should end up a nice deep rich red color | Serve over your favorite pasta

ingredients: 2 ripe avocados, 100g white mushrooms (diced), 2 tbsp vinaigrette dressing, 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1/4 tsp salt
instructions: Dice mushrooms and place in a bowl ? mix with vinaigrette and let sit 5 minutes to marinate | While mushrooms are marinating, peel and pit avocados | Add avocado, cilantro, lime juice, and salt to the bowl with the mushrooms | Mash the avocado as you mix everything together until desired consistency is reached | Serve immediately with tortilla chips

ingredients: 2 large pita breads, 2 cheese wedges (Laughing Cow or similar), 1/4 cup pizza sauce, 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded), 12 slices pepperoni
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Spread 1 cheese wedge on each pita bread | Next, evenly divide the pizza sauce between the pitas and spread it over the cheese | Sprinkle on the mozzarella, then top with pepperoni slices | Bake for roughly 7 minutes until the cheese has melted | Slice and serve immediately

ingredients: 1 whole roasting chicken (cut into pieces), 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 cup beer, 1/2 cup green olives, cooked rice or noodles for serving
instructions: Season chicken pieces with salt, pepper, paprika, and garlic powder | Place in a crock pot | Mix tomato paste and beer together and pour over the chicken | Add olives | Cover and cook on low for 10 hours (or high for 6 hours) until chicken is tender | Serve over rice or noodles

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 1 large egg, 1/4 cup breadcrumbs, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp water, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1/2 green bell pepper (diced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/2 cup provolone cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded)
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together egg, breadcrumbs, minced garlic, water, Italian seasoning, and half the salt and pepper | Add ground beef and stir with a fork until combined | With wet hands, form 4 patties of 1/2-inch thickness | In an ovenproof skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat ? add patties and cook about 6 minutes until the bottom is golden | Flip the patties and cook for 2 more minutes | Meanwhile, mix diced tomatoes, bell pepper, onion, parsley, and remaining salt and pepper | Spoon this mixture over the patties and top with shredded provolone and mozzarella | Broil 4 inches from the heat for about 4 minutes until cheese begins to brown and beef is no longer pink inside | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 English muffin (split and toasted), 2 large eggs, 2 tbsp half-and-half, 2 tsp butter, 4 slices bacon (cooked until crispy), 2 slices smoked Gouda cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) ? if baking bacon, place on a rack over a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes until crispy | In a small bowl, whisk together eggs and half-and-half | Melt butter on a hot griddle or skillet over medium-low heat | Pour eggs onto the griddle and cook without disturbing until done ? when almost set, cut in half and fold into smaller portions | Toast the English muffin and butter both halves | Assemble: place eggs on the bottom half, top with Gouda slices and bacon, then close with the muffin top | Serve immediately

ingredients: 8 large chocolate chip or chocolate cookies, 2 tsp instant coffee granules, 1 tbsp hot water, 1 cup nonfat vanilla ice cream or frozen yogurt
instructions: Tear off eight 8 x 12-inch sheets of foil | In a small cup, stir together instant coffee and hot water until dissolved | To assemble: place one cookie on the center of each foil sheet ? top each cookie with 2 tablespoons ice cream | Working quickly, use a fork to slightly flatten the ice cream | Spoon 1/2 teaspoon of the coffee mixture over each serving | Lightly press remaining cookies on top of the ice cream | Fold the long sides of the foil so they overlap at the center ? twist the ends so the packet resembles a wrapped candy | Place in the freezer for at least 1 hour or up to 1 week before serving

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 1/4 cup fresh lime juice, 3 tbsp olive oil, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, and minced garlic | Season generously with salt and pepper | Add chicken breasts, making sure they are well-coated with the marinade | Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours, preferably overnight | Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Remove chicken from marinade and discard the marinade | Arrange chicken in a shallow baking pan | Season with additional salt and pepper and roast for 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear | Serve hot

ingredients: 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 cups whole milk, 1 cup unsalted butter (softened), 2 cups powdered sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Mix flour and milk in a small saucepan ? whisk until smooth | Over medium heat, stir constantly while bringing to a slow boil | Boil until thickened, then remove from heat and place the pan in the refrigerator to cool completely | While the flour mixture cools, cream together softened butter, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract with a mixer | When the boiled mixture is completely cool, add it to the butter mixture and beat until very fluffy and thick | Spread on cooled cake

ingredients: For cake: 6 large eggs (separated), 1/4 cup dark rum, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 tsp cream of tartar, 1 cup granulated sugar, 200g dark chocolate (melted), 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted), 2 tbsp cornstarch, 2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, 1/2 cup crushed amaretti cookies. For cream: 500ml heavy whipping cream, 100g semisweet chocolate (melted with 1/2 cup hot water), 2 tbsp crushed amaretti, 1 tbsp dark rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) ? butter and flour three 9-inch round cake pans | Beat egg yolks until light and a slowly dissolving ribbon forms ? stir in rum and vanilla | Beat egg whites with cream of tartar in a large bowl to soft peaks, then add sugar 1 tablespoon at a time, beating until stiff and shiny | Stir melted chocolate and butter into yolks until well combined | Gently fold in 1/4 of the egg whites, then fold the chocolate mixture into the remaining whites | Sift together cornstarch and cocoa ? combine with crushed amaretti and gently fold into the batter | Divide among prepared pans and bake until centers rise and begin to crack, about 18 to 20 minutes | Cool 10 minutes in pans, then cool completely on wire racks | Make the chocolate cream: whisk melted semisweet chocolate into hot water and cool ? whip cream to stiff peaks and fold in the chocolate mixture, amaretti, and rum | Assemble: spread cream between layers and over top and sides | Chill until ready to serve

ingredients: 2 medium zucchini (cut into 3/4-inch rounds), 1/4 cup mayonnaise, 2 green onions (minced), 2 tbsp Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/4 tsp dried oregano, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, pinch of black pepper, 1/4 cup crushed cracker crumbs
instructions: Cut zucchini into 3/4-inch thick slices | Arrange slices in a single layer in a vegetable steamer | Cover and steam over boiling water until barely tender, about 5 minutes | Drain, cool, and blot dry with paper towels | Mix mayonnaise, minced green onion, Parmesan, oregano, garlic powder, and pepper together | Frost one side of each zucchini slice with the mayonnaise mixture | Crush crackers to make 1/4 cup crumbs ? dip the frosted side of each slice in the crumbs | Place on a cookie sheet, top side up | Broil about 4 inches from heat until lightly browned, about 3 to 6 minutes | Serve warm

ingredients: 1 ripe plantain (peeled and sliced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 3 slices bacon (diced), 1/2 cup chicken or vegetable stock, 1/3 cup heavy cream (divided), salt and fresh coarse ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat a Dutch oven over medium-high heat and add diced onion, garlic, and bacon | Cook until the bacon is crisp, about 12 to 15 minutes | Stir in the stock and 1/4 cup of the heavy cream | Reduce the heat to medium-low and add the sliced plantains | Simmer until the plantains are tender, about 5 to 8 minutes | Add the remaining cream, salt, and pepper | Mash together until well combined, adding a little more stock if too dry | Transfer to a serving bowl and serve hot

ingredients: 1 box brownie mix (plus eggs, water, and oil as directed on package), 2 cups pretzel twists, 1/2 cup caramel sauce, 1 tsp coarse sea salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?F) and line a 9 x 13-inch baking pan with parchment paper | Prepare brownie batter according to package instructions using eggs, water, and oil as directed | Pour 1/3 of the batter into the prepared pan and spread until the bottom is evenly coated | Add two even layers of pretzels, covering the entire surface | Carefully spoon the remaining brownie batter on top to cover the pretzels | Bake for 30 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean ? cool on a wire rack | Spoon caramel sauce over the top in an even layer (if too thick, microwave for 30 seconds) | Sprinkle with a few pinches of coarse sea salt | Let set before cutting into squares

ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut butter, 2 cups water, 500g lamb shoulder (cubed), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 2 sprigs fresh thyme, 1 tsp ground dried shrimp or shrimp powder (optional), 2 carrots (sliced), 2 cups cabbage (chopped), 2 sweet potatoes (peeled and cubed), 1 tsp salt
instructions: Boil water and stir in peanut butter ? simmer for 20 minutes to reduce, skimming off any accumulated fat from the surface | Meanwhile, in a Dutch oven, brown the lamb in oil over medium-high heat | Stir in diced onion and cook until translucent, about 10 minutes | Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds | Stir in diced tomatoes, thyme, shrimp powder if using, and salt | Add carrots, cabbage, and the peanut butter reduction ? simmer for another 20 minutes | Add sweet potatoes and cook until all vegetables are tender, about 40 minutes | Serve hot over rice or with flatbread

ingredients: 500g beef or pork (with bone), 6 cups water, 3 medium beetroots (boiled separately, peeled and diced), 3 medium potatoes (peeled and cubed), 1/2 cup sour cream, salt and black pepper to taste, fresh dill for garnish
instructions: In a large pot, boil the meat in water over low heat for 2 to 3 hours until tender ? remove meat and set aside | Add cubed potatoes and other vegetables to the broth and boil until tender | Meanwhile, in a separate pot, boil the beetroots until tender, reserving the red cooking water | Peel and dice the beetroots and add them to the soup along with the red beet water ? do not boil after this, just heat gently | Cut the meat into cubes and return to the soup | Serve hot with a generous dollop of sour cream and fresh dill

ingredients: 6 chicken legs and thighs, 2 tbsp English mustard powder, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 cup hard cider, 1/4 cup honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Place chicken pieces in a single layer in a large ovenproof dish | Combine mustard powder, salt, pepper, cider, and honey ? pour over the chicken | Allow to stand for a minimum of 1 hour | Bake slowly for approximately 1 hour, basting the pieces periodically as they cook, until the chicken is golden and cooked through | Serve hot with steamed greens and mashed or baked potatoes

ingredients: 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice, 1 can (400g) condensed beef consomm? or beef broth, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/4 cup water, 1/2 tsp onion powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) | Place all ingredients in a 1-quart baking dish and stir well | Bake for 25 minutes | Stir and continue baking for an additional 25 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed | Fluff with a fork and serve hot

ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, 200g fresh mushrooms (halved), 1/2 purple onion (sliced), 1 red bell pepper (sliced), 1 yellow bell pepper (sliced), 1/2 cup low-sodium chicken broth, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp dried rosemary, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 cloves garlic (minced)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) | Place mushroom caps, chicken breasts, onion, and bell peppers in a roasting pan coated with cooking spray | In a small bowl, mix together chicken broth, olive oil, rosemary, salt, pepper, and garlic | Pour half of the broth mixture into the roasting pan | Bake uncovered for 20 minutes | Stir and pour the remaining broth mixture into the pan | Bake an additional 10-15 minutes until vegetables are tender and chicken is cooked through | Cut chicken into bite-size pieces, mix with the vegetables, and serve

ingredients: 8 lasagna noodles (cooked and drained), 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese, 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese (shredded), 1 large egg, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated, divided), 1/4 cup fat-free chicken broth, 1/2 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 can (400g) tomato sauce, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 100g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 1 tbsp dried parsley, 2 tbsp red wine (optional), 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 cups cooked chicken (shredded)
instructions: In a bowl, combine cottage cheese, mozzarella, egg, and 2 tablespoons Parmesan ? cover and refrigerate | Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat ? add chicken broth, onion, and garlic and saut? until tender | Add tomato sauce, tomato paste, mushrooms, parsley, wine, oregano, and pepper ? bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally | Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions ? drain well | Spread 1 cup of the tomato mixture in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish | Stir shredded chicken into the remaining sauce | Spread 1/4 cup of the cheese mixture down each noodle and top with 2 tablespoons of the tomato-chicken mixture | Roll up and place seam-side down in the pan | Spoon the remaining sauce over the rolls and sprinkle with remaining Parmesan | Cover and bake at 350?F for 30 minutes until heated through | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 cups old-fashioned rolled oats, 1/3 cup brown sugar, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 cups whole milk, 1 large egg, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 apples (peeled and diced), 1/4 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease an 8-inch square baking dish | In a large bowl, combine oats, brown sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt | In another bowl, whisk together milk, egg, melted butter, and vanilla | Add the wet ingredients to the dry and stir until combined | Fold in diced apples and chopped walnuts | Pour into the prepared baking dish and spread evenly | Bake for 35-40 minutes until the top is golden and the oatmeal is set | Serve warm with additional milk or a dollop of yogurt

ingredients: 4 ripe tomatoes (halved), 2 cloves garlic (peeled), 1 baguette (sliced into rounds and toasted), 2 tbsp kosher salt, 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Cut each tomato in half and, holding the skin side, rub the cut side on the coarse side of a cheese grater to pulp the tomato ? be sure to catch all the juice | To serve, place a clove of garlic and a couple of rounds of toast on each plate | Rub the garlic clove lightly over the toast | Drizzle olive oil liberally over the bread, followed by spoonfuls of the freshly pulped tomato | Finish with a sprinkling of kosher salt | Serve immediately

ingredients: 6 large eggs, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1/4 tsp curry powder, pinch of cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp sea salt, 1 tbsp fresh chives or chervil (chopped), paprika for garnish
instructions: Place eggs in a large saucepan with enough water to cover by 2 inches ? add a pinch of salt | Bring to a boil over high heat | As soon as it boils, remove from heat, cover, and let stand for 10 minutes | Pour off the hot water, fill the pan with cold water, and let stand for about 10 minutes | Gently crack the shells under water to loosen, then peel | Halve the eggs lengthwise and scoop out the yolks | Mash the yolks well with a fork, then add mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, curry powder, cayenne, and sea salt ? mix until smooth | Taste and adjust seasoning | Fill the egg white halves with the yolk mixture | Sprinkle with paprika and chopped chives or chervil just before serving

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 3 tbsp granulated sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/8 tsp ground nutmeg, 1 large egg, 1 cup whole milk, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 tsp vanilla extract. For topping: 2 tbsp butter, 3 ripe peaches (sliced), 1/4 cup maple syrup, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1/2 tsp cinnamon
instructions: Preheat a large skillet or griddle to medium heat and preheat oven to low (180-200?F) | In a medium bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg | In another bowl, whisk egg until frothy ? add milk, oil, and vanilla and whisk until combined | Make a well in the dry ingredients and pour in the wet ingredients all at once ? stir until just combined | Make the peach topping: melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat ? add peach slices, maple syrup, lemon juice, and cinnamon ? toss to coat and cook for 5-10 minutes until peaches are softened and a sauce forms | Using a 1/4 cup measure, pour batter onto a hot greased skillet | Cook for 2-4 minutes until bubbles form on the surface ? flip and cook another 2 minutes until golden | Serve pancakes hot with the warm peach topping

ingredients: For filling: 4 cups blackberries, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup light brown sugar, 2 tbsp cornstarch, 1 tbsp dark rum or bourbon, 1 tsp lemon zest, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon. For topping: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup masa harina or cornmeal, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup powdered sugar, 1 large egg, 3/4 cup buttermilk
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) and butter a shallow 3-quart baking dish | Combine blackberries, sugars, cornstarch, rum, lemon zest, and cinnamon in a large bowl ? transfer to the prepared dish | Make the topping: sift together flour, masa harina or cornmeal, baking powder, baking soda, cloves, and salt | Cream butter and powdered sugar until fluffy ? beat in the egg | Add the flour mixture alternately with the buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour | Scoop the thick batter into a pastry bag fitted with a 1/2-inch plain tip and pipe over the berries in a lattice pattern | Bake for 25-30 minutes until bubbly and lightly browned | Serve hot or at room temperature

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 200g cremini mushrooms (diced), 100g shiitake mushrooms (diced), 1/2 yellow onion (diced), 2 shallots (diced), 1/2 red bell pepper (diced), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 cup chicken or vegetable stock, 1/4 cup dry white wine, 1 large egg yolk, 1/4 cup heavy cream, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 2 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, melt butter | Saut? all mushrooms, onion, shallots, and bell pepper until tender, about 8 minutes | Add flour and cook for 3 minutes, stirring constantly | Whisk in stock and cook until thickened, about 10 minutes | Stir in wine and reduce heat ? simmer for 20 minutes | In a small bowl, mix egg yolk and cream together | Whisk into the mushroom mixture | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Stir in chives and parsley | Serve hot with crackers or crostini

ingredients: 6 slices bread (crusts removed), 2 tbsp butter (melted), 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese (shredded, divided), 4 large eggs, 1 cup whole milk, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 can (400g) salmon (drained and flaked), 2 green onions (sliced)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and butter a 9-inch pie plate | Arrange bread slices in a spiral pattern in the prepared plate, arranging the edges to form a crown | Sprinkle 1/2 cup of the cheese over the bread | Whisk together eggs, milk, salt, and pepper until well combined | Stir in flaked salmon, sliced green onions, and the remaining 1 cup cheese | Pour the egg mixture evenly over the bread | Bake for 35-40 minutes until the center is set ? check after 15-20 minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 cup cottage cheese, 1/2 cup nonfat milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1-2 packets stevia or 1 tbsp sugar substitute, 1/2 cup ice cubes
instructions: Place cottage cheese, milk, vanilla extract, sweetener, and ice cubes in a blender | Blend on high until smooth and thick ? the cottage cheese will become creamy and gives it a cheesecake batter taste | Pour into a glass and serve immediately

ingredients: 2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 cup unsalted butter (softened), 3/4 cup brown sugar, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 large eggs, 2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | In a small bowl, combine flour, baking soda, and salt | In a large bowl, beat butter, both sugars, and vanilla until creamy | Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition | Gradually add the flour mixture, then stir in chocolate chips | Drop by tablespoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheets | Bake for about 10 minutes until golden brown | Cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes, then transfer to wire racks

ingredients: 4 large russet potatoes (peeled and chunked), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1/2 tsp salt, 200g Velveeta cheese (cubed), 1 tbsp dried parsley, 1/4 tsp black pepper, water for boiling
instructions: Cut potatoes into large chunks and place in a saucepan | Add diced onion and salt | Cover with water, cover, and boil until a fork goes easily into the potatoes | Drain all but about 3/4 cup water from the pan | Add cubed Velveeta, cover, and return to the burner on low heat | When mostly melted, stir gently to combine | Top with parsley and pepper | Let cool for 5 minutes before serving ? the longer they sit, the better they get

ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 large eggs, 3 ripe bananas (mashed), 1/3 cup vegetable oil, 2 tbsp water, 1 cup white chocolate chips, 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan | Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl | Beat eggs in a small bowl ? stir in mashed bananas, oil, and water | Add to the flour mixture and stir just until moistened | Stir in white chocolate chips and walnuts | Pour into the prepared loaf pan | Bake for 55 to 65 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean | Cool for 10 minutes in the pan, then remove and cool completely on a wire rack

ingredients: 2 cups self-rising flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tbsp granulated sugar, 3 tbsp cold butter or margarine, 3/4 cup whole milk (approximately)
instructions: Preheat oven to 200?C (400?F) | Rub together flour, baking powder, salt, sugar, and cold butter until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs | Mix to a soft dough with milk, adding gradually until the dough comes together | Roll out thinly ? working with a small piece of dough at a time is easier | Cut out large triangles and roll from the wide end toward the point | Curve the ends to form a crescent shape | Place on a greased baking sheet and bake for about 5 minutes | Brush with milk and continue baking for about another 5 minutes until golden brown | Serve warm

ingredients: 1.5 kg beef roast (chuck or rump), 1/4 cup red wine vinegar, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp dried thyme, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 medium onion (sliced), 2 red bell peppers (sliced), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Place the roast in a roaster and drizzle red wine vinegar over it | Season with salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme | Top with minced garlic, sliced peppers, and sliced onion | Cover the roaster and roast for about 3 hours until deep brown and tender, though not dried out | Slice and serve with the pan juices and peppers

ingredients: For dough: 1 cup whole milk (scalded), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup unsalted butter, 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp salt, 4 cups all-purpose flour. For fillings: apricot, prune, pineapple, poppy seed, cream cheese, or sausage (see instructions)
instructions: Scald the milk over medium heat ? add sugar and butter and stir to dissolve | Allow to cool to warm (not hot), then add yeast and let it begin to work ? add eggs | Put the milk mixture in a large mixing bowl | Measure flour and salt into another bowl and gradually work into the wet mixture | When the dough becomes too thick for a mixer, work in the flour by hand | When the dough comes together and leaves the sides of the bowl, form into a ball and cover ? let rise in a warm place until doubled | Turn out on a lightly floured surface and knead gently until soft and elastic | Divide into egg-size pieces, flatten, and make a depression in the center with your floured thumb | Fill each with 1 rounded teaspoon of desired filling | Let filled kolaches rise about 20 minutes ? brush tops with beaten egg mixed with a little milk and sugar | Bake at 350?F (175?C) for 15-20 minutes until lightly browned | Sprinkle with powdered sugar before serving

ingredients: 4 large sweet onions (sliced), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/4 cup crushed cracker crumbs, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 1-quart casserole with butter | Saut? sliced onions in butter over medium heat until tender, about 10 minutes | Remove from heat and stir in sour cream | Spoon half the mixture into the prepared dish and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese | Top with the remaining onions and sprinkle with cracker crumbs | Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbly and golden | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 large eggs, 1/4 tsp salt, 3 tbsp olive oil (divided), 2 green onions (sliced), 1 medium carrot (diced), 1/2 cup frozen peas, 3 cups cooked cold rice, 1 chicken bouillon cube (low-sodium, dissolved in 2 tbsp water), 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tbsp light soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large saucepan or wok over low heat | Cook beaten egg briefly, breaking into pieces ? remove and set aside | Add the remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil to the wok ? add green onions, diced carrot, and peas | Stir-fry for 2 minutes | Dissolve the chicken bouillon cube in 2 tablespoons water and add to the pan along with cold rice, garlic powder, soy sauce, and sesame oil | Toss lightly to mix well and heat through for 3 minutes | Add the cooked egg pieces back in and mix | Add additional soy sauce to taste if desired | Serve immediately

ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 cups whole milk, 1 cup Gruy?re cheese (shredded), 1/4 tsp kosher salt, 1/8 tsp fresh ground white pepper
instructions: Melt butter in a small saucepan over medium-low heat | Add flour and stir for 2 minutes ? do not brown | Gradually whisk in 1 1/2 cups milk | Increase heat to high and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium and simmer until thickened, stirring constantly, about 4 minutes | Remove from heat | Add shredded Gruy?re and stir until melted and smooth | Season with salt and white pepper | Can be made 2 hours ahead ? let stand at room temperature and rewarm before using, adding more milk if too thick

ingredients: 3 cups old-fashioned rolled oats, 1/2 cup wheat germ, 1/4 cup sunflower seeds, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 cup pecans (chopped), 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 cup vegetable oil, 1/3 cup honey, 2 tbsp water, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 300?F (150?C) and spray a jelly-roll pan with nonstick spray | In a large bowl, combine oats, wheat germ, sunflower seeds, cinnamon, pecans, brown sugar, and salt ? mix well | In another bowl, mix oil, honey, water, and vanilla | Pour the liquid mixture over the dry ingredients and mix until well coated | Spread evenly over the prepared pan | Bake for 50-60 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes | During the last 10-15 minutes, add the raisins | The granola will brown as it cooks | Cool completely in the pan on a wire rack | Store in an airtight container

ingredients: 8 chicken thighs (bone-in, skin-on), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp fresh gingerroot (grated), 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp Chinese rice wine or dry sherry, 2 tbsp clear honey, 1 tbsp soft brown sugar, 1 tsp hot chili sauce, fresh parsley for garnish
instructions: Heat a large wok over high heat and add oil | Stir-fry the chicken thighs for 5 minutes until golden ? you may need to do this in 2-3 batches | Remove chicken and drain on absorbent kitchen paper | Pour off the excess oil and carefully wipe out the wok | Add minced garlic, grated ginger, soy sauce, rice wine or sherry, and honey ? stir well | Sprinkle in the brown sugar and chili sauce to taste, then place over heat and bring to a boil | Reduce heat to a gentle simmer and carefully return chicken thighs to the wok | Cover and simmer very gently over low heat for 30 minutes until chicken is tender and the sauce is reduced and glazes the chicken | Stir or spoon the sauce occasionally over the chicken ? add a little water if the sauce becomes too thick | Arrange in a shallow serving dish, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve immediately

ingredients: 4 pork cutlets, 1 tbsp butter, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1 tbsp fresh thyme leaves, 2 cloves garlic (crushed), 1/2 fennel bulb (thinly sliced), 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 1/4 cup chicken stock, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, mashed potatoes for serving
instructions: Heat butter and oil in a heavy pan large enough to hold the cutlets | Add the cutlets and brown on both sides ? season well with salt and pepper | Scatter over fresh thyme leaves and crushed garlic ? lower the heat | Add balsamic vinegar and chicken stock and cook until the sauce thickens, about 3-4 minutes | Finely slice the fennel bulb, season well, and dress with lemon juice | Serve cutlets on a portion of mashed potato with fennel salad on the side | Pour any remaining pan juices over the top

ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 cup whole wheat flour, 1 tsp sea salt, 1 cup warm water (approximately), 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Combine flours and salt in a large mixing bowl ? make a well in the center in a volcano shape | Add olive oil and the first 1/2 cup of warm water into the well ? mix until a dry dough starts to form | Gradually add more water in intervals until a wet but not sticky dough forms ? you may not use the entire cup | Knead the dough until it clearly becomes elastic, dusting with flour as needed to prevent sticking ? if too dry, dip your fingertips in water and continue kneading | Wrap dough in plastic wrap and let rest under an inverted bowl for 30-60 minutes | Roll out extremely thin ? divide dough into 4-5 pieces for easier rolling | Cut and shape as desired | Cook in heavily salted boiling water until the pasta floats to the top ? this should take only a few minutes | Drain and serve with your favorite sauce

ingredients: For pancakes: 1 cup whole wheat flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 large egg, 3/4 cup milk, 1 tbsp butter (melted). For fillings: fennel (blanched, pur?ed with Parmesan), spinach (cooked, chopped, seasoned with nutmeg), tomato sauce (onions, garlic, tomatoes, celery, anise seed, tomato paste). For assembly: extra Parmesan for topping
instructions: Make the pancake batter: mix flour and salt ? beat together egg, milk, and melted butter | Pour into the flour and stir until smooth ? let stand for 30 minutes | Heat a little oil in a skillet and pour in 2 tablespoons of batter, tipping to spread evenly ? cook until golden on both sides | Repeat to make about 6-8 pancakes | Make the fillings: blanch fennel, stew in butter, and pur?e with Parmesan | Cook spinach in its own juices, chop finely, and season with nutmeg | For tomato sauce, fry onions and garlic in olive oil, add tomatoes, celery, anise seed, and tomato paste ? cook until thick | Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Assemble in a greased 9-inch springform pan: layer pancakes with the different fillings, ending with a pancake | Bake for 10-15 minutes ? turn out and serve with remaining tomato sauce and extra Parmesan

ingredients: 24 wonton skins, 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/4 cup black olives (chopped), 1/4 cup onion (finely diced), 1/4 cup green bell pepper (finely diced), 1/4 cup pepperoni (finely chopped), vegetable oil for deep frying, pizza sauce for dipping
instructions: Mix together cream cheese, pepperoni, olives, onion, and green pepper until well combined | Place a teaspoon of the mixture in the center of each wonton skin | Fold the wonton skins over and seal the edges with a dab of water or beaten egg, pressing firmly | Heat oil in a deep pot to 350?F (175?C) | Deep fry the pizza puffs in batches until hard and golden brown, about 2-3 minutes | Drain on paper towels | Serve hot with warm pizza sauce for dipping

ingredients: For cake: 1/2 cup caster sugar, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 tsp vanilla bean paste, 1/2 tsp lavender extract paste, 1 large egg, 1 large egg white, 1 1/2 cups plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 3/4 cup plain fat-free yogurt. For icing: 1 cup icing sugar, 2-3 tbsp water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) ? grease and line a loaf pan | Beat sugar, butter, vanilla bean paste, and lavender extract together with a mixer on medium speed until well-blended, about 5 minutes | Beat in the egg and egg white | In a separate bowl, sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt | Add the dry mixture to the butter mixture in three batches, alternating with the yogurt, beginning and ending with the flour mixture | Pour the batter into the prepared pan | Bake for 1 hour or until a skewer comes out clean | Cool in the tin for 10 minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool completely | Stir together icing sugar and water until smooth ? spread over the cooled cake | Let the icing set before serving

ingredients: 2 cups fresh or frozen blackberries, 2 tbsp cornstarch, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 cup rolled oats, 3/4 cup brown sugar, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp ground allspice, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 3/4 cup cold margarine (cubed)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) and grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan | Warm berries in a saucepan until the juices run ? reserve 1 cup of the juice, adding water if needed | Stir cornstarch into the reserved juice and cook, stirring constantly, until thickened | Stir in the blackberries and lemon juice ? set aside | Combine all dry ingredients (flour through cinnamon) in a large bowl | Cut in the cold margarine until crumbly | Press 2/3 of the mixture (about 4 cups) into the prepared pan | Bake for 15 minutes, then cool slightly | Spread the blackberry sauce over the crust | Crumble the remaining batter over the top and press lightly | Bake for another 20-25 minutes until golden | Cool completely before cutting into bars

ingredients: 500g carrots (peeled, halved lengthwise, cored, and sliced diagonally), 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp white vinegar, 1 tbsp confectioners sugar, 1 tsp sweet paprika, 1/2 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp flat-leaf parsley (chopped), 1 head romaine lettuce (torn)
instructions: Peel the carrots and cut in half lengthwise ? using a small sharp knife or an apple corer, remove the core and discard | Slice the rest diagonally into 1/2-inch pieces | Cook in boiling salted water for about 10 minutes until just soft ? plunge into cold water to cool, then drain and dry | Combine olive oil, vinegar, confectioners sugar, paprika, chili powder, salt, and parsley in a glass bowl ? whisk until the mixture is the consistency of honey | Add the carrots and stir to glaze evenly | Arrange torn romaine lettuce on a serving platter and spoon the glazed carrots into the center | Serve at room temperature

ingredients: For caramel layer: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup brown sugar, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp ground ginger. For cake: 1 box vanilla cake mix, 1 tsp apple pie spice, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 2 cans (400g each) apple pie filling, vanilla ice cream for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) ? spray two 9-inch cake pans with nonstick baking spray and line the bottoms with parchment paper | Make the caramel layer: mix together softened butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, and ginger until it resembles coarse crumbs | Divide between the two pans, pressing to the edges and 1/4 inch up the sides | Divide the apple pie filling between the two pans, spreading it up to 1 inch from the edges | Prepare the cake mix according to package directions, adding the apple pie spice and ginger ? divide between the two pans | Bake for 35-40 minutes until golden brown ? you might see caramel oozing up the sides | Cool in pans on a wire rack for 10 minutes | Run a hot knife around the edges, carefully flip onto a serving plate, and peel off the parchment paper | Slice into wedges and serve with vanilla ice cream

ingredients: 1 bag (900g) frozen hash browns (thawed), 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 can (400g) cream of chicken soup, 1 cup sour cream, 2 cups cheddar cheese (shredded), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a casserole dish | Combine hash browns, melted butter, diced onion, soup, sour cream, and cheese in a large bowl ? stir well | Season with salt and pepper | Spoon the mixture into the prepared casserole dish and spread evenly | Bake for 50 minutes until golden brown and bubbly | Serve hot

ingredients: For waffles: 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 1 tsp granulated sugar, 1/2 cup warm water, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 3 tbsp instant nonfat dry milk powder, 2 large eggs, 2 tbsp sugar, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted). For Dutch honey: 1 cup maple syrup, 1/2 cup honey, 1/4 cup unsalted butter
instructions: Dissolve yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar in warm water in a large mixing bowl ? let stand for 5 minutes until foamy | Add flour, baking powder, salt, dry milk powder, eggs, 2 tablespoons sugar, and melted butter ? beat at medium speed with an electric mixer until blended | Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight | Bake in a preheated, oiled waffle iron until golden and crisp | Make the Dutch honey: combine maple syrup, honey, and butter in a saucepan ? bring just to a boil over medium heat, stirring frequently | Serve the waffles warm with Dutch honey drizzled over the top

ingredients: 12 corn tortillas, vegetable oil for frying, 3 cups cooked roast beef (shredded), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1 cup Monterey Jack cheese (shredded), 1 cup sour cream, 1 can (200g) diced green chilies (undrained)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Heat 1/2 inch oil in a skillet and briefly fry each corn tortilla to soften ? drain well on paper towels | Shred the roast beef with any juices using a fork and warm in a small saucepan | Place 1 to 2 tablespoons roast beef in the center of each tortilla and sprinkle with diced onion and a small amount of each cheese | Roll up and place seam-side down in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish ? repeat until all tortillas are stuffed | Sprinkle any remaining onion and beef over the tops | Mix sour cream with undrained green chilies and spread over the enchiladas | Top with remaining cheeses | Bake for 20-25 minutes until warmed through and bubbly ? do not overbake or the tortillas will become tough | Serve immediately

ingredients: 2 cups plain flour (whole wheat preferred), 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 3/4 cup warm water (approximately), 1 tbsp vegetable oil, 1/4 cup onion (finely grated), 1/4 cup carrot (finely grated)
instructions: Sift flour and baking powder together in a clean dry bowl | In another bowl, mix warm water, salt, grated onion, grated carrot, and oil until the salt dissolves | Make a well in the flour mixture and pour in the water mixture | Mix gently to form a dough, then turn out onto a floured board | Knead until soft and elastic, about 5-7 minutes | Cover in a plastic bag and refrigerate for later use, or use immediately | For immediate use: divide into small balls and roll each to about 1/4-inch thickness on a floured board | Heat a flat frying pan over medium-high heat and sprinkle with a little oil | Place the rolled dough on the hot pan and cook, turning frequently, until golden brown spots appear on both sides | Serve with curry sauce or tea

ingredients: 2 tbsp onion powder, 2 tbsp garlic powder, 1 tsp cayenne pepper, 2 tbsp paprika, 2 tbsp poultry seasoning, 1 tbsp ground sage, 1 tbsp dried thyme, 1 tsp ground black pepper, 1 tbsp dried oregano, 1 tsp fil? powder (optional)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and mix well | Rub generously all over the outside of the turkey and inside the cavity before roasting | Store any leftover rub in an airtight container for up to 3 months

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 red bell pepper (diced), 1 medium zucchini (diced), 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1 can (400g) navy beans (drained and rinsed), 4 cups chicken or vegetable broth, 3 cups fresh spinach, salt and black pepper to taste, grated Parmesan for serving
instructions: Heat olive oil in a 4 or 5-quart pot over medium heat | Add minced garlic and stir until fragrant | Add diced onion and bell pepper ? saut? until starting to soften, about 5 to 6 minutes | Add diced zucchini, diced tomatoes, navy beans, and broth ? bring to a simmer and cover | Let simmer for 20 minutes | Stir in fresh spinach and cook an additional 10 minutes | Season to taste with salt and pepper | Serve hot with grated Parmesan on top

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 1 large egg, 1/3 cup rolled oats, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp garlic powder. For sauce: 3/4 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup water, 1/3 cup white vinegar, 1/3 cup ketchup, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp cornstarch
instructions: Preheat oven to 450?F (230?C) | Combine ground beef, egg, rolled oats, salt, pepper, and garlic powder ? mix well | Roll into small balls and place on a cookie sheet | Bake for 12-15 minutes until cooked through | While meatballs bake, whisk together brown sugar, water, vinegar, ketchup, soy sauce, and cornstarch in a bowl until smooth | Reduce oven temperature to 350?F (175?C) | Transfer meatballs to a casserole dish or roasting pan and pour the sauce over the top | Cover and bake for 1 hour | Serve with rice or egg noodles and a green salad

ingredients: 2 large eggs per person, diced ham, shredded cheese, hash browns, sliced green onions, sliced mushrooms, salt and pepper, quart-size Ziploc freezer bags
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil | Crack 2 eggs into a quart-size Ziploc bag (no more than 2 per bag) and shake to combine | Each person adds their preferred ingredients to their bag ? ham, cheese, hash browns, green onions, mushrooms, salt, and pepper | Shake the bag to mix well | Squeeze out the air and zip the bag tightly closed | Place the bags into the boiling water for exactly 13 minutes ? you can cook 6-8 bags at a time in a large pot | Carefully remove the bags from the water | Cut open the bags and the omelet will roll out easily | Serve with fresh fruit and coffee cake

ingredients: For crust: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/3 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted). For coconut layer: 1 can (400g) sweetened condensed milk, 2 cups sweetened flaked coconut. For topping: 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips, 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter, 1/4 cup chopped peanuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Combine graham cracker crumbs, brown sugar, flour, and melted butter ? mix well | Press the mixture firmly into an ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking pan | Bake for 10 minutes | Combine sweetened condensed milk and coconut ? mix well and spread over the baked crust | Bake for another 10-12 minutes until lightly golden | Combine chocolate chips and peanut butter in a small saucepan ? cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until melted and smooth | Spread the chocolate mixture over the coconut layer | Garnish with chopped peanuts | Cool completely and cut into bars

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 2 large eggs, 3/4 cup whole milk, 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce, maple syrup for serving
instructions: In a bowl, mix together flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt | Add melted butter, eggs, and milk ? mix well until smooth | Stir in applesauce until combined | Heat a griddle or skillet over medium heat and lightly grease | Pour 2 tablespoons of batter per pancake onto the hot griddle and flatten slightly | Cook for 2-3 minutes until bubbles form on the surface, then flip | Cook until golden brown on both sides | Serve warm with maple syrup, blueberry jam, or vanilla ice cream

ingredients: 2 cups granola cereal, 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter, 1/3 cup powdered sugar, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips, 2 tbsp water, 1/2 cup finely chopped nuts for rolling
instructions: Mix granola, peanut butter, powdered sugar, and softened butter very well until everything is fully coated ? shape into 1-inch balls (1/2-inch for smaller bites) | Refrigerate for about 1 hour 15 minutes until firm | Melt chocolate chips in a microwave-safe bowl with a lid ? add about 2 tablespoons of water to thin, stirring several times, about 3 minutes total | Dip the granola balls in the melted chocolate, then roll in chopped nuts | Place on wax paper in a loosely covered container and refrigerate for at least 1 hour until set

ingredients: 12 fish sticks (baked according to package directions), 8 small flour tortillas, 2 cups green cabbage (shredded), 1/4 cup fresh cilantro (chopped), 3 green onions (sliced), 1/2 cup shredded cheese, 1/2 cup salsa, 1 lime (cut into wedges), sliced jalape?os (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven and bake fish sticks according to package directions until browned and crispy | While they bake, chop the vegetables ? shred the cabbage, chop the cilantro, and slice the green onions | Warm each tortilla and layer with shredded cabbage, green onions, cilantro, jalape?os if using, salsa, and cheese | When fish sticks are ready, place them on top of the vegetables | Squeeze fresh lime juice over everything | Wrap the tortilla edges around the filling | Serve immediately with extra lime wedges and salsa

ingredients: 1 large sweet potato (steamed until tender, cooled, and peeled), 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, pinch of salt
instructions: Wash the sweet potato and steam for 20 to 30 minutes until tender | Cool and peel the potato, then pur?e it in a food processor or mash thoroughly with a potato masher | Add the softened butter and process until smooth | Add the nutmeg and a pinch of salt ? process until well mixed | Serve as a spread on toast, biscuits, or pancakes | Store refrigerated in an airtight container

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 1 tsp dried rosemary, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes with onion and garlic, 1 green bell pepper (diced), 1 carrot (diced), 1 medium zucchini (diced), salt and black pepper to taste, steamed rice for serving
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat | Brown chicken breasts in the hot oil for 5 minutes per side | Sprinkle with rosemary and season with salt and pepper | Add the diced tomatoes with their juices, bell pepper, carrot, and zucchini | Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and cover ? cook for 3 minutes over medium heat | Uncover and cook over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until the sauce has thickened and the chicken is no longer pink in the center | Serve hot over steamed rice

recipe_name: Sweet Potato Tortilla with Sage Pesto
ingredients: For pesto: 1/4 cup fresh sage leaves, 1/4 cup fresh parsley, 1/4 cup walnuts, 2 cloves garlic, 1/4 cup olive oil, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1/4 tsp kosher salt. For tortilla: 2 tbsp ghee (divided), 2 medium sweet potatoes (peeled and thinly sliced), 1 medium onion (diced), 6 large eggs, 2 tbsp milk, salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Make the pesto: place sage, parsley, walnuts, and garlic in a food processor ? process until broken down | Add olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and a few grinds of pepper ? process until well combined but still rustic | Turn on the broiler | Heat 1 tablespoon ghee in a large heavy oven-safe skillet over medium heat | Add sweet potatoes in an even layer and cook, stirring, until just tender | Add onions and continue cooking until both are soft ? season generously with salt and pepper and remove to a plate | Whisk eggs, milk, salt, and pepper together | Melt the remaining ghee in the skillet, coating the sides | Return the potato-onion mixture to the pan in an even layer | Pour the egg mixture over top, gently lifting the potatoes to allow the egg to flow underneath | Cook until the tortilla is just about set, then place under the broiler for about 2 minutes until set but not browned | Top with pesto and serve warm

ingredients: 250g rice noodles (soaked and drained), 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp ketchup, 1/2 tsp hot red pepper flakes, 2 tbsp creamy peanut butter, 200g firm tofu (cubed), 3 tbsp vegetable oil, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 large eggs (lightly beaten), 1 cup bean sprouts, 3 green onions (sliced), 1/4 cup fresh cilantro (chopped), lime wedges for serving
instructions: If using rice noodles, soak according to package directions ? if using regular pasta, cook, drain, rinse, and set aside | In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, lime juice, sugar, ketchup, red pepper flakes, and peanut butter until uniform ? set aside | Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat | Add cubed tofu and fry until golden and beginning to crisp on all sides ? remove to a bowl, leaving the oil behind | Add garlic to the hot oil and cook for 10 seconds, then add the eggs and scramble until cooked | Add drained noodles to the wok, mix well, and pour in the sauce | Cook, stirring constantly, until the noodles are soft, just a few minutes ? add up to 1/4 cup water if too dry | Stir in bean sprouts, green onions, and fried tofu ? fry for another minute | Taste and adjust seasoning with more lime or chili | Serve topped with cilantro, extra bean sprouts, and lime wedges

ingredients: 1/3 cup canola oil, 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce, 1/3 cup honey, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 tsp baking powder, 3 tbsp hot water, 3 ripe bananas (mashed), 2 cups whole wheat flour, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (165?C) and grease two standard-sized loaf pans | In a large bowl, thoroughly combine oil, vanilla, honey, brown sugar, and applesauce | Add eggs and beat well | Stir in mashed bananas | Add flour, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt ? stir gently to combine | Dissolve baking soda in hot water, then add to the batter | Stir in chopped walnuts just until smooth | Pour batter into the prepared pans | Bake for 60 minutes until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean | Cool on a wire rack for at least 1 hour before serving

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup cornmeal, 3 tbsp granulated sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 large eggs, 3/4 cup whole milk, 1/4 cup buttermilk, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted), 200g cooked pork sausage (crumbled), 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) and grease a muffin tin | Combine flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl | Add melted butter, eggs, milk, and buttermilk ? stir just until combined (do not overmix) | Fold in crumbled sausage and shredded cheese | Fill muffin cups almost full | Bake for about 15 minutes until golden and a toothpick comes out clean | Store leftovers in the refrigerator

ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter (softened), 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 3/4 cup brown sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, 2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Cream softened butter with both sugars until light and fluffy | Add eggs and vanilla and mix well | Add baking soda, salt, and half the flour ? mix until incorporated | Add remaining flour gradually and mix until well combined | Stir in chocolate chips | Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets | Bake for 12-15 minutes until edges are done and centers are still slightly chewy | Cool on the cookie sheet for about 2 minutes, then remove to a wire rack to cool completely

ingredients: 1 prepared shortbread pastry crust, 200g mushrooms (sliced), 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 100g blue cheese (crumbled), 2 scallions (sliced), 3 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), 3 large eggs, 1/2 cup whole milk, 1/2 cup half-and-half, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Line a pie tin with the pastry crust | Cook sliced mushrooms with lemon juice in a skillet until the liquid evaporates and they are dry | Spread the mushroom mixture in the pie shell along with crumbled blue cheese, sliced scallions, and crumbled bacon | In a separate bowl, lightly beat eggs, milk, half-and-half, pepper, and salt ? pour over the filling | Bake for 45 minutes until browned and puffy | Let cool for 5 minutes before slicing

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups wheat bran or all-bran cereal, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 cup molasses, 1 large egg, 3/4 cup whole milk, 1/2 cup raisins (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a muffin tin | Mix together egg, milk, and molasses in a small bowl | In a large bowl, combine bran, flour, baking soda, and salt | Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir until just combined ? do not overmix | Fold in raisins if using | Spoon into greased muffin tins, filling about 2/3 full | Bake for 20 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Serve warm

ingredients: 8 oz Philadelphia cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes (chopped), 1/4 cup black olives (sliced), 2 tbsp red onion (finely diced)
instructions: Mix softened cream cheese and sour cream in a medium bowl until well blended and smooth | Add sun-dried tomatoes, black olives, and red onion ? mix well | Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour for the flavors to blend before serving | Serve with crackers or crostini

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1 red onion (sliced), 1 apple (sliced), 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar, 1/2 cup low-sodium chicken broth, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper, then dredge in flour, shaking off excess | Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat ? cook chicken smooth-side down until golden, about 5 minutes per side | Transfer to a baking dish and bake until cooked through, about 15 minutes | Meanwhile, add sliced onion and apple to the skillet with 1 tablespoon oil ? increase heat to high and cook until the onion wilts and the apple is golden, about 2 minutes | Add vinegar and scrape up the browned bits ? boil until syrupy, about 1 minute | Add chicken broth and boil until reduced by half | Remove from heat, season with salt and pepper, and whisk in butter | Add any collected juices from the baked chicken to the sauce | Serve chicken topped with the apple-onion sauce and sprinkled with parsley

ingredients: 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple (drained, juice reserved), 1 package (85g) lime or lemon gelatin, 1 cup hot water, 1 can (354ml) evaporated milk (well chilled and whipped), 2 large egg whites (beaten to stiff peaks)
instructions: Dissolve the gelatin in the hot water and allow to cool to room temperature | Combine the cooled gelatin with the drained crushed pineapple | Fold in the whipped evaporated milk and beaten egg whites until well combined | Pour into a serving bowl or jelly mold | Refrigerate until fully set, at least 4 hours | Serve chilled

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups rolled oats, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted), 2 tbsp light corn syrup, 2 tbsp heavy cream. For dipping: 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips, 1 tbsp shortening
