instructions: Place egg yolks in a small bowl and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes ? place egg whites in a large bowl and refrigerate | In a large saucepan, combine pudding mix, milk, and sour cream until smooth ? cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly, about 5 minutes | Reduce heat and cook for 2 minutes longer | Gradually whisk 1 cup of the hot filling into the egg yolks, then return to the pan | Bring to a gentle boil and cook for 2 minutes ? remove from heat and stir in lemonade concentrate | Add lemon juice and cream of tartar to egg whites and beat on medium until soft peaks form ? gradually beat in sugar 1 tablespoon at a time until stiff glossy peaks form | Pour warm filling into the pastry shell and spread meringue over the filling, sealing to the edges | Bake at 350?F (175?C) for 15-20 minutes until meringue is golden brown | Cool on a wire rack for 1 hour and refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving

ingredients: 1 cup fresh or desiccated coconut, 1 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 tbsp milk or coconut milk, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp onion (finely chopped), 1/4 tsp chili powder (optional), sliced chilies for garnish
instructions: Place coconut in a bowl and sprinkle with paprika, salt, milk, lemon juice, chopped onion, and chili powder if desired | Mix thoroughly and taste and adjust seasoning | Pile into a small serving bowl and garnish with sliced chilies | Serve as a condiment with rice and curries

ingredients: 2 wheels Brie cheese, 1 cup fresh raspberries, 1/2 cup Peach and Bourbon BBQ sauce, 1 tbsp fresh thyme leaves, fresh ground black pepper, pre-soaked cedar grilling plank, sliced baguette and crackers for serving
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high (450?F / 230?C) | Place the Brie wheels evenly spaced on a pre-soaked plank | In a medium bowl, combine raspberries, BBQ sauce, fresh thyme, and black pepper to taste | Spoon the berry mixture evenly on top of the Brie | Place the planked Brie on the grill and close the lid | Bake for 10-15 minutes, checking frequently that the plank has not caught fire ? if it does, reduce heat and use a spray bottle of water | The cheese is ready when the sides are bulging and the rind is golden brown ? do not overcook | Remove from the grill and serve immediately on the plank with sliced baguette and crackers

ingredients: 1 fresh pineapple (cut into 8 slices, 1-inch thick), 1/2 cup macadamia nuts (chopped), 1/4 cup light brown sugar, 1/4 tsp salt, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted)
instructions: Preheat the broiler | Cut the pineapple into 8 slices about 1-inch thick | In a small bowl, combine chopped macadamia nuts, brown sugar, and salt | Add melted butter and stir until well blended | Place pineapple slices on a foil-lined baking sheet | Sprinkle the nut mixture over each slice | Broil about 6 inches from the heat until the filling starts to caramelize, about 1 1/2 minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: 1/2 cup vegan margarine (melted), 3/4 cup brown sugar, 2 cups plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 2 tsp mixed spice, 2 cups apples (peeled and grated)
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) and grease and flour a loaf tin | Melt the margarine | Sift dry ingredients into a bowl | Add the grated apple and melted margarine and mix well | Pour into the prepared tin | Bake for approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes, depending on the depth of the tin | Cool on a wire rack before serving

ingredients: 1 box white cake mix (plus water, eggs, and oil as directed), 1 package instant white chocolate pudding mix, 1 cup milk, 1 can vanilla frosting, 1/4 tsp peppermint extract, peppermint patty candies (chopped, for garnish)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Prepare the cake mix according to package directions for a 13 x 9-inch pan | Bake and allow to cool for 15 minutes | While still warm, poke holes every 1/4 inch across the cake using the handle of a wooden spoon (only about halfway down) | Beat pudding mix with milk for about 2 minutes ? immediately pour the filling evenly into the holes | Cover loosely and refrigerate for about 2 hours until chilled | Stir peppermint extract into the frosting and spread over the cake | Sprinkle with chopped peppermint patties | Store loosely covered in the refrigerator

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (pounded thin and lightly browned), 2 sheets frozen puff pastry (thawed), 8 slices mozzarella cheese, 1/2 cup pesto sauce, 1 large egg beaten with 1 tbsp water (egg wash)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) | Slice or pound chicken into thin pieces and brown lightly in a pan coated with cooking spray ? refrigerate until ready to use | Roll out each puff pastry sheet into a slightly larger rectangle and cut each into 4 equal pieces | On each pastry square, place one piece of chicken, one slice of mozzarella, and 1 tablespoon of pesto sauce | Brush edges with egg wash, fold over, and seal with a fork | Transfer to a greased baking sheet and brush tops with egg wash | Bake for approximately 20 minutes until golden brown | Serve with additional pesto or heated spaghetti sauce

ingredients: 1 box white cake mix, 2 large egg whites, 1 can (355ml) club soda, 1 package (85g) raspberry gelatin, 1 cup boiling water, 2 cups whipped topping, 1/2 cup flaked coconut
instructions: Preheat oven as directed on the cake mix box | Combine dry cake mix with egg whites and club soda ? mix well with an electric mixer | Pour into an ungreased 9 x 13-inch dish and bake as directed | Let cool for 15 minutes | Dissolve the gelatin in boiling water and stir until completely dissolved | Poke holes into the cake with the end of a wooden spoon and pour the gelatin mixture over | Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight | Spread whipped topping over the cake and top with coconut | Store in the refrigerator

ingredients: 2 green zucchini (thinly sliced lengthwise), 2 yellow zucchini (thinly sliced lengthwise), 2 cups fresh spinach, 3 fresh tomatoes (sliced), 1 cup tomato sauce, 1 cup tofu crumbles, 2 tbsp nutritional yeast
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) | Layer ingredients in a casserole dish: start with yellow zucchini, then spinach, tomato, tomato sauce, nutritional yeast, then more zucchini, more spinach, and top with tomatoes and sauce | Bake uncovered for about 45 minutes until the sauce in the bottom starts to bubble | Let rest for 5 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup egg substitute, 1 tbsp lemon zest, 1/4 cup orange juice, 1/2 cup fresh blueberries, 1/2 cup fresh strawberries (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) and prepare a mini muffin tray with liners or grease | Combine flour, baking powder, and salt ? set aside | Cream together butter and sugar, then gradually incorporate egg substitute | Add lemon zest and orange juice to the sugar mixture | Gradually incorporate the dry mixture into the wet | Fold in blueberries and strawberries ? cut blueberries in half and strawberries into small pieces | Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until lightly colored on top | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: 1 cup pumpkin pur?e, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/3 cup light brown sugar, 50g bittersweet chocolate (chopped), 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan over medium heat | Bring to a slight boil, then reduce heat to low | Continue cooking, stirring occasionally, for 30 minutes until the butter thickens | Allow to cool to room temperature | Spread on toast, crackers, or use as a dip for fruit | Store leftovers in a covered container for up to a week

ingredients: 300g medium shrimp (peeled), 2 shallots (minced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp salt, 4 cups chicken broth, 1 cup long-grain rice, 1 tbsp vegetable oil, 2 plum tomatoes (diced), 3 green onions (sliced), 1/4 cup fresh cilantro (chopped)
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine shrimp with shallots, garlic, fish sauce, pepper, and salt ? toss and set aside | Bring the broth to a rolling boil in a medium saucepan ? stir in the rice, return to a boil, then lower heat and simmer gently until the rice is very soft, about 15 minutes | Remove from heat and cover | In a medium skillet over medium-high heat, heat oil until hot ? add the shrimp mixture and cook, tossing well, until the garlic is fragrant and shrimp are pink, 1 to 2 minutes | Transfer the shrimp to the rice, scraping the pan to get every bit of flavor | Return the porridge to a gentle boil and cook for 2 to 3 minutes | Stir in tomatoes, green onions, and cilantro ? remove from heat | Serve hot or warm

ingredients: 1 kg chicken pieces, 3 tbsp olive oil, 4 medium potatoes (quartered), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp turmeric powder, 2 lemons (thinly sliced), 1/2 cup raisins, 2 cups chicken broth, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Arrange chicken pieces in a single layer in a Dutch oven and drizzle with oil | Place quartered potatoes between the chicken pieces | Sprinkle with garlic and turmeric and season with salt and pepper | Arrange lemon slices over the chicken, then sprinkle with raisins | Pour just enough broth to barely cover the chicken ? bring to a boil over high heat, cover, and boil for 10 minutes | Uncover, reduce heat, and simmer until chicken is cooked through and potatoes are fork-tender, about 25-30 minutes | Transfer chicken and potatoes to a platter and keep warm | Add lemon juice to the cooking juices in the pot ? boil until thickened and reduced, about 7-8 minutes, and season with salt and pepper | Spoon the sauce over the chicken and potatoes

ingredients: 8 oz light cream cheese (softened), 1 tbsp cracked black pepper, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tbsp flax seeds (divided)
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together cream cheese, cracked pepper, and garlic powder with a fork until blended | Divide into 2 balls | Place 1 tablespoon flax seeds in a small bowl ? roll one ball in the seeds to coat all sides | Repeat with the other ball | Wrap each with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 hours | Serve with crackers or vegetables

ingredients: For meat sauce: 500g Italian sausage (casing removed), 1 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1 medium onion (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp dried basil, 1 tsp dried oregano, 3 tbsp tomato paste, 2 cans (400g each) crushed tomatoes, 1 can (400g) tomato sauce, 1 cup water, 1 tbsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 tbsp sugar. For cheese filling: 2 cups ricotta cheese, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese, 2 cups mozzarella cheese (shredded, divided), 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 2 large eggs, 1 tsp seasoned salt. For assembly: 12 lasagna noodles (cooked al dente), additional mozzarella and Parmesan for topping
instructions: Make the meat sauce: cook sausage with red pepper flakes and onion until browned ? drain fat | Add garlic, basil, and oregano ? cook for 3 minutes | Add tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes | Add crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, water, salt, pepper, and sugar ? bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for about 2 hours, stirring occasionally | Cool and refrigerate overnight if possible | Make the cheese filling: saut? onion with Italian seasoning in a little oil until lightly browned, adding garlic in the last 2 minutes | Mix together ricotta, Parmesan, 2 cups mozzarella, cream cheese, eggs, seasoned salt, and black pepper | Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) and grease a large lasagna pan | Assemble: spread 2 1/2 to 3 cups meat sauce on the bottom, layer 8 noodles, spread half the ricotta mixture, one-third of the mozzarella slices, and 3 cups sauce ? repeat layers | Cover with foil and bake for 1 1/2 hours until bubbling | Remove foil, top with remaining mozzarella and Parmesan, and bake uncovered for about 8 minutes until melted | Let sit for at least 30 minutes before slicing

ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 500g large shrimp (peeled and deveined), 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar, 1/4 tsp hot sauce, salt and pepper to taste, crusty bread for serving
instructions: In a frying pan over medium heat, melt butter | Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute ? do not brown | Add balsamic vinegar, hot sauce, and seasoning ? bring to a boil | Add shrimp and cook until just done, 2 to 3 minutes | Remove shrimp and keep warm | Reduce the sauce by about one-third | Pour the sauce over the shrimp and serve immediately with crusty bread for dipping

ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 green bell pepper (diced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1 cup ketchup, 1 tbsp chili powder (or to taste)
instructions: Heat oil in a small saut? pan over medium-high heat | Saut? pepper and onion until soft, about 2-3 minutes | Stir the vegetables into the ketchup and add chili powder to taste | Serve as a condiment

ingredients: 2 tilapia fillets (about 150g each), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 2 medium potatoes (diced), 1 yellow bell pepper (sliced), 1 red onion (sliced)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Combine olive oil, sesame oil, lime juice, pepper flakes, salt, and ginger | Place diced potatoes, bell pepper, and onion in a baking dish ? toss with the oil-spice sauce | Bake for 25 minutes, stirring once | Remove from oven, push vegetables to one side, place the first fillet in the dish, and cover with vegetables ? repeat with the second fillet | Bake for another 20 minutes until the tilapia is thoroughly cooked and flakes easily | Serve immediately

ingredients: For crust: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted), 2 cups graham cracker crumbs. For filling: 2 tbsp cornstarch, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 500g cream cheese (softened), 500g ricotta cheese, 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 4 large eggs, 1/3 cup fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted and cooled)
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) | Combine graham cracker crumbs and melted butter ? press into the bottom and about 2 1/2 inches up the sides of a 9 x 3-inch springform pan | Sift flour and cornstarch together ? set aside | Beat ricotta and cream cheese together until smooth | Add sugar 1/2 cup at a time, beating well | Blend in vanilla, lemon juice, cornstarch, and flour | Add sour cream and cooled melted butter ? mix well | Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each | Wrap the outside of the pan in two layers of aluminum foil | Pour batter into the pan and place in a larger roasting pan ? fill with water halfway up the sides | Bake for 1 hour, then turn off the oven and leave the cheesecake inside untouched for another 45 minutes | Remove from oven, remove foil, and cool completely | Refrigerate overnight | To serve, remove sides of the pan and slice cold

ingredients: 1 cup granulated sugar (for caramel), 1 can (400g) sweetened condensed milk, 3/4 can (same can) water, 4 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Melt sugar in a non-stick loaf pan over low heat, sliding the pan constantly until the sugar is liquid but not burned ? alternatively, melt in a separate pot and pour into the loaf pan | Combine condensed milk, water, eggs, and vanilla in a blender ? blend until smooth | Pour this mixture over the hardened caramel in the loaf pan | Place the loaf pan into a larger casserole dish and fill with water halfway up the sides of the loaf pan | Bake for about 1 hour until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean | Remove from the water and refrigerate for 5 hours or overnight until completely cooled | To serve, place a plate over the pan and flip upside down ? the flan should slide right out

ingredients: For cookies: 3 large egg yolks, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 4 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp baking powder. For frosting: 1 cup powdered sugar, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 2-3 tbsp fresh lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Combine egg yolks, sugar, cream cheese, butter, and vanilla ? beat until smooth | Add flour, salt, and baking powder ? blend well | Drop dough by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets | Bake for 10 minutes | Make the frosting: mix powdered sugar and butter, then gradually add lemon juice until of frosting consistency | Spread frosting over cooled cookies

recipe_name: Bread Crumb Topping for Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs, 1/4 cup cheddar cheese (grated)
instructions: Toss panko breadcrumbs with melted butter | Mix in grated cheese | Sprinkle over macaroni and cheese or any recipe calling for bread crumb topping before baking | Bake until golden and crispy

ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 1/4 cup sour cream, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 3 cups cooked chicken (shredded or chopped), 2 celery stalks (diced), 2 green onions (sliced)
instructions: Mix mayonnaise, sour cream, lemon juice, salt, and pepper together in a large mixing bowl | Shred or chop the cooked chicken | Add the chicken, celery, and green onions to the dressing | Toss well to combine | Serve chilled on sandwiches or over salad greens

ingredients: 1 cup beer, 1/4 cup Dijon mustard, 1/4 cup honey, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp dried rosemary, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1.5 kg boneless pork loin roast, 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together beer, Dijon mustard, honey, olive oil, rosemary, garlic, and onion | Place the pork roast in a heavy-duty zip-lock plastic bag and pour in the marinade ? seal and turn to coat | Refrigerate overnight, turning occasionally | Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) | Place the roast on a rack in a roasting pan ? reserve the marinade | Season the roast with salt and pepper | Roast for 20 minutes at 425?F to create a seared crust | Reduce oven temperature to 350?F (175?C) and continue roasting until a meat thermometer reads 150?F (65?C), about 1 1/2 hours | Let rest for 15 minutes | Strain the reserved marinade into a saucepan and add whipping cream ? simmer until reduced slightly, about 15-20 minutes, and season with salt and pepper | Slice the pork and drizzle the sauce over the slices

ingredients: 60ml peach vodka, 30ml fresh lime juice, 60ml cranberry juice, 6 fresh raspberries, crushed ice
instructions: Combine peach vodka, lime juice, cranberry juice, and raspberries in a cocktail shaker with ice | Shake vigorously for 15 seconds | Strain over crushed ice in a rocks glass | Garnish with fresh raspberries and serve immediately

ingredients: 1.5 kg boneless pork loin roast, 1/2 cup fresh parsley, 1/2 medium onion, 4 cloves garlic, 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper
instructions: Place pork in a large self-sealing bag | In a blender, pulse parsley, onion, and garlic until minced | Add lemon juice, olive oil, oregano, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper ? process to blend | Pour the marinade into the bag, seal, and toss to coat the pork | Refrigerate overnight | Preheat oven to 500?F (260?C) | Remove pork from the bag and discard the marinade | Place pork on a wire rack inside a roasting pan and bake for 15 minutes | Lower oven temperature to 325?F (160?C) and continue cooking until internal temperature reaches 155?F (68?C), about 1 hour | Let rest for 10 minutes before slicing

ingredients: 500g sirloin steak, 1 1/2 tsp pickling spice, salt and black pepper, 1 tbsp olive oil, 4 large portobello mushroom caps, 6 slices rye bread, 1/4 cup Russian or Thousand Island dressing, 1/2 cup sauerkraut (drained), 6 slices Gruy?re cheese, cooking spray
instructions: Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat | Sprinkle pickling spice, salt, and pepper on both sides of the steak | Add steak to the skillet and cook to medium-rare, about 4 minutes per side ? transfer to a cutting board | Add mushrooms to the same skillet, cover, and cook until tender, about 3 minutes ? transfer to a bowl | Thinly slice the steak on the diagonal | Arrange 6 bread slices on a work surface and spread with dressing | Layer each with steak, 2 mushroom caps, sauerkraut, and cheese ? top with remaining bread | Spray 2 large nonstick skillets with cooking spray, add sandwiches, and cook covered over medium heat until bottoms are golden, about 3 minutes | Remove, spray skillets again, flip sandwiches, and cook until golden and cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 whole chicken (cut into pieces), 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 shallots (sliced), 2 lemons (thinly sliced), 1/2 cup dry white wine, steamed rice for serving
instructions: Sprinkle chicken pieces with salt and pepper | Melt butter in a large 12-inch heavy-bottomed skillet over medium heat | When foaming subsides, add chicken pieces skin-side down and cook until golden brown and crispy, 4-5 minutes | Turn pieces over and cook until browned on the other side, about 3 minutes | Add shallots and place lemon slices on top of the chicken | Cook for 5 minutes | Pour in the wine, cover the skillet, and cook until the chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes | Serve the chicken with the pan juices spooned over, with steamed rice on the side

ingredients: 1 cup instant coffee powder, 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 cups instant dry milk powder, 2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix
instructions: Measure all ingredients into a clean, dry bowl | Use a fork to combine everything evenly | Transfer the mixture into a resealable container | To prepare: measure 3 or 4 tablespoons of the mixture into a coffee mug | Fill with hot water and stir to dissolve | Serve hot

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 2 large eggs, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 cup breadcrumbs. For sauce: 1 can (400g) tomato sauce, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup grape jelly, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Combine all meatball ingredients in a bowl and mix well ? shape into 1-inch balls | Brown them in a nonstick frying pan until browned all over ? drain on paper towels and place in a large ungreased casserole dish | Bake for 30 minutes | Meanwhile, make the sauce: combine tomato sauce, brown sugar, grape jelly, Worcestershire sauce, cinnamon, and nutmeg in a saucepan over low heat and stir until smooth | Add the meatballs to the sauce | Serve hot as an appetizer or over rice

ingredients: 1 cup sour cream, 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese (shredded), 1 cup cooked ham (finely diced), 4 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), 1 can (200g) diced green chilies, 1/4 cup red onion (diced), 1/4 cup sweet white onion (diced), 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 large round bread loaf (hollowed out)
instructions: Cream together sour cream and cream cheese until smooth | Add shredded cheddar, diced ham, crumbled bacon, green chilies, both onions, and Worcestershire sauce ? mix well | Cut a thin slice from the top of the bread and carefully hollow out the round loaf | Fill the hollowed bread with the dip and cover with the top slice | Wrap the filled loaf with aluminum foil and bake at 350?F (175?C) for about 1 hour | Serve hot with cocktail breads, crackers, or celery

ingredients: 1/2 cup fat-free buttermilk, 2 tbsp white vinegar, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp dried dill weed, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and whisk until well blended | Refrigerate until ready to use | Serve over salad greens

ingredients: 2 ripe mangoes (peeled and diced), 2 ripe peaches (peeled and diced), 1/4 cup brown sugar, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tbsp prepared mustard, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/3 cup mango or peach nectar
instructions: Pour nectar into a medium-sized saucepan over medium heat | Peel and dice mango and peach into 1/4-inch cubes and add to the pot | Add brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, and cinnamon | Simmer until cooked down and the mixture thickens, approximately 20-30 minutes, stirring occasionally | Adjust seasonings to taste | Serve with jerk chicken or grilled meats

ingredients: 4 sheets phyllo pastry, 1/2 cup sultanas, 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped), 1/4 cup sliced almonds, 3 cups skim milk, 1 tsp ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 200?C (400?F) | Lay phyllo sheets out flat in single layers on 2 non-stick baking trays | Bake for about 15 minutes until crisp and golden | Break the sheets into large pieces | Arrange a layer of cooked phyllo into 4 individual cereal bowls ? top with some sultanas, walnuts, and almonds | Add more pastry and finish with the remaining fruit and nuts | Heat the milk and cinnamon in a saucepan until it just comes to a boil | Pour the hot milk over the layered fruit and phyllo and serve immediately

ingredients: 16 oz cream cheese (softened), 3 large eggs, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 prepared graham cracker crust, fresh strawberries and sugar for topping (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Add cream cheese, eggs, sugar, and vanilla to a blender ? blend until smooth | Pour into the graham cracker crust | Bake for 20-25 minutes until just set | Refrigerate overnight | If desired, blend fresh strawberries with sugar for a topping before serving

ingredients: 400g firm tofu (pressed and drained), 1 small head cauliflower (riced and squeezed dry), 1 large egg (beaten), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp dried Italian herbs, 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded), pizza sauce and toppings of choice
instructions: Press tofu in a bowl with a heavy weight to drain as much water as possible | Rice the cauliflower in a food processor ? cook in boiling water for 4-5 minutes, drain, and squeeze out excess water using a cheesecloth or nut milk bag | Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | In a bowl, mash the drained tofu well with your hands | Add cauliflower, beaten egg, herbs, salt, and cheese ? mix well | Press the dough out onto a parchment-lined baking sheet to about 1/2-inch thickness | Bake for 30-40 minutes until firm and slightly brown | Remove from oven, top with pizza sauce, toppings, and cheese | Bake for another 10-20 minutes until the cheese is bubbly and browned | Slice and serve

ingredients: 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce, 3 ripe bananas (mashed), 1/2 cup buttermilk, 1/3 cup milk, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp salt, extra sugar for topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a muffin tin | Beat eggs until foamy | Add applesauce, mashed bananas, buttermilk, and milk ? mix until creamy | Add sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, flour, and salt ? mix well | Pour into greased muffin tins and sprinkle a pinch of sugar on top of each muffin | Bake for 15-20 minutes until brown around the edges and they bounce back when touched | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: For cake: 1 cup quick oats, 1 1/4 cups boiling water, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup white sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 1/3 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder. For topping: 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/3 cup all-purpose flour, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 3 tbsp water, 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped), 1/2 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 9 x 13-inch pan | Combine oatmeal and boiling water in a small bowl ? cover and set aside for 10 minutes | Cream butter and both sugars until fluffy ? beat in eggs and vanilla | Add the oatmeal mixture and stir to incorporate | Add flour, baking soda, salt, and cocoa powder ? blend well | Pour into the prepared pan and bake for 30-40 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | While the cake bakes, combine all topping ingredients in a bowl | When the cake is done, spread the topping evenly over the hot cake | Broil until just bubbly, about 5-6 minutes ? watch carefully to prevent over-browning

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 cup sugar substitute, 3 ripe bananas (mashed), 1/2 cup egg substitute, 1/4 cup margarine (softened)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) and spray a muffin tin with cooking spray | Combine sugar substitute, margarine, and egg substitute in a bowl | In a separate bowl, combine whole wheat flour, salt, and baking powder | Add dry ingredients to wet and fold in mashed bananas | Spoon into the prepared muffin tin | Bake for approximately 15-20 minutes until done | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: 2 medium yellow onions (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 cup dry white wine, 1/2 cup vegetable or chicken stock, 30g dried porcini mushrooms (rehydrated, liquid reserved), 1 tbsp fresh thyme, 2 tbsp fresh Italian parsley (chopped), 1/2 tsp ground cumin, salt and pepper to taste, cooked fettuccine or pappardelle for serving
instructions: In a large skillet, saut? diced onion and minced garlic in oil and butter over medium heat until very soft | Add wine, stock, mushrooms with their soaking liquid, thyme, parsley, and cumin ? simmer until slightly thickened | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Pour over cooked fettuccine or pappardelle noodles | Garnish with fresh tomato, basil, and grated cheese

ingredients: 400g rotini pasta (cooked and drained), 2 cups cherry tomatoes (halved), 1 medium onion (diced), 2 salmon fillets (about 150g each, baked and flaked), 1 tbsp orange zest, 1/4 cup fresh basil (chopped), 2 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Toss onions and tomatoes with olive oil and spread on a parchment-lined sheet pan | Bake for 20 minutes until tomatoes begin to release juice and onions are tender | Remove vegetables and place salmon on the same sheet pan ? drizzle with olive oil and bake for 15 minutes until done | Use a fork to separate salmon into bite-size chunks | Toss together the roasted vegetables, cooked pasta, salmon, orange zest, and basil | Serve warm or chilled

ingredients: 1 cup fresh lemon juice concentrate, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 3 cups cold water, 1 whole orange (cut into 4-6 slices, unpeeled)
instructions: Mix lemon juice concentrate, sugar, and cold water in a 1-quart container until sugar dissolves | Cut the orange into 4-6 slices ? do not peel or squeeze | Drop the orange slices into the lemonade and stir | Serve cold over ice

ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles (cooked and drained), 3 tbsp butter, 200g asparagus spears (cut into 1-inch pieces), 200g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 2 cups cooked ham (diced), 2 cups whole milk (divided), 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 tsp chicken bouillon granules, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese (shredded, divided)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and spray a 13 x 9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray | Melt butter in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat ? add asparagus and mushrooms and cook for 5-7 minutes until asparagus is crisp-tender | Transfer to a large bowl and stir in ham | In the same skillet, combine 1/2 cup milk, flour, bouillon, pepper, and Dijon mustard ? blend well with a whisk | Add remaining 1 1/2 cups milk, blend well, and cook until bubbly and thickened | Remove from heat and stir in 1/2 cup cheese until melted | Spread 1/2 cup sauce in the bottom of the prepared dish ? reserve 1/2 cup for topping | Add remaining sauce to the ham mixture | Layer 3 noodles, half the ham mixture, and 1/2 cup cheese ? repeat | Top with remaining noodles, reserved sauce, and remaining cheese | Bake for 20-30 minutes until bubbly | Let stand for 15 minutes before serving

ingredients: For meat: 1 kg pork roast (cooked and shredded), 1 kg chicken (cooked and shredded), 1/2 cup corn oil, 6 tbsp chili powder, 3 tbsp garlic powder, 3 tbsp ground cumin, 1 tbsp black pepper, 2 tbsp salt. For masa: 1.8 kg masa corn flour, 3 tbsp paprika, 3 tbsp salt, 1 tbsp cumin seeds, 3 tbsp chili powder, 3 tbsp garlic powder, 4 cups corn oil, 4 quarts warm pork/chicken broth. For assembly: dried corn husks (soaked in warm water for 2 hours)
instructions: Cook and shred the pork roast: boil chunks in water for about 2 1/2 hours until tender ? shred and discard fat | Cook and shred the chicken: boil in water for 2 hours, remove skin and bones, and shred | Combine both meats in a large pan and mix thoroughly | Warm the oil and seasonings together ? pour over the meat and mix by hand until completely distributed ? refrigerate | Prepare the masa: mix masa flour with paprika, salt, cumin seeds, chili powder, and garlic powder | Add corn oil, then slowly work in warm broth until the consistency is like thick peanut butter | To assemble: spread about 1/2 cup masa on a soaked corn husk, leaving the right third and top third uncovered | Add a tablespoon of meat mixture along the left edge | Roll from left to right, then fold the top over | Steam tamales upright in a large pot with water in the bottom for at least 2 hours, adding water as needed | Test one for doneness ? the masa should be firm | Cool and serve

ingredients: 2 cups mixed dried fruit (apricots, apples, pears, prunes), 2 tbsp water if needed
instructions: Place dried fruit in a food processor and whiz until it becomes a smooth pur?e | Scoop onto greased wax paper and spread into a square about 1/4 inch thick using a palette knife | Slide the paper onto a baking tray and bake at 150?F (70?C) overnight, or at 300?F (160?C) for a couple of hours if in a hurry | The fruit should be soft but firm when done | Peel off the waxed paper and slice into bite-sized pieces ? cookie cutters can be used for shapes | Store in an airtight jar

ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 1/2 cup sour cream, 2 tbsp fresh dill (chopped), 2 tbsp Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp onion (diced), 1 clove garlic (minced), 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Whisk mayonnaise and sour cream in a medium bowl until smooth | Stir in dill, Parmesan, lemon juice, onion, garlic, and Worcestershire sauce | Season with salt and pepper | Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour to blend flavors before serving

ingredients: 2 cups long-grain white rice, 4 cups chicken or vegetable stock, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 cup boiling onions or diced onion, 1/4 cup pine nuts, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp fresh dill (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh mint (optional), 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese, lemon wedges for serving
instructions: Coat the rice cooker bowl with cooking spray | Add rice and stock, set for the regular white rice cycle, and start | When the machine switches to keep warm, let it steam for 10 minutes | While rice steams, heat olive oil in a small skillet, add onions, and cook for 5 minutes until soft | Add pine nuts and cook until golden, about 1 minute | When steaming is done, add the onion mixture to the rice along with lemon juice, dill, and mint ? stir to combine | Close the cover and keep warm for 10 more minutes | Transfer to a serving dish and top with crumbled feta and lemon wedges

ingredients: 500g ground turkey, 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), 1 tbsp yellow mustard, 1 large egg, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 4 slices Monterey Jack cheese, 1 red bell pepper (cut into rings), 1 yellow bell pepper (cut into rings), 4 hamburger buns
instructions: Combine ground turkey, cilantro, mustard, egg, salt, and pepper in a large bowl | Shape into 4 patties | Grill over high heat for 15 minutes or until no longer pink in the center | Top with cheese during the last few minutes of grilling | Grill pepper rings for 2 minutes on each side | Place burgers on buns and top with grilled pepper rings | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, 1 tsp instant espresso powder, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup dark brown sugar, 1 large egg, 100g bittersweet chocolate (melted and cooled), 2 tbsp milk, 1/2 cup confectioners sugar (for coating)
instructions: Stir together flour, cocoa, espresso, baking powder, and salt in a medium bowl | Beat butter and brown sugar with a mixer until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes | Beat in egg until well combined ? mix in cooled bittersweet chocolate | Reduce speed to low and gradually add flour mixture ? beat in milk until just combined | Cover dough with plastic wrap and freeze until firm, about 45 minutes | Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and line 2 baking sheets with parchment | Shape dough into 1/2-inch balls (1 teaspoon each) | Roll balls in confectioners sugar twice, letting them sit in the sugar between coatings | Place on baking sheets 2 inches apart | Bake for 10-12 minutes until cookies have spread and coating is cracked | Cool on a wire rack

recipe_name: Lamb Chops with Thai Peanut Sauce
ingredients: For sauce: 3 cloves garlic, 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves, 2 tbsp ketchup, 1 tbsp green curry paste, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sugar, 1/3 cup water. For lamb: 8 lamb loin chops
instructions: In a food processor, pulse garlic and cilantro until finely chopped | Add ketchup, curry paste, lime juice, fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar ? pulse until a paste forms | Spread 1/4 cup of the paste over the lamb chops | In a saucepan, whisk the remaining paste with 1/3 cup water ? warm over low heat until pourable | Light a grill or preheat a grill pan to medium-high | Grill the chops for 4 minutes per side until medium-rare (125-130?F / 52-54?C) | Transfer to a platter and spoon the warm peanut sauce over the chops | Serve with extra sauce on the side

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 cups whole milk, 1 cup tomato juice, 2 cans (200g each) salmon (drained and flaked), fresh dill for garnish
instructions: In a heavy saucepan, melt butter over medium-high heat | Add diced onion and celery and cook until tender, 3 to 5 minutes | Whisk in flour and salt, blending well | Slowly add milk, stirring constantly, and cook until thick, about 3 minutes | Add tomato juice and stir until blended | Add salmon and stir gently to combine | Heat through and serve hot garnished with fresh dill

ingredients: For vegetables: 2 courgettes (sliced), 1 aubergine (cubed), 2 red onions (cut into wedges), 2 red bell peppers (sliced), 3 cardamom pods (crushed), 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp olive oil. For cake: 500g ricotta cheese, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/2 cup Pecorino cheese (grated, divided), 2 large eggs, salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 190?C (375?F) | Mix crushed cardamom, honey, olive oil, and seasoning in a large bowl | Add peppers, aubergine, and courgette and mix to coat | Spread vegetables on a roasting tray in a single layer and bake for 1 hour | To make the cake: mix garlic, ricotta, and most of the Pecorino ? season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper | Turn the cheese mixture into a greased 23cm round springform tin ? smooth the top and sprinkle with remaining Pecorino | Bake for 30 minutes until firm and golden brown | Remove from the tin onto a serving plate, top with the roasted vegetables, and serve immediately

ingredients: For filling: 3 cups mashed potatoes, 6 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), 1 medium onion (diced and saut?ed in bacon drippings), 1 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper. For assembly: 24 wonton wrappers, 2 large eggs (beaten for egg wash), vegetable oil for frying
instructions: Cook bacon until crisp ? drain on paper towels, reserving the drippings | Saut? diced onion in the bacon drippings until translucent and soft | Stir onions into the mashed potatoes with salt, onion powder, and pepper ? cook on low for about 10 minutes, stirring | Remove from heat and gently fold in crumbled bacon | To assemble: brush the perimeter of each wonton wrapper with egg wash, place a small spoonful of filling in the center, and seal to form a triangle | Place on a parchment-lined baking sheet | Heat oil in an electric skillet or deep fryer to 350?F (175?C) | Fry wontons in batches until golden brown | Drain on paper towels and let cool for at least 30 minutes before serving

recipe_name: Pasta with Peas and Pesto Chicken
ingredients: 400g dry pasta, 2 chicken breasts (cubed), 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 cup red pesto sauce, 1 cup frozen peas, 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a large pan of salted water to a boil and add the pasta ? cook for 10 minutes | During the last 2 minutes, add the frozen peas | Bring back to a boil, cook for 1 minute, then drain well | Meanwhile, heat oil in a frying pan and saut? the chicken pieces over medium heat for 5-6 minutes until lightly browned and cooked through | Add the pesto and cook for a further minute | Add the pesto chicken to the drained pasta and peas ? mix well and season to taste | Sprinkle with grated cheese and serve in bowls with warm garlic bread

ingredients: 4 thin-cut pork chops, 1 large egg (beaten), 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp Goya Adobo seasoning, vegetable oil for frying
instructions: Season pork chops on both sides with Adobo seasoning | Place chops in a bowl, pour beaten egg over them, and mix well to coat each chop | In a separate bowl, mix flour, salt, and pepper | Heat about 1/4 inch of oil in a frying pan over high heat, then reduce slightly | Dredge each chop in the flour mixture and pan-fry ? thin chops cook fast, about 2-3 minutes per side | Drain on paper towels and serve hot with macaroni and fried cabbage or collard greens

ingredients: 400g penne pasta, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp olive oil, 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (cubed), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 cup chicken broth, 1/4 cup milk, 1 tsp cornstarch, 1/2 cup pesto sauce, 2 cups broccoli florets, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated, divided), salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook penne until al dente ? drain | Heat butter and olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat ? saut? chicken and garlic until chicken is almost cooked through | In a small bowl, stir together chicken broth, milk, and cornstarch ? pour into the skillet with the chicken, season with salt and pepper | Add pesto and half the Parmesan cheese | Add broccoli and cook until tender | Stir in the cooked pasta and toss to coat | Top with the remaining Parmesan and serve

ingredients: 1 kg pork shoulder (diced), 6 tomatillos (husked), 3 serrano chilies, 3 cloves garlic, 1/2 medium onion, 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, 2 medium potatoes (diced), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, salt to taste, warm tortillas for serving
instructions: Place tomatillos and serrano chilies in a small pan, cover with water, and bring to a boil ? boil for 15 minutes | While they boil, heat oil in a separate pan and brown the diced pork until golden and crisp on all sides | Once tomatillos and chilies have boiled, place them in a blender with garlic, onion, and 1/2 cup of the boiling liquid ? blend on low for 1 minute | Pour the chile mixture over the pork ? do not drain the oil | Add salt to taste, cilantro, and diced potatoes | Cover and cook on medium-low for 30-45 minutes until the pork is fork-tender | Serve with warm flour or corn tortillas

ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 1/2 cup vegetable shortening, 2 large eggs, 1 cup boiling water, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 tsp vanilla extract. For frosting: 1 cup confectioners sugar, 1/2 cup peanut butter, 3 tbsp water, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch pan | Mix all dry cake ingredients ? add boiling water, eggs, and vanilla | Pour into the prepared pan and bake for 45 minutes (check at 35 minutes) until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool the cake completely | For the frosting: mix confectioners sugar, peanut butter, water, and vanilla ? add more sugar, peanut butter, or cocoa to adjust consistency and taste | Frost the cooled cake gently | Slice and serve

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 carrots (diced), 1 apple (peeled and diced), 1 tbsp fresh sage (chopped), 500g roasted pumpkin (peeled and diced), 4 cups chicken stock, 1/2 cup heavy cream, salt and white pepper to taste
instructions: In a stockpot over medium heat, melt butter and saut? onion, carrot, apple, and sage until all are tender | Add roasted pumpkin and cook about 8 to 10 minutes | Pur?e the mixture using a food mill or food processor (add a little stock if needed) | Return the pur?e to the stockpot, add chicken stock, and simmer for 15 minutes | Add the cream and simmer for 5 more minutes, not letting it boil | Season to taste with salt and pepper | Divide among soup bowls and serve immediately

ingredients: 1.5 kg turkey wings, 2 medium onions (quartered), 8 cups chicken broth (divided), 1 carrot (diced), 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Arrange turkey wings in a single layer in a large roasting pan and scatter onions over top | Roast for 1 1/4 hours until the wings are browned | Transfer wings and onions to a 5-6 quart pot | Add a little water to the roasting pan and scrape up the brown bits ? add to the pot | Add 6 cups broth, carrot, and thyme ? bring to a boil | Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 1 1/2 hours | Remove wings and strain the broth, pressing vegetables to extract liquid ? discard solids | Skim fat from the broth | Whisk flour into the remaining 2 cups broth until smooth | Bring the strained broth to a gentle boil and whisk in the flour mixture ? boil 3-4 minutes to thicken | Stir in butter and pepper | Serve immediately or freeze for up to 6 months

ingredients: 1 can refrigerated crescent roll dough, 1 apple (peeled and finely diced), 2 tbsp raisins, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 tsp lemon zest, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, milk for brushing, brown sugar for sprinkling
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Separate the crescent rolls and arrange triangles on a greased baking sheet with bases overlapping to form a circle (points facing outward) | Mix the diced apple, raisins, sugar, lemon zest, and nutmeg ? spoon over the base of the triangles | Fold the points over the filling and tuck under the bases | Brush with milk and sprinkle with brown sugar | Bake for 25 minutes until golden | Serve warm

ingredients: 8 ripe tomatoes (quartered), 1/2 cup olive oil (divided), 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 4 cloves garlic (minced), salt and black pepper, 1 medium yellow onion (diced), 2 cups fresh basil leaves (plus extra for garnish), 2 cups cold water, 8 slices crusty bread (for croutons)
instructions: Preheat oven to 500?F (260?C) | In a large bowl, toss tomatoes with 1/4 cup olive oil, vinegar, garlic, salt, and pepper | Spread on a non-reactive baking sheet and roast until very dark in spots, 35-40 minutes ? cool slightly | For the croutons: brush bread slices with oil, season with salt, and toast in the oven until golden, about 6 minutes | In a large saucepan over medium heat, combine the remaining 1/4 cup oil, diced onions, and a pinch of salt ? cook until very soft, 8-10 minutes | Add the basil and saut? for about 1 minute | Add the roasted tomatoes and water ? bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes | Pur?e the soup in a blender until very smooth | Reheat and serve each bowl with a crouton in the center and torn basil on top

ingredients: 2 tbsp suet or vegetable oil, 500g beef round steak (cubed), 500g beef chuck (cubed), 1 can (400g) tomato sauce, 1 cup beer, 2 tbsp crushed red chili peppers, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 tbsp dried oregano, 1 tbsp paprika, 1 1/2 tsp ground cumin (divided), 1 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 cup Monterey Jack cheese (shredded)
instructions: Melt suet or heat oil in a heavy 3-quart pot over medium-high heat | Remove unrendered suet and crumble the meat into the pot ? break up lumps and cook until evenly browned | Add tomato sauce, beer, crushed red chili, garlic, onion, oregano, paprika, 1 teaspoon cumin, and salt ? stir and bring to a boil | Lower heat and simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 1 hour | Taste and adjust seasonings, adding cayenne pepper | Simmer uncovered 1 hour longer | Stir in the cheese and remaining 1/2 teaspoon cumin | Simmer 30 minutes more, stirring often to prevent burning | Serve with sour cream, shredded cheddar, and warm cornbread

ingredients: 2 tbsp canola oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 celery ribs (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced, optional), 4 cloves garlic (minced, divided), 500g ground beef, 1 can (400g) whole tomatoes (crushed by hand), 1 can (400g) kidney beans (with liquid), 2 tbsp chili powder (divided), 1 tsp dried basil, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp ground coriander, 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1/2 tsp black pepper, salt to taste
instructions: Heat a large stockpot over high heat for about a minute, then add oil, onions, celery, green pepper if using, and a little garlic | Reduce heat to medium-high and saut? for a couple of minutes, stirring frequently | Add the ground beef, breaking it up as you add it ? continue to saut? for a couple of minutes | Sprinkle in 1 tablespoon chili powder and cook for 3-4 minutes until the meat is browned | Lower heat to medium and add the remaining garlic, kidney beans with their liquid, and crushed tomatoes | Stir everything together and add the remaining spices (rub basil and oregano between your palms to release flavor) and remaining chili powder | Taste and add salt if needed | Lower heat and simmer for at least 1 hour, up to 3 hours, stirring occasionally

ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 cup yellow cornmeal, 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup canned corn (drained), 2 jalape?o peppers (seeded and minced), 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted)
instructions: Preheat oven to 450?F (230?C) and grease a medium muffin tin or use paper liners | Sift flour, baking powder, and salt together | Add cornmeal, eggs, sour cream, cheese, corn, jalape?os, and melted butter ? mix well | Fill the prepared muffin cups with the mixture | Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden and a toothpick comes out clean | Serve warm

ingredients: 500g fresh sorrel (washed and chopped), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/4 cup raisins
instructions: Strip the sorrel leaves from the stems and wash thoroughly | Place in a saucepan with no additional water ? cook over medium heat until wilted | Drain if necessary | Stir in butter and sugar and simmer for a few minutes | Add raisins and stir to combine | Serve hot as a side dish

ingredients: 2 cups mascarpone cheese, 24 ladyfinger cookies, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, 1 cup water, 2 tbsp instant coffee, 1 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: In a small pan, combine water and instant coffee ? boil until reduced by half, then let cool | Whip the heavy cream with sugar until soft peaks form | Fold the mascarpone into the whipped cream and blend until smooth ? set aside | Dip ladyfinger cookies briefly into the cooled coffee mixture and lay them in an 8 x 8-inch dish | Pour half the cheese mixture over the ladyfingers and spread evenly ? dust with cocoa powder | Lay another layer of dipped ladyfingers and top with the remaining cheese mixture | Dust the top with cocoa powder | Chill for at least 2 hours before serving

ingredients: For crust: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs, 1/3 cup unsalted butter (melted), 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 tsp lemon zest. For filling: 3 large egg yolks, 1 can (400g) sweetened condensed milk, 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice, 1 tbsp lemon zest, 1 cup fresh blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and spray an 8 x 8-inch baking dish with cooking spray | Combine graham cracker crumbs, melted butter, sugar, and lemon zest ? stir until moist | Press firmly into the prepared pan and bake for 10 minutes ? cool to room temperature | Combine egg yolks and condensed milk in a medium bowl ? stir in lemon juice and zest until smooth and slightly thickened | Gently fold in the blueberries | Pour the filling evenly over the cooled crust | Bake for 15 minutes until just set | Cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 1 hour before cutting into bars

ingredients: 400g tri-color spiral pasta, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 tbsp grated gingerroot, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 cups frozen mixed vegetables, 1 can (400g) pineapple chunks with juice, 2 tbsp orange juice concentrate
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions ? drain | While pasta cooks, heat oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat ? add gingerroot, soy sauce, and frozen vegetables | Saut? about 6 minutes, stirring frequently, until vegetables are heated through | In a large serving bowl, combine drained pasta, cooked vegetables, pineapple chunks with juice, and orange juice concentrate ? mix well | Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours before serving | Serve chilled

ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter (softened), 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp dried dill weed, pinch of salt
instructions: Whip the softened butter with an electric mixer | Slowly drizzle in the lemon juice, continuing to whip | Add the dried dill and a pinch of salt ? whip until well combined | Use immediately or wrap in foil and freeze ? slice off portions as needed for fish or vegetables

ingredients: 2 large yams or sweet potatoes, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1/4 cup heavy cream, 2 tbsp molasses, 1/2 tsp salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Place yams on a foil-lined baking sheet and bake until tender and beginning to ooze syrup, about 45 minutes | Cool enough to handle, then peel and place in a mixing bowl | Add olive oil, heavy cream, molasses, and salt | Mix with a hand mixer until smooth and creamy | Cover and gently reheat before serving

ingredients: 4 white fish fillets (about 150g each), 1/4 cup dry white wine, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 large egg (beaten), 1/2 cup walnuts (finely chopped), 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs, 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp chili powder, 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/4 tsp white pepper
instructions: Marinate the fish in wine, olive oil, and lime juice for at least 2 hours ? reserve the marinade | In a large bowl, mix together the breadcrumbs, walnuts, and spices | Beat the egg and dip each fillet into the egg | Coat the fillets in the walnut mixture, making the coating as thick as possible | Place in a greased baking pan and pour the reserved marinade around the edges, being careful not to wash off the breading | Cover and bake at 350?F (175?C) for 15-20 minutes until the fish flakes when tested with a fork | Serve with rice pilaf or quinoa and steamed vegetables

ingredients: 4 large sweet onions (sliced), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/2 cup whole milk, 1 tsp dried dill weed, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese (shredded, divided), 1 large egg, 1 can (400g) corn (drained), 1 box cornbread mix, 1/4 tsp hot pepper sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish | In a large skillet, saut? sliced onions in butter over medium heat until tender | In a small bowl, combine sour cream, milk, dill, and salt ? stir in 1 cup of cheese | Stir into the onion mixture, remove from heat, and set aside | In a separate bowl, combine egg, corn, cornbread mix, and hot pepper sauce | Pour into the prepared baking dish | Spoon the onion mixture over the top and sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 cup cheese | Bake uncovered for 45-50 minutes until the top is set and lightly browned | Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1/2 cup plain flour, 1/2 cup self-rising flour, 2 large eggs (lightly beaten), 1 cup water, 1/2 cup whole milk, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tbsp vegetable oil, cooking spray
instructions: Sift both flours into a bowl or wide jug | Add beaten eggs and half the milk-water mixture | Whisk with an electric whisk until combined, then add the remaining milk-water | Whisk for about 1 minute more | Add oil and salt, whisk for 1 more minute until smooth and frothy | Refrigerate for 30 minutes | Remove from the fridge and whisk again lightly ? check consistency and add a little extra liquid if needed | Spray a nonstick pan with oil and heat over medium | Lift the pan off the heat, pour a small amount of batter in, and rotate to cover the bottom thinly and evenly | Cook until the underside is browned, then flip | Cook until done | Keep warm under a plate while making the rest | Fill as desired and serve

ingredients: 60ml vanilla vodka, 30ml triple sec, soda water or lemon-lime soda to taste, ice cubes
instructions: Pour vanilla vodka into an ice-filled glass | Add the triple sec | Top with soda to taste and stir gently | Serve immediately

recipe_name: Penne Salad with Peppers and Peas
ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream, 1/4 cup skim milk, 1/4 cup fat-free mayonnaise, 1 tsp granulated sugar, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp dried parsley flakes, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 400g penne pasta (cooked and cooled), 1 cup frozen peas (thawed), 2 red bell peppers (diced)
instructions: Combine sour cream, milk, mayonnaise, sugar, parsley, vinegar, and black pepper in a blender ? process until smooth and creamy | Cover and refrigerate for 45 minutes | Combine cooked pasta, peas, and diced bell peppers in a large bowl | Pour the dressing over and toss gently until ingredients are coated | Serve immediately or refrigerate and serve within 2 days

ingredients: 1 cup frozen green peas (thawed), 1/2 cup low-fat sharp cheddar cheese (cubed), 1/4 cup onion (diced), 1/4 cup low-fat mayonnaise, 1/4 cup Miracle Whip light, 1 tsp prepared mustard, mixed salad greens for serving
instructions: Mix all ingredients except salad greens lightly but thoroughly | Spoon over salad greens and serve immediately

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 500g fresh green beans (trimmed), 1 cup chicken broth, 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 1 cup crispy fried onions, 1/2 tsp house seasoning, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Melt butter in a large skillet and saut? diced onion until soft | Boil green beans in chicken broth for 10 minutes, then drain | Add the green beans, mushroom soup, fried onions, and house seasoning to the onion mixture ? stir well | Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish | Bake for 20 minutes, then top with cheddar cheese and bake for 10 minutes longer until hot and melted | Serve immediately

ingredients: 12 mini sweet bell peppers (tops cut as lids, seeds left), 1 medium onion (finely diced), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp tomato paste, 1/2 cup medium-grain rice, 1 tsp granulated sugar, 1 tsp dried mint, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 cup water, grape tomatoes for garnish, olive oil for drizzling
instructions: Sweat the diced onion in a dry frying pan over medium heat until slightly softened | Add olive oil and when heated, add tomato paste ? stir to mix | Toss in the rice and sugar, and cook over low heat for 10-15 minutes, stirring frequently until the rice is soft on the outside and slightly grainy inside | Remove from heat, add mint and salt, and stir ? allow to cool | Wash peppers and cut a circle around the stalk as a lid | Fill each pepper halfway with the rice mixture (do not overfill) | Place a small grape tomato under each lid and arrange peppers in a saut? pan | Pour in water, cover, and cook over medium heat until the liquid reduces and rice is fully cooked, about 1 hour | Drizzle with olive oil, cover, and cool completely | Serve cold

ingredients: 2 ears fresh corn (cooked and kernels cut off), 2 medium yellow squash (diced), 2 tbsp water, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper
instructions: Cook corn ears in boiling salted water for 10-15 minutes until tender ? drain and cool, then cut kernels off the cobs | Place diced squash in a skillet with 2 tablespoons water ? cook over medium heat until tender, 5-10 minutes | Drain any excess water | Stir in corn, butter, parsley, salt, and pepper ? cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, about 5 minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: 450g dried black beans (soaked overnight with oregano, cumin, and bay leaf), 9 cups water, 1 medium yellow onion (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 can (400g) tomato sauce, 2 tbsp white vinegar, 1 tsp salt, fresh cilantro for garnish
instructions: Soak black beans overnight in water with oregano, a pinch of cumin, and a bay leaf (or pressure cook for 25 minutes) | Finely chop onion, green pepper, and garlic | In a separate pan, heat olive oil and saut? the chopped vegetables until glazed | Add black pepper and tomato sauce ? stir for about 2-3 minutes, then pour into the pot of hot black beans | Stir in vinegar and salt to taste | Cook until the beans thicken, approximately 25 minutes | Serve hot garnished with fresh cilantro

ingredients: 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup water, 3 cups cubed seedless watermelon, 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice, 1 cup carbonated water (chilled), ice cubes
instructions: Make a simple syrup: bring water and sugar to a boil in a saucepan over medium-high heat, stirring constantly until the sugar dissolves ? let cool | Press the cubed watermelon through a fine sieve with the back of a spoon into a bowl ? discard the pulp | Combine the watermelon juice, cooled sugar syrup, and lemon juice in a 2-quart pitcher | Chill thoroughly | Add carbonated water just before serving over ice

ingredients: For chicken: 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, 1 tsp dried parsley, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp ginger paste, 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts. For couscous: 2 cups water, 1 cup couscous, 1 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 tsp turmeric, 1 tbsp dried parsley, 1 red bell pepper (sliced), 2 cups arugula, 1/4 cup slivered almonds (toasted), 1 tsp black sesame seeds
instructions: Mix cumin, cayenne, white pepper, cinnamon, cloves, and parsley together | Combine olive oil, soy sauce, and ginger paste in a zip-lock bag ? add the spice mixture | Add chicken, seal the bag, and coat thoroughly | Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour | About 20 minutes before serving, grill the chicken until cooked through | Bring water to a boil, prepare couscous according to package directions with butter, turmeric, and parsley | Toast almond slivers in a small pan and set aside | Saut? red bell pepper in olive oil until tender | Slice the grilled chicken into strips and toss with arugula and bell pepper | Serve over a layer of couscous, topped with almonds and sesame seeds

ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 cups whole milk (warmed), 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1/4 tsp ground ginger, 1 tsp dried basil, 1/2 cup fresh Parmesan cheese (grated), 2 Roma tomatoes (diced), fresh basil for garnish
instructions: Slowly warm the milk to room temperature ? do not boil | Melt butter in a frying pan over medium heat ? add flour and mix into a thick paste | Add 1/2 cup of the warm milk, whisking until smooth ? continue adding milk in batches until all is incorporated | Add white pepper, ginger, and basil ? bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to medium-low | Add Parmesan cheese and stir until melted and smooth | Add diced tomatoes and heat through | Serve over pasta or squash and garnish with fresh basil

ingredients: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, fresh fruit for serving
instructions: With an electric mixer, whip the cream cheese until smooth with no lumps | Add sour cream and mix only until blended | Mix in sugar and vanilla | Serve immediately with fresh fruit, or chill until ready to serve

recipe_name: Hot Torta of Chicken and Cheese
ingredients: 4 small crusty rolls (split), 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tbsp cornstarch, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 4 chicken cutlets, 2 tbsp olive oil (divided), 1/2 cup salsa verde, 1 can (200g) mild green chilies (diced), 1/2 tsp cumin seeds, 1/2 cup crumbled queso fresco or feta, 1/2 cup shredded Gouda cheese, 1/4 cup sour cream
instructions: In a shallow bowl, combine lemon juice, cornstarch, garlic, salt, and pepper ? add chicken cutlets and toss to coat | Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat ? add 1 tablespoon oil and saut? chicken until browned and cooked through, about 2 minutes per side ? set aside | Open each roll and lightly brush the outsides with remaining oil | Inside, spread a spoonful of salsa, then a layer of chicken, diced chilies, a sprinkling of cumin, and both cheeses | Top with sour cream and press sandwiches closed | Heat the skillet over medium-high heat and cook sandwiches until golden and cheese is melted, about 6 minutes per side ? press with another skillet for crisper results | Cut in half and serve with additional salsa

ingredients: 500g chicken tenders, 1 cup buttermilk, 2 cloves garlic (mashed with 1/2 tsp salt), 1/4 cup red wine vinegar, 1/2 cup plus 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 cup Italian breadcrumbs, black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 500?F (260?C) and brush 2 heavy baking sheets with 1 tablespoon oil each | Place buttermilk in a large bowl, add chicken tenders, and stir to coat ? let stand 15-30 minutes | Mash garlic with salt, whisk in vinegar and remaining 1/2 cup olive oil, and season with pepper ? set aside as dipping sauce | Stir Parmesan and breadcrumbs in a shallow dish | Remove chicken from buttermilk and dredge in the breadcrumb mixture, pressing to adhere | Arrange on prepared baking sheets, drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons oil, and bake for 14-18 minutes until golden and cooked through | Serve with the vinaigrette alongside for dipping

ingredients: 1 package oatmeal cookie mix, 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter (cubed), 1 large egg, 1 can (400g) sweetened condensed milk, 1 tbsp lemon zest, 1/3 cup fresh lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and spray an 8-inch square pan with cooking spray | Cut butter into the cookie mix using a fork or pastry blender until crumbly | Stir in egg until the mixture is crumbly | Press half the cookie mixture into the bottom of the pan ? bake for 15 minutes | Stir together condensed milk, lemon zest, and lemon juice until thick ? spread over the baked crust | Crumble the remaining cookie mixture over the top | Bake for about 25 minutes longer until light golden brown | Refrigerate for 30 minutes or until set before cutting into bars | Store covered in the refrigerator

ingredients: 1/2 cup olive oil, 3 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1 tsp granulated sugar, 1 clove garlic (minced), 2 tbsp Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/4 cup sour cream
instructions: In a blender, combine olive oil, vinegar, salt, pepper, oregano, basil, sugar, garlic, and Parmesan cheese ? blend until emulsified | Add sour cream and blend until well mixed | Best if made 24 hours in advance | Serve as a salad dressing or as a dip for vegetables

ingredients: 2 cups rolled oats, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/4 cup sugar substitute or sugar, 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce, 1/2 cup egg substitute, 1 tbsp lecithin granules (optional), 1/3 cup nonfat milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper | Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl until well combined | Using an ice cream scoop, drop portions onto the prepared baking sheet | Bake for 12 minutes until lightly golden | Enjoy warm or at room temperature

ingredients: For pastry: 3/4 cup plain flour, 3/4 cup self-rising flour, 1/4 cup caster sugar, 1/3 cup cold unsalted butter (cubed), 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2-3 tbsp cold water. For filling: 2 apples (peeled and diced), 2 tbsp caster sugar, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 2 tbsp sultanas, 1 tbsp milk for brushing, icing sugar for dusting
instructions: Make the pastry: combine flours, sugar, and lemon juice | Cut in the cold butter until crumbly | Gradually add water until the dough comes together ? mould into a disc, wrap, and refrigerate until firm | Make the filling: combine diced apples, sugar, cinnamon, and sultanas in a bowl | Preheat oven to 180?C (350?F) | Roll out the chilled pastry and cut into rectangles | Place filling on one side of each rectangle, fold over, and pinch or crimp the edges to seal | Brush with milk and place on a baking tray | Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown | Dust with icing sugar and serve warm

ingredients: 4 cups romaine lettuce (chopped), 2 cups Boston lettuce (torn), 2 ripe tomatoes (cut into wedges), 1/2 Spanish onion (thinly sliced), 1/4 cup green olives, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/4 cup olive oil, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper until well combined | Just before serving, toss the dressing with the lettuces, tomatoes, onion, and olives | Serve immediately

ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter (divided), 1 medium onion (sliced), 1 tbsp light brown sugar, 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp Cajun seasoning, 500g fresh green beans (trimmed)
instructions: In a skillet, melt 1 tablespoon butter over medium heat ? add sliced onion and cook until starting to brown, 7-10 minutes | Add brown sugar, salt, and Cajun seasoning ? reduce heat to medium-low and cook until the onion is soft and golden, about 5 minutes | Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil ? add green beans and cook until tender, 4-5 minutes | Drain well and add to the onion mixture with the remaining 1 tablespoon butter | Cook, stirring, until heated through, about 1 minute | Serve hot

ingredients: For arancini: 2 cups cooked long-grain rice (chilled), 4 slices smoked bacon (cooked and crumbled), 2 avocados (1 1/2 mashed with lemon juice, 1/2 reserved for dip), 1 tsp dried oregano, 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, 1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes (chopped), 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded), salt and black pepper, 2 large eggs (beaten), 1 cup Italian breadcrumbs, canola oil for frying. For dip: reserved avocado half, 1/2 tsp lemon juice, 1/4 cup sour cream, 1 tbsp ranch seasoning
instructions: Cook rice and spread on a baking sheet ? refrigerate for 30 minutes until cold | Cook bacon until crisp and crumble | Mash 1 1/2 avocados with lemon juice ? mix in oregano, red pepper flakes, sun-dried tomatoes, mozzarella, bacon, salt, and pepper | Stir in the chilled rice | Beat eggs in a shallow bowl ? pour breadcrumbs into another shallow dish | Roll the mixture into 1-inch balls, dip in egg, then coat in breadcrumbs | Heat 3/4 inch of canola oil to 350?F (175?C) in a frying pan | Fry arancini in small batches until golden brown, about 3 minutes | Make the dip: mash the reserved avocado half with lemon juice, sour cream, and ranch seasoning until smooth | Serve the arancini warm with the cool avocado dip

ingredients: 4 cups prepared mashed potatoes, 1/4 cup ranch salad dressing, 1/2 cup blue cheese (crumbled, divided)
instructions: Preheat the broiler | Mix ranch dressing and half the blue cheese into the mashed potatoes | Heat the potato mixture in the microwave for 1-2 minutes until hot | Sprinkle the remaining blue cheese on top | Broil until slightly golden and bubbly | Serve immediately

ingredients: 6 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 3/4 cup light brown sugar, 8 slices thick bread, 6 large eggs, 1 1/2 cups whole milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup pecans (chopped), powdered sugar and maple syrup for serving
instructions: Combine melted butter and brown sugar in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish | Arrange bread slices in the dish (overlapping is fine) | Whisk together eggs, milk, vanilla, cinnamon, ginger, and salt ? pour over the bread and let it soak in | Top evenly with pecans | Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 3 to 12 hours | Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) ? let the casserole sit at room temperature for 20 minutes | Bake until browned and set, 30 to 45 minutes | Cool slightly, dust with powdered sugar, and serve with maple syrup

ingredients: 3 cloves garlic, 1/4 cup raw cashews (soaked for 2 hours), 3 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 cup water, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp sesame seeds, 2 heads romaine lettuce (chopped)
instructions: Place all ingredients except sesame seeds in a blender ? blend until smooth and creamy | Toss with torn romaine lettuce | Top with sesame or hemp seeds | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (pounded to 1/2-inch thickness), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground pepper, 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 2 shallots (minced), 1/2 cup reduced-sodium chicken broth, 1/4 cup dry vermouth or white wine, 1 tbsp cider vinegar, 1 tbsp brandy, 1 tbsp fresh tarragon (chopped), 2 tbsp Dijon mustard, 2 tbsp reduced-fat cream cheese
instructions: Place chicken breasts between plastic wrap and pound to 1/2-inch thickness ? season with salt and pepper | Heat olive oil in a heavy large skillet over medium-high heat | Add chicken and cook for 7-9 minutes until browned and no longer pink, turning once ? transfer to a plate and cover loosely with foil | Add shallots to the same skillet and cook for 30 seconds | Add broth, wine, vinegar, and brandy, stirring to scrape up the browned bits | Add tarragon, Dijon mustard, and cream cheese ? cook for 2 minutes until slightly thickened | Return chicken and any accumulated juices to the skillet ? cook for 1 minute until heated through | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1 large egg, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup pumpkin pur?e, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp pumpkin pie spice, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 cup white chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | In a large bowl, cream butter and both sugars until light and fluffy | Beat in egg, vanilla, and pumpkin pur?e | Combine dry ingredients and gradually add to the creamed mixture ? mix well | Stir in white chocolate chips | Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheets | Bake for 12-14 minutes until firm | Remove to wire racks to cool

ingredients: 2 cups long-grain rice, 1 can (400ml) coconut milk, 1 1/2 cups water, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1/2 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp fresh ginger (grated), 2 tbsp crystallized ginger (chopped), 1/4 cup sliced almonds (toasted)
instructions: Combine rice, coconut milk, water, salt, sugar, red pepper flakes, turmeric, and fresh ginger in a saucepan ? stir well | Cook over medium-high heat, stirring, until the mixture comes to a low boil | Immediately reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for about 18 minutes | Fluff with a fork, cover, and let sit for 5 more minutes | Garnish with crystallized ginger and toasted sliced almonds before serving

ingredients: 1 box white cake mix, 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix, 1 cup water, 4 large eggs, 1/3 cup vegetable oil, 1 1/2 cups sweetened flaked coconut (divided), 1/2 cup walnuts or pecans (chopped). For frosting: 4 tbsp unsalted butter (divided), 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 2 tbsp milk, 2 cups confectioners sugar, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease and flour three 9-inch cake pans | Combine cake mix, flour, pudding mix, water, eggs, and oil in a large bowl ? beat at medium speed for 4 minutes | Stir in 1 cup coconut and the chopped nuts | Pour into the prepared pans and bake for 35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean ? cool completely | Make the frosting: melt 2 tablespoons butter in a skillet, add the remaining 1/2 cup coconut, and stir over low heat until golden brown ? divide into 1/4 cup and 1 3/4 cups portions and cool on paper towels | Cream remaining 2 tablespoons butter with cream cheese, add milk, and beat in confectioners sugar gradually ? blend in vanilla | Stir in the 1 3/4 cups toasted coconut | Frost the cake layers, stack them, and sprinkle the reserved 1/4 cup coconut on top

ingredients: 2 red bell peppers (diced), 1 medium eggplant (cubed), 1 yellow squash (cubed), 1 cup butternut squash (cubed), 3 tbsp olive oil, 400g penne pasta, 2 ripe tomatoes (diced), 1/4 cup fresh basil (torn), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar, salt and black pepper to taste, Parmesan cheese for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 450?F (230?C) and spray a roasting pan with cooking spray | Combine peppers, eggplant, yellow squash, and butternut squash in the roaster ? spray lightly with oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper | Roast for 20-25 minutes until tender and beginning to brown, stirring occasionally | Cook pasta in boiling salted water until al dente ? drain, reserving 1/3 cup of the pasta water | Toss the roasted vegetables with the pasta, tomatoes, and basil | Add garlic, olive oil, and balsamic vinegar ? if too dry, add a little reserved pasta water | Season with salt and pepper and serve with Parmesan cheese

ingredients: 1 medium zucchini (grated and squeezed dry), 1 medium sweet potato (peeled and grated), 1 large egg, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp ground cumin, 1 tbsp dried parsley, 2 tbsp coconut flour, 1 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp coconut oil, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine grated zucchini, grated sweet potato, and egg in a medium bowl | In a small bowl, mix coconut flour with garlic powder, cumin, and parsley | Add the dry ingredients to the zucchini mixture and stir until fully combined | Heat butter and coconut oil in a medium pan | Divide the mixture into 5 equal portions and drop into the pan, pressing down until about 1/2 inch thick | Cook on medium heat until golden and crisp, then flip carefully and cook the other side | Remove and season with salt and pepper | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4 mahi mahi fillets (about 150g each), juice of 1 lemon, 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 cup whole milk, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 200g lump crabmeat, 2 cups fresh spinach (chopped), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Baste mahi mahi fillets with lemon juice and bake for 15-20 minutes until the fish flakes easily | Meanwhile, make the Rockefeller topping: melt butter in a large saucepan, stir in flour until smooth, and gradually add milk | Bring to a boil and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes until thickened | Reduce heat and add Parmesan cheese, stirring until smooth | Add crabmeat and spinach ? stir until the crab is heated through | Serve the topping generously over the cooked mahi mahi fillets
