ingredients: 1/4 cup loose black tea, 1/2 cup fresh mint leaves, 8 cups boiling water (divided), 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice, 1/2 cup cherry juice, lemon slices for garnish
instructions: Steep the loose tea and fresh mint in 5 cups of boiling water for 20 minutes | Strain the tea mixture and allow to cool | Add the sugar to the remaining 3 cups of boiling water ? stir until dissolved | Pour the sugar water into a pitcher and let cool | Once cooled, add the lemon juice and cherry juice, followed by the tea mixture | Chill in the refrigerator | Serve in tall glasses over ice, garnished with a lemon slice

ingredients: 200g dark chocolate (chopped), 3/4 cup heavy cream, 3 tbsp champagne or sparkling wine, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, unsweetened cocoa powder for dusting
instructions: Line a 23 x 12cm (9 x 5-inch) dish or tin with plastic wrap | Place the chopped chocolate in a large heatproof bowl | Heat the cream in a pan until gently bubbling ? pour half over the chocolate, leave for 1 minute, then mix with an electric whisk | Add the remaining cream and continue mixing until smooth and glossy | Stir in the champagne and vanilla | Pour the truffle mixture into the prepared tin, smooth the top, and chill for at least 4 hours to set | Using a hot knife, cut into bite-sized squares | Dust with cocoa powder before serving

ingredients: 1/2 sweet onion (diced), 1 cup fresh pineapple (diced), 1/2 red bell pepper (diced), 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, pinch of salt
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine all ingredients and stir until well blended | Let stand for 15 minutes to allow the flavors to meld | Serve with grilled fish or chicken

ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 1/4 cups granulated sugar, 250g dark chocolate (150g melted, 50g chopped), 3 large eggs plus 1 egg yolk, 3/4 cup plain flour, 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, 1/2 tsp baking powder, pinch of salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 180?C (160?C fan) and line a 23cm square baking tin with baking paper | Beat butter and sugar for a few minutes until white and fluffy | Melt 150g chocolate in a bowl over simmering water ? remove from heat | Chop the remaining 50g chocolate into small pieces | Lightly beat the eggs and extra yolk | Sift together flour, cocoa, baking powder, and salt | With the mixer on low, add the eggs a little at a time to the butter mixture | Remove from the mixer and fold in the melted chocolate, then the flour mixture ? gently but firmly | Pour into the prepared tin and bake for 25-30 minutes until risen and slightly softer in the middle | A toothpick should come out slightly sticky but not with raw batter | Cool before cutting ? they will solidify as they cool

ingredients: 1 whole chicken (about 1.5 kg), 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp fresh rosemary (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh thyme, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 lemon (halved), 4 sprigs fresh herbs for cavity
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) | Pat the chicken dry with paper towels | Mix olive oil with minced garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper | Rub the herb mixture all over the chicken, including under the skin | Place lemon halves and extra herb sprigs inside the cavity | Place the chicken in a roasting pan and roast for 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 165?F (74?C) | Let rest for 10 minutes before carving | Serve with the pan juices

ingredients: 4 salmon fillets (about 150g each, skin-on), 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp sea salt, 1/4 tsp freshly ground black pepper. For roasted peppers: 2 red bell peppers, 1 tbsp olive oil. For dressing: 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp red wine vinegar, 1 tbsp capers. For serving: mixed salad leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) | Place bell peppers on a baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, and roast for 20 minutes until scorched ? place in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and set aside | Place a solid baking sheet in the oven to heat for 3 minutes | Mix together olive oil, paprika, salt, and pepper ? brush this spiced oil all over the salmon | Lightly oil the hot baking sheet and place the salmon skin-side down ? bake for 10-12 minutes until cooked but still pink inside | Peel the cooled peppers, remove seeds, and cut into strips | Whisk together the dressing ingredients | Toss salad leaves with the dressing and place on serving plates | Top with the salmon and arrange roasted pepper strips and capers on top

ingredients: 1 package Oreo cookies, 1 cup whole milk, 2 cups whipped topping (thawed)
instructions: Set aside 6 cookies for later use | Twist the remaining cookies apart, dunk briefly in milk until slightly softened (do not get soggy), and arrange in a layer in a 13 x 9-inch pan | Spread a thin layer of whipped topping over the cookies | Repeat the layers until all cookies and whipped topping are used, ending with whipped topping | Crumble the 6 reserved cookies and sprinkle over the top | Refrigerate until chilled | Slice and serve

ingredients: 1/2 cup water, 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, 1/2 medium onion (roughly chopped), 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 green onions, 2 tbsp canola oil, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp ground allspice, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp ground black pepper, 1 tsp dried thyme, 1/4 tsp ground cayenne pepper, 4 pork chops
instructions: Place water, lemon juice, onion, brown sugar, green onions, oil, salt, allspice, cinnamon, black pepper, thyme, and cayenne in a blender ? pur?e until smooth | Reserve 1/2 cup of the marinade in a small bowl, cover, and refrigerate for basting | Place the pork chops in a shallow dish and pour the remaining marinade over them ? cover and refrigerate at least 12 hours, up to 24 hours | Heat grill to medium heat | Remove pork from the marinade and grill 4-5 inches from the heat | Turn chops frequently, basting with the reserved marinade | Cook until medium done (160?F / 71?C), about 8-11 minutes | Let rest briefly and serve

ingredients: 500g ground turkey, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp fresh ground pepper, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/4 cup chicken broth
instructions: Combine ground turkey and all dry spices in a large bowl ? mix together thoroughly | Add chicken broth and mix well ? let stand for 15 to 20 minutes | Form the turkey into 8 patties, approximately 3/4 inch thick | Cook in a nonstick skillet over medium heat for 7-8 minutes on each side, or grill on an oiled grate | Serve hot

ingredients: 3 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/3 cup vegetable shortening, 1 cup warm water (approximately)
instructions: Place flour, salt, and baking powder in a bowl and mix well | Add shortening and mix thoroughly with your hands, a pastry cutter, or two knives | Pour in warm water and mix ? finish mixing with your hands | Roll the dough into a ball and knead for 6-7 minutes | Place back in the bowl, cover, and let rest for 15-30 minutes | Divide into approximately 32 small balls | Lightly flour a surface and roll each ball into a 6-8 inch tortilla | Cook on a griddle or cast iron skillet over low heat until the top starts to bubble, then flip for a few more seconds | Serve warm

ingredients: 400g penne pasta, 1 can (400g) artichoke hearts (drained, liquid reserved), 2 cups fresh spinach, 1/2 red onion (diced), 1 can (400g) chickpeas (drained and rinsed), 2 tbsp white wine vinegar, 3 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp hot pepper sauce, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook penne for 8-10 minutes until tender but firm ? drain and rinse under cold water | In a large bowl, toss pasta with artichoke hearts, spinach, red onion, and chickpeas | Whisk together the reserved artichoke liquid, vinegar, olive oil, salt, pepper, hot pepper sauce, and parsley | Toss the dressing with the pasta mixture until coated | Serve chilled or at room temperature

ingredients: 1 cup mustard powder, 1 cup white vinegar, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup water, 1/2 tsp salt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan | Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally | Pour into a sterilized jar and refrigerate | Use as a condiment with meats or in dressings

ingredients: 4 large eggs, 2 cups whole milk, 2 tbsp cornstarch, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: In a medium saucepan, whisk together eggs, milk, cornstarch, and sugar until smooth | Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon | Remove from heat and stir in vanilla | Pour into a bowl and let cool | Serve chilled over fruit or desserts

ingredients: 450g dried pinto beans (soaked overnight), 4 cups water, 2 andouille sausages (sliced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 bell pepper (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 bay leaf, 1 tsp dried oregano, 2 fresh parsley stems, 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1 tsp salt, cornbread for serving
instructions: Soak beans for at least 4 hours, best overnight ? drain | Add 4 cups fresh water, beans, and all other ingredients to a large crock pot ? stir well | Cook on low for 8 hours until the beans are tender | Remove the bay leaf and parsley stems | Ladle into bowls and serve with cornbread

ingredients: 500g beef (cubed), 250g pork or ham (cubed), 3 cups sauerkraut (drained), 1 medium onion (diced), 2 medium potatoes (cubed), 1 carrot (grated), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 2 bay leaves, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp fresh dill (chopped), 6 black peppercorns, 2 cups water, sour cream for serving
instructions: In a large pot, combine beef, pork, and boiling water ? add the whole onion, potatoes, and carrot | Boil for 1.5 hours until the meat is half-cooked | Add the sauerkraut, the rest of the vegetables cut into strips, and the seasonings | Continue to boil for 1 more hour until all meat and vegetables are tender | Serve hot with a dollop of sour cream

ingredients: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tsp lemon extract, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1 tbsp lemon zest. For glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar, 2-3 tbsp fresh lemon juice, sliced almonds for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Beat cream cheese, butter, sugar, vanilla, and lemon extract in a mixer until creamy | Add flour, baking soda, and lemon zest ? mix until well blended | Chill the dough for 1 hour or overnight | Roll out on a well-floured surface to about 1/8-inch thickness and cut into star shapes | Bake on greased cookie sheets for 8-10 minutes until the edges start to lightly brown ? cool on a wire rack | Mix powdered sugar with enough lemon juice to make a drizzle ? glaze the cookies and immediately press sliced almonds into the glaze

ingredients: 4 cups white cabbage (shredded), 1/2 green bell pepper (diced), 2 green onions (sliced), 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/4 cup mayonnaise, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp salt, 100g Stilton cheese (crumbled)
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the shredded cabbage, diced pepper, and sliced green onions ? refrigerate for at least 1 hour | In a separate bowl, combine sour cream, mayonnaise, lemon juice, sugar, salt, and crumbled Stilton to make the dressing ? refrigerate for 1 hour | To serve, pour the dressing over the cabbage mixture and toss well | Serve immediately

ingredients: 3 1/2 cups all-purpose flour (divided), 3 tbsp granulated sugar, 2 1/4 tsp fast-rising yeast, 1/2 tsp salt, 3/4 cup milk, 1/4 cup water, 3 tbsp unsalted butter, additional melted butter for brushing
instructions: Combine 3/4 cup flour, sugar, undissolved yeast, and salt in a large bowl | Heat milk, water, and butter until very warm (120-130?F) and add to the flour mixture | Beat for 2 minutes at medium speed with an electric mixer | Add 1/4 cup flour and beat for 2 minutes at high speed | Stir in enough remaining flour to make a soft dough ? knead on a lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic, about 8-10 minutes | Cover and let rest for 10 minutes | Divide dough into 12 equal pieces and shape into balls ? place in a greased 8-inch round pan | Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 30 minutes | Bake at 375?F (190?C) for 20 minutes until golden | Remove from pan and brush with additional melted butter | Serve warm

ingredients: 500g butter beans (canned or pre-cooked), 1 can (400g) tomato sauce, 2 carrots (diced), 1 cup frozen spinach, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 sprigs fresh thyme, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 andouille sausages (sliced), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a medium stock pot, bring all ingredients to a boil | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes until the beans are tender and the sausage has cooked through | Serve hot

ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable shortening, 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, 1 tbsp red food coloring, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 cup whole milk, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 tbsp white vinegar, cream cheese frosting for topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease and flour cake pans | Make a paste of cocoa powder and red food coloring ? set aside | Cream shortening and sugar until light and fluffy | Add eggs one at a time, beating well | Add vanilla and the cocoa-food coloring paste | Sift together flour and salt ? add alternately with milk, beating well | Dissolve baking soda in vinegar and add to the batter while foaming | Pour into prepared pans and bake for about 40 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool completely and frost with cream cheese icing

ingredients: 4 salmon fillets (about 150g each), 2 tbsp wasabi paste, 1/4 cup white sesame seeds, 2 tbsp black sesame seeds, 2 tbsp vegetable oil. For vinaigrette: 3 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1 tbsp grated fresh ginger, 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Make the vinaigrette: whisk together lime juice, ginger, olive oil, salt, and pepper ? set aside | Combine white and black sesame seeds on a plate | Brush each salmon fillet with a thin layer of wasabi paste and season with salt and pepper | Roll the salmon in the sesame seeds to coat evenly on all sides | Heat oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat | Cook the salmon for about 1 minute on each of the 4 sides (including the narrow edges), lowering the heat if the sesame seeds brown too quickly | Place on plates and drizzle with the ginger lime vinaigrette | Serve immediately

ingredients: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1 jar (200g) marshmallow creme, 2 cups whipped topping (thawed), 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup crushed pineapple (drained, optional), fresh strawberries for garnish (optional)
instructions: Beat cream cheese until smooth | Add marshmallow creme and mix until completely blended | Fold in whipped topping, vanilla, and crushed pineapple if using | Frost any type of cake and top with fresh strawberry slices if desired | Makes enough for about 2 cakes depending on how heavily you frost

ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes (scrubbed), 250g bulk pork sausage, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup cooked ham (diced), 4 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), 1/4 cup sour cream, 2 tbsp ranch or creamy salad dressing, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) ? scrub and pierce potatoes, then bake for about 1 hour until tender (or microwave on high for 12-14 minutes) | Meanwhile, cook sausage in a skillet over medium heat until no longer pink ? drain | When potatoes are cool enough to handle, cut in half lengthwise and scoop out the pulp, leaving a 1/4-inch shell | In a large bowl, mash the potato pulp with butter | Stir in sausage, cheese, ham, bacon, sour cream, salad dressing, salt, and pepper | Spoon the mixture back into the potato shells | Place on ungreased baking sheets and bake at 400?F for 30 minutes until golden brown | Serve hot

ingredients: 5 sheets phyllo dough (or prepared crust), cooking spray, 8 oz fat-free cream cheese (softened), 1 can (425g) pumpkin pur?e, 1/2 cup skim milk, 1 tsp pumpkin pie spice, 2 tbsp maple syrup or honey, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Layer phyllo sheets in a pie dish sprayed with cooking spray, pressing in lightly ? trim excess with scissors | Combine cream cheese, pumpkin, milk, pumpkin pie spice, maple syrup, and vanilla in a blender ? blend until smooth | Pour into the prepared crust | Brush the crust edges with skim milk and wrap with aluminum foil | Bake for 30 minutes, removing foil for the last 15 minutes to brown the edges | Cool and refrigerate before serving

ingredients: 1/2 cup coconut flour, 2 tbsp granulated sugar or sweetener, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 4 large eggs, 1/4 cup coconut milk, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tsp lemon zest, butter for serving
instructions: Whisk together half the coconut flour with all the other dry ingredients | Add the eggs, coconut milk, vanilla, and lemon zest ? whisk thoroughly | Slowly add the remaining coconut flour until the batter reaches the right consistency | Heat a pan to medium heat and lightly grease | Pour small portions of batter (coconut flour pancakes work best when made small) | Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden | Serve topped with butter

ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts (cooked and sliced), 1 can (400ml) coconut milk, 2 cups water, 1 tsp lemon zest, 4 kaffir lime leaves, 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 1 tbsp brown sugar, 2 dried chili peppers, 1/4 cup fresh cilantro (loosely chopped), 1 tbsp vegetable oil
instructions: Saut? chicken breasts in oil over medium-high heat until the center is no longer pink ? slice into thin strips | Warm coconut milk in a medium saucepan with water | Add lemon zest, kaffir lime leaves, dried chili peppers, ginger, and brown sugar | Loosely chop cilantro and add to the saucepan | Add the sliced chicken and let simmer for 10-15 minutes to allow flavors to meld | Serve hot in bowls

ingredients: 1/4 cup flavored vinegar (red or white wine vinegar), 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 clove garlic (minced, optional)
instructions: Combine vinegar, mustard, salt, pepper, and garlic in a small bowl | Slowly whisk in the olive oil until emulsified | Taste and adjust the ratio of oil to vinegar as desired | Store in a sealed jar in the refrigerator

ingredients: 3 cups broccoli florets (cut into 1/2-inch pieces), 2 tbsp water, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 Roma tomatoes (cut into wedges), 1/2 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese (shredded)
instructions: Wash and cut broccoli florets into 1/2-inch pieces | Place broccoli and water in a shallow microwave-safe dish ? cover and microwave on high for 5-7 minutes until tender, stirring once | Drain | Stir in oregano, pepper, lemon juice, and tomato wedges | Sprinkle cheese on top | Cover and microwave briefly to melt the cheese | Let stand for 2 minutes before serving

ingredients: For dry mix: 2 cups plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 tbsp caster sugar. To make pancakes: 150g dry mix, 1 large egg, 3/4 cup whole milk, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted)
instructions: Make the dry mix: combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and sugar in a bowl ? store in an airtight container | To make pancakes: mix 150g of the dry mix with egg, milk, and melted butter until smooth | Heat a flat griddle or non-stick frying pan without oil | Spoon 1 1/2 to 2 tablespoons of batter per pancake onto the hot griddle | When bubbles appear on the surface, flip and cook until golden brown on both sides ? about 1 minute per side | Serve warm

ingredients: 4 catfish fillets (cut into 1-inch strips), 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1/2 tsp hot pepper sauce, 2 cups shredded cabbage, 1/2 cup cornmeal, 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1 tbsp Cajun seasoning, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 8 corn or flour tortillas (warmed), lime wedges for serving
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine lime juice, mayonnaise, and hot pepper sauce ? add cabbage and toss to make the slaw | Rinse fish strips and pat dry ? season with Cajun seasoning | Combine cornmeal and flour in a bowl ? add fish and toss to coat | Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook catfish in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and flaky | Warm tortillas and layer with fish and slaw | Serve with lime wedges and extra hot sauce

ingredients: 800g plum tomatoes (cored, pur?ed, and strained), 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 cup dry red wine, 1 tsp granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1/4 cup fresh basil (torn)
instructions: Prepare the tomatoes: core, roughly chop, and pur?e in a food processor ? strain to remove seeds and skins | Heat olive oil in a large pot and cook the diced onion over medium heat, stirring, until soft | Add garlic and cook until soft without browning | Add the tomato pur?e, wine, sugar, salt, and pepper ? reduce heat to low and simmer until thickened, about 15 minutes | Stir in fresh basil just before serving | Serve over pasta

ingredients: 4 slices bacon (diced), 1 cup couscous, 2 tbsp cider vinegar, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 3 tbsp olive oil, 3 cups iceberg lettuce (chopped), 2 ripe tomatoes (diced), salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, cook bacon until crisp ? transfer to paper towels to drain | Pour off all but 1 tablespoon of the bacon fat | Return saucepan to medium-high heat, add couscous, and toast, stirring often, until lightly browned, 2-4 minutes | Spread toasted couscous on a baking sheet to cool for 25 minutes | Make the dressing: whisk together vinegar, lemon juice, and mustard ? slowly whisk in olive oil | In a large bowl, combine lettuce and tomatoes | Add the cooled couscous, reserved bacon, and dressing ? toss well | Season with salt and pepper and serve

ingredients: For aspic: 1 tbsp unflavored gelatin, 1/4 cup cold water, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 cup strong black coffee (hot), 2 tbsp Kahlua. For mousse: 1 tbsp unflavored gelatin, 2 tbsp cold water, 3 large egg yolks, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup hot milk, 200g bittersweet chocolate (melted), 1 cup heavy cream (whipped), chocolate curls for garnish
instructions: Line a buttered 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with parchment paper | Make the aspic: sprinkle gelatin over cold water and let stand for 1 minute ? add sugar, hot coffee, and Kahlua, stirring until dissolved | Pour into the prepared pan and refrigerate until set, about 20 minutes | Make the mousse: sprinkle gelatin over cold water and let stand for 1 minute ? whisk in egg yolks and sugar | Stir in hot milk and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon | Stir in melted chocolate and let cool | Whip cream until stiff and fold into the cooled chocolate mixture | Spread the mousse evenly over the set coffee aspic | Cover and chill for 3 hours | Invert onto a serving platter, remove paper, and garnish with chocolate curls

ingredients: 1/4 cup raisins, 1/4 cup almonds, 200g white mushrooms, 1/2 cup edamame, 1/4 cup green lentils (cooked), 1/4 cup brown lentils (cooked), 1 cup Israeli couscous (cooked, divided), 1 tsp curry powder, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp dried porcini mushrooms (rehydrated), 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 2 tbsp canola oil, 1/2 cup ketchup, 2 tbsp pomegranate molasses, burger buns and mesclun greens for serving
instructions: In a food processor, combine raisins and almonds ? process until finely chopped | Add mushrooms and process until coarsely chopped | Add edamame, lentils, and half the couscous ? process until coarsely chopped | Stir curry powder into lemon juice and add to the processor along with porcini ? process to a coarse paste | Remove to a bowl, fold in the remaining couscous, and season with salt | Form into 6 patties about 1-inch thick | Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet and cook patties over moderate heat, turning once, until browned, about 6 minutes | Combine ketchup with pomegranate molasses | Serve patties on buns with pomegranate ketchup and mesclun greens

ingredients: 500g dried black-eyed peas, 1 ham hock (scored), 2 tbsp bacon grease, 6 cups water, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Add water to a large pot and start to bring to a boil | Add the ham hock and boil for about 20 minutes to season the water | Add bacon grease and stir until melted | Add the black-eyed peas | Boil at a rapid boil for the first 20 minutes, then reduce to a low boil, cover, and continue cooking until the peas are tender | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Serve hot

ingredients: 250g pork tenderloin (thinly sliced), 3 tbsp hoisin sauce, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp fresh ginger (grated), 200g pasta or noodles (cooked), 1 tbsp vegetable oil, 2 cups fresh spinach, 1/2 cup water chestnuts (sliced), 1 carrot (julienned), 3 green onions (sliced)
instructions: Cook pasta until just tender ? drain and set aside | Whisk together hoisin sauce, garlic, red pepper flakes, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and ginger ? pour half over the pork strips and toss to coat ? let stand for 15 minutes | Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a wok over medium-high heat ? add pork and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, then remove | Heat 1 tablespoon oil in the wok ? add spinach, water chestnuts, carrot, and green onion and stir-fry until the spinach is wilted, about 3 minutes | Add the cooked pasta, pork, and remaining hoisin sauce mixture ? cook for about 2 minutes until heated through | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1.5 kg boneless skinless chicken breasts, 1/2 cup Italian dressing, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 can (400g) cream of chicken soup, 1/2 cup chicken broth, 8 oz Neufchatel cheese (cubed), cooking spray
instructions: Place chicken in a slow cooker and coat with Italian dressing ? cook on low for 4-6 hours | In a medium saucepan, saut? onion and garlic in cooking spray for 1-2 minutes | Add cream of chicken soup, chicken broth, and Neufchatel cheese ? stir until smooth and consistent | Add the pan mixture to the slow cooker and cook for 1 more hour | Serve the chicken with the sauce over rice or pasta

ingredients: 1 cup granulated sugar, 4 large eggs, 1 can (400g) sweetened condensed milk, 1 can (354ml) evaporated milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | In a medium saucepan over medium-low heat, melt the sugar until liquified and golden ? carefully pour the hot syrup into a 9-inch round glass baking dish, turning to coat the bottom and sides | In a large bowl, beat eggs ? beat in condensed milk, evaporated milk, and vanilla until smooth | Pour the egg mixture into the caramel-coated dish and cover with aluminum foil | Place the dish in a larger pan and fill with water halfway up the sides | Bake for 60 minutes | Cool completely, then carefully invert onto a serving plate

ingredients: 400g spaghettini, 3 tbsp olive oil, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 2 ripe tomatoes (diced), 1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes (chopped), 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, salt and black pepper, 200g fresh asparagus (cut and blanched), 200g fresh crabmeat, 1/4 cup mascarpone cheese, 1/4 cup fresh basil leaves (torn)
instructions: Saut? garlic in olive oil over medium heat for 2 minutes | Add fresh diced tomatoes, sun-dried tomatoes, and red pepper flakes | Cover and simmer for about 5 minutes ? season with salt and pepper | Cook asparagus in boiling water for 2 minutes, then transfer to the skillet with the sauce | Cook spaghettini in salted boiling water until al dente ? drain | Bring the sauce to a simmer, mix in crabmeat and mascarpone, and blend well | Add the pasta and basil ? toss just to heat through and serve immediately

ingredients: 30ml cr?me de cacao, 30ml hazelnut liqueur (such as Frangelico), 30ml heavy cream, ice cubes
instructions: Pour the cr?me de cacao and hazelnut liqueur into an ice-filled highball glass | Add the cream and stir gently | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4 slices lean bacon (chopped), 1 medium onion (diced), 6 cups water, 2 carrots (diced), 2 medium potatoes (cubed), 1/2 tsp sea salt, 1 can (400g) crushed tomatoes, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 2 celery ribs (diced), 2 tbsp ketchup, 2 cans (200g each) baby clams (with liquid), 1 cup whole milk, 2 tbsp instant potato flakes, oyster crackers for serving
instructions: In a medium frying pan, lightly fry chopped bacon until partially cooked ? drain and discard fat | Add diced onion to the bacon and saut? for 5 minutes without browning ? set aside | In a large pot, bring water to a boil and add carrots, potatoes, salt, and pepper | Pur?e the tomatoes in a blender and add to the pot along with the bacon-onion mixture | Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes until carrots and potatoes are tender | Add celery and ketchup and cook for 5 minutes | Add the clams with their liquid and simmer for 5 minutes | Stir in milk and bring just to a boil | Add instant potato flakes, stir well, and simmer for 3 minutes | Adjust thickness with more potato flakes if needed | Let sit for 15 minutes before serving with oyster crackers

ingredients: 200g smoked salmon, 1 can (200g) tuna (drained), 1/2 fennel bulb, 2 tbsp fresh chives, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 2 cups whole milk, 1/2 cup low-fat cottage cheese, 400g pasta (cooked)
instructions: Blend salmon, tuna, fennel, and chives in a food processor | Melt butter in a pot over low heat ? stir in flour, salt, and pepper | Add milk bit by bit, stirring well after each addition until all the milk is added | Bring to a boil, stirring constantly, and boil for 2 minutes | Add cottage cheese and stir | Blend the sauce with the seafood mixture in a food processor until smooth | Return to the pot and heat through over low heat | Serve over cooked pasta

ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles (cooked), 200g mushrooms (sliced), 1 can (400g) whole tomatoes, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp dried rosemary, 1/2 tsp salt, 500g minced beef (browned), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 cups whole milk, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/4 cup breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 180?C (350?F) | Make the meat sauce: brown the minced beef, add tomatoes with their liquid, onion, garlic, oregano, rosemary, and salt ? simmer for 40 minutes until liquid has almost evaporated | Make the cheese sauce: melt butter, stir in flour, and gradually add milk ? cook until thickened, then add cheddar cheese and stir until melted | Layer in an ovenproof dish: noodles, half the meat sauce, half the cheese sauce ? repeat | Sprinkle the top with breadcrumbs and Parmesan | Bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling

ingredients: 500g large shrimp (peeled and deveined), 1 tsp salt, 4 cloves garlic (sliced), 3 tbsp olive oil, 100g cooked ham (diced), 1/4 tsp hot red pepper flakes, 1 red bell pepper (diced), 1/4 cup dry sherry, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), crusty bread for serving
instructions: Rinse shrimp and pat dry ? sprinkle both sides with salt and let stand between paper towels for 10 minutes | In a large heavy skillet, cook sliced garlic in olive oil over moderate heat, stirring, until golden ? remove with a slotted spoon and set aside | Add ham and red pepper flakes and cook for 3-5 minutes until the ham deepens in color | Add bell pepper and cook until softened | Add shrimp and saut? over moderately high heat, turning, for 3 minutes | Add the sherry and reserved garlic ? simmer until the shrimp are just cooked through | Transfer to a heated serving dish, sprinkle with parsley, and serve with crusty bread

ingredients: 1 medium head green cabbage (cored and finely shredded), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 tbsp light soy sauce, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/2 tsp caraway seeds, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper
instructions: Cut the central core from the cabbage and shred the leaves finely | Heat oil in a wok until quite hot | Stir-fry the cabbage for about 2 minutes | Toss in the soy sauce, lemon juice, caraway seeds, and pepper ? stir well | Serve immediately

ingredients: 2 medium baking potatoes (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 500g lean ground beef, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup beer, 1/2 cup beef consomm?, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes with green pepper and onion, 1/4 cup green olives (sliced), 1 tbsp cider vinegar, 1 can refrigerated breadstick dough, 1 tbsp garlic butter spread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Heat a large Dutch oven coated with cooking spray over medium heat ? add potato and onion, cover, and cook for 7 minutes | Add beef, oregano, chili powder, cumin, salt, pepper, and garlic ? cook uncovered for 7 minutes until browned | Sprinkle flour over the pan and cook for 1 minute | Gradually add beer, consomm?, and tomatoes ? bring to a boil | Remove from heat and stir in olives and vinegar | Spoon into an 11 x 7-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray | Unroll breadstick dough and roll together into a 12 x 10-inch rectangle ? place over the beef mixture | Cut 5 slits in the top and brush with garlic butter spread | Bake for 25 minutes until golden brown and bubbly | Let stand 10 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1 whole chicken (about 1.5 kg), water to cover
instructions: Fill a very large pot (at least 8 quarts) with enough water to completely cover the chicken | Bring the water to a boil without the chicken | Carefully add the chicken to the boiling water | As soon as the boiling stops, remove the chicken | Return the water to a boil, then carefully return the chicken to the pot and cover tightly | Turn off the heat but leave the pot on the burner | Leave untouched for exactly 1 hour | Remove the chicken from the water and let cool just enough to handle, then debone | Use the meat as desired

ingredients: 1 cup unsalted margarine (softened), 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 4 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tsp rum extract, 2 cups all-purpose flour (sifted)
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) and grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan | Cream margarine thoroughly, then add sugar gradually | Add eggs one at a time, mixing well after each | Add vanilla and rum extracts | Add sifted flour a little at a time, blending well | Pour batter into the prepared pan | Bake for about 1 hour until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean | Cool in the pan for 10 minutes before turning out onto a wire rack

ingredients: 4 catfish fillets (about 150g each), 1/4 cup mayonnaise, 2 tbsp buttermilk, 1 tsp lemon zest, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp dried dill, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumbs, 1/2 tsp seasoned salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) and line a baking sheet with foil sprayed with nonstick cooking spray | Mix breadcrumbs with seasoned salt, black pepper, and cayenne in a bowl | In another bowl, combine mayonnaise, buttermilk, lemon zest, lemon juice, dill, and garlic | Brush fillets on both sides with the mayonnaise mixture | Coat evenly with the breadcrumb mixture | Place on the prepared baking sheet | Bake for 20-22 minutes until the fish flakes easily with a fork | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 prepared 9-inch pie crust (baked and cooled), 2/3 cup granulated sugar, 3 tbsp cornstarch, 3 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 1/2 cups water, 1 can (354ml) evaporated milk, 2 large egg yolks (beaten), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 ripe bananas (sliced), whipped cream sweetened with confectioners sugar for topping
instructions: Prepare and bake the pie crust ? set aside to cool | Mix sugar, cornstarch, cocoa, and salt in a 2-quart saucepan | Stir in water and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until bubbly | Pour in evaporated milk and stir to blend | Spoon a little of the hot mixture into the beaten egg yolks, then return to the saucepan | Cook until bubbly and thickened, stirring constantly | Stir in butter and vanilla ? let stand for 20 minutes | Pour half the cocoa mixture into the pie crust | Slice bananas directly onto the custard | Pour the remaining custard over the bananas | Cool completely and chill | Before serving, top with sweetened whipped cream

ingredients: 500g ground beef, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1 large egg, 1/4 cup matzo meal or breadcrumbs. For sauce: 1 bottle (340g) chili sauce, 1/2 cup water, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice
instructions: Mix together ground beef, garlic powder, onion powder, egg, and matzo meal | Form into small balls and set aside | Pour chili sauce into a medium saucepan ? refill the bottle with water, shake well, and add to the pot | Add brown sugar and lemon juice and mix | Bring the sauce to a boil ? taste and adjust sweet and sour balance | Drop in the meatballs, return to a boil, cover, and simmer for at least 20 minutes | Serve over rice or as an appetizer

ingredients: 4 turkey cutlets (about 150g each), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 tsp dried tarragon (divided), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 shallots (minced), 1/3 cup dry white wine, 1/2 cup heavy cream
instructions: Season turkey cutlets with salt, pepper, and 1 teaspoon tarragon | Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat | Add turkey and cook, turning once, until golden, 4-5 minutes ? remove to a plate, leaving the drippings | Add shallots to the pan and cook until softened, about 1 minute | Add wine, raise heat to high, and cook, scraping up browned bits, until reduced by one-third, about 2 minutes | Add cream and the remaining 1 teaspoon tarragon ? cook until the sauce slightly thickens, about 2 minutes | Return turkey and any juices to the sauce ? cook until heated through, about 1 minute | Serve immediately

ingredients: 500g turkey breast (diced), 500g chicken breast (diced), 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp sweet paprika, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp mustard powder, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, pinch of cayenne, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 red bell pepper (diced), 1 yellow bell pepper (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 200g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 cups chicken stock, 2 tbsp dry milk powder, 8 oz fat-free cream cheese (cubed), 4 cups cooked long-grain rice
instructions: Mix together salt, onion powder, paprika, garlic powder, mustard, white pepper, nutmeg, and cayenne | Sprinkle diced turkey and chicken with 2 teaspoons of the seasoning mix | Heat oil in a heavy 5-quart pot over high heat ? add the seasoned meat and cook until browned on all sides, 3-5 minutes | Add onions, peppers, mushrooms, and the remaining seasoning ? cook for 4 minutes | Blend 1 cup stock, dry milk powder, and flour in a blender until smooth ? add to the pot with the remaining stock | Bring to a gentle boil, then lower heat and simmer for 4-6 minutes | Remove 1 cup of liquid and blend with the cream cheese ? stir back into the pot | Serve immediately over hot rice

ingredients: 4 cups fresh spinach (washed), 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese, 1/2 cup fresh blueberries, 1/4 cup walnuts or pecans (chopped), 3 tbsp balsamic vinaigrette or poppy seed dressing
instructions: Place cleaned spinach in a large bowl | Sprinkle with feta crumbles ? keep bits on the smaller side | Add blueberries and nuts | Toss with salad dressing and chill | Serve cool, allowing guests to add more dressing as desired

ingredients: 2 cups fresh strawberries (halved), 2 cups fresh rhubarb (chopped), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 tbsp cornstarch, 1 cup old-fashioned rolled oats, 1/2 cup Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese (grated), 1/4 cup dark brown sugar, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1 tsp vanilla extract, vanilla ice cream for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Toss strawberries and rhubarb with sugar and cornstarch in a 9 x 9-inch glass baking dish | In a bowl, mix oats, Parmesan, and brown sugar | Stir vanilla into the melted butter and pour over the oat mixture ? stir until wet and clumpy | Scatter the oat mixture over the fruit | Bake for about 20 minutes until the fruit is bubbling and the top is crisped | Serve warm with vanilla ice cream

ingredients: 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream, 1 tbsp orange zest, 1/2 cup white chocolate chips, 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips, 1/2 tsp orange extract, powdered sugar and cocoa powder for coating
instructions: In a saucepan, bring the heavy cream and orange zest to a gentle boil ? immediately pour over both types of chocolate chips in a medium bowl | Let stand for about 1 minute, then whisk until smooth | Add the orange extract and stir well | Cover and chill for 30 minutes until the mixture begins to thicken slightly | Beat for 30 seconds until the color lightens ? do not overbeat | Drop rounded teaspoons onto wax paper-lined baking sheets | Refrigerate for 30 minutes until firm enough to roll into small balls | Roll in a mixture of equal parts powdered sugar and cocoa powder | Keep refrigerated

ingredients: 250g seitan (cubed), 1 red bell pepper (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp vegan Worcestershire sauce, 2 tbsp dry sherry, 2 cups broccoli florets, 2 tangerines or mandarin oranges (segmented), 2 green onions (sliced), steamed rice for serving
instructions: Combine seitan, bell pepper, garlic, ginger, red pepper flakes, soy sauce, rice vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, and sherry in a slow cooker | Cover and cook on low for 6 hours | During the last 30 minutes, add broccoli | Before serving, mix in tangerine segments and green onions | Serve over hot rice

ingredients: 2 cups green cabbage (finely chopped), 1 carrot (finely chopped), 1 apple (finely chopped), 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 cup mayonnaise, 2 tbsp skim milk, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice
instructions: Finely chop the cabbage, carrot, and apple (a food processor works well) | In a separate bowl, mix together sugar, pepper, salt, mayonnaise, milk, vinegar, and lemon juice | Pour the dressing over the cabbage mixture and toss well | Chill and serve

ingredients: For basic batter: 1 cup sourdough starter, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 cup water. For waffles: 2 large eggs (separated), 1/4 cup milk, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1 cup all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp baking powder
instructions: The night before: combine sourdough starter, 1 cup flour, 2 tablespoons sugar, and water in a large container ? cover loosely and let sit at room temperature for 6-12 hours | The next morning: beat egg whites until stiff peaks form | In a medium bowl, beat egg yolks, milk, and melted butter ? stir in 1 cup of the basic batter | In a separate bowl, sift together flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, and baking soda | Stir into the egg yolk mixture and let rest for 10 minutes | Gently fold in the beaten egg whites | Ladle batter onto a preheated waffle iron and cook according to the manufacturer's instructions | Serve immediately

ingredients: 3 tbsp vegan margarine, 1 jar (200g) marshmallow creme or vegan marshmallow fluff, 4 cups crispy rice cereal
instructions: Melt margarine in a large saucepan over low heat | Add marshmallow creme and cook over low heat for about 5 minutes, stirring constantly | Remove from heat and add crispy rice cereal ? stir until well coated | Using a greased spatula, press the mixture evenly into a greased 9-inch square pan | Let cool completely, then cut into squares

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups heavy cream, 1/2 cup whole milk, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 vanilla bean (split and scraped), 50g dark chocolate (melted, optional)
instructions: Combine cream, milk, and sugar in a medium saucepan over medium heat ? bring to a simmer, then remove from heat | Scrape the vanilla seeds into the milk mixture, add the bean, and let sit for 30 minutes | Strain into a clean bowl, discarding the bean | Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight | Transfer to an ice cream maker and freeze according to the manufacturer's directions | If adding chocolate, melt it in the microwave in 20-second intervals until smooth ? drizzle into the gelato during the last 2 minutes of churning | Scoop into bowls and serve immediately

ingredients: 1 cup granulated sugar, 3 large eggs, 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple (undrained), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup cornmeal, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup shredded coconut, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted), 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 prepared pie shell
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | In a large saucepan, combine sugar, eggs, pineapple with juice, flour, cornmeal, salt, coconut, butter, and vanilla | Cook over medium heat until the filling is thick, stirring constantly | Pour into the prepared pie shell | Bake for about 20 minutes until firm | Cool on a wire rack before serving

ingredients: 2 cups long-grain white rice, 3 cups cold water
instructions: Pour the rice into a mesh strainer and rinse under cold running water, stirring with your hand until the water runs clear | Combine the rinsed rice and cold water in a medium saucepan | Bring to a boil over medium-high heat and boil for 2 minutes | Cover, reduce heat to low, and cook for 18 minutes | Remove from heat and let rest covered for 5 minutes | Fluff with a fork and serve immediately

ingredients: 1 cup vegetable shortening, 3/4 cup brown sugar, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 tbsp hot water, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 1/2 cups quick oats, 2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Cream together shortening, brown sugar, and granulated sugar in a large bowl | Add eggs, vanilla, and hot water ? mix well | In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking soda, and salt ? gradually add to the creamed mixture | Stir in quick oats 1/2 cup at a time | Add chocolate chips and stir to combine evenly | Drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets, 2 inches apart | Bake for approximately 12 minutes | Cool on the cookie sheet for 2 minutes before moving to a wire rack

ingredients: 1 kg chicken wings, 1 cup orange juice, 3 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp ketchup, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp ground ginger, 2 green onions (chopped)
instructions: Place chicken wings in a shallow dish or zip-top bag | Whisk together orange juice, honey, soy sauce, ketchup, garlic, and ginger | Add 1 cup of the mixture to the wings ? reserve the remaining mixture | Cover and chill for 1 hour | Remove wings from the marinade, discarding the used marinade | Grill wings covered over medium-high heat for 17-20 minutes, turning occasionally | Meanwhile, bring the reserved orange juice mixture to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 25 minutes until reduced by half | Toss the warm wings with 1/4 cup of the reduced sauce | Transfer to a platter, sprinkle with green onions, and serve with the remaining sauce

ingredients: 4 ripe bananas (peeled and mashed), 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple with juice, 3 cups granulated sugar, 1 package (57g) powdered pectin
instructions: Peel and mash the bananas, then add the pineapple with juice | Add sugar to the fruit mixture and pour into a large enameled pot | Stir over low heat until the sugar dissolves | Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring continuously ? boil for 1 minute | Remove from heat, stir in pectin, and stir for 5 minutes | Skim and ladle into hot sterilized canning jars | Process in a water bath for 10 minutes if desired | Store in a cool dark place

ingredients: 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 100g shiitake mushrooms (sliced), 1 carrot (julienned), 2 shallots (sliced), 2 tbsp sake, 2 tbsp Japanese soy sauce, 2 1/2 cups water, 200g asparagus spears (cut into pieces), 1 cup snow peas, 1 tbsp arrowroot powder mixed with 2 tbsp water, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, steamed rice for serving
instructions: Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat ? add shiitakes, carrots, and shallots and cook, stirring frequently, 8-10 minutes until mushrooms have released their juices | Add sake and soy sauce ? increase heat and simmer rapidly for about 3 minutes until syrupy | Stir in water and bring to a boil ? reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes | Add asparagus and simmer 3-5 minutes until tender | Stir in snow peas and the arrowroot mixture ? cook, stirring constantly, 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens | Remove from heat and stir in rice vinegar | Ladle over rice in shallow bowls

ingredients: 500g lean rump steak (very thinly sliced), 1 medium onion (sliced), 2 carrots (julienned), 2 celery stalks (sliced), 1 red bell pepper (sliced), 1 green bell pepper (sliced), 1 cup broccoli florets, 2 tbsp cornstarch, 1 cup beef stock, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 3 tbsp black bean sauce, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp fish sauce
instructions: Slice beef very thinly diagonally | Prepare all vegetables as stated | Blend cornstarch into the beef stock until smooth ? set aside | Heat oil in a wok over high heat | Brown the beef in batches ? set aside | Clean out the wok and add all the vegetables at once ? stir-fry until just tender but not overcooked | Add black bean sauce, sugar, fish sauce, and the beef stock mixture ? stir quickly to make a sauce | Return the beef and vegetables to the wok and stir-fry for 1 minute more for crunchy vegetables, or simmer on low for 5 minutes for softer | Serve over rice

ingredients: 1 bag (900g) frozen hash brown potatoes, 6 large eggs, 1/2 cup whole milk, 6 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish | Cook bacon until crisp ? crumble and set aside | Layer half the hash browns in the bottom of the dish and sprinkle with salt, pepper, onion powder, and garlic powder ? add the remaining potatoes and season again | Top with crumbled bacon and cheese | Whisk together eggs and milk until incorporated ? pour evenly over the layers | Bake uncovered for about 1 1/2 hours until the liquid is absorbed and the top is golden | Let cool for 5 minutes before cutting into squares | Serve hot

ingredients: 1.5 kg pork roast, 1 tsp garlic salt, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 2 tbsp paprika, 1 medium onion (sliced), 1/2 cup water
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) | Combine garlic salt, ginger, pepper, and paprika ? rub over the entire roast | Place the roast fat-side up on a greased rack in a roasting pan | Top with sliced onion and pour water into the pan | Bake uncovered for 2 to 2 1/2 hours until a meat thermometer reads 160-170?F (71-77?C) | Let stand for 10-15 minutes before slicing | Serve with pan juices

ingredients: For cake: 2 cups cake flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp salt, 4 large eggs, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup brown sugar, 2 tbsp dark rum, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup Coca-Cola (fresh and bubbly), 1/4 cup milk. For sauce: 1/2 cup Coca-Cola, 1/2 cup white sugar, 2 tbsp light corn syrup, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp dark rum
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) and generously grease and flour a Bundt pan | Sift together flour, baking soda, and salt ? set aside | Beat eggs with an electric mixer, gradually add softened butter and brown sugar, and beat until creamy | Beat in rum, vanilla, Coca-Cola, and milk | Gradually add the flour mixture, beating constantly until smooth | Pour into the prepared pan and bake for 45-60 minutes until a tester comes out clean | Make the sauce: bring Coca-Cola, white sugar, and corn syrup to a boil in a saucepan ? cook until thickened | Remove from heat and stir in butter and rum | Serve the cake warm with plenty of sauce spooned over each serving

ingredients: 2 cups cooked brown rice, 1/3 cup maple syrup, 1 1/2 cups whole milk, 1 large egg (beaten), 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, cinnamon
instructions: Mix together maple syrup, milk, egg, cinnamon, and nutmeg in a medium pot | Add the cooked rice and cook for 10 minutes over low to medium heat, stirring frequently, until thick and creamy | Serve warm with a sprinkle of cinnamon

ingredients: 1 can (425g) pumpkin pur?e, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 can (354ml) evaporated milk, 2 large eggs, 3/4 cup brown sugar, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, 2 tbsp dark molasses, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1 unbaked 9-inch pie shell
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) | Combine pumpkin, salt, evaporated milk, eggs, brown sugar, cloves, molasses, cinnamon, ginger, and nutmeg in a large mixing bowl ? mix until thoroughly combined | Pour into the unbaked pie shell | Bake for 45-55 minutes until a knife inserted comes out clean | Cool and serve

ingredients: 4 medium potatoes (cooked and mashed), 3 large eggs (beaten), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tsp lemon zest, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (cut into small pieces), 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 tsp almond extract, 1/4 tsp grated nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and lightly butter a casserole dish | To the mashed potatoes, add beaten eggs, sugar, salt, vanilla, almond extract, and lemon zest ? mix well | Spoon into the prepared dish | Dot the top with butter pieces and sprinkle generously with grated nutmeg | Bake for 30 minutes until lightly browned | Serve warm

ingredients: 1 fennel bulb (cut into wedges), 1 acorn squash (peeled and cubed), 2 parsnips (peeled and sliced), 4 cloves garlic (smashed), 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp fresh sage (chopped), 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 cup vegetable or chicken broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Arrange vegetables and garlic in a shallow baking pan | Add oil, sage, salt, and pepper ? toss to coat | Roast for about 40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until almost tender | Add broth and bake 10 more minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: 1/2 cup white wine vinegar, 1/2 cup cider vinegar, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 3 habanero peppers (seeds removed for milder heat), 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves
instructions: In a nonreactive saucepan, cook vinegars and sugar over medium-high heat until the sugar is completely melted and the mixture is reduced by at least half and is thick | Finely chop the habaneros and carefully transfer the hot mixture to a blender | Add the habaneros and mint ? blend until smooth | Let cool to room temperature | Serve with chicken, goat, lamb, or mutton

ingredients: 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 cup vegetable shortening, 2 tbsp cold unsalted butter (cubed), milk or melted butter for brushing
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) and position the rack in the upper third | Stir lemon juice and whipping cream together and let stand for a few minutes | Stack 2 baking sheets together and line the top sheet with parchment paper | In a food processor, combine flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, and baking soda ? blend briefly | Add shortening and butter and pulse to make a coarse grainy mixture | Turn out into a large bowl, drizzle the soured cream over, and stir lightly with a fork | Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead 8-10 times | Pat to 1-inch thickness and cut into 2-inch disks | Brush tops with milk or melted butter and bake for 12-15 minutes until golden

ingredients: 4 slices bacon (diced), 1 medium head green cabbage (shredded), 2 medium onions (sliced), 2 chicken breasts (seasoned and browned), 2 cans (400g each) great northern beans, 2 medium potatoes (diced), 4 cups chicken broth, 2 chicken bouillon cubes, 1 cup water, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Render fat from the bacon in a large pot ? remove bacon and chop into bite-size pieces, set aside | Shred the cabbage and slice onions ? saut? in the bacon fat until lightly browned | Mix the bacon pieces back in and set aside | Season chicken with salt and pepper and fry in the bacon fat until well browned | Add chicken broth, bouillon cubes, potatoes, and water ? boil until the chicken is tender | Remove the chicken, shred into chunky pieces, and return to the pot | Add the cabbage mixture and beans | Boil until reduced to a thick gravy-like consistency, at least 1 to 1 1/2 hours ? the longer it cooks, the better | Serve hot

ingredients: For puffs: 1/2 cup water, 1/4 cup unsalted butter, 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 large eggs. For filling: 4 oz cream cheese (softened), 1 tbsp milk, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp curry powder, pinch of pepper, 1 cup cooked chicken (diced), 1/4 cup sliced almonds, 2 green onions (sliced)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Bring water and butter to a boil ? add flour and salt and stir vigorously over low heat until the mixture forms a ball | Remove from heat and beat in eggs one at a time until smooth | Drop level tablespoons of batter onto an ungreased baking sheet | Bake for 25 minutes ? cool completely | Combine cream cheese, milk, salt, curry powder, and pepper ? mix until well blended | Add chicken, almonds, and onion ? mix lightly | Cut tops from the puffs and fill with the chicken mixture | Replace tops and place on a cookie sheet | Bake at 375?F (190?C) for 5 minutes until warm | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1.5 kg pork ribs (membrane removed), salt and black pepper. For rub: 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 2 tbsp brown sugar. For sauce: 1 cup barbecue sauce, 1/2 cup ketchup, 2 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1 tbsp molasses, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/4 tsp salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 300?F (150?C) and line a baking sheet with foil ? spray with cooking spray | Peel the membrane off the ribs and season both sides with salt and pepper | Mix paprika, garlic powder, and brown sugar ? rub evenly over both sides of the ribs | Place on the baking sheet and cover tightly with foil | Bake for 2 hours | Make the BBQ sauce: combine all sauce ingredients in a saucepan, bring to a boil, then simmer for 5 minutes | Remove ribs from the oven, uncover, and turn the broiler to low | Coat the ribs with BBQ sauce and broil for 10 minutes | Let rest for a few minutes before serving

ingredients: 3 medium zucchini (grated and squeezed dry), 1 medium onion (grated and drained), 2 cloves garlic, 1/4 cup walnuts, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 tbsp dried parsley, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, olive oil for baking
instructions: Grate the zucchini, toss with salt, and let drain in a colander | Grate the onion and let the juice drain away | Process garlic and walnuts until finely chopped | Press as much liquid from the zucchini and onion as possible | Combine with garlic, walnuts, parsley, and cheese in a bowl | Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and lightly oil a baking sheet | Shape into small patties and coat with breadcrumbs | Arrange on the baking sheet and bake for about 35 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden | Serve warm

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups spelt flour, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 large egg, 1 cup rice milk or milk, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, butter or oil for cooking, maple syrup for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt | In a small bowl, mix together the egg, milk, and oil with a fork | Add the egg mixture all at once to the flour mixture ? stir until just moistened (still lumpy) | Heat a skillet over medium heat and grease lightly | Pour desired amount of batter and cook until bubbles cover the surface and the bottom is golden | Flip and cook the other side until done | Serve warm with maple syrup

ingredients: For crust: 200g coconut cookies (crushed), 1/2 cup shredded coconut, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted). For filling: 1 cup whole milk, 1/3 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp cornstarch, 1/2 cup cream of coconut, 1 tbsp lime zest, 1 large egg yolk, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1/2 tsp coconut extract, 1/2 cup heavy cream (whipped). For topping: 1/2 cup heavy cream (whipped), lime slices
instructions: Make the crust: crush cookies in a food processor, add coconut and butter, and pulse until moistened | Press into a 9-inch tart pan and bake at 350?F (175?C) for about 15 minutes until golden ? cool | Whisk milk, sugar, and cornstarch in a heavy saucepan | Whisk in cream of coconut and lime zest ? bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened, about 2 minutes | Remove from heat | Whisk the egg yolk in a bowl, whisk in the hot milk mixture, then return to the pan and simmer for 2 minutes | Stir in lime juice and coconut extract | Cover the surface with plastic wrap and refrigerate until cold, about 2 hours | Whisk the filling to loosen, then fold in the whipped cream | Scrape into the crust and smooth the top ? refrigerate for 1 hour | Whip cream for topping and pipe rosettes around the edge ? garnish with lime slice quarters

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1 cup instant brown rice (uncooked), 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 tbsp chili powder, salt to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 300?F (150?C) | In a skillet, cook and crumble the ground beef ? drain well | Add diced onion and stir in tomatoes (with their juice), uncooked instant rice, salt, pepper, and chili powder ? heat through | Pour into an ungreased 2-quart casserole dish | Bake for 30-40 minutes | If using regular brown rice, partially cook it before adding to ensure it cooks through

ingredients: 400g elbow macaroni (cooked, drained, and cooled), 3/4 cup mayonnaise, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp sweet pickle relish, 1/4 cup sweet onion (diced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 1/2 green bell pepper (diced), 1/2 cup frozen baby peas (thawed), 2 hard-boiled eggs (chopped), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Cook the macaroni according to package directions ? drain well, rinse, and cool | Mix the mayonnaise, salt, relish, and onion in a small bowl ? set aside | Combine the macaroni, celery, bell pepper, and peas in a large bowl | Add the mayonnaise mixture and toss to coat | Gently fold in the chopped eggs | Season with additional salt and pepper to taste | Chill well, about 2 hours, then taste and adjust seasoning before serving

ingredients: 1 turkey carcass (with some meat remaining), 2 litres water, 1 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 celery ribs (diced), 1 carrot (diced), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1 tsp dried marjoram, 1 bay leaf, 200g cooked egg noodles
instructions: Combine the turkey carcass and water in a crock pot | Add salt, pepper, onion, celery, carrot, parsley, marjoram, and bay leaf | Cover and cook on low for 5-6 hours | Remove the carcass and bay leaf ? take the meat off the bones and return the meat to the broth ? discard the bones | Add cooked noodles to the crock pot | Cover and cook on high for 20-30 minutes | Discard the bay leaf and serve hot

ingredients: 1 large egg white, 8 tbsp granulated sugar (divided), 1 cup cornflakes (crushed), 1/2 cup shredded coconut, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, pinch of salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a cookie sheet | In a medium bowl, beat the egg white, gradually adding 2 tablespoons of sugar until stiff | Stir in the remaining 6 tablespoons sugar, cornflakes, coconut, vanilla, and salt | Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto the prepared cookie sheet | Bake for 10 minutes until lightly browned | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: For cake: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 1/4 cups granulated sugar, 1 cup pumpkin pur?e, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped), 1/2 cup raisins. For icing: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup evaporated milk, 2 tbsp maple syrup, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a Bundt pan | Cream butter and sugar until fluffy | Add pumpkin, eggs, and vanilla ? beat until smooth | Combine dry ingredients in a medium bowl and add to the creamed mixture one cup at a time, stirring until blended | Stir in nuts and raisins | Spoon into the prepared pan | Bake for 55-65 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then invert onto a serving plate and cool completely | Make the icing: melt butter in a heavy saucepan, stir in sugar, evaporated milk, and maple syrup ? bring to a boil, stirring constantly, and boil for 6 minutes | Remove from heat, stir in vanilla, and cool for 10 minutes | Beat for 8-10 minutes until thick and creamy and spread over the cake

ingredients: For crust: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/3 cup unsalted butter (melted). For filling: 3 large eggs (separated), 1 whole egg, 1/2 cup fresh key lime juice, 1 can (400g) sweetened condensed milk, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp cream of tartar, green food coloring (optional). For topping: sweetened whipped cream, lime slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) | Make the crust: mix graham cracker crumbs with sugar, cinnamon, and melted butter ? press into a 9-inch pie plate | Bake for 5 minutes ? cool completely | Separate 3 eggs, placing the whites in a mixing bowl | To the yolks add 1 whole egg, lime juice, and condensed milk ? mix until smooth and add food coloring if using | Beat the egg whites with salt and cream of tartar until stiff but not dry ? fold into the lime mixture | Pour the filling into the cooled crust | Bake for 10-15 minutes until just set | Cool at room temperature, then freeze for a minimum of 5 hours or overnight | Just before serving, top with sweetened whipped cream and lime slices

ingredients: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 tbsp habanero hot sauce, 1/4 cup mayonnaise, 1 can (400g) artichoke hearts (drained and chopped), 1 can (200g) diced green chilies, 1/4 cup sliced black olives, crackers or tortilla chips for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) | Mix cream cheese, Parmesan, hot sauce, and mayonnaise in a stand mixer until well combined | Add artichoke hearts, chilies, and olives ? mix just until integrated | Pour into a 2-quart baking dish and top with olives | Bake for 45 minutes | Serve warm with crackers, bread, or tortilla chips

ingredients: 1/2 cup light corn syrup, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp cream of tartar, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Beat corn syrup, sugar, and cream of tartar together over hot water for 7 minutes | Add vanilla and beat until cool and fluffy | Use as a substitute for store-bought marshmallow fluff

ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 tsp Italian seasoning, pinch of cayenne pepper, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 1 cup whole milk or cream, 2 cups cooked chicken (diced), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (plus extra for serving), 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, 1/2 cup sour cream, 400g cooked pasta
instructions: Heat butter over medium heat in a medium saucepan | Add onion, Italian seasoning, and cayenne ? saut? until softened, about 3-4 minutes | Add garlic and cook for 2 minutes | Stir in mushroom soup, milk, chicken, and 1/4 cup Parmesan ? bring to a simmer over medium heat | Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally | Season with black pepper | Cook the pasta according to package directions | Just before serving, mix the sour cream into the sauce until heated through (do not boil) | Serve over cooked pasta with extra Parmesan on top

ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise, 2 tbsp fresh dill (chopped), 1 tsp lemon zest, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Add dill, lemon zest, and lemon juice to the mayonnaise ? mix well | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Serve with eggs, vegetables, new potatoes, or fish

ingredients: 1.5 kg rack of pork, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp kosher salt, 2 tbsp Dijon mustard, 2 tbsp liquid honey, 1 tbsp dried rosemary (crushed), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 cup beef broth, 1 cup chicken broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Make many shallow 1-inch slits over the surface of the fat | Mix garlic with salt and spread over the roast, pressing into the slits | Place in a shallow baking dish and roast uncovered for 2 hours | Mix oil with Dijon mustard and crushed rosemary | After the initial 2 hours, cover the roast with the Dijon mixture and baste every 15 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 155?F (68?C) | If the roast browns too quickly, cover loosely with foil | Let rest for at least 10 minutes | Skim fat from the pan juices, add broths, and scrape up any brown bits ? boil gently for 5 minutes | Slice the pork and serve with the pan juices

ingredients: 1 medium head green cabbage (chopped), 3 tbsp olive oil, 6 slices bacon (cut into thirds), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Place chopped cabbage in an oblong baking dish (it will wilt a lot while cooking) | Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper | Lay bacon pieces over the cabbage to completely cover the dish | Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour | Remove foil and bake 30 minutes more to crisp the bacon | Serve hot

ingredients: 1/4 cup unsalted butter, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 2 tbsp dry white wine, salt and black pepper, 2 tbsp heavy cream, 24 canned snails (drained), 2 tbsp breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat ? sweat garlic for 1 minute, then add parsley, wine, salt, and pepper ? bring to a simmer | Remove from heat and stir in cream until blended | Add the snails and turn in the sauce until coated | Divide snails and sauce among 4 small ovenproof dishes or ramekins ? top with breadcrumbs | Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden and bubbling | Serve immediately with crusty bread

ingredients: 4 slices deli ham, 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 1 can (400g) cream of chicken soup, 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream, 6 slices low-fat Swiss cheese (divided)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Fry the ham in a non-stick pan until a little crispy ? line the bottom of a baking dish with the ham | Place the chicken breasts over the ham | Mix the soup, sour cream, and half the cheese ? spread over the chicken | Cover with the remaining Swiss cheese | Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes | Uncover and bake until the cheese is brown and the chicken juices run clear, about 15-20 minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 cups whole milk, 1/2 cup water, 4 large eggs, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted), 6 cups bread cubes. For sauce: 2 large eggs, 2 tbsp whiskey, lemon juice, or amaretto, 1/2 cup confectioners sugar, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Combine sugar, milk, and water in a bowl ? mix well | Add eggs, salt, vanilla, coconut, and melted butter ? mix well | Stir in the bread cubes and let stand until the liquid is absorbed | Spoon into a 9 x 12-inch baking dish | Bake for 35-40 minutes until the pudding rises and springs back when touched | Make the sauce: whisk eggs and your chosen flavoring in a food processor until well blended | Add confectioners sugar and melted butter ? process until smooth | Serve the pudding warm with the sauce

ingredients: 1/2 cup uncooked white rice, 1/3 cup granulated sugar, 2 cups whole milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup mixed fruit (peaches, berries, or canned fruit), 2 large egg whites, 1/4 cup extra granulated sugar
instructions: Combine rice, sugar, and milk in a saucepan ? stir constantly over heat until boiling | Reduce heat to lowest setting, cover, and cook for about 1 hour until the rice is tender and the mixture is thick and creamy, stirring occasionally | Stir in vanilla | Spread the rice mixture over the base of an ovenproof dish (7-cup capacity) | Top evenly with fruit | Beat egg whites with an electric mixer until soft peaks form ? gradually add extra sugar and beat until thick and glossy | Spoon the meringue over the fruit to cover completely | Bake at 180?C (350?F) for 20-30 minutes until the meringue is evenly browned | Serve warm with thin cream if desired

ingredients: 1 cup plain breadcrumbs, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp dried parsley flakes, 1/2 tsp ground black pepper, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp dried basil
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl, tossing to blend thoroughly | Store in an airtight container | Use in any recipe calling for Italian breadcrumbs

ingredients: 2 large cucumbers (peeled and thinly sliced), 1 tsp salt, 1/2 cup sweet onion (diced), 1/2 cup plain yogurt, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp fresh dill (chopped), 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1/4 tsp fresh ground pepper
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the cucumbers and place in a large bowl | Add salt and toss to cover all slices ? let stand for about 1 hour | Drain off all water in a colander | In a small bowl, combine yogurt, lemon juice, dill, and pepper ? stir until well mixed | Add olive oil and stir vigorously until blended | Place the drained cucumber slices in a salad bowl, pour the dressing over, and toss gently | Refrigerate for about 1 hour to allow the flavors to meld, then serve

ingredients: 1 kg chuck steak (trimmed), 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1 medium onion (sliced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp sugar, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes with green chilies, 1 cup hot water, 1 beef bouillon cube, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, steamed rice for serving
instructions: Trim large areas of fat from the steak and remove any bones | Mix flour with salt and pepper on a plate | Heat oil in a frying pan ? dredge steak in flour and place in the hot pan | Brown on both sides and place in the bottom of a crock pot | In the same pan, cook onion and garlic with sugar until browned and caramelized ? place on top of the steak | Dissolve the bouillon cube in hot water and pour over the steak | Pour the can of tomatoes over the top | Cover and cook on low for 6 hours | Serve over white or brown rice

ingredients: 12 fresh oysters (shucked, shells reserved), 2 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp wasabi paste, pinch of chili flakes, sea salt for serving
instructions: Combine mirin, vinegar, lemon juice, wasabi, and chili in a small jug ? stir well | Remove oysters from shells, drain on absorbent paper, and wash and dry the shells | Return oysters to the shells and arrange on a bed of sea salt on a serving platter | Spoon the dressing over each oyster | Serve cold immediately

ingredients: 400g firm tofu (pressed and cubed), 3 tbsp olive oil (divided), 2 tbsp cornstarch, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh basil (chopped), 200g mushrooms (sliced), 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 cups fresh spinach, 1 tbsp water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Press the tofu for 30-60 minutes, then pat dry and cut into 1-inch cubes | Toss tofu in 2 tablespoons oil, then roll in cornstarch | Place in a single layer on a baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes until crispy and browned | While the tofu bakes, lightly saut? the spinach in a little olive oil for 2-3 minutes, then cover and cook with 1 tablespoon water for 3 minutes | Saut? mushrooms in remaining 1 tablespoon oil for 5 minutes ? add garlic and basil and cook briefly until the garlic is golden | Remove from heat, stir in lemon juice, and cover to keep warm | Serve the baked tofu over the braised spinach with the mushroom-garlic mixture on top

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup brown sugar (packed), 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 1/2 cups shredded coconut, 2-3 tbsp heavy cream
instructions: Cream together the butter and vanilla | Add brown sugar gradually while continuing to beat | Stir in the shredded coconut | Add only enough cream to achieve the desired spreading consistency | For best results, make the night before: after step 2, microwave for 1 minute, beat for a minute, and let stand at room temperature overnight ? add cream the next day before using

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 large eggs, 100g dark chocolate (melted), 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 9 x 9 x 1 3/4-inch baking pan | Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy | Add vanilla and eggs ? beat well | Stir in the melted chocolate | Sift together flour and salt and add to the creamed mixture | Fold in the walnuts | Spread evenly in the prepared pan | Bake for 25 minutes | Cool and cut into squares or bars

ingredients: For meatballs: 500g ground beef, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 cup bulgur (fine), 1/2 onion (grated), 1/4 tsp red pepper, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 large egg. For soup: 1 large egg, 1 cup plain yogurt, 1 tbsp dried mint, 2 cans (400g each) chicken broth, 2 cups water, 1 tbsp unsalted butter
instructions: Make the meatballs: mix together ground beef, salt, bulgur, onion, red pepper, black pepper, and egg ? use a food processor if needed | With wet hands, roll into small balls about the size of a quarter | For the soup: whisk the egg into the yogurt and mix well with the dried mint | Heat the broth and water in a pot ? add the yogurt mixture, stirring constantly so the soup does not curdle | Add butter and stir until melted | Once the broth is nearly boiling, add the meatballs and cook for 10 minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: For filling: 4 oz cream cheese (softened), 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 tbsp strawberry jam, 1/2 cup heavy cream (whipped), red food coloring (optional). For cookies: 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/3 cup all-purpose flour, 2 large egg whites, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, pinch of salt, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted). For garnish: fresh strawberries (diced), extra sugar
instructions: Make the filling: combine cream cheese, sugar, and jam ? fold in whipped cream and food coloring if desired ? chill | Make the cookies: whisk sugar, flour, egg whites, vanilla, and salt until smooth ? whisk in melted butter | Line baking sheets with parchment | Working 4 cookies at a time, drop batter by 1 1/2 teaspoonfuls 4 inches apart | Bake at 400?F (200?C) for 5-8 minutes until edges are lightly browned | Immediately remove one cookie at a time and form into a tube around a greased wooden clothespin ? hold for about 20 seconds to set | Repeat with remaining batter, returning cookies to the oven for 1 minute to soften if needed | Just before serving, pipe or spoon filling into the cookie shells and dip ends into diced strawberries and sugar | Serve immediately
