ingredients: 200g cremini mushrooms (sliced), 2 tbsp water, 2 cups fresh spinach, 4 large flour tortillas, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), salsa and lime wedges for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | In a large skillet, cook mushrooms with water over medium heat, covered, until tender, about 9 minutes | Add spinach, cover, and cook just until wilted, about 4 minutes ? drain well | Divide the mushroom-spinach mixture among the wraps, spooning down the center of each | Sprinkle with cheese and add salsa if desired | Wrap up snugly and place on a baking sheet | Bake for about 5 minutes until heated through | Serve with a squeeze of lime

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 red bell pepper (diced), 2 celery ribs (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 4 cups chicken broth, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs (cut into pieces), 1 cup frozen cut okra, 300g large shrimp (peeled and deveined), 1 tsp hot sauce, steamed rice for serving
instructions: In a large pot over medium-high heat, melt butter | Add onion, bell pepper, celery, and garlic ? cook until softened, 5-6 minutes | Stir in flour and cook, stirring, until lightly browned, about 5 minutes | Stir in broth, tomatoes with their juices, salt, and pepper ? bring to a boil | Add chicken, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook for 10 minutes | Add okra and cook for 5 minutes | Add shrimp and cook until the chicken, okra, and shrimp are just cooked through, about 5 minutes | Stir in hot sauce | Serve over steamed rice

ingredients: 1 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 can (400g) tomato paste, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp granulated sugar, 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, 1/2 tsp dried basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 140?F (60?C) with the door slightly open | Saut? onions and garlic in olive oil until soft and golden | Add tomato paste, salt, sugar, parsley, pepper, and basil ? cook slowly for 10 minutes | Spray a non-stick cookie sheet with cooking spray and spread the tomato mixture in a thin layer | Dry in the oven for about 6 hours | Roll the leather and store in a plastic bag ? may be frozen | To reconstitute: add 3 times the volume of water to the leather, cook and stir over low heat until warm and smooth

ingredients: 4 large potatoes (peeled and cubed), 1/4 cup low-fat milk, 1 tbsp unsalted butter, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Bring cubed potatoes to a boil in salted water and cook until tender | Drain and return to the pot | Add milk and butter and mash with beaters until smooth and creamy | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Serve hot

ingredients: 3 tbsp olive oil, 4 cloves garlic (smashed), 2 cans (400g each) whole tomatoes, 1 cup fresh parsley (chopped, divided), 1/2 tsp dried red pepper flakes, 400g penne pasta (cooked), 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Cook oil and garlic in a heavy large skillet over medium-high heat until the garlic begins to sizzle | Stir in tomatoes with their liquid, 3/4 cup parsley, and the red pepper flakes ? break up the tomatoes with the back of a spoon | Season with salt and pepper | Reduce heat to medium-low, partially cover, and cook until the tomatoes are thick and pulpy, stirring occasionally, about 1 hour and 15 minutes | Discard the garlic | Mix in the remaining 1/4 cup parsley | Pour the sauce over the cooked penne and toss well | Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and serve

ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves, 1 cup frozen raspberries, 1/2 can frozen limeade concentrate, 2 cups cold water, 2 cups ice cubes, lime wedges for garnish
instructions: Rub the mint leaves around the inside of a large pitcher, then drop them in | Pour in the raspberries, limeade concentrate, and cold water ? mix well | Add ice and stir | Serve in glasses with a lime wedge on the rim

ingredients: 1 cup rolled oats, 1/4 cup unsalted butter, 1/2 cup boiling water, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 cup ground pepitas (pumpkin seeds), 50g dark chocolate (melted), 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 180?C (350?F) and spray mini muffin trays with oil | Mix oats and butter with your fingers until well combined | Add boiling water and mix ? stir in ground pepitas and set aside to cool | In a separate bowl, combine sugar, cinnamon, eggs, and vanilla | Add to the cooled oat mixture and combine well | Sift together flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt ? fold in with the melted chocolate | Spoon batter into prepared trays, being careful not to overfill | Bake for 10 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: 4 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 medium head green cabbage (chopped), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 400g egg noodles (cooked and drained), sour cream for serving
instructions: Melt butter in a large pan or pot large enough to hold the chopped cabbage | Saut? the cabbage and onion in the butter until glossy and tender | Add salt and pepper | Cover and let simmer over low heat for about 15 minutes | Add the cooked drained egg noodles and mix well | Serve hot with a generous dollop of sour cream

ingredients: For chocolate layer: 1/2 cup unsalted butter, 100g dark chocolate (chopped), 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 3/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp salt. For cream layer: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 2 tbsp Irish cream liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and line a 13 x 9-inch baking pan with aluminum foil ? lightly coat with cooking spray | Melt butter and chocolate in a saucepan over low heat, stirring often ? let cool | Beat sugar and eggs until light and fluffy, about 4 minutes ? add flour and salt gradually and fold in the melted chocolate | In another bowl, beat cream cheese and sugar until creamy ? add egg and liqueur and beat | Pour half the chocolate batter into the pan, spread all the cream layer over it, then pour the remaining chocolate batter over and smooth | Swirl with a knife for a marbled effect if desired | Bake for 40 minutes | Cool completely before cutting into squares

ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (cold, cubed), 1/4 cup dark brown sugar, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp cream of tartar, 1 large egg, 2-3 tbsp hot water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Cut the butter into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse meal | Add brown sugar, baking soda, and cream of tartar ? mix well | Add the egg and just enough hot water to make a pastry-consistency dough | Roll out on a floured surface until very thin (about 3mm to 6mm thick) | Cut into small squares | Bake on unoiled baking sheets until golden brown, about 15 minutes | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: 500g ground beef (browned and drained), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 1 celery stalk (diced), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp dry mustard, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tbsp white vinegar, 1 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 cup ketchup, hamburger buns for serving
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker or in a saucepan on the stove (brown the beef first) | Cook on low for 2-4 hours in a slow cooker or simmer on the stove for 30 minutes | Serve on hamburger buns

ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable shortening, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 tbsp milk, 1 1/2 cups cake flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tsp baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 300?F (150?C) and grease a baking sheet | Cream together sugar and shortening | Beat in egg, vanilla extract, and milk | Sift together flour, salt, and baking powder ? add alternately with the wet mixture to the creamed mixture | Drop by teaspoonfuls onto the prepared baking sheet | Bake for 20 minutes until lightly golden | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: For cake: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup margarine (softened), 3/4 cup skim milk, 1 tbsp fresh lemon zest, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 large egg whites. For meringue: 2 large egg whites, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, fresh strawberries for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and spray a 9 x 9-inch pan with cooking spray | Beat flour, 1 cup sugar, margarine, milk, baking powder, lemon zest, vanilla, salt, and 2 egg whites with an electric mixer on low for 30 seconds | Beat on high for 2 minutes | Pour into the pan and bake for 25-30 minutes until golden brown ? cool slightly | Increase oven temperature to 400?F (200?C) | Beat the remaining 2 egg whites until frothy, then slowly beat in 1/2 cup sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, until stiff and glossy | Spread meringue over the cake and bake for 8-10 minutes until lightly browned | Cool completely and top with sliced strawberries before serving

ingredients: 1 kg fresh mussels (rinsed and debearded), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 celery stalks (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 carrot (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 cup chicken broth, 1/2 cup dry white wine, 1/2 cup heavy cream, crusty bread for serving
instructions: Rinse the mussels and discard any that are open | Chop celery, onions, carrots, and garlic | In a medium pot, saut? the onions, garlic, celery, and carrots in butter for about 2 minutes | Add the mussels and saut? for 1 minute | Add the broth and white wine ? boil until the mussels open | Add the cream, reduce heat to medium, and stir until combined | Serve immediately with crusty bread

ingredients: 450g dried navy beans (soaked overnight), 200g smoked ham (cubed), 1 medium onion (diced), 1/4 cup brown sugar, 2 tbsp maple syrup, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp ground mustard, 3 cups water, 2 tbsp ketchup, 1 tbsp prepared mustard
instructions: Cover beans with water and soak overnight ? drain and discard water | Cover with fresh water, boil for 10 minutes, then drain and discard water | Add beans to a slow cooker with 1 cup fresh water | Add cubed ham and diced onion | Combine brown sugar, maple syrup, salt, ground mustard, and water ? add to the slow cooker and mix well | Cover and cook on low for 10-12 hours | Stir in ketchup and prepared mustard before serving | Serve hot

ingredients: For marinade: 1/2 cup soy sauce, 1/2 cup bourbon, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp ground ginger, 3 cloves garlic (minced). For beef: 1 kg beef tenderloin, 2 tbsp fresh coarse ground black pepper, 1 tbsp white pepper, 2 tbsp canola oil, 1/4 cup water
instructions: At least 4 hours before cooking, combine all marinade ingredients | Place the tenderloin in a plastic bag or shallow dish and pour the marinade over | Refrigerate, turning occasionally | Prepare a smoker to 200-220?F (93-104?C) | Remove the tenderloin and drain the marinade, reserving it | Coat the tenderloin thoroughly with black pepper, then white pepper ? let sit for 30 minutes | Reserve half the marinade in the refrigerator; boil the other half with oil and water for a mop sauce | Sear the meat quickly on all sides in a heavy skillet over high heat | Transfer to the smoker and cook for 1 1/2-2 hours, mopping with the mop mixture every 20 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches 140-145?F (60-63?C) | Bring the reserved marinade to a boil and reduce by one-fourth | Slice the tenderloin and serve with the reduced sauce

ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 1/2 cup sour cream, 4 oz cream cheese (softened), 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp black pepper, paprika and chopped scallions for garnish
instructions: Combine mayonnaise, sour cream, cream cheese, lemon juice, garlic powder, and pepper ? mix well | Transfer to a serving bowl, cover, and refrigerate | Before serving, stir the dip and garnish with paprika and chopped scallions or tomatoes | Serve with fresh cut vegetables

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 500g beef stew meat (cubed), 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 1 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 2 cups water, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), rice, noodles, or dumplings for serving
instructions: In a Dutch oven, heat oil over medium heat | Toss the meat in flour to coat | When the oil is hot, add the meat, onions, and peppers ? brown everything well | Add garlic powder, black pepper, red pepper flakes, water, diced tomatoes, and salt | Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours until the meat is very tender | Stir in parsley | Serve over rice, noodles, or topped with dumplings

ingredients: 2 tbsp canola oil, 2 tbsp distilled white vinegar, 1 tsp fresh ginger (grated), 1 tsp ketchup, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1/4 tsp garlic salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground pepper, 4 cups fresh spinach, 1 carrot (julienned), 1 red bell pepper (thinly sliced), 2 tbsp sliced almonds
instructions: Combine the first 8 ingredients in a small bowl and blend well | Toss spinach, carrot, bell pepper, and almonds in the dressing | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4 slices beef liver (soaked in cold water and patted dry), 1/2 tsp ground black pepper, 1/2 tsp salt, 3 tbsp olive oil (divided), 2 large yellow onions (sliced), 4 tbsp unsalted butter, 4 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 cup beef broth, 1/2 cup water
instructions: Season the liver slices with salt and pepper | Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over high heat ? add liver and cook for 3 minutes per side ? remove and keep warm | Add remaining oil and sliced onions ? season with salt and pepper and cook until browned | For the gravy: melt butter in a separate pan, add flour, and stir for 1 minute ? gradually add broth and water, stirring constantly | Bring to a boil and simmer for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally | Serve the liver topped with onions and gravy

ingredients: 2 large egg yolks, 3/4 cup olive oil, 3 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp tomato paste, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
instructions: In a large stainless steel bowl, whisk the egg yolks until they turn light yellow | Slowly add the olive oil, whisking continuously until emulsified | Add the red wine vinegar and all remaining ingredients ? whisk until well combined | Store in the refrigerator for up to 1 week

ingredients: For syrup: 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 1 tbsp fresh rosemary, 1/2 tsp black peppercorns. For chard: 1 bunch Swiss chard (stems sliced, leaves cut into strips), 1/2 red onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper, 2 tbsp water. For lamb: 8 lamb rib chops, 1/2 tsp garlic salt, 1 tsp fresh rosemary, pinch of black pepper
instructions: Make the balsamic syrup: simmer balsamic vinegar, rosemary, and peppercorns in a small nonreactive saucepan until reduced to about 1/4 cup ? strain and set aside | Cook onion and garlic in olive oil in a large skillet until softened, about 4 minutes | Add chard stems, salt, and pepper ? cook until tender, about 6 minutes | Stir in chard leaves and water ? cook until tender, about 8 minutes | While chard cooks, season lamb chops with garlic salt, rosemary, and pepper | Broil on a lightly oiled broiler pan 4-5 inches from the heat, turning once, for 6-7 minutes total for medium-rare | Serve chops and chard drizzled with the balsamic syrup

ingredients: 1 cup instant coffee granules, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well | Store in an airtight container | To make one serving: add 4-6 teaspoons of the mix to 1 cup of boiling water ? stir until dissolved

ingredients: 500g ground beef, 1 tbsp chili powder, 1 tsp dried basil, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 cup water, 1 tbsp dried onion flakes
instructions: Saut? the ground beef over medium heat until browned ? drain fat | Turn heat to low | Sprinkle all seasonings over the meat and stir well | Add water and stir again | Cover and simmer on low for 10-15 minutes until most of the water is absorbed | Remove lid, let dry slightly, and remove from heat | Use for tacos, burritos, enchiladas, or taco salad

ingredients: 1 tbsp yellow mustard, 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients and whisk until emulsified | Toss with lettuce and desired vegetables just before serving

ingredients: 500g vegetarian ground beef substitute, 2 medium onions (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 can (400g) chopped tomatoes, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 green bell pepper (diced), 1 tbsp dried cilantro, 2 tbsp chili powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 2 tbsp cornmeal, 1 cup water, 2 cans (400g each) dark red kidney beans (drained), 1 can (400g) black beans (drained), shredded vegetarian cheese and lime zest for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 275?F (135?C) | In a large skillet, warm the veggie ground beef substitute | Add onion and cook until soft | Add garlic, tomatoes, tomato paste, bell pepper, cilantro, chili powder, cumin, cayenne, and cornmeal ? stir and simmer for about 1 minute | Spoon into an ovenproof 2 to 2 1/2-quart casserole dish and add enough water to cover | Cover and bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours | Stir after 1 hour, adding more liquid if dry | Half an hour before serving, stir in the beans and cook until heated through | Garnish with shredded cheese mixed with lime zest

ingredients: 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, 2 large egg whites, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/3 cup butterscotch chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and coat an 8-inch square baking pan with cooking spray | Beat both sugars and butter at medium speed until well blended, about 4 minutes | Add egg whites and vanilla ? beat well | Combine flour, baking powder, and salt ? add to the sugar mixture and beat at low speed just until blended | Spread batter evenly into the prepared pan and sprinkle with butterscotch chips | Bake for 28 minutes until a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean | Cool in the pan on a wire rack

ingredients: 4 cube steaks, 1 large egg, 1 tbsp water, 1/2 cup Italian breadcrumbs, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 3 tbsp olive oil, 1/4 cup dry white wine, 1 Roma tomato (diced), 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: Beat the egg with water in a shallow bowl | Combine breadcrumbs and Parmesan in another shallow bowl | Season the steaks with salt and pepper | Dip each steak in the egg mixture, then coat with the breadcrumb mixture | Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat | Add steaks and cook for 2-3 minutes per side ? transfer to a clean plate | Add wine to the pan and scrape up the brown bits ? allow the sauce to thicken and reduce to a thin syrup | Return steaks to the pan and flip to coat | Remove and garnish with diced tomatoes and parsley

ingredients: 1 can (400g) refried beans, 1 can (200g) diced green chilies, 8 tostada shells, 500g ground beef (browned and drained), 1 1/2 cups salsa, shredded lettuce, shredded cheddar cheese, diced tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Stir together beans and chilies | Spread 2-3 tablespoons of the bean mixture onto each tostada shell and place on an ungreased cookie sheet | Bake for 5-7 minutes until hot | Brown the ground beef in a skillet ? drain | Stir in 1 1/2 cups salsa and cook over medium heat for 2-3 minutes until hot | Serve tostada shells topped with the hot beef mixture, shredded lettuce, cheese, tomatoes, and remaining salsa

ingredients: 4 cups reduced-sodium chicken broth, 1/2 tsp saffron threads, 1/4 tsp ground pepper, 1 tsp paprika, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 green bell pepper (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 1/2 cups Arborio rice, 200g bay scallops, 200g medium shrimp (peeled), 2 plum tomatoes (diced)
instructions: Combine broth, saffron, pepper, and paprika in a medium saucepan ? bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 10 minutes | Heat olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat ? add bell pepper, onion, and garlic and cook for 3-5 minutes until lightly browned | Add rice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly | Stir in the broth mixture and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally | Stir in shrimp, scallops, and tomatoes ? simmer uncovered for 10 minutes until the liquid is absorbed | Remove from heat, cover, and let stand for 5 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1 box frozen chopped spinach (thawed and drained), 2 cups fat-free egg substitute, 1/2 cup fat-free shredded cheese, 1/2 cup mushrooms (diced), 1/4 cup onion (diced), hot pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and line a 12-cup muffin tray with foil baking cups ? spray with cooking spray | Microwave the spinach for 2 1/2 minutes and drain completely | Combine egg substitute, cheese, mushrooms, spinach, and onion in a bowl ? add hot pepper to taste | Divide evenly among the muffin cups | Bake for 20 minutes until a knife inserted comes out clean | May be frozen and reheated

ingredients: 1 medium onion (diced), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 cup chili sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/2 cup water, 3 cups cooked turkey (shredded), hamburger buns for serving
instructions: In a large saucepan, cook diced onion in oil until tender | Stir in chili sauce, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, and water ? bring to a boil | Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes | Stir in the shredded turkey and heat through | Serve on hamburger buns

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 1 1/2 cups cake flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/3 cup whole milk. For topping: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp Marmite, 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (grated)
instructions: Preheat oven to 190?C (375?F) and grease a 23cm ovenproof dish or ring mould | Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy | Add egg and beat well | Sift together flour, baking powder, and salt ? stir the flour mixture and milk alternately into the egg mixture | Pour into the prepared mould and bake for about 25 minutes | Make the topping: melt butter and Marmite together ? pour over the cooled cake while hot | Sprinkle with grated cheese just before serving

ingredients: 500g fresh spinach (finely chopped or ground), 2 tbsp butter or ghee, 1/2 tsp mustard seeds, 1/2 tsp cumin seeds, 1 sweet white onion (diced), 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, 2 green chilies (slit), 8-10 curry leaves, 1/2 cup green peas, 1/2 tsp salt
instructions: Finely chop or grind the spinach ? set aside | Heat butter or ghee in a pan | Add mustard seeds and cumin ? when they begin to pop, add the onion and fry until golden | Add ginger-garlic paste, chilies, and curry leaves ? fry until fragrant | Add peas and cook until almost done | Add the spinach and salt ? cook until wilted and all the water evaporates | Serve hot

ingredients: 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp cornstarch, 2 cups whole milk, 1/2 cup half-and-half, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients in a heavy saucepan | Bring to a boil over medium heat, whisking constantly | Boil, whisking constantly, for 1 minute until thickened | Remove from heat | Place the pan in a bowl of ice water and whisk occasionally until cool | Chill completely, about 2 hours, before using in trifle

ingredients: 2 cups powdered sugar, 2 tbsp water, 1 tsp apple cider vinegar, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tsp honey
instructions: Mix sugar, water, vinegar, vanilla, and honey together ? heat gently to no more than 240?F (115?C) | Spray smooth paper plates with oil and pour the mixture into molds | Let sit for a couple of days, then pop out of the mold | Use as bee feed by placing between brood boxes

ingredients: 4 medium sweet potatoes (peeled and cubed), 4 cups water, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 tbsp honey, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a large pot over high heat, bring sweet potatoes and water to a boil | Cook for 10-15 minutes until the sweet potatoes are tender | Drain well and return to the pot | Add butter, salt, pepper, cinnamon, and honey ? mash until all ingredients are well combined | Serve immediately

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp mixed spice, 1/2 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 cup onion (diced), 1 large egg, 1/4 cup rolled oats
instructions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly | Form into hamburger patties | Place on cookie sheets in layers separated by wax paper and freeze | Cook from frozen on a grill or in a skillet until fully cooked

ingredients: 4 lemons (halved), 1/4 tsp salt (optional)
instructions: Cut the lemons in half | Place cut-side down on a hot grill | Grill until lightly charred, about 3-5 minutes | Sprinkle with salt if desired and serve alongside grilled meats or seafood

ingredients: For sauce: 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1/4 tsp salt, pinch of black pepper, 1/4 cup mayonnaise. For burgers: 500g salmon fillet (skin removed, coarsely chopped), 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, 2 tbsp cilantro leaves, 2 green onions (sliced), 1 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 4 hamburger buns, cucumber slices and lettuce for serving
instructions: Make the cilantro-lime mayonnaise: combine cilantro, lime juice, salt, pepper, and mayonnaise ? cover and chill | Place salmon in a food processor and pulse until coarsely chopped | Add breadcrumbs, cilantro, green onions, lime juice, salt, and pepper ? pulse 4 times until well blended | Divide into 4 equal portions and shape into 3/4-inch-thick patties | Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat and coat with cooking spray | Cook patties for 2 minutes per side until done | Spread the mayonnaise mixture on the bottom of each bun, top with a salmon patty, cucumber slices, and lettuce | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 kg new potatoes (boiled and diced), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 cup Miracle Whip, 1/4 cup sour cream, 1 tbsp prepared mustard, 2 tbsp fresh dill weed (chopped), 2 green onions (sliced), 1/4 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 cup diced dill pickles, paprika for garnish
instructions: Boil the potatoes until tender ? drain and toss with olive oil while hot | In a bowl, mix together Miracle Whip, sour cream, mustard, dill, green onions, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and pickles | Pour the mixture over the hot potatoes and mix well | Let cool to room temperature | Sprinkle with paprika and serve

ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable shortening, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 1/2 cups quick-cooking oats, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 3/4 cup raisins, 3/4 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Cream together sugars, butter, and shortening | Add vanilla and eggs ? beat until you have a grainy paste | Combine flour, oats, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon ? gradually add to the sugar mixture | Stir in raisins and chocolate chips | Drop by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets | Bake for 10-12 minutes until golden brown

ingredients: 4 large potatoes (peeled, boiled, and mashed), 1/2 cup onion (finely diced), 4 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/4 cup milk if needed, 1/2 cup French's fried onions, salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Boil potatoes until tender, then drain and mash | Mix in diced onion, cream cheese, sour cream, and cheddar cheese ? add a little milk if too thick (the mixture should be really creamy) | Spread into a rectangular baking dish | Bake for 30 minutes until hot and bubbly around the edges | Top with French's fried onions during the last 5 minutes of baking | Serve hot

ingredients: For aioli: 2 large egg yolks, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, pinch of salt, 1/2 cup olive oil, 1 clove garlic (minced), juice of 1/2 lemon. For sandwich: 1 large piece focaccia bread (halved and toasted), olive oil, 1 avocado (sliced), 2 tomatoes (sliced), 1 carrot (grated), 1/2 cup watercress, 1/2 cup sliced beetroot, 1/2 green bell pepper (sliced), fresh basil leaves, 1 red chili (sliced)
instructions: Make the aioli: whisk egg yolks, mustard, and salt ? slowly pour in olive oil, whisking continuously until thick | Add garlic and lemon juice ? season with salt and pepper | Drizzle the cut sides of the focaccia with olive oil and toast on a griddle pan | Spread aioli on the toasted focaccia | Layer all the vegetables in layers on one piece of the focaccia | Scatter sliced chili and basil on top | Close with the second piece of focaccia, slice into quarters, and serve immediately

ingredients: 1/2 cup non-dairy milk substitute, 1/4 cup light brown sugar, 1/4 cup unsweetened applesauce, 2 tbsp coconut oil (melted), 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup sorghum flour, 1/4 cup tapioca starch, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/4 tsp guar gum, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp cream of tartar, pinch of salt, cinnamon sugar or melted coconut oil for coating
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease mini muffin tins | Beat together the non-dairy milk, brown sugar, applesauce, oil, and vanilla until smooth | Add the flours, tapioca starch, nutmeg, guar gum, baking soda, cream of tartar, and salt ? mix until a sturdy batter-dough forms, about 5 minutes | Form into balls and place in the mini muffin tins | Bake for 15 minutes ? cool in the tin for 3 minutes, then unmold | For cinnamon sugar coating: dip warm doughnut holes in melted coconut oil and roll in cinnamon sugar | Allow to cool completely if filling or glazing

ingredients: 1 whole chicken (cut into pieces), 2 oz unsalted butter, 1 tbsp vegetable oil, 2 shallots (diced), 200g mushrooms (sliced), 1 cup lager beer, 2 tbsp gin, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 1 tbsp Guinness stout (optional), salt and black pepper, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), fresh pasta for serving
instructions: Saut? the chicken pieces in butter and oil over medium heat until browned all over | Add the shallots and mushrooms and continue to cook until softened | Pour in the lager and gin, season with salt and pepper, and simmer gently for about 1 hour until the chicken is tender | Remove the chicken to a deep dish and keep warm | Over high heat, reduce the sauce by about half, then whisk in the cream and remaining butter | Whisk in the Guinness if using | Pour the sauce back over the chicken and sprinkle with parsley | Serve with fresh pasta

ingredients: 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for dish), 6 ripe plums (pitted and sliced), 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1/3 cup brown sugar, pinch of salt, 3 large eggs, 1 cup whole milk, 1 tbsp brandy, 1 tsp vanilla extract, powdered sugar for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) and thoroughly butter a 10-inch baking dish | Arrange the plum slices in the dish, with some skin-side up | Whisk together flour, brown sugar, and salt in a small bowl | In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, brandy, and vanilla ? add the flour mixture and whisk vigorously until no lumps remain | Pour the batter over the fruit | Bake for 35-40 minutes until puffed and golden | Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve immediately

ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 cup pecan halves, 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon, 4 cups fresh spinach, 1 cup fresh strawberries (sliced), 1 nectarine (sliced), 2 cups cooked chicken (sliced), poppy seed dressing for serving
instructions: In a small heavy saucepan or skillet, melt butter | Add pecans and saut? for 2 minutes, stirring constantly | Sprinkle with cinnamon, mix well, and continue cooking 2 minutes more | Cool on a foil-lined baking sheet | In a large bowl, combine spinach, fruit, and chicken | Place on four salad plates and top with pecans | Serve with poppy seed dressing

recipe_name: Orange Roughy with Garlic Potato Crust
ingredients: 4 orange roughy fillets (about 150g each), 1 large russet potato (steamed and mashed), 4 cloves garlic (roasted), 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp milk, 1 tsp lemon zest, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp dried tarragon, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, lemon wedges for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Toss garlic cloves in olive oil and roast for 30 minutes until golden and soft | Steam potatoes until soft, then mash | Pur?e the roasted garlic with milk and add to the potatoes | Add salt, pepper, tarragon, lemon zest, and 2 teaspoons lemon juice ? mix well | Place fillets in a baking dish and cover evenly with the potato mixture | Squeeze lemon juice liberally over each fillet | Broil for 12-15 minutes until golden brown and the fish is cooked through | Serve with lemon wedges

ingredients: 250g ground turkey, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 cup brown rice, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 cup low-sodium beef broth, 1 cup water, 1 cup mushrooms (sliced)
instructions: Cook the ground turkey in a large skillet ? drain if needed | Add diced onion, minced garlic, brown rice, water, beef broth, and soy sauce | Cook for 50 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed | Add mushrooms and heat through | Serve hot

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 1 cup Italian dressing, buns or salad for serving
instructions: Trim the fat from each chicken breast and poke with a fork several times on both sides ? also use a steak knife to pierce thicker parts | Place each breast in its own zip-lock bag and divide the Italian dressing among them | Seal tightly, removing air bubbles, and refrigerate for at least 24 hours, turning every 6 hours | Remove from bags and grill until cooked through | Serve on buns or sliced on a salad

ingredients: For broth: shells from 500g shrimp, 1 onion (quartered), 2 cloves garlic, 1 carrot, parsley, bay leaf, thyme, leek, 2 cloves, 4 cups water. For paella: 7 cups combined shrimp and clam broth, pinch of saffron, 300g chorizo (sliced), 200g firm white fish, 500g shrimp (peeled), 8 littleneck clams (steamed open), 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 onion (diced), 8 cloves garlic (minced), 1 red bell pepper (diced), 2 tomatoes (diced), 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 cups Arborio rice, 1 bay leaf, 1/2 cup lima beans, 1/2 cup green beans, 200g mussels (steamed open)
instructions: Peel the shrimp and reserve the shells | Make a bouquet garni with parsley, bay leaf, thyme, leek, and cloves | Combine shrimp shells, quartered onion, 2 garlic cloves, carrot, bouquet garni, and 4 cups water in a pot ? bring to a boil, then simmer for 45 minutes | Strain and season with salt | Steam clams with wine, garlic, and onion until open ? strain the broth and combine with shrimp broth to measure 7 cups | Stir in saffron and set aside | In a skillet, brown the chorizo slices ? cut into pieces and set aside | Season the fish with salt and sear briefly | Saut? shrimp until just pink ? set aside | In a paella pan, heat olive oil and saut? diced onion until it begins to color | Add garlic and bell pepper ? cook briefly | Add tomatoes, paprika, and salt ? cook until fragrant | Stir in chorizo and rice until coated with oil | Add bay leaf, peas, and green beans | Pour in the broth and mussels | Arrange clams, shrimp, and fish on top | Cook uncovered at a moderate bubble for 20-24 minutes without stirring until the broth is absorbed | Remove from heat, cover with foil, and let sit for 10-15 minutes before serving

ingredients: 500g ground beef (browned), 3 medium raw potatoes (sliced), 2 celery stalks (sliced), 1 medium onion (sliced), 1 green bell pepper (sliced), 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a casserole dish | Layer the ingredients in order: potatoes, celery, ground beef, onions, green pepper ? sprinkling each layer with salt and pepper | Pour the diced tomatoes over the top | Bake for 2 hours, covering with foil after about 1 hour if the top is browning too quickly | Serve hot

ingredients: 200g fresh large mushrooms (sliced), 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 celery stalks (diced), 2 green onions (sliced), 2 tomatoes (diced), 1 cup watercress, 2 cups lettuce (chopped), 2 cooked chicken breast halves (sliced), salt and fresh ground black pepper, salad dressing of choice
instructions: Heat olive oil in a non-stick frying pan ? add sliced mushrooms and saut? until nicely browned on both sides, about 10 minutes ? set aside to cool | Add celery, green onions, tomatoes, watercress, and lettuce to a large bowl ? mix well | Scatter the warm mushrooms over the salad | Place chicken slices on top and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper | Serve with your choice of salad dressing if desired

ingredients: 2 apples (cored and diced), 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 cups carrots (grated), 2 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Place the diced apples in a large bowl and toss with lemon juice | Add grated carrots, chives, olive oil, sugar, salt, pepper, and feta cheese ? toss to mix thoroughly | Serve immediately or chill for 30 minutes

ingredients: 1 kg beef stew meat, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 medium yellow onion (diced), 1 head garlic, 2 ears corn (cut into pieces), 1/2 head cabbage (chopped), 2 zucchini (sliced), 2 potatoes (cubed), 1 can (400g) tomato sauce, 2 lemons (juiced), 1 tsp ground cumin, salt to taste, water to fill pot
instructions: Heat oil in a large stock pot over medium-high heat ? braise the meat with onion and garlic | Fill the pot halfway with water | Add all the vegetables and fill with more water if needed | Add the tomato sauce and season lightly | After 1 hour, taste the broth and add more seasoning if needed | Cook on medium-high for 3 hours until the meat is tender and easily shreds | Serve hot with lemon wedges

ingredients: 2 cups low-fat yogurt, 1/2 cup ricotta cheese, 1 cup graham cracker crumbs, 1 tsp lemon zest, pinch of salt, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1/3 cup honey, 1 large egg, 1 tsp lemon zest, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 fresh mango (diced)
instructions: The day before: stir yogurt and ricotta together and place in a cheesecloth-lined strainer over a bowl ? wrap loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 24 hours | Discard the whey and refrigerate the yogurt cheese until ready to use | Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) | Combine graham cracker crumbs, lemon zest, salt, and melted butter ? press into an ungreased 9-inch pie plate and bake for 10 minutes ? cool | Stir the yogurt cheese with honey, egg, lemon zest, and vanilla | Spoon into the cooled pie shell and bake for 30 minutes | Cool to room temperature, then chill for at least 4 hours | Top with diced mango before serving

ingredients: 1 whole chicken (cut into pieces), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, 3 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a deep frying pan with a lid, melt butter over medium heat | Add diced onion | Season chicken pieces with salt and pepper and place good side down in the pan | Brown the chicken | Turn the pieces over, sprinkle with lemon juice, and cover | Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for about 40 minutes, stirring the onions and turning the chicken only once or twice | Sprinkle generously with parsley during the last 2 minutes, then cover again | Serve hot with the pan juices

ingredients: 1/2 cup Kikkoman soy sauce, 1 tbsp fresh gingerroot (grated), 1 clove garlic (minced), 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp rice vinegar
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jar and shake well | Keep refrigerated until ready to use ? the flavor gets stronger with age | Use as a dipping sauce or seasoning

ingredients: 2 cups cooked pork (shredded), 1/2 cup onion (diced), 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup ketchup, 2 tbsp white vinegar, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/4 cup water, hamburger buns for serving
instructions: In a large skillet, combine onion, sugar, ketchup, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, and water ? blend well | Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes | Stir in the shredded pork and simmer an additional 10 minutes | Serve on hamburger buns

ingredients: 400g medium pasta shells, 1 cup sour cream, 1 cup Colby cheese (shredded), 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Cook pasta shells according to package directions until al dente | While pasta cooks, combine sour cream and both cheeses in a large bowl ? stir well | Drain the cooked pasta and add to the cheese mixture ? combine thoroughly | Transfer to a large greased casserole dish | Bake for approximately 30 minutes until the cheese is completely melted and hot and bubbly | Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1/4 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 cup mashed sweet potatoes, 1/4 cup whole milk, 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease two 5 3/4 x 3 x 2-inch loaf pans | Cream butter and sugar ? add egg and mix well | Combine flour, baking powder, cinnamon, ginger, and salt ? add to the creamed mixture just until blended | Combine sweet potatoes and milk ? stir into the batter until blended | Fold in raisins | Transfer to the prepared loaf pans | Bake for 35-40 minutes until lightly browned and a toothpick comes out clean | Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pans

ingredients: 1 cup water, 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp orange blossom water
instructions: Bring water and sugar to a boil in a saucepan | After the mixture boils rapidly, add lemon juice and orange blossom water | Set aside uncovered to cool | Use as a glaze over your favorite Lebanese desserts

ingredients: 2 cups cooked chicken (diced), 2 large eggs (beaten), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 3 cups cooked cold rice, 2 tbsp light soy sauce, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1/2 tsp salt, 3 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 cup mixed vegetables, 1 tsp sesame oil
instructions: Rub the chicken pieces with a little salt | Heat oil in a wok over high heat and fry the chicken until cooked ? set aside | Scramble the beaten eggs until done and broken into small pieces ? add garlic and fry until slightly browned | Add the mixed vegetables and stir-fry for 2 minutes | Add the chicken and cold rice | Add soy sauce, white pepper, and salt ? mix well | Add sesame oil and fry for another minute | Serve hot

recipe_name: Raspberry Chicken with Red Wine Applesauce
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 3 tbsp olive oil, 3 tbsp raspberry vinegar, 2 tbsp maple syrup, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tsp dried thyme, 1/4 cup red wine, 1/4 cup heavy cream, 1 tbsp fresh ginger (chopped), 2 apples (peeled and diced), 2 tbsp apricot marmalade, salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Make the marinade: combine olive oil, raspberry vinegar, maple syrup, Worcestershire sauce, thyme, and chili flakes | Place chicken in a plastic bag, pour the marinade over, seal, and refrigerate for 3-4 hours | Mix red wine, cream, and chopped ginger ? refrigerate for 3-4 hours | Remove chicken from the marinade and brown in a frying pan | Transfer to a baking sheet and bake at 350?F (175?C) for 10-15 minutes | Discard the marinating ginger from the wine sauce ? pour the wine-cream mixture into the frying pan and add apricot marmalade | Microwave diced apples for 2 1/2 minutes, mash with a fork, and add to the sauce ? simmer until thick | Top the chicken with the sauce and serve hot

ingredients: 1 cup green seedless grapes (halved), 1 cup red seedless grapes (halved), 1 English cucumber (diced), 1/4 cup sweet onion (diced), 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), juice of 1 lime, 1/4 tsp salt, tortilla chips for serving
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl | Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving | Serve with tortilla chips

ingredients: 1 medium onion (thinly sliced), 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 can (200g) tuna in olive oil (undrained), 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 baguette (quartered), lettuce leaves, 2 tomatoes (sliced), 2 hard-boiled eggs (sliced), 2 anchovy fillets, black olives, capers, 2 green onions (chopped)
instructions: Combine onions with 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1 tablespoon vinegar, salt, and pepper | Work in the undrained tuna and season with lemon juice, vinegar, and salt | Cut the baguette in half lengthwise and crosswise | Layer the bottom halves with lettuce and tomato slices | Add the tuna mixture and hard-boiled egg slices | Crisscross with anchovy fillets and top with olives, capers, and green onions | Drizzle generously with olive oil and close the sandwiches | Wrap tightly in plastic wrap and let stand at least 20 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable shortening, 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup buttermilk, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt. For icing: 2 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 2 tbsp milk, 1/2 tsp vanilla, 1 cup icing sugar
instructions: Cream shortening and sugar together | Add eggs and vanilla ? beat well | Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a separate bowl | Stir the flour mixture alternately with the buttermilk into the creamed mixture until it forms a soft ball | Cover and refrigerate for about 1 hour | Roll out on a floured surface to about 1/4-inch thickness and cut into circles | Bake at 375?F (190?C) for 9 minutes | Mix all icing ingredients until of spreading consistency | Ice the cooled cookies and sprinkle with coconut if desired

ingredients: 500g raw chicken (cubed), 2 tbsp red chili powder, 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 cup plain yogurt, 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 cup tomato pur?e, 1 tsp sugar, 2 green chilies (sliced), 1 tbsp dried fenugreek leaves, 1/4 cup fresh cream, rice or naan for serving
instructions: Mix red chili powder, ginger-garlic paste, salt, and yogurt together for the marinade | Marinate the chicken overnight in the refrigerator | Roast the marinated chicken at 400?F (200?C) for 5-10 minutes until three-quarters done | Heat butter in a pan ? add tomato pur?e, sugar, red chili powder, and salt ? mix well | Add the prepared chicken, fresh cream, sliced green chilies, and crushed fenugreek leaves | Cook until the chicken is done | Serve hot with rice or naan

ingredients: 2 cups elbow macaroni (cooked), 2 cups cooked chicken (diced), 1 cup celery (diced), 1/2 green bell pepper (diced), 1/2 cup stuffed green olives (sliced), 1 cup whole milk, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/2 tsp salt, crushed potato chips for topping
instructions: Mix all casserole ingredients together | Pour into a buttered casserole dish | Refrigerate overnight | Remove from the refrigerator 1 hour before baking | Top with crushed potato chips | Bake at 350?F (175?C) for 1 hour until hot and bubbly | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts (cut into 1-inch cubes), 1 lb bacon (slices cut into thirds), 1/4 cup BBQ seasoning, 1/4 cup brown sugar, wooden toothpicks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Spray a flat non-stick roasting rack with cooking spray and place over a foil-lined roasting pan | Wrap a piece of bacon around each chicken cube and secure with a toothpick | Combine the BBQ seasoning with the brown sugar | Toss each skewer in the mixture until completely coated | Arrange on the rack and bake for 30-35 minutes until the bacon is crisp and the topping is browned | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 red bell pepper (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp dried parsley, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/2 tsp hot paprika, 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, 1 tsp sugar, 200g andouille sausage (sliced), 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts (cubed), 1 can (400g) crushed tomatoes, 1 cup uncooked white rice, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp unsalted butter
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large pot ? add sliced sausage and half the seasoning ? saut? until the sausage gets some color, then remove and set aside | Add the chicken with the remaining seasoning and saut? until browned but not cooked through ? remove and set aside | Add butter and a bit more olive oil ? saut? peppers, onions, and celery until softened, about 8 minutes | Add garlic and saut? for 2 more minutes | Stir in cayenne, paprika, and red pepper flakes ? saut? for 1 minute | Stir in crushed tomatoes and bring to a simmer ? add thyme, basil, parsley, oregano, and sugar | Simmer partially covered for 20 minutes | Return sausage and chicken to the pot ? stir in the rice | Cook for 20-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice is tender and the chicken is cooked through | Season with salt and pepper and serve

ingredients: 9 lasagna noodles (cooked), 1 jar Alfredo sauce, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 2 cups mozzarella cheese (shredded), 2 cups meat spaghetti sauce, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and lightly grease a 9 x 13-inch pan | Spread a bit of meat sauce on the bottom of the pan | Layer 3 noodles, meat sauce, some Alfredo sauce, parsley, Parmesan, then mozzarella | Repeat layers in that order, ending with mozzarella on top | Bake for 1 hour until the cheese on top is golden brown | Can be made the night before and refrigerated

ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts (boiled and shredded), 300g elbow macaroni (cooked), 1 can (400g) cream of chicken soup, 1 cup light sour cream, 1 1/2 cups Colby cheese (shredded), 1/2 tsp dry mustard, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted)
instructions: Boil the chicken, cool, and shred ? set aside | Cook macaroni and place in a large mixing bowl | Mix in the cream of chicken soup and sour cream | Add all the spices to the macaroni mixture | Stir in the shredded chicken and cheese, reserving some for the top | Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish and top with remaining cheese | Pour the melted butter on top | Cover with foil and bake at 300?F (150?C) for 20 minutes until heated through and the cheese is melted

ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 medium onion (diced), 500g ground beef, 2 cups fresh broccoli florets, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/2 cup garlic cooking cream cheese, 8 sheets phyllo pastry, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted), fresh parsley for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat ? add onions and cook 2-3 minutes | Add ground beef, breaking it up, and cook until browned ? drain | Return the meat to the skillet, add broccoli, and cook 2-3 minutes | Sprinkle flour, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes over the mixture ? stir to coat | Add sour cream and garlic cooking cream cheese (reserve 3 tablespoons for garnish) ? simmer on low for 2-3 minutes | Layer 3 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with melted butter ? cut in half lengthwise to make strips | Mound a spoonful of filling at one end and fold over to form a triangle ? continue folding like a flag | Place on a cookie sheet, brush with butter, and bake for 12-15 minutes until golden | Drizzle with reserved cooking cream and sprinkle with parsley

ingredients: 400g orecchiette pasta (cooked), 200g cremini mushrooms (sliced), 1 red bell pepper (diced), 1 yellow bell pepper (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 can (400g) artichoke hearts (drained and halved), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese, 1/4 cup walnuts (chopped), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Saut? mushrooms, bell peppers, and garlic in olive oil in a large skillet until tender, 3-5 minutes | Add artichoke hearts and parsley ? cook until heated through, 3-4 minutes | Season with salt and pepper | Spoon the vegetable mixture over the cooked pasta and toss | Serve topped with crumbled feta and chopped walnuts

ingredients: 1.5 kg pork ribs, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 bottles barbecue sauce (divided), 1 can beer (optional), water to cover
instructions: Cut the ribs to fit the largest pot you have | Add onion, garlic, 1 bottle BBQ sauce, and beer if using ? add water to cover | Bring to a boil uncovered, then lower heat and simmer for at least 45 minutes to 1 hour | Remove ribs to a platter and let cool slightly | Slather generously with the remaining bottle of BBQ sauce | Preheat the grill and cook the ribs for about 10 minutes per side, basting often | Serve with your favorite BBQ sides

ingredients: 1 can (400g) black beans (drained and rinsed), 1 cup fresh or frozen corn kernels, 1 red bell pepper (diced), 1 jalape?o chili (minced), 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), juice of 1 lime, 1 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper to taste, lettuce leaves and lime wedges for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, combine beans, corn, bell pepper, chilies, cilantro, lime juice, and oil ? mix lightly | Season with salt and pepper | Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to a day | To serve, line a serving bowl with lettuce leaves ? spoon in the bean mixture | Garnish with lime wedges and cilantro sprigs

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted), 1 cup granulated sugar (divided), 1 tsp vanilla extract (divided), 1 large egg, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 cup fresh blueberries, 1 cup sour cream, 2 large egg yolks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 9-inch springform pan | Mix together 1/2 cup sugar, melted butter, 1/2 tsp vanilla, and the egg | Add flour and baking powder and mix well | Pat evenly into the prepared pan | Sprinkle blueberries over the batter | In a small bowl, combine sour cream, remaining 1/2 cup sugar, egg yolks, and remaining 1/2 tsp vanilla | Pour over the blueberries | Bake for 1 hour until lightly browned around the edges and set | Cool before serving

ingredients: 1 acorn squash (halved and roasted), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts (cubed), 2 carrots (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 medium potato (diced), 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground pepper, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp ground cumin, 4 cups chicken broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Bake the squash halves cut-side down for 40 minutes ? turn over, brush with melted butter, sprinkle with brown sugar, and bake 5 minutes more ? set aside to cool | Season the chicken with salt and pepper | In a Dutch oven, heat oil and cook carrots, onion, and potato until starting to soften | Add the chicken and cook until cooked through | Sprinkle with cumin and stir | Scoop the cooled squash out of the skin and mash | Add the chicken broth and mashed squash to the vegetables | Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: 4 large portobello mushroom caps (stems removed and diced, gills scraped out), 200g raw shrimp (chopped), 4 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 red bell pepper (diced), 1/4 cup onion (diced), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp ground pepper, 1/4 tsp garlic powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) | Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat ? saut? shrimp, onion, diced mushroom stems, and bell pepper until the shrimp is pink and vegetables are softened | Remove from heat and place in a large mixing bowl | Add cream cheese and stir well | Add Parmesan, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and half the cheddar ? mix well | Stuff the mushroom caps generously with the mixture and place in a greased 8 x 11-inch baking dish | Sprinkle the remaining cheddar over the top | Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour until golden | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 1 cup vegetable oil, 3 large eggs, 1 cup buttermilk, 1 cup pitted prunes (chopped), 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp ground cloves, 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup pecans (chopped). For glaze: 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup buttermilk, 2 tbsp light corn syrup, 1/4 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, 2 tbsp unsalted butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) and grease a 12-cup Bundt pan | Mix sugar and oil together | Add eggs and mix well | Add buttermilk and chopped prunes, mixing well | Sift together flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, cloves, and nutmeg ? stir into the sugar mixture | Add vanilla and pecans ? mix well | Pour into the prepared pan and bake for 70 minutes | While hot, pour the glaze over the cake | Make the glaze: combine all ingredients in a saucepan, bring to a boil, and cook for 4-5 minutes, stirring often

ingredients: 500g ground beef, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 3 cups chicken broth, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 carrot (diced), 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1 cup corn kernels, 2 cups frozen hash browns, 4 slices American cheese, 1/2 cup whole milk, 2 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), sour cream for serving
instructions: Brown the ground beef with garlic and onion in a skillet ? drain | In a 3-quart Dutch oven, combine the beef mixture, chili powder, cayenne, carrot, chicken broth, tomatoes, and corn | Cover and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and cook for about 15 minutes until the carrots are tender | Reduce heat to low and add hash browns, American cheese, and milk ? stir until the cheese is melted, about 5 minutes | Serve each bowl with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkle of chives

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes (drained, juice reserved), 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, salt and black pepper, 500g frozen cut okra
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat | Saut? the onion and garlic until limp | Add the green pepper and cook until tender | Pour in the drained tomatoes and season with thyme, parsley, cayenne, salt, and pepper ? simmer for 5 minutes | Add the frozen okra and enough reserved tomato juice to cover the bottom of the pan | Cover and cook for 15 minutes until the okra is tender | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 cups cooked white rice, 1 cup sour cream, 2 cups Monterey Jack cheese (shredded), 1 can (200g) diced green chilies, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 tsp salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Cook rice according to package directions | Combine sour cream, cheese, green chilies, garlic, and salt with the cooked rice | Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole dish | Bake uncovered for approximately 30 minutes until hot and bubbly | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 100g mushrooms (finely chopped), 1 cup raw cashews, 1 cup Brazil nuts, 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (grated), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 large egg, 2 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), 1/4 cup breadcrumbs. For sauce: 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 onion (diced), 1 clove garlic (minced), 2 tomatoes (diced), 1 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tsp caster sugar, 1/4 cup water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 5 1/2 x 8 1/2-inch loaf tin ? line with baking paper | Heat oil and fry onion, garlic, and mushrooms until soft ? cool | Process the nuts in a food processor until finely chopped | Mix together the nuts, mushroom mixture, cheeses, egg, chives, and breadcrumbs | Press firmly into the prepared tin and bake for 45 minutes until firm | Leave in the tin for 5 minutes, then turn out | Make the sauce: heat oil, fry onion and garlic until soft, add tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar, and water ? simmer for 3-5 minutes until thickened | Slice the nut roast and serve with the tomato sauce

ingredients: 3 tbsp champagne vinegar, 3 tbsp light olive oil, 1 tsp granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp onion powder, 4 celery ribs (thinly sliced), 2 Belgian endives (sliced), 1/4 red onion (thinly sliced), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together vinegar, oil, sugar, and onion powder | Add celery, endive, and red onion ? season with salt and pepper | Toss well and serve immediately

ingredients: 2 large flour tortilla wraps, 1/2 can tomato sauce, 1 cup Italian cheese blend, 2 tbsp Parmesan cheese, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp dried sweet basil, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) and spray a pizza pan with cooking spray | Place the wrap on the pan | Spread half the tomato sauce on each wrap | Sprinkle with cheese blend and Parmesan | Add oregano, basil, pepper, and red pepper flakes | Bake for 9-10 minutes until crispy | Cut into quarters and serve

ingredients: 1 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 cup long-grain white rice, 2 cups cold water, 1/4 cup seedless raisins, 4 whole cloves, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp turmeric, 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 1 tbsp unsalted butter (to finish)
instructions: In a medium saucepan, saut? the rice in 1 tablespoon butter for 3-5 minutes until fragrant | Add the water and bring to a boil | Turn the heat to the lowest setting and add the raisins, cloves, salt, turmeric, and ginger | Cover and simmer gently until the rice is tender and all the liquid has been absorbed, about 20 minutes | Add the remaining butter, fluff with a fork, and discard the ginger | Serve hot

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted), 1 cup Parmesan cheese (canned, for breading), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 cup grated Parmesan (for topping)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Place the melted butter and canned Parmesan in separate bowls | Mix garlic, parsley, and seasonings into the cheese mixture | Dip each chicken breast in the melted butter, then coat thoroughly in the cheese mixture | Top with grated Parmesan | Place in a greased baking dish | Bake until the chicken is cooked through and golden, about 25-30 minutes

ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 200g mushrooms (sliced), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup Marsala wine, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 2 cups water, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 cup uncooked long-grain rice, 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | In a large skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat ? add mushrooms and cook until softened, about 5 minutes | Sprinkle flour on top and stir for 1 minute | Stir in Marsala and cream ? simmer until slightly thickened, about 3 minutes | Stir in water, parsley, salt, and pepper | In a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole, spread the rice in an even layer and top with the chicken | Pour the mushroom gravy on top | Cover snugly with foil and bake for about 35 minutes | Discard the foil, sprinkle with Parmesan, and bake for 5 more minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 medium onion (diced), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 500g ground beef, 200g dry egg noodles, 2 cups tomato juice, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp celery salt, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 cup sour cream
instructions: Saut? the onion in butter until soft ? remove and set aside | Brown the ground beef ? return the onion to the skillet | Lay the dry noodles over the meat and onion mixture ? do not stir | Pour the tomato juice mixed with salt, celery salt, Worcestershire sauce, and pepper over everything | Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, then stir | Cook covered for 15 minutes more | Add the sour cream ? stir well and heat through without boiling | Serve immediately

ingredients: For dressing: 1/4 cup olive oil, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/4 tsp seasoned salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1/4 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1/2 tsp sugar. For salad: 2 cups cooked couscous (cooled), 1/2 cup Kalamata olives, 1 cup cherry tomatoes (halved), 1 red bell pepper (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 1/2 cucumber (diced), 1/4 red onion (diced), 1 can (400g) artichoke hearts (drained), 1/4 cup fresh parsley (chopped), 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Make the dressing: whisk all dressing ingredients together ? cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or overnight | Cook the couscous according to package directions ? spread on a tray to cool completely | In a large bowl, combine the cooled couscous, olives, tomatoes, bell peppers, cucumber, onion, artichokes, and parsley | Add 1/2 cup of the prepared dressing and toss well | Mix in the feta cheese and season with black pepper and salt if needed | Cover and refrigerate until completely cold | Serve chilled

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce, 1 cup light brown sugar, 1/4 cup egg substitute, 1/4 cup skim milk or soy milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground cardamom, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, 1 tbsp orange zest, 1 1/2 cups quick-cooking oats, 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Combine applesauce, sugar, egg substitute, milk, and vanilla ? whisk until smooth | Add flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, cardamom, nutmeg, cloves, and zest ? stir just to mix | Stir in oats and raisins | Drop heaping tablespoons onto greased cookie sheets, leaving 3 inches between cookies ? flatten gently with a wet spatula | Bake for 12-14 minutes until firm and lightly browned on the bottom | Cool on the cookie sheet for 1 minute, then transfer to a wire rack

ingredients: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1 clove garlic (minced), 2 green onions (sliced), 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tsp fresh lemon juice, 200g crabmeat (drained), 8 egg roll wrappers, vegetable oil for frying or cooking spray for baking
instructions: Combine cream cheese, garlic, green onion, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and lemon juice ? beat until thoroughly combined | Stir in the crabmeat | Place 2 tablespoons of the mixture on each egg roll wrapper and roll up tightly | To fry: heat oil and fry until golden brown, 2-3 minutes per side | To bake: place on a sprayed baking sheet and bake at 350?F (175?C) for 15-20 minutes | Serve hot with sweet chili sauce

ingredients: 60ml vanilla vodka, 30ml marshmallow vodka or cr?me de cacao, 120ml lemon-lime soda, ice cubes, maraschino cherry for garnish
instructions: Fill a glass with ice | Pour in both vodkas | Top with lemon-lime soda and stir gently | Garnish with a maraschino cherry | Serve immediately

ingredients: 500g fresh spinach (or tenerumi leaves), 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1 yellow onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 ripe tomatoes (diced), 15 cups water, 200g spaghettini (broken into pieces), salt and black pepper, Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese for serving
instructions: Place the spinach with water still clinging to the leaves in a medium pot ? cover and cook over medium heat until wilted, about 10 minutes ? drain and set aside | Heat oil in the same pot and add onions ? cook until fragrant, about 1 minute | Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds | Return the spinach, add tomatoes and 15 cups water ? season with salt and pepper | Bring to a boil and add the broken spaghettini | Reduce heat and simmer until the pasta is tender, about 15 minutes | Serve with grated Parmigiano-Reggiano at the table

ingredients: 1/4 cup coarse salt, 6 lemons (quartered), 2 bay leaves, 4 whole cloves, 1 cinnamon stick, extra fresh lemon juice as needed
instructions: Scatter a spoonful of salt into a 1-litre sterilised jar | Tip the lemon quarters into a wide tub with the remaining salt and massage vigorously | Pack the lemons into the jar, inserting pieces of bay leaf, cloves, and bits of cinnamon throughout | Pour all the remaining salt over the lemons and press down hard to squeeze out the juice | Cover with extra lemon juice if needed to fully submerge | Wipe the neck of the jar with a clean cloth dipped in boiling water and cap tightly | Store for at least 3 weeks before using

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 sweet onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 3 cups seafood stock, 1/4 cup dry white wine, 2 tbsp cooking sherry, 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, 2 bay leaves, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/4 tsp hot sauce, 500g lump crabmeat, 1 cup frozen corn, 1 cup heavy cream, salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Melt butter in a large stock pot over medium-high heat | Add onions and garlic and cook until clear and soft, about 12 minutes | Add seafood stock, wine, and sherry ? lower heat to medium | Bring to a boil and whisk in flour, Worcestershire sauce, bay leaves, paprika, thyme, and hot sauce | Add the crabmeat, cover, and boil for 15 minutes | Remove the bay leaves and blend the soup until smooth | Return to the pot, add the frozen corn, and lower heat to medium-low | Add the heavy cream and heat through, stirring constantly, about 10 minutes | Serve hot

recipe_name: Steak and Eggs with Home Fries
ingredients: 2 sirloin steaks, 2 cloves garlic (halved), 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 3 tbsp vegetable oil (divided), 1 medium onion (sliced), 2 medium potatoes (quartered and thinly sliced), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 4 large eggs, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Rub the steaks with the cut sides of the garlic and brush both sides with Worcestershire sauce ? season with salt and pepper and set aside | Heat 2 tablespoons oil over medium-high heat ? add onion and potatoes, toss to coat, and cook until nicely browned, about 5 minutes ? season and keep warm | Wipe the pan clean, add the remaining oil, and heat for 1 minute | Add the steaks, cover, and cook undisturbed for 3 minutes | Turn over, cover, reduce heat to medium, and cook until browned and the desired doneness | Remove the steaks to a cutting board | Add butter to the pan and cook the eggs as desired | Slice the steak on an angle and serve with eggs and potatoes

ingredients: 1/2 cup white sugar, 1/2 cup cider vinegar, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup water, 2 large cucumbers (peeled and thinly sliced)
instructions: Mix sugar, vinegar, pepper, salt, and water in a bowl until the sugar dissolves | Sprinkle the sliced cucumbers with salt and let stand for 30 minutes ? rinse and drain well | Place the cucumber slices in a glass bowl or jar | Pour the sugar-vinegar mixture over the cucumbers | Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 24 hours | Adjust sweetness to taste | Serve chilled

ingredients: 1/2 tsp sea salt, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 300g large shrimp (peeled and deveined), 1 1/2 tbsp olive oil, 1 mango (sliced), 1 avocado (sliced), 1/4 red onion (thinly sliced), 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), juice of 1 lime
instructions: Combine the sea salt and cumin ? lightly dust the shrimp with the mixture | Heat 1/2 tablespoon olive oil in a medium skillet over high heat ? add the shrimp and cook for 1-2 minutes until just opaque, then turn and cook for 30 seconds more | Remove from heat | Fan the mango slices on a serving plate and arrange the shrimp, avocado, and red onion on top | Sprinkle with chopped cilantro, drizzle with the remaining olive oil and lime juice | Sprinkle with sea salt to taste | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 bone-in ham (about 3 kg), whole cloves. For mustard glaze: 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 2 tbsp brown mustard, 1/2 cup brown sugar. For peach-ginger sauce: 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar, 1 cup peach nectar, 1/2 cup peach preserves, 2 fresh peaches (sliced), 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 1 cinnamon stick
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (165?C) | Score the top of the ham in a diamond pattern and press whole cloves into it | Place on a roasting rack and bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until the internal temperature reaches 140?F (60?C) | Mix together the mustard glaze ingredients and set aside | In a saucepan, combine the sauce ingredients and bring to a boil ? simmer until the peaches are tender and the sauce thickens, 25-30 minutes | Remove the ham from the oven, brush liberally with the mustard glaze, and increase the oven to 350?F (175?C) | Return the ham to the oven uncovered for 20-30 minutes until the glaze is bubbly | Let rest for 15-20 minutes before carving | Serve with the hot peach-ginger sauce

ingredients: 8 large eggs, 1/4 tsp Italian seasoning, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 cup low-fat cheddar cheese (shredded), 4 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and spray a glass pie dish with olive oil spray | Crack the eggs into the dish | Sprinkle with Italian seasoning and black pepper | Top with the shredded cheese | Bake for 17 minutes until the cheese starts to brown | Sprinkle the crumbled bacon over the top | Let stand for 5 minutes before serving

ingredients: 1 can (400g) baked beans, 1/4 cup walnuts (chopped), 1 celery stalk (diced), 2 tbsp sweet onion (diced), 1/4 tsp salt, 2 tbsp sweet pickle relish, 2 tbsp ketchup, 1 tbsp unsalted butter, 4 slices bread (buttered)
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the buttered bread ? mix well | Spread the mixture on the buttered bread | Serve immediately

ingredients: 200g mild cheddar cheese, 100g cream cheese or Neufchatel, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tbsp warm water, 1/2 cup chopped pimiento (drained), 1 celery stalk (finely diced), 2 scallions (sliced), 1/4 cup pecans (toasted and chopped)
instructions: In a food processor, combine the cheddar, cream cheese, lemon juice, and water ? process for 3-4 minutes until very smooth | Transfer to a bowl and stir in the pimientos, celery, and scallions | Add the toasted pecans just before serving or sprinkle them on top | Keeps for 4-5 days in the refrigerator

ingredients: 1 medium zucchini (sliced), 1 yellow squash (sliced), 1 medium onion (cut into wedges), 200g button mushrooms (halved), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp poultry seasoning, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) | Combine zucchini, squash, onion, and mushrooms in a large bowl | Add olive oil and toss until all vegetables are coated | Sprinkle with poultry seasoning, salt, and pepper ? toss again | Spread in a shallow baking pan | Roast for 20-25 minutes until tender, tossing with tongs halfway through | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 kg chicken wings, 6 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 cup white vinegar, 1 tsp whole black peppercorns, 2 bay leaves, 1/2 cup soy sauce, 1 tsp accent seasoning (MSG, optional), 1/2 tsp salt, 1 cup water, 2 tbsp vegetable oil for frying, steamed rice for serving
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the oil in a stainless steel saucepan | Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce heat to medium-low | Cover and simmer for about 30 minutes until the meat is very tender, turning occasionally | Remove the meat from the sauce and pan-fry in a little oil until browned on all sides | Transfer to a serving platter and pour the sauce over | Serve with warm steamed rice

ingredients: 400g rotini pasta, 200g fresh broccoli florets, 1/2 cup plain yogurt, 2 tbsp wheat germ, 2 tbsp white vinegar, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 cups cooked chicken (diced), 1 fresh tomato (diced), 1/4 cup red onion (diced)
instructions: Cook the rotini according to package directions, adding the broccoli during the last 4 minutes ? drain and rinse in cold water | In a large bowl, combine the yogurt, wheat germ, vinegar, mustard, and pepper ? mix well | Add the pasta, broccoli, chicken, tomato, and onion ? toss to coat | Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours | Toss again before serving

ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil, 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup carrots (grated), 1/2 cup crushed pineapple (drained), 1/2 cup shredded coconut, 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and line a 9 x 9-inch pan with parchment paper | Beat together oil and sugar, add eggs, and beat well | Add flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt ? mix well | Stir in vanilla, carrots, pineapple, coconut, and walnuts ? mix until combined | Pour into the prepared pan and bake for 45-50 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool before serving

ingredients: 4 cups chicken broth, 1 can (354ml) evaporated milk, 1 avocado (diced), 1/4 cup ripe olives (sliced), 1 chayote squash (peeled and cubed), 4 slices bacon (diced), salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Cut the chayote into small cubes and saut? with the diced bacon until the bacon is crisp | Heat the broth and evaporated milk together in a pot | Add the avocado and olives | Add the chayote and bacon mixture to the soup | Adjust seasonings with salt and pepper | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 kg Yukon Gold potatoes (peeled and cut into 2-inch pieces), 6 cloves garlic (peeled), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/3 cup whole milk, 2 tbsp fresh basil (chopped), 2 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Fill a large pot 3/4 full with water, salt lightly, and bring to a boil | Add potatoes and garlic and cook until fork-tender, about 20-25 minutes ? drain | Return the potatoes and garlic to the pot and add butter | Mash until smooth, then add basil, chives, and enough milk to achieve a creamy but not runny texture | Season with salt and pepper | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 cups plain Greek yogurt, 3 tbsp maple syrup, 1/2 cup fresh blueberries, 1/2 cup fresh strawberries (sliced), 1/4 cup granola cereal
instructions: Line a quarter-sheet pan with parchment paper | Whisk together the yogurt and maple syrup in a small bowl | Spread the mixture onto the prepared sheet pan | Top with blueberries, strawberries, and granola | Freeze for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight | Break into pieces and serve | Freeze any leftovers

ingredients: 200g cooked salmon (flaked), 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 2 tbsp heavy cream, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 green onions (sliced), 2 tbsp fresh dill (chopped), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Place salmon, cream cheese, cream, and lemon juice in a jug or food processor ? blend until well combined | Stir in green onions and dill and season to taste | If not serving immediately, cover and refrigerate ? bring out 15-30 minutes before serving | Serve with crackers or vegetables

ingredients: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1 large egg, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 jar red pepper jelly, crackers for serving
