instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | In a food processor, blend cream cheese, egg, garlic, and Parmesan until smooth | Add 2/3 of the jar of red pepper jelly and blend well | Place a pan of water in the oven to keep the cheesecake moist | Pour the mixture into a 6-inch springform pan and bake beside the water for 40 minutes until a knife inserted in the centre comes out clean | Chill for several hours | Remove from the pan, top with the remaining jelly, and serve with crackers

ingredients: 2 tbsp vegetable shortening, 500g lamb shoulder (cubed), 4 cups water, 1 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 bay leaf, 3 carrots (sliced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 potato (cubed), 1/2 cup frozen peas, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour mixed with 1/4 cup water. For dumplings: 2 cups Bisquick baking mix, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 2/3 cup milk
instructions: Melt the shortening in a large skillet and brown the meat well ? spoon off the drippings | Add 4 cups water, salt, pepper, and bay leaf ? bring to a boil, then reduce heat | Cover and cook for about 2 hours, stirring occasionally | Stir in carrots, onion, and potato ? cook for 20 minutes longer | Stir in peas | Blend 2 tablespoons baking mix with 1/4 cup water and stir into the stew ? cook until thickened | Make the dumplings: stir together 2 cups baking mix, parsley, and milk to form a soft dough | Drop by spoonfuls onto the boiling stew | Cook uncovered over low heat for 10 minutes, then cover and cook 10 minutes longer | Serve hot

ingredients: 6 rectangular ice cream sandwiches, 1/2 cup white frosting, orange and black food coloring, chocolate sprinkles, Halloween sprinkles for decorating
instructions: Tint 1/2 cup frosting orange and 1 tablespoon frosting black | Cut the corners off each ice cream sandwich to form coffin shapes | Dip the sides of the sandwiches in chocolate sprinkles | Frost the tops with orange frosting | Decorate as desired with black frosting, white frosting, and sprinkles | Freeze until ready to serve

ingredients: 3 large eggs, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted), 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 cup pitted dates (chopped), 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped), 1/2 cup seedless raisins, 3 tbsp confectioners sugar for rolling
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 9-inch square cake pan | Mix eggs, sugar, vanilla, and melted butter with an electric mixer until well blended, about 3 minutes | Mixing constantly, add flour a little at a time and the baking powder | Using a rubber spatula, fold in dates, nuts, and raisins ? mix well | Pour into the prepared pan and bake for about 30 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean | While still warm, cut into bars about 1 inch wide and 3 inches long | Roll each bar in confectioners sugar | Store in an airtight container with wax paper between layers

ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable shortening, 4 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 1/2 tsp almond extract, 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 cup pecans (finely chopped), 24 maraschino cherries (halved)
instructions: Cream together shortening and cream cheese ? gradually add sugar, beating until light and fluffy | Add the egg and almond extract, beating well | Combine flour, baking soda, and salt ? stir into the creamed mixture | Chill the dough for at least 1 hour | Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Shape the dough into 1-inch balls | Roll each ball in the chopped pecans and place on an ungreased cookie sheet | Gently press a cherry half into the centre of each cookie | Bake for 16-18 minutes | Cool on wire racks

ingredients: 1 cup strong brewed coffee, 1 cup whole milk, 2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, 1 cup Irish cream liqueur (divided)
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine coffee, milk, and cocoa ? heat over moderate heat, whisking, until the cocoa is dissolved ? let cool | Stir in 1/2 cup of the liqueur and pour into a metal ice tray fitted with a divider ? freeze until solid | In a blender, blend the frozen coffee mixture with the remaining 1/2 cup liqueur until smooth but still frozen | Serve in 2 stemmed glasses

ingredients: 4 bone-in pork chops, 2 slices bacon (diced), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 cup apple cider, 1/2 tsp ground black pepper, 1 yellow onion (sliced), 2 Granny Smith apples (sliced), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 cup water, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp fresh thyme leaves, 2 bay leaves, 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: Fry the diced bacon in a small saucepan over medium heat until lightly browned, about 8-10 minutes ? remove the bacon and reserve the fat (you should have about 2 tablespoons) | Reduce heat to medium-low and gradually whisk flour into the fat until smooth and light brown, about 5 minutes | Whisk in the apple cider, bring to a boil, then cover and set aside | Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a 12-inch skillet over high heat | Season the pork chops with 1/2 teaspoon pepper and brown on both sides, about 3 minutes per side ? remove to a plate | Reduce heat to medium, add the onions, apples, salt, and water ? cook until the onions are softened and browned, about 5 minutes | Stir in garlic and thyme and cook for 30 seconds | Return the chops to the skillet in a single layer, pour in the warm sauce, and add the bay leaves | Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer until the pork is tender, about 30 minutes | Remove the chops to a platter | Increase heat to medium-high and simmer the sauce rapidly until thickened to a gravy consistency, about 5 minutes | Discard the bay leaves, stir in parsley, and season with salt and pepper | Pour the sauce over the chops and sprinkle with the reserved bacon

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 3 scallions (sliced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 1 jalape?o (minced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 2 cans (400g each) black beans (drained), 1 can (400g) Rotel tomatoes, 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth, 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar, sour cream and shredded cheese for serving
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot ? saut? scallions, celery, jalape?o, and garlic for 5 minutes | Add cumin, oregano, and cayenne ? cook for 2 more minutes | Add the Rotel tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes | Add the black beans and chicken broth and simmer for 10 minutes | Stir in the balsamic vinegar | Pur?e the soup in batches in a blender and return to the pot | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Serve topped with sour cream, cheese, or onions

ingredients: 2 cups whole milk, 1/2 cup half-and-half, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 4 oz cream cheese (cubed), 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/2 tsp mustard powder, 2 tbsp onion (diced), 2 cups Monterey Jack and cheddar cheese blend (shredded), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, 400g elbow macaroni (uncooked)
instructions: Spray a 5-quart or larger crock pot with nonstick cooking spray | Pour milk and half-and-half into the crock pot and stir in the flour to dissolve | Add all remaining ingredients except the macaroni ? stir well | Cover and cook on low for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or on high for 1 1/2 hours, stirring about halfway through and again during the last 10-15 minutes | Cook the macaroni according to package directions ? drain and stir into the cheese sauce | Add additional milk if needed for desired creaminess | Serve hot

ingredients: For cookies: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup confectioners sugar, 1/4 cup sour cream, 1 tsp vanilla extract, pinch of salt. For frosting: 1 cup confectioners sugar, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 2 tbsp milk or cream, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, sprinkles for decorating
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper | Combine flour, baking powder, and salt ? set aside | Whisk together butter and both sugars until light and fluffy | Beat in the egg yolks one at a time and incorporate the vanilla and sour cream | Slowly add the dry ingredients to the wet and mix until well combined ? chill for 30 minutes | Roll the dough into balls by the tablespoon and place on the prepared sheet, 2-3 inches apart | Bake for 10-12 minutes until the bottoms are lightly browned | Cool on a wire rack | Make the frosting: whisk sugar and butter together, then slowly add milk until the frosting holds the proper consistency | Frost the cooled cookies and top with sprinkles

ingredients: 1/4 cup unsalted butter, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup sliced almonds, 2 cups crushed cornflake cereal, 1/2 cup shredded coconut, 1.5 litres vanilla ice cream (softened), 1 tsp ground cinnamon, honey or caramel sauce for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Melt butter in a 10-inch skillet over medium heat ? add almonds and cook for 3 minutes, stirring | Stir in crushed cereal, coconut, and brown sugar ? mix well | Press the mixture into the bottom of an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan | Bake for 8 minutes ? cool, then place in the freezer for 30 minutes | In a large bowl, soften the ice cream and sprinkle with cinnamon ? mix well | Spread over the cooled crust, cover, and freeze for about 4 hours | Cut into squares and serve with honey, caramel, or chocolate sauce drizzled over the top

recipe_name: Easy Bake Oven Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tbsp margarine, 1/4 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp vanilla extract, 2 tsp water, 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp mini chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat the Easy Bake Oven for 15 minutes | Stir together the sugars and margarine | Add baking powder, vanilla, water, and flour ? stir until combined | Mix in the chocolate chips | Roll the dough between your fingers to make 12 small balls, about 1/2 inch each | Place a few balls on a greased and floured baking sheet with space between them | Bake for 10-12 minutes | Repeat until all cookies are baked

ingredients: 1 medium eggplant (sliced and fried), 1 medium onion (sliced and saut?ed), 200g mushrooms (sliced and saut?ed), 250g ground beef (browned with crushed red pepper), 4 large eggs, 1 cup whole milk, 1/4 tsp hot pepper sauce, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), 2 tomatoes (sliced), 1 unbaked 9-inch pie shell, salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) | Heat oil in a skillet and deep-fry eggplant slices until translucent and lightly browned, 2-3 minutes ? drain on paper towels | Saut? onion until almost soft and drain | Saut? mushrooms until moisture evaporates and drain | Mix the ground beef with crushed red pepper | In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, hot pepper sauce, Parmesan, garlic, and chives ? season with salt and pepper | Layer eggplant, mushrooms, onions, tomatoes, and meat in the pie shell until 3/4 full | Pour the egg mixture over to fill | Bake on the lower third of the oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour until the custard is set | Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

ingredients: 500g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 6 slices American cheese, 1/4 cup ripe olives (sliced), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 cup half-and-half, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 1/2 cup crushed crackers
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Alternate layers of mushrooms, cheese, and olives in a greased 2-quart casserole | Blend flour and half-and-half together ? pour over the layered mixture | Pour the melted butter over the casserole | Sprinkle crushed crackers on top | Bake for 30 minutes until golden and bubbly | Serve hot

ingredients: 1/3 cup all-purpose flour, 1/3 cup rolled oats, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup cold margarine (cubed), 1 can (400g) cherry pie filling, 2 tbsp orange marmalade, 2 tbsp sliced almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) and grease an 8-inch square baking dish | Combine flour, rolled oats, and brown sugar ? blend well | Using a fork or pastry blender, cut in the cold margarine until the mixture is crumbly | Spread the pie filling in the greased dish | Top with orange marmalade and almonds | Sprinkle the flour mixture evenly over the fruit | Bake for 20-30 minutes until golden brown | Serve warm

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 chicken breasts (cubed), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 200g mushrooms (sliced), 1 leek (sliced), 1/2 cup whole milk, 1 packet cream of chicken soup mix, 1/2 cup chicken stock, 1 tsp dried tarragon, 1 avocado (diced), 6 vol-au-vent pastry cases
instructions: Preheat oven to 180?C (350?F) | Heat oil in a pan and cook the chicken in batches until browned ? set aside | Add a little more oil and saut? the leeks, garlic, and mushrooms until softened | Return the chicken to the pan and remove from heat | In a saucepan, whisk the soup powder with milk and stock ? bring to a boil to thicken, then stir in the tarragon | Pour the soup mixture into the pan with the chicken and mushrooms ? stir to combine, then gently fold in the avocado | Spoon into the pastry cases | Bake for 5-8 minutes until hot | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 celery stalk (diced), 1 carrot (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 200g mushrooms (sliced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp ghee or butter, 1 cup black lentils (rinsed), 2 cups vegetable broth, 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar, salt to taste
instructions: Chop the onion, celery, carrot, and mushrooms ? mince the garlic | Heat the olive oil and ghee in a pressure cooker over low heat | Add the onions and garlic and gently cook for 2-5 minutes until the onion becomes clear but not brown | Add the mushrooms, celery, and carrot and cook for another 5 minutes | Add the lentils and broth | Lock the lid into place and cook at high pressure for 12 minutes | Allow the pressure to reduce gradually | Stir in the vinegar and salt to taste

ingredients: 1 medium onion (sliced and saut?ed), 300g sliced roast beef, 1/2 cup fontina cheese (shredded), 1 can refrigerated French bread dough, 4 tbsp unsalted butter (divided), 1 clove garlic (minced), 2 tbsp Parmesan cheese (grated), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 can (400g) condensed French onion soup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Saut? the onion until soft | Unroll the loaf of dough | Layer half the roast beef, saut?ed onions, and cheese over the dough to within 1/2 inch of one long side | Top with the remaining roast beef | Starting on the long side with the filling, roll up and press the seam firmly to seal | Place diagonally seam-side down on an ungreased 15 x 10-inch pan | Melt 2 tablespoons butter and brush over the loaf ? sprinkle with Parmesan | Bake for 25-30 minutes until golden brown, then cover with foil and bake 10 minutes more | Make the sauce: melt the remaining 2 tablespoons butter, stir in the flour with a whisk, and cook for 2 minutes | Whisk in the soup and bring to a boil ? reduce to a simmer and cook until thickened, about 10 minutes | Slice the roll and serve with the sauce on the side

ingredients: 1 can (400g) cut green beans (undrained), 1 can (400g) corn (undrained), 1 can (400g) condensed tomato soup, 4 cups water, 1 tsp garlic salt, 1/4 tsp ground pepper, 1 tsp dried basil, 1 cup small shell pasta
instructions: Combine the green beans, corn, and tomato soup with their liquids in a large pan with the water | Add garlic salt, pepper, and basil | Heat on the stovetop to a rolling boil | Add the shell pasta | Cook for 7-10 minutes until the pasta is tender | Serve hot and season to taste

ingredients: 4 cups romaine lettuce (chopped), 1/2 cup seasoned croutons, 1 Roma tomato (diced), 2 tbsp Parmesan cheese (grated), 2 tbsp black olives (sliced), Italian dressing to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl | Toss with your favorite Italian dressing | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 can refrigerated biscuits (8 count), 1 cup cherry pie filling, 1 tbsp powdered sugar for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and spray a muffin pan with cooking spray | Separate the biscuits and flatten each into a 4-inch circle | Place about 3 cherries from the pie filling in the centre of each and bring the edges up to form balls | Place each in a prepared muffin well seam-side down | Bake for 8-10 minutes until golden | Remove from the pan and cool slightly | Sprinkle each with a pinch of powdered sugar before serving

ingredients: 4 large eggs, 4 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), 2 green onions (sliced), 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese (shredded), 2 cups refrigerated hash browns, salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | In a 12-inch cast iron skillet, cook bacon over medium heat until crispy ? remove and crumble | Swirl the skillet to coat the sides with bacon grease, then pour out the excess | Spread the hash browns evenly over the bottom of the skillet and create 4 wells | Let the hash browns brown for about 5 minutes | Place the skillet in the oven for about 15 minutes to cook and brown the potatoes | Remove and cool for 5 minutes | Carefully crack one egg into each well | Return to the oven for 10 minutes | Sprinkle cheese, bacon, and green onions over the top and bake for 2 more minutes | Divide into 4 portions and serve

ingredients: 400g pasta (cooked), 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream, 1 can (400g) condensed cream of mushroom soup, 1/4 cup chicken broth or white wine, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated)
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions ? drain | Heat olive oil over medium-high heat in a saucepan | Add the onion and saut? for 5 minutes until soft, then add garlic and saut? for 2 more minutes | Stir in the sour cream, soup, broth or wine, Worcestershire sauce, and pepper ? stir until smooth | Reduce heat to medium and bring to a simmer | When the sauce has thickened to your liking, stir in Parmesan cheese | Combine with the cooked pasta and serve

recipe_name: Garlic Chicken Nibbles with Dill Dip
ingredients: 1 kg chicken wings, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tbsp paprika, salt and black pepper. For dip: 1/2 cup plain yogurt, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh dill (chopped), 1/2 tsp dried dill, salt to taste
instructions: Combine chicken with garlic, lemon juice, paprika, salt, and pepper in a large bowl ? stir well to coat | Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or overnight | Remove the chicken from the marinade, reserving the marinade | Place the chicken on a wire rack in a baking dish | Bake uncovered in a moderate oven (180?C / 350?F) for about 50 minutes until well browned and tender, brushing occasionally with the reserved marinade | Make the dip: combine all dip ingredients in a small bowl | Serve the chicken with the dill dip

ingredients: 2 lobster tails (cooked and chopped), 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 celery stalk (finely diced), 1 tbsp dill pickles (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 hot dog buns, crumbled potato chips for garnish
instructions: Remove the meat from the cooked lobsters and chop into bite-size pieces | Combine the lobster meat with mayonnaise, Dijon, lemon juice, celery, pickles, chives, and parsley ? season with salt and pepper | Butter the hot dog buns and grill until toasted | Fill the buns with the lobster mixture | Garnish with crumbled potato chips and serve immediately

ingredients: For hummus: 1 can (400g) garbanzo beans (drained), 2 cloves garlic, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tbsp fresh parsley, 1 jalape?o (seeded). For bread: 2 cups self-rising flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 2 large eggs, 1/3 cup whole milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) and grease a loaf pan | Make the hummus: pur?e all hummus ingredients in a food processor until mostly smooth but still with some texture | Mix together the flour, salt, and garlic powder in a large bowl | In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs and milk, then add to the dry ingredients | Stir in the hummus mixture until combined | Pour into the prepared pan | Bake for 40 minutes until golden brown on top and a knife inserted comes out clean | Cool for at least 10 minutes before removing from the pan

ingredients: 1 cup bulgur wheat, 1 cup boiling water, 200g scallops (poached and cooled), 1/2 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley (chopped), 1/4 cup fresh cilantro (chopped), 1 tomato (diced), 3 scallions (sliced), 100g baby shrimp (cooked). For dressing: 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, 1/4 cup olive oil, 1 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tsp anchovy paste, 1/4 tsp fresh ground pepper
instructions: In a heatproof bowl, pour 1 cup boiling water over the bulgur and let stand for 30 minutes | Poach the scallops in simmering salted water for 2 minutes ? drain and cool | Drain the bulgur in a colander lined with cheesecloth or a clean kitchen towel ? squeeze out all the liquid | Place the bulgur in a large bowl, add parsley, cilantro, tomato, and scallions ? toss well | Whisk together all dressing ingredients | Add the dressing to the bulgur mixture and toss to coat evenly | Chill for 1 hour | If chilling longer than 1 hour, add the scallops and shrimp 1 hour before serving

ingredients: 4 celery stalks (cut into pieces), 1/2 cup cream cheese or cheese spread, 1/2 cup goldfish crackers
instructions: Fill the prepared celery stalks with cream cheese or cheese spread | Add the goldfish crackers on top to look like fish swimming | For extra fun, tint the cream cheese with a little blue food coloring to look like water | Serve immediately

ingredients: 2 large tortilla wraps, 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1/2 onion (sliced), 1 pear (sliced), 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1/2 cup Gorgonzola cheese (crumbled), 1/4 cup walnuts (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 450?F (230?C) | Heat oil in a non-stick skillet ? add onions and saut? until softened, 7-8 minutes | Add the sliced pears and saut? for 2 more minutes | Add balsamic vinegar and pepper and stir until all the liquid evaporates and the onions are glazed | Divide the mixture between the two wraps | Top with Gorgonzola and walnuts | Bake for 8-10 minutes until the cheese is melted | Slice and serve

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 large egg yolks, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy | Add the egg yolks and vanilla and mix well | In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking powder, and salt | Add the flour mixture to the creamed mixture ? do not overmix | If the dough is too warm, wrap in plastic and refrigerate for 1 hour | Roll out to 1/4-inch thickness and cut into shapes | Transfer to a parchment-lined cookie sheet | Bake for 10-12 minutes until lightly golden ? watch carefully as they brown quickly | Remove from the oven and immediately transfer to a wire rack | Cool completely and decorate as desired

ingredients: 4 slices bread, 2 tbsp fat-free mayonnaise, 1 tsp prepared mustard, 8 fresh basil leaves, 2 ripe tomatoes (sliced), 1/4 cup fat-free cheddar cheese (shredded), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Spread each slice of bread thinly with mayonnaise and mustard | Place basil leaves on top of each slice | Arrange tomato slices on top of the basil | Sprinkle with salt and pepper | Top with a sprinkle of cheese | Place in a toaster oven or under the broiler until the cheese begins to melt and the edges of the bread are crispy | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup whole milk, 1/2 cup water, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 cup vegetable oil for frying, honey, powdered sugar, and extra cinnamon for serving
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, milk, water, sugar, egg, baking powder, and cinnamon until thick like pancake batter | Heat 1/4 cup vegetable oil in a medium non-stick pan | Drop tablespoonfuls of the batter into the hot oil ? you can cook about 5 at a time | When bubbles form on the surface, flip and cook until golden brown on both sides | Transfer to a paper towel-lined platter to drain excess oil | Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with cinnamon and powdered sugar | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 cups fresh cranberries (washed), 1 cup water, 3/4 cup granulated sugar
instructions: Wash the cranberries thoroughly | Place the cranberries and water in a saucepan | Cook over medium heat until the berries are soft and begin to burst | Add the sugar | Cook for 3-5 minutes more until the berries are boiling | Remove from heat and let the sauce cool | Serve at room temperature or chilled

ingredients: 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple with juice, 2 cups fresh spinach, 1/4 cup fresh cilantro (chopped), 1/2 cup peanut butter, hot sauce to taste, rice for serving
instructions: Saut? the onions and garlic in the vegetable oil until softened | Add the can of pineapple with its juices and let simmer for 5 minutes | Add the spinach and cook covered until wilted | Stir in the cilantro, hot sauce to taste, and peanut butter until smooth and combined | Serve hot over rice

ingredients: 3 large egg whites (at room temperature), 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp cream of tartar, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 3 candy canes (crushed into small pieces)
instructions: Preheat oven to 225?F (110?C) and line baking sheets with parchment paper or ungreased foil | Crush the candy canes and mix with the sugar | In a large deep mixing bowl, beat the egg whites until just foamy ? sprinkle with salt and cream of tartar and beat until soft peaks form | Gradually add the sugar-candy cane mixture, beating on high until very stiff peaks form, about 5-8 minutes | Drop by teaspoonfuls or pipe with a star tip onto the prepared sheets | Bake on the lowest rack for 1 1/2 hours | Turn off the oven and leave the meringues in with the door ajar for at least another hour until completely cool | Store in an airtight container

ingredients: 1 whole chicken (cut into pieces), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 4 cups chicken broth, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp ground coriander, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 can (400g) stewed tomatoes (blended), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 cup frozen green peas, 1 green bell pepper (diced), 100g smoked ham (diced), 1/4 cup green olives, 1 tbsp capers, 2 cups cooked rice, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese
instructions: Sear the chicken pieces and onion in oil in a deep 12-inch skillet or Dutch oven | Add broth, salt, oregano, coriander, blended tomatoes, and garlic ? bring to a boil, then reduce heat | Cover and simmer for 30 minutes | Cook the rice according to package directions, using chicken broth in place of water | Add the peas, green pepper, ham, olives, and capers to the chicken ? cover and simmer until the rice is done | Serve the chicken mixture over the rice, pour the sauce over, and sprinkle with Parmesan

ingredients: 400g angel hair pasta (cooked and drained), 2 tbsp sesame seeds (toasted), 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 3 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1 cup red cabbage (shredded), 2 scallions (sliced), 1/2 cup water chestnuts (sliced), 2 tbsp sliced almonds (toasted)
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions ? drain and set aside | Heat oil in a small skillet ? add almonds and sesame seeds and saut? until slightly brown ? set aside | In a jar, combine oil, sugar, vinegar, salt, and white pepper ? shake well | In a large bowl, combine cabbage, scallions, water chestnuts, and pasta | Toss in the nut mixture | Toss with the dressing just before serving

ingredients: 2 cups white chocolate chips, 4 cups Kix cereal, 2 tbsp sugar substitute
instructions: Melt the white chocolate chips in a microwave-safe 6-cup bowl, stirring to ensure they are completely melted | Pour in the Kix cereal and stir until completely coated | Sprinkle the sugar substitute over the mixture as you stir once more | Drop by tablespoons onto a cookie sheet or wax paper | Refrigerate for 30 minutes or freeze for 15 minutes | Remove from the sheet and store in the refrigerator

ingredients: 3/4 cup dark brown sugar, 1/3 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 cup cold water, 2 large egg yolks, 1 cup boiling water, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup evaporated milk, 1 baked 9-inch pie shell, 2 ripe bananas (sliced), whipped cream for topping
instructions: Mix brown sugar, flour, and salt in a saucepan | Stir in the cold water and egg yolks ? beat until smooth | Gradually stir in the boiling water | Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, for about 3 minutes until smoothly thickened | Stir in the butter, vanilla, and evaporated milk | Cool slightly, then pour into the baked pie shell | Shortly before serving, slice the bananas and arrange over the filling | Top with whipped cream and serve

ingredients: 3 cups heavy whipping cream, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 package chocolate wafer cookies (about 40), cocoa powder or chocolate shavings for garnish
instructions: In a large bowl, beat cream, sugar, and vanilla with an electric mixer on high speed until soft peaks form | On a flat serving plate, arrange 7 cookies side by side in a circle, with 1 cookie in the centre | Spread with 1/2 cup whipped cream, making a 7-inch circle | Repeat with remaining cookies and cream, making 11 layers of cookies and ending with a layer of cream | Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight | To serve, dust the top lightly with cocoa powder or chocolate shavings

ingredients: 500g firm white fish fillets (cut into strips), 2 large egg whites, 2 tsp salt (divided), 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 cup yellow cornmeal, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, vegetable oil for frying
instructions: Preheat oven to 250?F (120?C) and line one baking sheet with foil ? fit another with a wire rack | Whisk together egg whites, 1 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper ? add the fish strips and toss to coat | In another bowl, combine cornmeal, Parmesan, flour, and the remaining 1 teaspoon salt ? season with pepper | Working in batches, lift the fish from the egg mixture and dredge in the cornmeal mixture, patting to adhere | Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat | Cook the fish in batches until golden brown and opaque, 4-6 minutes, turning once | Transfer to the wire rack and keep warm in the oven while cooking the remaining fish | Serve hot with tartar sauce

ingredients: 100g unsweetened chocolate (chopped), 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips (divided), 1 tsp vanilla extract, 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/3 cup all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, powdered sugar for dusting
instructions: In a large saucepan over low heat, melt the unsweetened chocolate, 1/2 cup of the chocolate chips, vanilla, and butter together ? stir until smooth | Remove from heat and cool for 10 minutes | Beat the eggs and sugar together for 2 minutes with an electric mixer | Beat in the chocolate mixture | Combine flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt ? add to the chocolate mixture just until combined | Stir in the remaining 1/2 cup chocolate chips | Cover the dough and chill for at least 3 hours | Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Roll the dough into 1-inch balls with lightly floured hands and place 2 inches apart on ungreased or parchment-lined cookie sheets | Bake for 10-12 minutes until lightly puffed and set | Cool for 3-4 minutes on the sheets before removing to a wire rack | Dust with powdered sugar

ingredients: 1 box frozen chopped spinach (thawed and drained), 1 box frozen broccoli (thawed and drained), 200g fresh mushrooms (sliced and saut?ed), 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 1/4 cup light mayonnaise, 2 large egg whites, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and spray an 8 x 8-inch pan with cooking spray | Microwave the spinach and broccoli according to package directions ? drain well | Saut? the mushrooms in a little light margarine with crushed garlic | In a large mixing bowl, combine the soup, mayonnaise, egg whites, and seasonings | Add the cooked vegetables and mushrooms ? mix well | Pour into the prepared pan | Bake for 35-40 minutes until firm | Serve hot

ingredients: 4 chicken thighs (bone-in), 1 can (400g) pineapple tidbits (drained, juice reserved), 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp fresh ginger (grated), 1/2 medium onion (sliced), 1/4 cup shredded coconut, steamed rice for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Drain the liquid from the canned pineapple into a small mixing bowl | Add soy sauce and ginger to the juice and stir | Pour the mixture into an 8 x 8-inch baking dish and place the chicken inside, turning once to coat both sides | Marinate for at least 1 hour or overnight | Sprinkle the pineapple tidbits, sliced onion, and coconut over the chicken | Bake for about 1 hour and 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through | Serve over steamed rice

ingredients: 3 1/2 cups bread flour (divided), 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 3 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 tsp salt, 1 cup cold milk, 250g cold unsalted butter (for laminating), 1 large egg yolk mixed with 1 tbsp cream (for egg wash)
instructions: Place 3 1/2 cups flour in a large bowl and make a well in the centre | Add yeast, sugar, salt, and 2 tablespoons softened butter cut into pieces ? add enough cold milk to make a medium-firm dough | Knead briefly until smooth but not elastic ? refrigerate for 10 minutes | While the dough rests, shape the remaining cold butter into a flattened brick by rolling it between wax paper to a 1/4-inch-thick square ? cut in half and refrigerate | Roll the dough into a rectangle 3 times longer than it is wide | Place one butter piece in the centre, fold one end over, place the second butter piece on top, and fold the other end over ? press the edges to seal | Roll out again into a long rectangle, fold both ends to meet in the centre, then fold in half like closing a book ? refrigerate for 1 hour | Repeat the rolling and folding once more ? refrigerate for 2-3 hours | Cut the dough in half and roll each half to 1/8-inch thickness ? cut into 5-inch-wide strips, then into triangles | Roll each triangle from the wide end toward the point, stretching slightly ? chill the formed rolls for 30 minutes | Preheat oven to 475?F (245?C) | Brush the rolls with egg wash | Bake for 5 minutes at 475?F, then reduce heat to 400?F (200?C) and bake for 8-9 minutes longer until golden brown | Cool before serving

ingredients: 1 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 shallots (minced), 3 tbsp dry vermouth, 300g boneless salmon fillets, 200g bay scallops, 1 large egg, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1/4 cup breadcrumbs, 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream, 1 box frozen chopped spinach (thawed and squeezed dry). For sauce: 1 cucumber (grated and drained), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup sour cream, 2 tbsp milk, 2 tbsp fresh dill (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) and spray an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan with cooking spray | Melt butter and saut? shallots for 2 minutes | Add vermouth and simmer until reduced to 1 tablespoon | Pulse salmon and scallops in a food processor until finely chopped | Add shallot mixture, breadcrumbs, egg, salt, pepper, and hot pepper sauce | With the machine running, add cream gradually and process until just pur?ed | Combine 1 cup salmon pur?e with the spinach | Layer half the remaining pur?e, then the spinach mixture, then the remaining pur?e in the prepared pan | Cover with buttered wax paper | Place in a roasting pan with enough hot water to come halfway up the sides | Bake until the centre registers 140?F (60?C), about 55 minutes | Cool on a rack, remove wax paper, cover with plastic wrap, and chill at least 4 hours | Make the sauce: combine cucumber and salt, let stand 30 minutes, drain, rinse, and pat dry ? mix with sour cream, milk, and dill ? refrigerate at least 2 hours | Invert the terrine onto a platter and slice crosswise ? serve with the cucumber-dill sauce

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 4 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup white sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 large eggs, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 cup raisins, 1 1/2 cups quick-cooking oats, 1/2 cup sweetened flaked coconut, 1/2 cup pecans (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 370?F (190?C) and line baking sheets with parchment paper | Cream together butter, cream cheese, and both sugars until light and fluffy | Add eggs and vanilla ? mix well | Combine flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon ? add to the creamed mixture and mix until incorporated | Stir in oats, coconut, pecans, and raisins | Drop by small scoops evenly spaced onto the prepared sheets | Bake for 9-12 minutes until lightly browned | Cool on the cookie sheet

ingredients: 1 box lemon cake mix, 1 package instant lemon pudding mix, 4 large eggs, 3/4 cup canola oil, 3/4 cup water. For glaze: 2 cups powdered sugar, 2 tbsp canola oil, 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 10 x 13-inch pan | Mix together the cake mix, pudding mix, eggs, oil, and water until well combined | Pour into the prepared pan | Bake for 30-35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool for 10 minutes ? no longer | Blend together the glaze ingredients until smooth | Prick the top of the warm cake with a fork | Pour the glaze over the cake, allowing it to soak in | Cool completely before serving

ingredients: For muffins: 2 large eggs, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup pumpkin pur?e, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/3 cup vegetable oil, 2 tbsp nectar or maple syrup. For streusel: 1/4 cup flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp ground pecans, pinch of salt, 2 tbsp cold unsalted butter (cubed)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) and line a mini muffin pan with paper liners | Sift together flour, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt ? set aside | Beat eggs, sugar, and vanilla on medium for 2 minutes until pale yellow | Add pumpkin, oil, and nectar and whisk on low until just combined | Fold in the dry ingredients until just combined | Make the streusel: combine the first four ingredients and cut in the butter until crumbly | Fill the lined muffin cups 3/4 full with batter and top with streusel | Bake for 10-12 minutes | Cool and serve

ingredients: 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple with syrup, 1 cup dried apricots (chopped), 3 cups granulated sugar, 1 package (85g) orange gelatin
instructions: Mix the pineapple with its syrup, apricots, and sugar in a large pan | Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes | Stir in the gelatin and simmer 10 minutes longer, stirring occasionally | Skim off any foam | Ladle quickly into sterilized jars, filling to within 1/8 inch of the top | Wipe jar rims, apply lids, and screw bands tightly | Process in a boiling water bath for 10 minutes | Cool and check seals

ingredients: 1 large celeriac root (peeled and cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup cr?me fra?che, 2 tbsp olive oil, salt and white pepper to taste
instructions: Peel the celeriac and cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces ? sprinkle with salt and steam until very soft | Drain and cool | Pur?e the celeriac in a food processor | Add the cr?me fra?che and process until very smooth and white | With the processor running, slowly add the olive oil and process until very smooth | Reheat in a double boiler over low heat or in the microwave | Serve immediately

ingredients: For avocado cream: 1 avocado, 2 tbsp milk, 4 fresh basil leaves, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. For flatbread: 2 flatbreads, 1 tbsp olive oil, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 200g asparagus spears (blanched and halved), 1/4 red onion (sliced), 4 slices prosciutto
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) | Pur?e the avocado with milk, basil, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and pepper flakes until smooth ? add extra milk if needed for drizzling consistency | Blanch the asparagus and red pepper in boiling salted water for 3 minutes, then transfer to an ice bath ? drain, dry, and halve the asparagus lengthwise | Blend oil with garlic and brush over the flatbreads ? bake for 8-10 minutes until crisp and golden | Drizzle half the avocado mixture over the flatbreads | Top with asparagus, red pepper, onion, and prosciutto ? drizzle with additional sauce | Slice and serve

ingredients: 2 yellow onions (diced), 6 cloves garlic (minced), 3 tbsp canola oil, 1 can (400g) tomato paste, 1/4 cup Dijon mustard, 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar, 1/2 cup molasses, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup hoisin sauce, 1/4 cup Worcestershire sauce, 1/4 cup low-sodium soy sauce, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Heat the oil in a heavy-bottomed stockpot over medium-low heat | Add onions and garlic ? cook for 10-15 minutes until softened and translucent, without browning | Stir in all remaining ingredients | Bring to a simmer and cook uncovered over low heat for 30 minutes | Cool slightly, then blend until smooth using an immersion blender | Transfer to jars and refrigerate, or process in a boiling water bath for 30 minutes for pint jars | Use as a barbecue sauce for grilled meats

ingredients: 1 can (200g) tuna (drained), 2 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tbsp sweetcorn, 1/2 red bell pepper (finely diced), 2 slices bread, 2 slices cheese, black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat a sandwich toaster to its highest setting | Deseed and finely dice the pepper ? mix with the tuna, mayonnaise, and sweetcorn ? season with black pepper | Spread the tuna mixture over one slice of bread, top with cheese slices, and cover with the second slice | Place in the toaster, close the lid slowly, and cook for 3 1/2 minutes until crisp | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 package (85g) cherry or raspberry gelatin, 1 cup hot water, 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple (undrained), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 cups fresh cranberries (ground), 1 apple (cored and diced), 1 celery stalk (diced)
instructions: Dissolve the gelatin in hot water | Combine all ingredients together | Pour into a serving dish | Chill overnight before serving

ingredients: 3 large eggs, 1 cup dark brown sugar, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted), 1 cup light corn syrup, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tsp orange zest, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1 1/2 cups walnuts (chopped), 1/2 cup raisins, 1 unbaked 9-inch pie shell
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Crack the eggs into a large bowl ? add the brown sugar, salt, melted butter, and corn syrup ? whisk until well blended | Stir in the vanilla, orange zest, and nutmeg, then stir in the walnuts and raisins | Pour the filling into the pie shell | Bake until the filling is set and the pastry is golden brown, 35-40 minutes ? a knife inserted in the centre should come out clean | Cool on a wire rack | Serve slightly warm or cool

ingredients: 1 apple (cored and sliced), 1 pear (cored and sliced), 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp quick-cooking oats, 1 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 tbsp cold margarine (cubed)
instructions: Place the sliced fruit in a small microwave-safe bowl | In another bowl, combine the brown sugar, oats, flour, and cinnamon ? cut in the margarine until crumbly | Sprinkle the mixture over the fruit | Microwave on high for 2 1/2 minutes until the fruit is tender | Serve warm

recipe_name: Flat Iron Steaks with Parmesan Grilled Vegetables
ingredients: For seasoning: 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp black pepper. For grilling: 2 flat iron steaks, 2 red bell peppers (quartered), 1 red onion (cut into wedges), 2 cloves garlic (minced)
instructions: Combine the seasoning ingredients ? reserve 4 teaspoons for the steaks | Add cheese, oil, and vinegar to the remaining seasoning ? mix well | Press the reserved seasoning onto both sides of the steaks | Grill the steaks over medium coals for 10-14 minutes, covered, turning once | Grill the peppers for 12-15 minutes and the onion for 15-20 minutes until tender | Brush the vegetables with the cheese mixture during the last 10 minutes | Serve the steaks with the grilled vegetables

ingredients: 1.5 kg pork tenderloin, 1 cup orange marmalade or apricot preserves, 1/4 cup apple juice, salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Mix the marmalade with the apple juice | Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with cooking spray and coat the bottom with some of the glaze | Place the tenderloin in the pan and pour the remaining glaze over it | Cover loosely with foil with several small slits cut in it | Bake for 30 minutes per pound (about 90 minutes for a 3-pound roast), basting every 30 minutes | Remove the foil after the last basting and cook uncovered for the final 30 minutes | The internal temperature should reach 170?F (77?C) for well done | Let rest before slicing

ingredients: 4 veal steaks (pounded to 1/4 to 1/2-inch thickness), 1 large egg (beaten), 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1 cup breadcrumbs, 1/4 cup vegetable shortening, salt and black pepper, lemon wedges for serving
instructions: Season the veal steaks with salt and pepper | Dredge each steak in flour, dip in beaten egg, then coat in breadcrumbs mixed with paprika | Melt the shortening in a frying pan over medium heat | Fry the veal until golden brown on both sides | Drain on paper towels | Serve with lemon wedges

ingredients: 1 kg pork shoulder (cut into chunks and chilled), 200g pork fat, 2 tsp rubbed sage, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp white pepper, 1/2 tsp marjoram, 1/2 tsp red chili flakes, 1/2 tsp savory, 1/4 tsp ground cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/4 tsp ground allspice
instructions: Chill the meat and fat in the freezer until firm ? grind twice using a coarse blade | Add all the spices to the meat mixture and knead thoroughly | Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight | Stuff into prepared casings or form into patties | Refrigerate for up to 3 days or freeze for longer storage | Cook thoroughly before serving

ingredients: 1 kg potatoes (boiled and cubed), 2 tbsp Creole mustard, 1 tsp Cajun seasoning, 1 green bell pepper (diced), 2 green onions (sliced), 4 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled), 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 1/4 cup sour cream, 1 tsp sugar, salt and black pepper, fresh parsley for garnish
instructions: Boil the potatoes in salted water until fork-tender ? drain and cut into 1-inch chunks | Combine the mustard and Cajun seasoning in a large bowl ? add the warm potatoes and toss | Add the green pepper, green onions, and bacon | Combine the mayonnaise, sour cream, and sugar ? add to the potato mixture | Season with salt and pepper | Refrigerate for at least 3 hours to meld the flavours | Garnish with parsley before serving

ingredients: 4 cups brewed tea (cooled), 4 cups water, 2 cups vodka, 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate, 1 can frozen pink lemonade concentrate, 2 litres grapefruit soda
instructions: Mix together the tea, water, vodka, orange juice concentrate, and lemonade concentrate in a large freezer-proof bowl | Freeze overnight or several days ahead | Scrape the frozen mixture with a fork into a slush | Pour in the grapefruit soda and stir | Serve cold

ingredients: 400g ziti pasta (cooked), 2 cups ricotta cheese, 2 cups tomato pasta sauce, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/4 cup Romano cheese (grated), 2 cups mozzarella cheese (shredded)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Cook the ziti according to package directions ? drain | Toss the pasta with the sauce and ricotta | Add the Parmesan and half the mozzarella ? combine well | Transfer to a greased baking dish and top with the remaining mozzarella and Romano | Bake for 30 minutes until bubbly and golden | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 tbsp sugar substitute, 2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, 1 cup water, 1 tbsp instant coffee granules, 2 cups nonfat milk, 1/4 tsp peppermint extract
instructions: Combine the sugar substitute and cocoa in a medium saucepan ? stir well | Add the water and bring to a boil, stirring constantly | Stir in the coffee granules | Gradually add the milk, stirring well | Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes until thoroughly heated, stirring often | Remove from heat and stir in the peppermint extract | Beat with a wire whisk until foamy | Serve warm

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 2 tbsp fresh coriander (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1/2 tsp flaked sea salt
instructions: Let the butter come to room temperature | Mix in the coriander, lime juice, and salt with a fork until well blended | Roll into a log in plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm | Slice and use on grilled meats, fish, or vegetables

ingredients: For salsa: 2 tbsp chives (chopped), 1/2 cup frozen corn (thawed), 2 Roma tomatoes (diced), 1/4 cup red onion (diced), salt and black pepper, juice and zest of 1 lemon, 2 green onion tops. For remoulade: 1/4 cup fresh parsley, 1 celery stalk, 2 tbsp Creole mustard, 2 tbsp ketchup, 1 tbsp tomato paste, 1 clove garlic, 1/2 tsp paprika, salt and black pepper. For shrimp: 500g cooked shrimp (chopped), 2 tbsp fresh parsley, salt and white pepper, slider buns, tomato slices
instructions: Make the salsa: combine all salsa ingredients and refrigerate until ready to serve | Make the remoulade: blend all remoulade ingredients in a blender until smooth | Toss the shrimp with the parsley and 1/4 cup of the remoulade ? season with salt and white pepper | Spread remoulade on the bottom of each slider bun, top with a tomato slice, the shrimp mixture, and the top bun | Serve with the salsa and potato chips

ingredients: 1 cup water, 2 tbsp powdered milk, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 cup whole wheat flour, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup rolled oats, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp vital wheat gluten, 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast
instructions: Add all ingredients to the bread machine according to the manufacturer's instructions | Set to the dough cycle | When the cycle is complete, remove the dough and shape into a loaf | Place in a greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan | Cover and let rise for about 30 minutes | Bake at 350?F (175?C) for about 30 minutes until nicely browned | Cool on a wire rack before slicing

ingredients: 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips, 1 tbsp vegetable shortening, 24 large ridged potato chips
instructions: Combine the chocolate chips and shortening in a small glass bowl | Microwave on high for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes until melted and smooth when stirred | Dip each potato chip one at a time into the chocolate, coating one half to three-quarters of each chip | Pull the chip against the edge of the dish to remove excess chocolate | Place on a wax paper-lined baking sheet | Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes, then refrigerate until set | Serve at room temperature

ingredients: 500g top round beef (cut into thin strips), 3 tbsp vegetable oil (divided), 200g button mushrooms (sliced), 1 carrot (julienned), 1 medium onion (sliced), 1/4 cup dry red wine, 1/4 cup beef broth, 1 tbsp unsalted butter, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Season the beef strips with salt and pepper | Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large heavy skillet over medium-high heat ? sear the meat for about 1 minute per side until just browned ? remove and keep warm | Add the remaining oil to the skillet and heat ? add the mushrooms, carrot, and onion and saut? until the mushrooms release their juices, about 8 minutes | Return the beef to the skillet and stir in the wine and broth ? saut? until the meat is just done, 1-2 minutes | Stir in the butter until just melted | Season to taste and serve immediately

recipe_name: Asian Pork Mushroom and Noodle Stir-Fry
ingredients: 200g dried noodles (cooked), 1/2 cup chicken broth, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp dry sherry, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water, 3 tbsp vegetable oil (divided), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 large eggs (beaten), 300g pork tenderloin (thinly sliced), 200g shiitake mushrooms (sliced), 2 heads baby bok choy (chopped), salt and black pepper
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package directions ? drain and rinse under cold water | Mix the stock, soy sauce, sherry, sesame oil, and red pepper ? set aside | Mix the cornstarch with water ? set aside | Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large skillet ? add the garlic and cook until golden, about 3 minutes ? remove to a plate | Add the eggs and cook until set ? transfer to the plate | Season the pork with salt and pepper ? stir-fry until browned and cooked through, about 3 minutes ? transfer to the plate | Heat the remaining oil ? add the mushrooms and cook until tender, about 4 minutes | Add the bok choy and cook until softened, about 3 minutes | Add the noodles, soy sauce mixture, and cornstarch mixture ? cook until the sauce thickens, about 2 minutes | Return the garlic, eggs, pork, and any juices to the pan and toss until heated through | Serve in bowls

ingredients: 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil, 3 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/4 tsp sea salt, pinch of black pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a container with a watertight lid | Close the lid tightly | Shake vigorously until emulsified | Serve over salad greens

ingredients: 1 cup whole milk, 1 tbsp instant coffee granules, 1 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/2 cup ice cubes
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender | Blend at high speed for 2 minutes until smooth and frothy | Pour into a tall glass and serve immediately

ingredients: 1 turkey carcass, 2 yellow onions (diced), 4 boiling potatoes (cubed), 3 carrots (sliced), 2 bay leaves, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1 tsp dried thyme, 1 tsp dried sage, 8 cups chicken broth, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Place all ingredients except salt and pepper in a large pot | Bring to a boil over medium heat | Reduce heat and simmer gently for about 1 hour | Remove the turkey carcass and pick off any remaining meat ? return the meat to the pot | Season with salt and pepper and serve hot

ingredients: 1 can (400g) baked beans, 1/4 cup chili sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp yellow mustard, 1/2 medium onion (diced and saut?ed), 1/2 tsp Tabasco sauce, 2 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled)
instructions: Cook the bacon until crisp ? remove from the pan and crumble | Saut? the onion in the bacon grease until tender ? drain the grease | Combine all ingredients in a heavy pan or crock pot | Simmer on the stove top for about 1 hour, or in the crock pot on low for a couple of hours | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 500g beef stew meat (cubed), 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 shallots (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 cup beef broth, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 300g butternut squash (cubed), fresh cilantro for garnish
instructions: Combine the first 6 spices in a bowl ? add the beef and toss well to coat | Heat the oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat ? add the beef and shallots and cook for 4 minutes until browned | Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute | Stir in the broth and tomatoes ? bring to a boil and cook for 5 minutes | Add the squash, cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 15 minutes until the squash is tender | Sprinkle with cilantro and serve

ingredients: For pastry: 1 unbaked 9-inch deep dish pie shell. For filling: 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp salt, 6 apples (peeled and sliced). For crumb topping: 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup quick oats, 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter (cubed), 1/4 cup pecans (chopped), caramel sauce for drizzling
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) and place the pastry in a 9-inch deep dish pie pan | Combine the sugar, flour, cinnamon, and salt ? toss with the apples and pour into the pie shell | Combine the crumb topping ingredients until crumbly ? sprinkle over the apples | Bake for 20-30 minutes, then cover with foil and bake another 20 minutes until the apples are tender | Remove from the oven, sprinkle with pecans, and drizzle with caramel sauce | Serve warm

ingredients: 1 cup warm water, 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour (divided), 1 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp cornmeal, canola oil for brushing
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the warm water, yeast, and 2 tablespoons flour ? sprinkle 1 tablespoon flour on top | Wait until the flour is absorbed, then add the remaining ingredients | Knead by hand for 7-10 minutes until smooth and elastic, or with a dough hook until the dough cleans the sides of the bowl | Divide the dough in half and roll out on a cornmeal-dusted surface | Brush lightly with oil and prick with a fork | Pre-bake in a preheated 500?F (260?C) oven for 5-8 minutes | Remove, cool, and add toppings ? bake at 450?F (230?C) for 15-20 minutes until the crust is browned and the cheese is melted

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 1 can (425g) pumpkin pur?e, 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce, 1/2 cup water, 1/4 cup egg substitute, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/4 tsp ground cloves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a loaf pan | Mix all ingredients together until well combined | Pour into the prepared pan | Bake for 65-70 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack

ingredients: 500g ground pork, 2 tbsp red wine, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp fennel seeds, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tbsp olive oil, hard rolls, sliced provolone cheese, lettuce, tomato, and onion for serving
instructions: Mix together the pork, red wine, garlic, fennel seeds, salt, and pepper | Form gently into 4 patties | Brush each patty lightly with olive oil | Grill over hot coals with the hood closed for 5 minutes, then turn and cook for 4 minutes on the second side until no longer pink | Serve on hard rolls with cheese, lettuce, tomato, and onion

ingredients: 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 1 tsp ground coriander, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp turmeric, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp salt, 2 tomatoes (diced), 1/2 cup water, 500g boneless chicken (cubed), 1 cup unsweetened coconut milk, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, fresh cilantro for garnish, steamed basmati rice for serving
instructions: Heat the oil in a Dutch oven ? add the onion and cook until nicely browned, about 7 minutes | Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute | Add the coriander, cumin, turmeric, cayenne, and black pepper ? stir for 1 minute | Add the salt, tomato, and water ? cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly, until the tomato is softened | Add the chicken and simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 15 minutes | Add the coconut milk and simmer partially covered for another 15 minutes until the gravy thickens | Add the cinnamon and cloves and simmer 1 more minute | Garnish with cilantro and serve with steamed basmati rice

ingredients: 1 box angel food cake mix, 1 can (425g) pumpkin pur?e, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, 1/4 tsp ground ginger
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Combine the pumpkin, vanilla, and spices in a large bowl | Prepare the cake mix according to package directions | Fold 1/4 of the batter into the pumpkin mixture, then fold in the remaining batter | Spoon into an ungreased 10-inch tube pan | Bake on the lowest oven rack for 38-44 minutes until the top is golden brown | Invert the pan onto a wire rack and cool completely | Remove from the pan and serve

ingredients: 12 jumbo pasta shells (cooked), 400g firm tofu (crumbled), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp dried basil, 3 cups spaghetti sauce, 1/4 cup fat-free Parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Spread 2 cups of spaghetti sauce in a 13 x 9-inch pan | Add 1/2 cup water to the remaining sauce | Combine the tofu, parsley, onion powder, salt, garlic powder, and basil ? mix well | Fill each cooked shell with the tofu mixture and place in the pan | Pour the remaining sauce over the shells | Sprinkle with Parmesan | Bake for 25 minutes until bubbly | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 fresh pineapple (peeled and cut into bite-sized chunks), 2 cups granulated sugar, 1 cup water, 1/4 cup light corn syrup
instructions: Peel the pineapple and slice into bite-sized chunks | In a heavy saucepan, bring the sugar, water, and corn syrup to a boil | Add the pineapple chunks | Cook over low heat until the fruit becomes translucent | Drain the pineapple on a rack and allow to dry | Store in an airtight container

ingredients: 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup vegetable shortening, 3 ripe bananas (mashed), 2 large eggs, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a loaf pan | Cream together the sugar and shortening | Add the mashed bananas and eggs ? mix well | Sift together the flour, salt, and baking powder ? add to the banana mixture without overmixing | Pour into the prepared loaf pan | Bake for about 35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool before slicing

ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower (cut into florets), 1 tbsp salt (for blanching water), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 tsp salt
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add 1 tablespoon salt | Add the cauliflower florets and boil for about 1 minute until tender but still firm ? drain and set aside | Heat a large wok over high heat ? add the oil and swirl to coat | Add the garlic and stir-fry until it starts to turn golden, 15-20 seconds | Add the cauliflower and stir-fry for 30 seconds to 1 minute, pressing it against the side of the wok to sear | Add 1/2 teaspoon salt, stir-fry briefly, and serve

ingredients: 500g ground beef, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1 cup longhorn cheese (shredded), 8 flour tortillas, 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 1 can (354ml) evaporated milk, 200g processed cheese (cubed), 1 can (200g) diced green chilies, 1/4 cup pimientos
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Brown the ground beef with salt and garlic powder ? drain | Add the longhorn cheese and onion ? mix well | Spoon the beef mixture onto the tortillas and roll tightly ? place seam-side down in a buttered 8 x 10-inch baking dish | Heat the soup, evaporated milk, and processed cheese in a saucepan until the cheese melts, stirring constantly | Add the green chilies and pimientos ? mix well | Pour the cheese sauce over the enchiladas | Cover and bake for 30 minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: 250g dried chickpeas (soaked overnight), 4 cups water, 3 cloves garlic, 2 bay leaves, 1 thick slab bacon, 1 ham bone, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 slices bread (fried until golden), 100g Spanish ham (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 tsp paprika, 2 cups Swiss chard (chopped), 2 small red potatoes (cubed), salt to taste, 2 hard-boiled eggs (yolks mashed, whites chopped), 2 tbsp almonds (ground)
instructions: Soak the chickpeas overnight and drain | In a large pot, combine the chickpeas, 4 cups water, garlic, bay leaves, bacon, and ham bone ? bring to a boil, cover, and simmer for about 1 1/2 hours | In a skillet, heat the oil and fry the bread until golden on both sides ? reserve | Add the ham and onion to the skillet and saut? until the onion has wilted | Stir in the paprika and remove from heat ? add to the chickpeas | Add the Swiss chard, potatoes, and salt ? continue cooking for 30 minutes until tender | Remove the ham bone | In a mortar or food processor, combine the fried bread, almonds, 2 tablespoons chickpeas from the pot, and the mashed egg yolks ? mash into a paste | Stir the paste into the stew, cover, and let sit for 10 minutes | Serve in bowls garnished with the chopped egg whites

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 large eggplant (sliced), 1 cup ricotta cheese, 2 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), 2 cups tomato sauce, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, 1/4 cup Romano cheese (grated)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Cook the eggplant slices in olive oil in a heavy-bottomed skillet until tender ? drain | Mix the tomato sauce with the garlic and oregano | Add the chives to the ricotta | Mix the breadcrumbs with the Romano cheese | In a greased 12 x 8-inch baking dish, layer half the eggplant, half the ricotta, half the tomato sauce, and half the crumb mixture | Repeat the layers | Bake for 30 minutes until bubbly | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 can (400g) cream of chicken soup, 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 2/3 cup milk, 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 cups frozen mixed vegetables, 2 cups cooked chicken (diced), 1 can refrigerated biscuits (quartered)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | In a 2-quart saucepan, stir together the soups, milk, thyme, and pepper | Stir in the vegetables and chicken | Heat over medium-high until the mixture just begins to boil ? reduce heat and cook for 3-4 minutes | Pour into an ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking dish | Cut the biscuits into quarters and arrange around the edges of the dish on top of the hot mixture | Bake for 18-22 minutes until the biscuits are golden brown and baked through | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 cup cold milk (divided), 1 tbsp instant coffee granules, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 package whipped topping mix, 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix, 1 prepared graham cracker crust
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, beat 1 cup milk, the whipped topping mix, coffee granules, vanilla, and cinnamon on medium speed until combined | Beat on high for 4-6 minutes until thick | Add the remaining milk and the pudding mix ? beat on medium for about 2 minutes until thick | Spread into the crust | Refrigerate for at least 3 hours until firm | Garnish as desired and store in the refrigerator

ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil, 500g ground turkey, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 cups tomato sauce, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp dried oregano, 9 uncooked lasagna noodles (broken to fit), 2 cups low-fat cottage cheese, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, 2 cups part-skim mozzarella cheese (shredded)
instructions: Brown the ground turkey in olive oil with the onion and garlic | Add the tomato sauce, tomato paste, and oregano ? mix thoroughly | Spoon a layer of meat sauce onto the bottom of a slow cooker | Add a double layer of uncooked lasagna noodles (broken to fit) and top with the cheeses | Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used | Cover and cook on low for 4-5 hours | Serve hot

ingredients: 1/2 cup frozen strawberries, 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream, 1/2 cup vanilla yogurt, 1/2 cup diet ginger ale, maraschino cherries for garnish
instructions: Pour the whipping cream into a blender and blend until creamy | Add the yogurt and blend again for about 30 seconds | Add the frozen strawberries and blend for 1 minute | Slowly pour in the ginger ale and blend briefly | Pour into glasses and garnish with a maraschino cherry | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 tsp unflavored gelatin, 1 tsp instant coffee powder, 2 tbsp water, 2 tbsp icing sugar, 1 cup heavy whipping cream, 3 tbsp Baileys Irish Cream
instructions: Combine the gelatin, coffee, and water in a small bowl ? microwave on high for about 20 seconds until the gelatin is dissolved ? let cool without setting | Whip the cream and sifted icing sugar until soft peaks form | Fold in the gelatin mixture and Baileys | Pour into 4 individual dishes | Refrigerate until set and serve chilled

ingredients: 4 large egg yolks, 2 tbsp cornflour, 2 cups whole milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 3 tbsp caster sugar
instructions: In a bowl, beat the egg yolks and cornflour with a whisk until well combined | Heat the milk and vanilla in a heavy-based saucepan over medium heat | Add the yolk mixture and sugar | Stir constantly in a figure-8 motion over medium-low heat for about 10 minutes until thick and coating the back of a spoon ? do not let it boil | Rest for 10 minutes and serve warm

ingredients: 4 pork steaks (deboned, pounded to 1/8-inch thickness), 1 tbsp celery seeds, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1/4 cup lard or vegetable oil for frying, paprika gravy for serving
instructions: Debone the pork steaks and pound them out to 1/8-inch thickness | Rub both sides of each steak with the celery seeds | Place the flour in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper | Dredge the pork in the seasoned flour | Heat the lard or oil in a large skillet over medium heat | Pan-fry the pork steaks until golden brown on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side | Drain on paper towels | Serve with paprika gravy

ingredients: 1.5 kg pork spareribs, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp five-spice powder, 2 tbsp palm sugar or brown sugar, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp rice wine
instructions: Combine all marinade ingredients in a bowl | Add the spareribs and coat well ? marinate overnight in the refrigerator | Preheat oven to 180?C (350?F) | Bake the spareribs for 20 minutes | Finish on a barbecue or under the broiler over medium heat until golden brown, about 10 minutes | Slice and serve

ingredients: 2 cups semolina flour, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 3/4 cup warm water (approximately), pinch of salt
instructions: Place both flours in a large mixing bowl and stir to combine | Make a well in the centre and add the water a little at a time, mixing with your hands until a dough forms | Knead on a floured surface for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic | Cover and let rest for 10 minutes at room temperature before rolling and cutting | Cook in salted boiling water until al dente, 2-3 minutes for fresh pasta

ingredients: 200g fresh spinach (washed, trimmed, and coarsely chopped), 1 tbsp peanut oil, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 cup onion (diced), 1/4 cup water chestnuts (chopped), salt and black pepper to taste, 24 wonton wrappers, water for sealing, broth, steaming, or oil for cooking
instructions: Wash the spinach thoroughly, trim any tough stems, and pat dry ? coarsely chop | Heat a wok over medium-high heat until smoking hot | Add the peanut oil with the garlic and onion ? stir-fry for 30 seconds | Add the spinach and water chestnuts ? cook for an additional 3 minutes until the water from the spinach evaporates | Transfer to a bowl and season with salt and pepper ? let cool for 5 minutes | To form each wonton: moisten the edges of a wrapper with water, place a scant teaspoon of filling in the centre, fold into a triangle, then bring the long corners together and pinch to seal | Cover completed wontons with plastic wrap | Cook by simmering in broth for soup, steaming and serving with soy dipping sauce, or deep-frying until golden | Uncooked wontons can be frozen in a single layer, then transferred to a resealable bag

ingredients: 1 box plain crackers (such as saltines), 1/3 cup canola oil, 2 tbsp clarified butter (melted), 1 tbsp dried parsley, 1 tsp seasoning salt, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp cayenne powder
instructions: Heat the crackers in the microwave on half power until they are quite warm | Heat the oil and clarified butter together until hot | Drizzle the hot oil mixture over the crackers in thirds, stirring between each addition | Sprinkle on the parsley, seasoning salt, garlic powder, and cayenne ? mix well until evenly coated | Let cool and store in an airtight container | Serve as a snack

ingredients: 400g penne pasta, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 red onion (diced), 1 red bell pepper (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 300g ground pork, 1/4 cup dry red wine, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1/2 cup tomato sauce, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp dried rosemary, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 2 medium zucchini (diced), 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, 1/2 cup shredded cheese, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions ? drain | Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat ? add the onion and saut? for 3 minutes | Add the red pepper and cook for 3 minutes | Add the garlic and saut? for 1 minute | Add the pork and cook until no longer pink | Add the red wine and cook until the liquid has almost evaporated | Add the diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, oregano, basil, rosemary, and brown sugar ? stir to combine | Reduce heat to medium-low and cook for 10-15 minutes | Add the drained pasta and diced zucchini to the skillet ? season with black pepper and red pepper flakes | Increase heat to medium, cover, and cook until the zucchini is tender, about 5-8 minutes | Stir in the cheese until melted | Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve immediately

ingredients: 1.5 kg beef brisket, 2 tbsp seasoning mix. For sauce: 1 cup ketchup, 1/4 cup soy sauce, 2 shallots (minced), 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp white vinegar, hickory chips for smoking
instructions: Rinse the brisket and pat dry ? sprinkle both sides with seasoning | Place in a plastic bag and marinate in the refrigerator overnight | Start a charcoal fire in a smoker ? pre-soak hickory chips in water | Place the brisket fat-side up in a disposable aluminium pan on the grill | Cover the smoker and add soaked hickory chips directly onto the coals ? replenish periodically | Baste the meat occasionally with the fat from the cooking | Cook for 6-8 hours until the meat pulls apart easily | Make the sauce: combine all sauce ingredients in a heavy-bottomed pan and bring to a boil ? reduce heat and simmer until thick, about 10 minutes | Slice the brisket thinly across the grain and serve with the barbecue sauce | For oven cooking: slow-roast at 275?F (135?C) for 60 minutes per pound

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour, 1/2 cup sugar substitute, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce, 1/2 cup pumpkin pur?e, 1/4 cup fat-free egg substitute, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | In a mixing bowl, combine all dry ingredients (flour, sugar substitute, brown sugar, baking soda, and salt) ? mix well | In a separate bowl, mix together all wet ingredients (applesauce, pumpkin, egg substitute, and vanilla) | Add the wet mixture to the dry ingredients and stir until completely blended | Fold in the chocolate chips | Spray a large baking pan with nonstick spray and spoon the batter into 8 evenly spaced circles | Bake for about 10 minutes until the cookies appear done and feel firm | Cool slightly and enjoy while still warm

ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk, 1 package instant French vanilla pudding mix, 1 can fruit cocktail (drained), 1 can mandarin oranges (drained), 1 cup coloured miniature marshmallows, 1 cup whipped topping (thawed)
instructions: In a mixing bowl, beat the buttermilk and pudding mix on medium speed for 1 minute ? let stand for 5 minutes | Fold in the drained fruit cocktail, oranges, marshmallows, and whipped topping | Refrigerate until ready to serve

ingredients: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup powdered sugar, 1 tsp fresh lemon juice, 12 large fresh strawberries (hulled and hollowed), 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Beat together the cream cheese, powdered sugar, and lemon juice until smooth and creamy ? set aside | Using a paring knife, hollow out the top of each strawberry to a depth of about 3/4 inch | Gently fill each strawberry with the cream cheese mixture using a pastry bag, filling just slightly above the tops | Dip each filled top into the graham cracker crumbs | Place on a baking sheet and refrigerate for several hours or overnight to chill completely | Serve cold

ingredients: 400g malfadine or mafalda pasta, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 150g lardons or smoked bacon (cubed), 1 can (400g) Italian tomatoes, 1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes (chopped), salt and black pepper, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 cup Parmesan or Romano cheese (grated)
instructions: In a frying pan, saut? the onion in olive oil until softened but not browned | Add the lardons or bacon cubes and brown them | Add the canned tomatoes and chopped sun-dried tomatoes | Season with salt and pepper and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally | Cook the malfadine until al dente ? drain, reserving 2 tablespoons of the pasta water | Add the drained pasta and the reserved pasta water to the sauce ? let the pasta absorb the flavour for 1 minute | Add the butter and cheese, remove from heat, and mix everything well | Transfer to a serving dish and serve immediately

ingredients: 300g lump crabmeat (checked for shells), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 shallots (minced), 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 tbsp dry vermouth, 8 oz cream cheese (cubed), 1/2 cup Gruy?re cheese (shredded), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/2 cup half-and-half, 1/2 tsp Tabasco sauce, 2 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), crackers or toast rounds for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Carefully check the crabmeat for any remaining bits of shell | Melt the butter in a 2-quart heavy-bottomed pan ? add the shallots, cayenne, and black pepper and saut? over medium heat for 5 minutes | Add the garlic and saut? until fragrant, about 30 seconds | Pour in the vermouth and lemon juice ? increase heat to medium-high, scraping the bottom of the pan to deglaze, and cook uncovered for 5 minutes | Lower heat to medium-low ? stir in the cream cheese chunks until melted and well combined | Add the Gruy?re and Parmesan and stir until melted | Stir in the crabmeat, half-and-half, and Tabasco ? mix well | Transfer to a baking dish and bake for 30 minutes | Garnish with chives and serve with crackers or toast rounds

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 2 tbsp milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1 cup rolled oats, 1/2 cup chocolate chips, 1/2 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 175?C (350?F) | Cream together the butter and both sugars | Add the egg, milk, and vanilla ? mix well | Sift together the flour and baking soda and add to the creamed mixture ? mix until combined | Stir in the oats, chocolate chips, and raisins | Roll the dough into balls and place on an ungreased baking sheet | Bake for 10-15 minutes until golden | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: 1 can (400g) salmon (drained, liquid reserved), milk (enough to make 2 1/4 cups with salmon liquid), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 2 tbsp celery (diced), 1 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), 4 English muffins (split and toasted), 4 hard-boiled eggs (halved), fresh parsley for garnish, lettuce and tomato slices for serving
