instructions: Drain the liquid from the salmon and add enough milk to make 2 1/4 cups ? set aside | Flake the salmon and mash any soft bones ? set aside | Melt the butter in a heavy saucepan ? blend in the flour, salt, and pepper | Remove from heat and stir in the milk mixture | Return to low heat and cook, stirring, until thickened | Add the salmon and Dijon mustard ? keep warm | Toast the muffin halves and spread with a little mustard | Top with celery and chives | Arrange 2 egg halves on each muffin and top with the salmon sauce | Sprinkle with parsley and serve with lettuce and tomato slices

ingredients: 3 tbsp walnut oil, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp fresh thyme leaves, 1 tsp sugar, 3 ears fresh corn (kernels cut from the cob), 2 ripe tomatoes (diced), 1/4 red onion (diced), 1 can (400g) chickpeas (drained), mixed salad greens, crumbled veggie bacon and goat cheese for garnish
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the walnut oil, vinegar, thyme, and sugar ? set aside | Using a serrated knife, carefully cut the corn kernels from the cobs | Add the corn, tomatoes, onion, and chickpeas to the bowl with the dressing ? toss well | Divide the greens among 4 serving plates and top with the corn mixture | Garnish with crumbled veggie bacon, goat cheese, and chive blossoms if desired | Serve immediately

ingredients: 2 cans (200g each) minced clams (drained), 1/4 cup onion (diced), 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp reduced-sodium Worcestershire sauce, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp Tabasco sauce, 2 tbsp Parmesan cheese (grated), 8 slices white bread (crusts removed, rolled flat), 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) | Mix together the clams, onion, mayonnaise, Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, Tabasco, and Parmesan until well combined | Cut the crusts off the bread and roll each slice with a rolling pin until very thin | Spread about 1 tablespoon of the clam mixture on each slice of bread and roll up like a jelly roll | Brush with melted butter and arrange about 1 inch apart on a greased cookie sheet | Bake for approximately 12 minutes until lightly browned | Serve hot

ingredients: 60ml spiced rum, 60ml cream of coconut, 120ml pineapple juice, 1/2 cup ice cubes, pineapple wedge and shredded coconut for garnish
instructions: Combine all ingredients with ice in a blender and blend until smooth | Pour into a glass | Garnish with a pineapple wedge and shredded coconut

ingredients: 4 green tomatoes (cut into 1/4-inch-thick slices), 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp garlic salt, 1/4 tsp cracked black pepper, pinch of cayenne pepper, 1/2 cup buttermilk, vegetable oil for frying, hot pepper sauce for serving
instructions: Cut the tomatoes into 1/4-inch-thick slices | Combine the flour, cornmeal, salt, garlic salt, black pepper, and cayenne in a shallow bowl ? mix well | Pour the buttermilk into a second shallow bowl | Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium heat | Dip each tomato slice into the buttermilk, coating both sides, then dredge in the flour mixture, shaking off the excess | Fry the tomato slices in the hot oil for 3-5 minutes per side until golden brown | Transfer to paper towels to drain | Serve immediately with hot pepper sauce

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 1/4 cups whole milk, 1/2 cup fresh blueberries, maple syrup for serving
instructions: Mix together the flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar | Beat the eggs and milk together and add to the dry ingredients ? stir until just combined | Bake in a preheated waffle iron according to the manufacturer's directions | Place a few fresh blueberries in each of the waffle indentations and serve with maple syrup

ingredients: 500g bay scallops or sea scallops (halved horizontally if using sea scallops), 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, salt and black pepper, 4 tbsp unsalted butter (divided), 2 shallots (minced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh flat-leaf parsley (chopped), 1/4 cup dry white wine, 1 lemon (juiced)
instructions: Season the scallops with salt and pepper and toss with the flour ? shake off the excess | Heat 2 tablespoons butter in a very large saut? pan over high heat until sizzling | Add the scallops in a single layer and lower the heat to medium ? allow them to brown lightly on one side without moving, then turn and brown the other side, about 3-4 minutes total | Melt the remaining butter in the pan, add the shallots, garlic, and parsley, and saut? for 2 more minutes, tossing with the scallops | Add the wine and cook for 1 minute ? taste for seasoning | Serve hot with a squeeze of lemon juice

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts (cut into strips or nuggets), 1 package Shake 'n Bake coating mix, dipping sauce of choice for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) | Cut the chicken breasts into strips or nuggets as preferred | Pour the Shake 'n Bake into the provided bag, add the chicken pieces, and shake to coat evenly | Arrange on a baking sheet in a single layer | Bake for 15 minutes until golden and cooked through | Serve with your favourite dipping sauce

ingredients: 4 cups bread cubes (toasted), 2 tbsp white wine vinegar, 1 tbsp water, 2 tbsp fat-free mayonnaise, 1 tsp sugar, 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 4 cups leaf lettuce (torn), 2 ripe tomatoes (diced), 2 green onions (sliced), 4 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Place the bread cubes in a single layer on a baking sheet and lightly coat with cooking spray | Bake for 10 minutes until golden, stirring once | Combine the vinegar, water, mayonnaise, sugar, olive oil, salt, and pepper in a large bowl ? whisk until smooth | Add the toasted bread cubes, lettuce, and tomatoes ? toss gently to coat | Sprinkle with green onions and crumbled bacon | Serve immediately

ingredients: 500g fresh green beans (trimmed), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 tsp dried marjoram, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/4 tsp dried chervil, 1/4 tsp dried savory, 1/4 tsp dried thyme, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 3 tbsp sunflower seeds (toasted), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Melt the butter in a small saucepan and add the marjoram, basil, chervil, savory, and thyme | In a large frying pan, add just enough water to cover the bottom and bring to a boil | Add the parsley, chives, garlic, and green beans ? cook until the beans are just crisp-tender | Pour off the excess water, add the herb butter and sunflower seeds | Stir to coat and season with salt and pepper | Toss over medium heat for 2-3 minutes until well mixed | Serve hot

recipe_name: Brussels Sprouts and Potatoes in Cream Broth
ingredients: 200g Brussels sprouts (halved), 2 scallions (sliced), 100g cremini mushrooms (halved), 4 small red potatoes (quartered), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 cup chicken broth, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/2 tsp fresh thyme leaves, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, 2 tbsp Parmesan or Romano cheese (grated)
instructions: Prepare the vegetables: halve the Brussels sprouts, quarter the potatoes, halve the mushrooms, and slice the scallions | Melt the butter in a large pan and saut? the garlic briefly | Add the potatoes and Brussels sprouts and brown for 3-4 minutes | Add the broth and simmer on medium-low until the sprouts and potatoes are about halfway done, 7-8 minutes | Add the mushrooms and cook another 5 minutes until all the vegetables are tender and most of the broth has reduced | Stir in the cream, nutmeg, thyme, parsley, salt, and pepper ? cook 3-4 minutes until slightly thickened | Top with grated Parmesan or Romano cheese and serve

ingredients: For biscuits: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 3 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 tbsp baking powder, 1 cup half-and-half (plus extra as needed). For filling: 1 cup fresh blueberries, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tbsp cornstarch, 3 tbsp granulated sugar, 2 tbsp water. For glaze: 1/2 cup confectioners sugar, 2-3 tsp milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Make the biscuits: combine the flour, sugar, and baking powder ? cut in the butter or stir in the half-and-half until a soft dough forms ? knead 3-4 times | Pat out to about 1-inch thickness on a lightly floured surface and cut into rounds | Bake for 15 minutes until golden brown | Make the filling: combine the blueberries, lemon juice, cornstarch, sugar, and water in a saucepan ? cook over medium-high heat until boiling and thickened, then reduce heat and cook for 5 minutes | Hollow out the centres of the baked biscuits and fill with the blueberry mixture | Drizzle with the glaze just before serving

ingredients: 12 jumbo pasta shells (parboiled), 1 cup low-fat ricotta cheese, 1/2 cup fat-free cottage cheese, 1 cup part-skim mozzarella cheese (shredded, divided), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 tsp dried basil, 1 tsp dried parsley, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 cup egg substitute, 2 cups spaghetti sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Boil the pasta shells in salted water for 2/3 of the recommended time ? drain and spread on an oiled sheet pan | Mix the ricotta, cottage cheese, 1/2 cup mozzarella, Parmesan, egg substitute, and all seasonings in a large zip-lock bag ? cut off a corner and pipe the filling into the par-cooked shells | Spread 1 cup of spaghetti sauce in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish | Arrange the stuffed shells in the dish and top with the remaining sauce | Sprinkle with the remaining mozzarella | Bake for 30 minutes until bubbling and golden brown | Cool for 10 minutes before serving

ingredients: 4 slices bacon (diced and browned), 1/4 cup onion (diced), 1/4 cup green bell pepper (diced), 1/4 cup mushrooms (sliced), 1/2 cup pepperoni (sliced and quartered), 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 4 hamburger buns (split)
instructions: Cook the diced bacon until crisp ? drain the fat | Add the onion, green pepper, and mushrooms to the bacon and cook until the onions begin to soften, stirring often | Add the spaghetti sauce, pepperoni, oregano, and garlic powder ? heat through | Remove from heat and let cool slightly | Stir in the cheeses | Spread the mixture on the open-faced buns and broil until bubbly and the cheese is melted | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4 large eggs, 2 tbsp whole milk, salt and black pepper, 1 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/4 cup mushrooms (sliced), 1/4 cup shredded cheese, 2 tbsp bacon crumbles, fresh parsley for garnish
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl ? add the milk, salt, and pepper and whisk well | Saut? the mushrooms in butter for 2-3 minutes | Add the shredded cheese, bacon crumbles, and saut?ed mushrooms to the egg mixture ? stir to combine | Pour the egg mixture into a pan over medium-high heat and cook, scrambling constantly, until no liquid is visible | Top with additional cheese and parsley if desired | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 medium head green cabbage (chopped), 4 slices bacon (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp water, 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar, salt and black pepper to taste, dash of hot sauce (optional)
instructions: Chop the bacon and cook in a medium pan with high sides until crispy | Add 1 tablespoon water to deglaze the pan and cook for 4 minutes | Add the butter and chopped onion ? cook for 2-3 minutes | Add the cabbage, salt, and pepper and saut? until well coated with the bacon drippings and butter | Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until the cabbage reaches your desired tenderness, stirring occasionally ? add a bit of water if needed | Turn off the heat and add a dash of apple cider vinegar and hot sauce if using | Season to taste and serve

ingredients: 6 cups fresh watermelon juice (strained if desired), 2 packages powdered pectin, 5 cups granulated sugar
instructions: Measure out 6 cups of watermelon juice | Mix the juice with the pectin in a deep pot | Bring to a rolling boil and add the sugar all at once | Stir well and return to a rolling boil | Boil for exactly 1 minute, stirring constantly | Remove from heat and skim off any foam | Pour into hot sterilized jars and seal | Process in a boiling water bath for 10 minutes | Cool and store

ingredients: 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter, 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1 cup powdered sugar, 1 1/2 cups whipped topping (thawed), 2 tbsp milk, 1 prepared graham cracker crust, chocolate sauce for topping (optional)
instructions: Beat together the peanut butter, cream cheese, and powdered sugar until smooth | Fold in the whipped topping and milk until well combined | Pour into the prepared graham cracker crust and spread evenly | Freeze until firm | Top with chocolate sauce if desired before serving

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 1 can (400g) black beans (drained), 1 cup salsa, 1/2 cup sour cream, steamed white rice for serving
instructions: Place the chicken breasts, black beans, and salsa in a crock pot ? stir to combine | Cook on low for 3-4 hours | Before serving, stir in the sour cream and let heat through | Serve over white rice

ingredients: For crust: 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, 1/3 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter (cubed). For filling: 3 large eggs, 1 cup granulated sugar, 3/4 cup honey, 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/3 cup unsalted butter (melted), 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 1/2 cups pecans (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Combine 1 1/4 cups flour and 1/3 cup sugar ? cut in the cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse meal | Press evenly into a greased 9-inch square pan | Bake for 15 minutes | Combine the eggs, sugar, honey, flour, salt, melted butter, and vanilla ? beat well | Stir in the pecans | Pour the filling over the pre-baked crust | Reduce oven temperature to 350?F (175?C) and bake for 25 minutes until firm | Cool on a wire rack and cut into squares

ingredients: 500g walleye or white fish fillets (cooked and flaked), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 green onions (sliced), 1/4 cup red bell pepper (diced), 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 large egg (beaten), 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, salt and black pepper, lemon dill sauce for serving
instructions: Mix together the flaked fish, butter, green onions, bell pepper, mayonnaise, egg, mustard, and seasonings until well combined | Form into small patties and coat with breadcrumbs | Place on a well-greased baking sheet and bake at 350?F (175?C) for about 15 minutes, flipping once, until golden on both sides | Alternatively, pan-fry in a greased skillet over medium heat for 4-5 minutes per side | Serve immediately with lemon dill sauce on the side

ingredients: 1 cup quick grits, 4 cups water, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 cup Cheez Whiz or sharp cheddar cheese (shredded), 2 large eggs (beaten), 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, 2 tbsp onion (diced)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a casserole dish | Combine the grits, water, and salt in a saucepan ? simmer until thickened | Add the butter, cheese, eggs, cayenne, garlic powder, and onion ? stir well | Pour into the prepared casserole dish | Bake for 30 minutes until set and golden | Serve hot

ingredients: 8 cups popped popcorn, 1/2 cup sliced almonds, 1/4 cup unsalted butter, 1/2 cup honey, 1/4 cup light brown sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 250?F (120?C) | Turn the popped popcorn into a large shallow roasting pan and sprinkle the almonds over it | Melt the butter in a saucepan ? stir in the honey and brown sugar | Cook over medium heat until the mixture comes to a boil ? simmer without stirring for 5 minutes | Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla | Pour the mixture over the popcorn and almonds ? stir until well coated | Bake for 1 hour, stirring well every 15 minutes | Remove from oven and continue stirring as the mixture cools to prevent clumping | Cool completely and store in an airtight container

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 4 cups whole milk, 4 large eggs (beaten), 2 cups heavy whipping cream, 1 tbsp vanilla extract
instructions: Combine the sugar, flour, and salt in a 3-quart saucepan ? gradually stir in the milk | Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes until thickened, stirring constantly | Stir 1/4 of the hot mixture into the beaten eggs, then add to the remaining hot mixture, stirring constantly | Cook for 1 minute more ? remove from heat and cool | Chill for 2 hours | Combine the whipping cream and vanilla in a large bowl ? add the chilled custard and whisk to combine | Pour into an ice cream maker and freeze according to the manufacturer's directions | Let ripen in the freezer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours before serving

ingredients: 1 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 2 medium potatoes (cubed), 2 carrots (sliced), 1 kohlrabi (diced), 2 celery stalks (sliced), 1 cup broad beans, 1/2 cup peas, 1 cup cauliflower florets, 1 tbsp tomato paste, 4 cups chicken or vegetable stock, 4 slices cheese (such as Gouda or Swiss), extra parsley for garnish
instructions: Heat the butter and oil in a saucepan and saut? the onion, garlic, and parsley | Add all the remaining vegetables and enough stock to cover them | Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer ? cover and cook until the vegetables are just tender, 15-20 minutes | Ladle the soup into bowls and place one slice of cheese in each bowl ? let it soften for a few minutes | Garnish with additional parsley if desired | Serve immediately

ingredients: 200g dark chocolate (chopped), 1/2 cup unsalted butter, 3 large eggs, 1 cup granulated sugar, 3/4 cup self-rising flour, 100g milk chocolate (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease and line an 11 x 8-inch brownie pan | Melt the dark chocolate and butter together until smooth and creamy ? set aside | Beat the eggs and sugar well, then stir in the melted chocolate mixture | Stir in the flour | Fold in the chopped milk chocolate | Pour into the prepared pan and bake for 35 minutes until just done ? the top should still be shiny | Cool completely in the pan | Refrigerate overnight for easier cutting

ingredients: 1.5 kg beef ribs, 1 medium onion (diced), 1/2 cup water, 1/4 cup white vinegar, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/2 cup ketchup, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp chili powder, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1/2 tsp salt
instructions: Preheat the broiler and brown the ribs for about 25-30 minutes (or cook on the grill) | Combine all sauce ingredients in a saucepan and simmer for 15-20 minutes until the flavours are well blended ? adjust seasonings to taste | Place the ribs in a roasting pan and cover with the sauce | Bake at 325?F (160?C) for about 2 1/2 hours until the ribs are tender, basting occasionally with the sauce | Serve hot

ingredients: 4 medium potatoes (peeled and thinly sliced), 6 tbsp unsalted butter (divided), 2 cups cheddar cheese (shredded, divided), 1/4 cup whole milk, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the potatoes | Coat the bottom of a 2-quart microwave-safe dish with 3 tablespoons butter | Layer half the potatoes, 1 cup cheese, and 3 tablespoons butter | Add the remaining potatoes and top with the remaining 1 cup cheese | Season with salt and pepper | Add a thin layer of milk to the bottom of the dish, about 1/4 inch | Cover with plastic wrap | Microwave on high for 10 minutes | Let rest for 5 minutes before serving

recipe_name: Cheesy Mashed Potato Patties with Bacon
ingredients: 2 cups prepared mashed potatoes, 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 3 tbsp bacon bits, 2 tbsp cream cheese (softened), 1 tbsp green onion (sliced), butter or oil for frying, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Mix the mashed potatoes, cheddar cheese, bacon bits, cream cheese, and green onion until well blended | Form into patties | Heat butter or oil in a skillet over medium heat | Fry the patties until golden brown on both sides | Season to taste and serve hot

ingredients: 1.5 kg beef silverside (trimmed), 2 tbsp canning salt, 1 tbsp kosher salt, 1 tbsp cracked black pepper, 2 tbsp light brown sugar, 2 tbsp dark brown sugar, 2 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp ground coriander, extra cracked black pepper for finishing, white beef stock for cooking
instructions: Combine the salts, pepper, both sugars, ginger, garlic, and coriander | Rub the seasoning mixture into all surfaces of the beef | Place in a heavy-duty sealable plastic bag, expel the air, and seal | Refrigerate for 12 days, rotating and massaging the bag at least once daily | Preheat the smoker to 180?C (350?F) | Remove the beef from the bag and hang it in the smoker ? air dry with no smoke for 24 hours | Remove and cool loosely | Return to the smoker at 135?C (275?F) for 2 hours | Gradually increase the temperature over several hours until the internal temperature reaches 120?F (49?C) | Apply a finishing rub of cracked black pepper | Cool quickly, wrap tightly, and refrigerate for 2 days | To serve, cover with white beef stock, bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 2 hours until tender | Slice and serve

ingredients: 500g ground beef, 2 large eggs, 1/4 cup water, 1/4 cup ketchup, 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 cup onion (diced)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Combine all ingredients in a large bowl ? mix well | Shape into a loaf in a 13 x 9-inch baking or roasting pan | Bake uncovered for 1 hour until done | Let stand for 10 minutes before slicing | Serve with extra ketchup on top if desired

ingredients: 2 cups cake flour, 1 2/3 cups bread flour, 1 1/4 tsp baking soda, 1 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp coarse sea salt (plus extra for sprinkling), 1 1/4 cups unsalted butter (softened), 1 1/4 cups brown sugar, 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 2 tsp vanilla extract, 3 cups chocolate chips
instructions: Sift together the flours, baking soda, baking powder, and salt ? set aside | Cream the butter and both sugars until fluffy, about 5 minutes | Add the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla | Reduce the mixer speed to low and gradually add the dry ingredients, mixing until just combined | Fold in the chocolate chips | Refrigerate the dough for 24-36 hours | When ready to bake, preheat the oven to 350?F (175?C) | Scoop the dough onto parchment-lined baking sheets and sprinkle sparingly with sea salt | Bake for 10-12 minutes until golden at the edges | Cool on the sheets briefly, then transfer to a wire rack

ingredients: 2 cups cooked chicken (shredded), 1 can (400g) pinto beans (drained), 1 can (400g) red kidney beans (drained), 1 can (400g) Rotel diced tomatoes, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 4 cups chicken broth, 1 medium onion (diced), crushed tortilla chips, sour cream, and shredded cheese for serving
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large pot and simmer for at least 1 hour, or place in a crock pot on low for 8 hours | Serve with crushed tortilla chips, sour cream, and shredded cheese

ingredients: 400g spaghetti, 2 litres water, 1 tbsp salt, 1 tbsp olive oil, 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated)
instructions: Bring the water to a boil and add the salt and oil | Add the pasta and cook until al dente | Drain well in a colander | Melt the butter in the same pan, return the pasta, and toss well | Sprinkle the grated Parmesan over the top and serve immediately

ingredients: 1 cup granulated sugar, 1 cup vegetable shortening, 2 large eggs, 2 tbsp light corn syrup, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tsp lemon zest, 1 tsp orange zest, 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, icing sugar for decorating
instructions: Combine the sugar and shortening in a large bowl ? blend well | Add the eggs, corn syrup, vanilla, and citrus zests ? mix thoroughly | In a separate bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt ? gradually add to the sugar mixture | Form the dough into 4 balls and refrigerate for at least 1 hour | Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Roll out each ball to about 1/4-inch thickness on a lightly floured surface | Cut into shapes and place on a cookie sheet 1-2 inches apart | Bake for 5 minutes for small cookies, up to 9 minutes for larger ones | Cool completely and decorate with icing

ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower (cut into florets), 1 whole head garlic (roasted at 350?F for 40 minutes), 2 tbsp low-fat milk, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tbsp margarine, 2 tbsp instant potato flakes (optional)
instructions: Roast the garlic at 350?F (175?C) for about 40 minutes, covered with foil | Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil | Boil the cauliflower for 7-10 minutes until completely tender but not mushy ? drain well | In a food processor or blender, combine the drained cauliflower, roasted garlic (squeezed from the cloves), milk, salt, pepper, and margarine | Pur?e until smooth, adjusting the consistency with extra milk or a few potato flakes if desired | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 cup chicken broth, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup bulgur, 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 100g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 1 celery stalk (diced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a small saucepan, bring the chicken broth and salt to a boil ? add the bulgur | Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes until the broth is absorbed and the bulgur is tender | In a small skillet, heat the olive oil | Add the mushrooms, celery, and onion ? saut? until the onion is tender but not brown | Add the garlic during the last minute or two | Stir in the cooked bulgur | Season with salt and pepper to taste | Serve as a side dish or stuffing

ingredients: For brownie: 100g dark chocolate (chopped), 1/2 cup unsalted butter, 1 cup granulated sugar, 3 large eggs, 3/4 cup all-purpose flour. For cheesecake: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg, 1 large egg yolk, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 300?F (150?C) and grease a 9-inch square pan or line with parchment | Melt the chocolate and butter together in a double boiler ? cool slightly | Beat 1 cup sugar and 3 eggs until pale yellow, about 2 minutes | Add the flour at low speed for 5 seconds | Add the cooled chocolate mixture and blend on low for 15 seconds | Spread the batter evenly in the prepared pan and place in the freezer for 10 minutes | Process the cream cheese, 1/2 cup sugar, 1 egg, egg yolk, and lemon juice in a food processor until smooth, about 1 minute | Remove the pan from the freezer and spoon the cheesecake mixture over the brownie mixture without mixing | Bake on the centre rack for 1 hour 5-10 minutes until the top is set | Cool for 30 minutes, then cut with a sharp knife dipped in hot water | Refrigerate covered for up to 2 days

ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 cups whole milk, 1 cup chicken stock, 200g fresh spinach, 1/2 tsp sea salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper. For eggs: 4 large eggs, 1 tbsp tarragon vinegar, water for poaching, paprika for garnish
instructions: In a medium pot, melt the butter and stir in the flour to make a roux | Gradually stir in the milk, then the chicken stock | Add the spinach and bring to a boil | Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes until the spinach is wilted | Pur?e the soup in batches in a blender or with an immersion blender until smooth | Return to the pot, keep on low heat, and season with salt and pepper | Fill a large skillet with water and the vinegar ? bring to a boil, then turn off the heat | Crack each egg into a small bowl and gently lower into the water | Cook for 5-8 minutes depending on how you like the eggs | Ladle the soup into bowls and top each with a poached egg | Garnish with paprika

ingredients: 2 cans (400g each) great northern beans (drained), 4 cups chicken broth, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 cans (200g each) diced green chilies, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 cups cooked chicken (shredded), sour cream and Monterey Jack cheese for serving
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the chicken in a large pot | Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour | Add the shredded chicken and cook for an additional 30 minutes | Top each bowl with sour cream and shredded Monterey Jack cheese before serving

ingredients: 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips (divided), 1/2 cup unsalted butter, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a muffin tin or line with paper cups | Melt 1/2 cup chocolate chips and the butter together until smooth | Pour into a mixing bowl, add the sugar, and beat until well blended | Beat in the eggs one at a time, then add the vanilla | Stir in half the flour, baking soda, and salt ? mix well | Add the remaining flour and water ? mix until smooth | Pour into the prepared pan | Bake for 20-25 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup chocolate chips over the hot cupcakes ? let stand for 2-3 minutes until softened, then gently spread the melted chocolate over the tops | Cool completely before serving

ingredients: 3 carrots (cut into pieces), 2 medium zucchini (cut into pieces), 4 plum tomatoes (quartered), 6 cloves garlic, 2 tbsp canola oil, 1 tsp fresh thyme, 1 1/2 tsp salt (divided), 1/2 tsp ground black pepper (divided), 3 cups chicken broth, 1/2 cup half-and-half, sour cream and smoked paprika for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Toss the carrots, zucchini, tomatoes, and garlic with the oil, thyme, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper ? spread on a large rimmed baking sheet | Roast for 35-40 minutes, turning occasionally, until the vegetables are tender | Cool slightly and remove the garlic peels | Pur?e the vegetables with the chicken broth in batches in a blender until smooth | Transfer to a large saucepan and add the remaining salt, pepper, and the half-and-half | Cook over medium heat for about 10 minutes until heated through | Serve with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkle of smoked paprika

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 1/4 cup honey, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp black pepper, steamed rice and vegetables for serving
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the honey, soy sauce, and garlic | Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat | Season the chicken with pepper and cook for 5-6 minutes per side until golden | Pour the honey garlic sauce over the chicken and cook for 2-3 minutes until the sauce thickens and glazes the chicken | Serve over steamed rice with vegetables

ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust, 8 oz cream cheese spread (softened), 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 2 tbsp cold unsalted butter (cubed), 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Prepare the pizza crust according to package directions for a crispy crust | Microwave the cream cheese on high for 15-20 seconds until very soft and spreadable | Spread the softened cream cheese evenly over the crust | Mix together the flour, cinnamon, and brown sugar | Cut in the cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs | Sprinkle the flour mixture over the cream cheese | Bake for 12-17 minutes according to the crust directions until golden | Slice and serve

ingredients: 2 parsnips (peeled and diced), 1 turnip (peeled and diced), 2 carrots (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 4 slices bacon (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a large non-stick saut? pan, cook the bacon over low heat until crisp ? remove and drain on paper towels | In the bacon drippings, saut? the onion and garlic until soft | Add all the diced vegetables and cook slowly until tender | Season with salt and pepper | Just before serving, stir in the parsley and crumbled bacon | Serve hot

ingredients: 1/2 cup crushed tomatoes (divided), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 2 green onions (sliced), 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1 jalape?o (minced), 1/4 tsp salt. For meatloaf: 1/2 cup crushed tortilla chips, 1/2 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 250g ground beef, 250g ground pork, 1/2 cup corn kernels, 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese (shredded)
instructions: Make the salsa: combine 1/2 cup crushed tomatoes (minus 1/2 cup for the meatloaf), bell pepper, green onions, cilantro, jalape?o, lime juice, and 1/4 tsp salt ? set aside | In a large bowl, combine the remaining 1/2 cup crushed tomatoes with the crushed tortilla chips ? stir in the onion, garlic, cumin, chili powder, paprika, salt, and pepper | Add the ground beef, pork, and corn ? mix well and form into a loaf | Arrange foil strips in a criss-cross in the slow cooker, place the meatloaf in the centre, and lower into the cooker | Cook on low for 5-6 hours or on high for 2 1/2-3 hours until the internal temperature reaches 160?F (71?C) | Carefully lift out the meatloaf, sprinkle with cheese, and let stand for 10 minutes | Serve with the salsa

ingredients: 4 navel oranges (peeled and sliced, juice reserved), 8 anchovy fillets, 1/4 cup black olives, 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, warm Italian bread for serving
instructions: Peel and slice the navel oranges (one per person), keeping as much of the juice as possible ? arrange on individual plates or a platter | Top each orange slice with an anchovy fillet and several olives | Drizzle generously with olive oil | Serve with warm Italian bread for soaking up the olive oil and juices

ingredients: For choux pastry: 1/2 cup water, 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 cup plain flour, 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/4 cup Gruy?re cheese (shredded). For filling: 1 medium onion (sliced), 200g mushrooms (sliced), 1 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 2 tbsp walnuts (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 200?C (400?F) | Make the choux pastry: put the water and butter in a pan and stir over medium heat until the butter melts | When the mixture comes to a boil, turn off the heat and quickly tip in all the flour at once ? stir vigorously with a wooden spoon | Beat until the mixture forms a smooth paste that doesn't stick to the sides | Beat in the eggs a little at a time, followed by both cheeses, until smooth and glossy | Spoon the mixture onto a greased baking sheet in a circle about 8-10 inches across | Make the filling: fry the sliced onion in a little oil until soft, add the mushrooms and flour, then the soy sauce ? add a little water if needed ? stir in the parsley and walnuts | Spread the filling on top of the choux circle | Bake for about 30 minutes until puffed and golden | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/4 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp ground allspice, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1 large egg, 1/2 cup plain yogurt, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup crushed pineapple (drained), 1/2 cup carrot (grated), 1/4 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) and grease or line a muffin tin | Combine all dry ingredients in a large bowl | Beat together the egg, yogurt, vanilla, and pineapple ? pour into the dry mixture | Stir just until combined ? do not overmix | Fold in the carrot and raisins | Fill the muffin cups about 2/3 full | Bake for 15-17 minutes until golden and a toothpick comes out clean | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry (thawed), 1 large egg (beaten with 1 tbsp water). Filling options: Parmesan cheese with parsley and oregano, raspberry jam with chocolate chips, or cinnamon-sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Thaw the pastry sheet at room temperature for 30 minutes | Mix the egg with 1 tablespoon water | Unfold the pastry on a lightly floured surface and roll into a 14 x 10-inch rectangle | Cut in half lengthwise | Brush both halves with the egg mixture | Top one rectangle with your chosen filling and place the remaining rectangle over it, egg-side down | Roll gently with a rolling pin to seal | Cut crosswise into 1/2-inch wide strips | Twist each strip and place 2 inches apart on a greased baking sheet, pressing down the ends | Brush with the remaining egg mixture | Bake for 10 minutes until golden | Serve warm or at room temperature

ingredients: 12 large white mushrooms (stems removed and chopped), 200g crabmeat, 1/4 cup onion (diced), 1/2 tsp dry mustard, 1 cup Parmesan cheese (grated, divided), 1/4 cup breadcrumbs, 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/4 tsp ground cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp garlic salt (divided), 1 large egg, 2 tbsp mayonnaise, 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), fresh chives and lemon wedges for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) and spray a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with cooking spray | Wipe the mushrooms with a damp paper towel ? remove the stems and chop them for the filling | In a medium bowl, mix the crabmeat, chopped mushroom stems, onion, dry mustard, 1 cup Parmesan, breadcrumbs, parsley, cayenne, black pepper, and 1/4 tsp garlic salt ? mix well | Stir in the egg and mayonnaise | Mound the filling onto each mushroom cap and flatten slightly | Mix the remaining garlic salt into the melted butter and drizzle over the filled mushrooms | Top with a generous mound of the remaining Parmesan | Bake for 20 minutes until golden | Serve hot garnished with chives and a squeeze of lemon

ingredients: 16 oz cream cheese (softened), 1 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 3 large eggs, 1 prepared graham cracker crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) for a silver springform pan or 300?F (150?C) for a dark nonstick pan | Beat the cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla with an electric mixer on medium speed until well blended | Add the eggs one at a time, mixing on low speed after each just until blended | Pour over the crust | Bake for 55 minutes until the centre is almost set | Loosen the cake from the side of the pan and cool completely before removing the pan sides | Refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight | Store leftovers in the refrigerator

ingredients: 1 bottle cold Mexican beer, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/2 tsp Tabasco sauce, juice of 1 lime, 1/4 tsp fresh coarse ground black pepper, pinch of sea salt, ice cubes
instructions: In a large glass or pitcher, add a few ice cubes | Pour in the beer, Worcestershire sauce, Tabasco, lime juice, pepper, and salt ? stir gently | Pour into a pint glass and serve immediately

ingredients: 500g flank steak (thinly sliced against the grain), 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 tbsp cornstarch, 1 tbsp dry sherry, 1 tbsp hoisin sauce, 1 tsp rice vinegar, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp peanut oil, 3 green onions (cut into pieces), steamed rice for serving
instructions: Whisk together the soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, sherry, hoisin, rice vinegar, and salt in a small bowl | Heat the peanut oil in a large nonstick skillet or wok over medium-high heat | Saut? the ginger, garlic, and beef for about 2 minutes until the beef is browned | Add the green onion pieces and saut? for 30 seconds | Add the soy sauce mixture and cook for 1 minute until thickened, stirring constantly | Serve immediately over steamed rice

ingredients: Turkey giblets (heart, liver, gizzard), 6 cups water, 3 1/2 cups reduced-sodium chicken broth, 1 carrot (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 celery stalk (diced), 1 bay leaf, 5 tbsp unsalted butter, 5 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup heavy cream, up to 1 cup turkey pan juices, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Place the giblets in a large saucepan with the water, chicken broth, carrot, onion, celery, and bay leaf | Simmer over medium heat until the stock is reduced to about 3 cups (about 2 hours) | Strain the stock into a bowl ? chop the giblets and set aside | Melt the butter in a large heavy saucepan over medium heat ? whisk in the flour for 2 minutes | Gradually whisk in the strained stock, cream, and up to 1 cup of turkey pan juices | Simmer until the gravy reaches the desired consistency, whisking occasionally | Add the chopped giblets | Season with salt and pepper and serve hot

ingredients: 1 cup sourdough starter, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 cup chopped nuts or dried fruit (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease and sugar two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans | Place all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and mix by hand with a wooden spoon until smooth | Fold in the chopped nuts or dried fruit if using | Pour the batter into the prepared pans | Bake for about 40 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the centre comes out dry | Cool for 10 minutes before removing from the pans | Serve warm or at room temperature

ingredients: 1 breaded fish fillet (cod or halibut), 1 English muffin (split and toasted), 1 slice American cheese, 1 tbsp tartar sauce, oven fries and side salad for serving
instructions: Bake the fish fillet according to package directions | When the fish has about a minute left, split and toast the English muffin | Place the cheese on one half of the toasted muffin and the tartar sauce on the other | Sandwich the hot fish fillet in between | Serve with crisp oven fries and a side salad

ingredients: 200g orzo pasta, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 200g white button mushrooms (sliced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 tsp fresh coarse ground black pepper, 1 cup cooked chicken strips, 1/2 cup chicken broth
instructions: Cook the orzo according to package directions ? drain | Melt the butter over medium heat in a skillet | Add the mushrooms and garlic ? season generously with black pepper | Cook until the mushrooms are browned | Add the chicken strips and chicken broth ? stir occasionally and cook until the chicken is heated through and the broth is near a boil | Pour over the cooked pasta and serve immediately

ingredients: 500g bulk pork sausage, 200g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 1/2 red bell pepper (diced), 1/2 green bell pepper (diced), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 10 large eggs, 1/2 cup half-and-half, 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded)
instructions: In a 12-inch nonstick skillet, cook the sausage over medium-high heat for 5-7 minutes until no longer pink | Add the mushrooms and bell peppers ? cook for 4-5 minutes until tender | Remove the mixture from the skillet and drain ? wipe the skillet clean | Melt the butter in the same skillet over medium heat | Beat the eggs with the half-and-half, thyme, salt, and pepper ? pour into the skillet | Cook over medium heat for about 7 minutes, stirring constantly, until firm but still moist | Stir in the soup | Spray a 3-4 quart slow cooker with cooking spray ? layer half the egg mixture, half the sausage mixture, and half the cheese ? repeat layers | Cover and cook on low for 30 minutes until the cheese is melted | Keep warm for up to 2 hours

ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs (chopped), 1/4 cup watercress (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh chives (chopped), 3 tbsp mayonnaise (plus extra for spreading), 1/4 tsp Tabasco sauce, salt and black pepper, 8 slices white bread (crusts removed), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: Remove the crusts from the bread | Gently mix the chopped eggs with the watercress, chives, and just enough mayonnaise to bind ? season with salt, pepper, and Tabasco | Spread the egg mixture on 4 slices of bread and top with the remaining slices | Lightly spread the outside edges of each sandwich with mayonnaise and dip into the chopped parsley | Cut each sandwich into 4 triangles | Arrange on a platter and garnish with extra watercress

ingredients: 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream, 2 scallions (sliced), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1 tsp lemon zest, salt and black pepper, 2 cups cooked chicken (diced), lettuce leaves for serving
instructions: Combine the sour cream, scallions, parsley, lemon zest, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl ? whisk well | Add the diced chicken and toss to coat | Serve on a bed of lettuce leaves

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (divided), 1 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup hot water
instructions: Melt half the butter in a small saucepan over low heat | Stir in the flour mixed with the salt and pepper to make a smooth paste | Gradually whisk in the hot water | Bring to a boil and cook for 5 minutes | Add the remaining butter piece by piece, whisking until incorporated | Serve warm over seafood or vegetables

ingredients: 1 whole roasting chicken (about 2 kg), 2 cups herb-seasoned stuffing cubes, 1 cup water, 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 box frozen chopped spinach (thawed and squeezed dry), 100g prosciutto (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp dried sage, 1 tsp dried rosemary, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, salt and black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and place a roasting rack in a large roasting pan | Rinse the chicken and pat dry | Toss the stuffing cubes with 1 cup water in a large bowl | Melt the butter in a large skillet ? add the onion, spinach, prosciutto, garlic, sage, and rosemary ? saut? until tender, about 5 minutes | Add the spinach mixture to the stuffing and stir in the heavy cream and lemon juice ? mix well | Loosely spoon the stuffing into the chicken cavity (about 3/4 full) | Fold the skin over the openings and secure with skewers ? tuck the wings under | Place on the roasting rack | Roast for about 1 hour 45 minutes until an instant-read thermometer inserted in the thigh registers 180?F (82?C) and the chicken is golden | Let rest for 10 minutes before carving

ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes (peeled and diced), 1 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 large egg, 4 oz Gruy?re cheese (shredded, divided), 1/2 cup whole milk, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 1 tbsp unsalted butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and butter a 2-quart casserole | Combine the potatoes, salt, pepper, onion, egg, and half the Gruy?re in a large bowl | Heat the milk and cream to boiling in a saucepan ? combine with the potato mixture | Transfer to the prepared casserole | Sprinkle with the remaining Gruy?re and dot with butter | Bake for 1 hour until the potatoes are tender | If the top isn't browned, broil briefly until lightly golden | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 3/4 cup vegetable shortening, 1/2 cup whole milk
instructions: Stir together the flour, baking powder, and salt in a medium bowl | Cut the shortening into the flour mixture with a pastry blender until crumbly | Add the milk, stirring with a fork until the dry ingredients are moistened and the mixture forms a soft ball | Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead 6-8 times | Use as directed in your pie or pastry recipe

ingredients: 300g rhubarb (chopped), 1/2 cup brown sugar, 2 tbsp orange juice, 1 cup self-rising flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 100g white chocolate (chopped), 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted), custard or ice cream for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 180?C (350?F) and grease 6 x 1-cup ramekins | Place the rhubarb, sugar, and orange juice in a small saucepan ? bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 5 minutes ? cool | Combine the flour, baking soda, and white chocolate in a large bowl | Add the eggs, melted butter, and cooled rhubarb mixture ? mix gently to combine | Spoon into the prepared ramekins and cover each with foil | Place on a baking tray and bake for 40 minutes | Remove from the oven and let stand for 5 minutes, then invert onto serving plates | Serve with custard or ice cream

ingredients: 4 whole trout (cleaned), 1 cup diced bread, 1/2 bell pepper (diced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1 celery stalk (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 3 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp paprika, heavy-duty foil and cooking spray
instructions: Mix the diced bread, parsley, salt, pepper, and paprika in a bowl | In a separate bowl, combine the onion, bell pepper, celery, and garlic | Combine everything together and stir in the melted butter | Fill each trout cavity with the stuffing mixture | Sprinkle the trout with additional paprika | Spray pieces of heavy-duty foil with cooking spray and wrap each fish tightly | Bury the foil packets in hot coals of a campfire or place on a hot grill for about 10 minutes until the fish flakes easily with a fork | Serve immediately

ingredients: 200g spaghetti (cooked and drained), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 1 red bell pepper (diced), 2 tbsp margarine, 1 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded), 4 large eggs, 1/2 cup whole milk, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp seasoned salt, 1/4 tsp white pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) and butter a 9 x 13-inch baking dish | Saut? the onion and both peppers in margarine over medium heat for 5 minutes without browning | In a large bowl, combine the onion-pepper mixture with the cooked spaghetti and toss ? add the mozzarella and toss | In a separate bowl, beat the eggs, milk, Parmesan, basil, oregano, seasoned salt, and pepper | Add to the spaghetti mixture and stir to combine | Pour into the prepared baking dish and cover with foil | Bake for 15-20 minutes until the eggs are set ? if not set, bake 2-3 minutes longer | Slice and serve

ingredients: 1 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp brown sugar, 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 500g pork tenderloin (cubed), 2 tbsp olive oil, 200g kielbasa (sliced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, fruit salsa for serving
instructions: Combine the chili powder, brown sugar, salt, and pepper ? toss with the pork cubes to coat | Heat the olive oil in a skillet and saut? the pork for 5 minutes over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally | Stir in the kielbasa and garlic ? saut? for an additional 5 minutes until the kielbasa begins to brown | Deglaze with the lime juice and boil until syrupy, about 1-2 minutes | Serve with fruit salsa

ingredients: 1/2 cup pecans (chopped), 1 box chocolate cake mix, 1 package instant chocolate pudding mix, 1/2 cup dark rum, 1/2 cup water, 1/2 cup vegetable oil, 4 large eggs. For glaze: 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup unsalted butter, 2 tbsp dark rum, 2 tbsp water
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) and grease and flour a Bundt pan | Sprinkle the chopped pecans in the bottom of the pan | Mix the cake mix, pudding mix, rum, water, oil, and eggs in a large bowl until well combined | Pour into the prepared pan | Bake for 50-60 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Make the glaze: combine the sugar, butter, rum, and water in a saucepan ? boil for 2-3 minutes | When the cake is done, remove from the pan and pour the hot rum glaze over it | Let cool ? can be served slightly warm or at room temperature

ingredients: 200g asparagus spears (trimmed and steamed crisp-tender), 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 4 small pita breads, 2 plum tomatoes (sliced), 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated)
instructions: Preheat oven to 450?F (230?C) | Steam the asparagus covered for 2 minutes until crisp-tender ? rinse with cold water and drain | Combine the olive oil and garlic ? brush over the pita breads | Arrange the tomato slices and asparagus on the pitas | Sprinkle with basil, red pepper flakes, and salt | Top evenly with the Parmesan cheese | Bake for 7-8 minutes until the edges are golden | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4-5 fresh pears (peeled, cored, and sliced), 1 unbaked 9-inch pie shell, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted), 2 large eggs, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1 tbsp Cointreau liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Arrange the pear slices in an attractive pattern in the pie shell | Beat the sugar, flour, melted butter, eggs, lemon juice, vanilla, ginger, and Cointreau with a mixer until smooth and well blended | Pour the mixture over the pears | Bake for 40-45 minutes until light brown and the top springs back when pressed | Cool on a wire rack before serving

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 4 cups green cabbage (shredded), 1 apple (peeled and diced), 2 tbsp honey or brown sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 slices bread (cubed and soaked in boiling water, squeezed dry), 2 tbsp potato starch, 3 large eggs (separated), 1/4 cup raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and spray a 2-quart casserole with cooking spray | Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat ? add the cabbage and cook, stirring often, over low-medium heat for about 20 minutes | Add the apple and cook for 5 minutes more | Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sweetener and the salt ? raise the heat slightly and cook for 10 minutes until soft and slightly browned ? cool | Soak the bread cubes in boiling water until soft, then squeeze dry | Mash the bread with the potato starch, then beat in the egg yolks | Stir in the cooled cabbage, the remaining sweetener, and the raisins | Beat the egg whites until stiff and fold them into the mixture | Spoon into the prepared casserole and bake for 40 minutes until set | Serve immediately

ingredients: 2 medium potatoes (cubed and cooked), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 tbsp canola oil, 3 grape tomatoes, 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 2 tbsp margarine, 2 tsp curry powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1/2 cup frozen baby peas, 1 can (400g) chickpeas (drained), 1/2 tsp salt, steamed rice for serving
instructions: Cook the cubed potatoes in salted water until tender but firm ? drain and set aside | Saut? the onion in 1 tablespoon oil until clear ? transfer to a food processor with the grape tomatoes and ginger ? blend until smooth | Melt the margarine in a large saucepan and add the curry powder and cumin ? saut? for 4-5 minutes over medium heat, stirring often | Add the tomato mixture and cook for 5-6 minutes, stirring often | Add the chickpeas, potatoes, and frozen peas ? cook for 5-10 minutes more until heated through | Serve hot over steamed rice

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 tbsp fresh sage (chopped), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 500g Brussels sprouts (halved), 3 parsnips (peeled and cut into chunks), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Melt the butter in a saucepan and stir in the sage and garlic | Place the Brussels sprouts and parsnips in an ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan | Pour the butter mixture over the vegetables and stir to coat | Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes | Remove the foil and bake about 15 minutes longer until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned | Serve hot

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts (frozen), 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 can (400g) cannellini beans (drained), 1 can (400g) white kidney beans (drained), 1/2 cup water, pasta or polenta for serving
instructions: Place the frozen chicken breasts in the crock pot and surround with all the remaining ingredients | Cover and cook on low for 8 hours | Shred the chicken and stir to combine | Serve over pasta or polenta

ingredients: For dough: 1/4 cup warm water, 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 4 1/4 cups all-purpose flour (divided), 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup milk, 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened). For filling: 1/4 cup water, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1 cup fresh or frozen cranberries, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/3 cup light brown sugar, 1 tbsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 cup walnuts (optional). For glaze: 1/2 cup confectioners sugar, 2-3 tbsp milk
instructions: Make the dough: stir together the warm water, yeast, and a pinch of sugar ? let stand until foamy, 5-10 minutes | Combine 5 cups flour, salt, and the remaining sugar in the bowl of an electric mixer with a dough hook | Whisk together the milk and eggs and add to the dry ingredients along with the yeast ? beat at low speed until combined | Beat at medium speed until a very soft dough forms, about 2 minutes | Add the butter and beat until smooth, soft, and elastic, about 4 minutes | Place in a warm greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise until doubled, 45 minutes to 1 hour | Make the filling: bring the water and 1 cup sugar to a boil ? add the cranberries and simmer until they begin to burst, about 2 minutes ? drain and cool | Roll the dough into a 16-inch square on a floured surface | Spread with softened butter and sprinkle with the brown sugar, cinnamon, and cranberries | Roll up tightly, cut into 12 slices, and arrange in buttered cake pans | Cover and let rise for 1 hour | Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and bake for 30-35 minutes until puffed and golden | Cool for 10 minutes, then drizzle with the glaze made from confectioners sugar and milk | Serve warm

ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower (cut into florets and steamed), 1 cup cherry tomatoes (halved), 1/2 red onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 carrot (sliced), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp garam masala, 1/4 cup plain fat-free yogurt, black pepper and salt to taste
instructions: Steam the cauliflower until fork-tender | Warm the olive oil in a pan and fry the onion, garlic, and carrot until soft | Add the cherry tomatoes and cook until softened | Add the cauliflower and toss to combine | Stir in the garam masala and yogurt ? season with salt and pepper | Serve hot

ingredients: 400g rotini pasta (cooked), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 medium zucchini (diced), 1/2 cup vegetable broth, 1 tsp lemon zest, 1 can (400g) cannellini beans (drained and rinsed), salt and black pepper, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 ripe tomatoes (diced), 1/4 cup fresh basil (torn), Parmesan cheese for serving
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, saut? the garlic and red pepper flakes in olive oil for 1 minute | Add the zucchini, turn the heat to high, and stir-fry for 1 minute | Add the broth and lemon zest ? reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 5 minutes | Stir in the cannellini beans and heat through, about 1 minute | Remove from heat ? season with salt and pepper and stir in the lemon juice | Add the tomatoes, cooked rotini, and basil ? toss thoroughly | Transfer to bowls and top with grated Parmesan

ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (sliced), 1 red bell pepper (sliced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 cup frozen corn kernels, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 2 scallions (sliced), 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), 8 flour tortillas, 2 cups Monterey Jack cheese (shredded), cooking spray
instructions: Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat | Add the onion, bell pepper, and garlic ? cook until softened | Stir in the corn, cumin, and oregano ? cook for about 2 minutes | Remove from heat and stir in the scallions and cilantro | Place 4 tortillas on a work surface ? sprinkle each with 1/4 cup cheese | Spoon the vegetable mixture on top | Cover with the remaining 4 tortillas, pressing down lightly | Wipe the skillet clean and spray with nonstick spray ? heat over medium-high | Cook each quesadilla until crispy on both sides | Slice into wedges and serve

ingredients: 3 cups self-rising flour, 3 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 can (355ml) beer (room temperature)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan | Mix together the flour and sugar in a large bowl | Add the beer and stir until combined ? the batter will be sticky | Pour into the prepared pan | Bake for 50-60 minutes until the top is crunchy and a toothpick comes out clean | Cool in the pan for 10 minutes before removing

ingredients: 1/4 cup olive oil, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 tsp paprika, juice and zest of 2 limes, 1/2 tsp salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a dish | Rub over meat, fish, or tofu and leave to marinate for at least 30 minutes before cooking

ingredients: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 portobello mushrooms (diced), 100g shiitake mushrooms (diced), 2 cups vegetable broth, 2 tbsp tamari or soy sauce, 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp dried sage, 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water, fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Heat the oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat ? add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes | Add all the mushrooms and cook, stirring often, until they begin to release their juices, about 10 minutes | Add the broth, tamari, thyme, and sage ? simmer for 10 minutes | Stir in the cornstarch mixture and simmer, stirring often, until slightly thickened, about 10 minutes more | Season with pepper | For a smooth gravy, pass through a fine sieve | Serve hot

ingredients: For filling: 3 dried bean curd sheets (soaked and steamed), 4 dried shiitake mushrooms (soaked, stems removed, diced), 2 tbsp mushroom soaking liquid, 200g firm tofu (mashed), 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tbsp cornstarch, pinch of MSG (optional), 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1 sheet nori seaweed (shredded). For batter: 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup glutinous rice flour, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 3/4 cup water. For assembly: flour-water paste, vegetable oil for deep frying
instructions: Soak the bean curd sheets to soften, then steam for 8 minutes with the chopped mushroom stems | Shred the seaweed and combine with the steamed mushrooms | Mash the steamed bean curd with the salt, sugar, cornstarch, pepper, and MSG | Mix the batter ingredients until smooth | Make a paste from equal parts flour and water for sealing | Cut the bean curd sheets into 10 pieces placed as diamonds | Place a teaspoon of mashed bean curd in the centre, add a bit of seaweed mixture, then top with more bean curd | Fold the bottom up, then the top, and brush with the flour paste ? fold the sides and seal | Heat oil in a wok and coat 4-5 wrapped pieces in batter ? deep-fry until golden brown, about 5 minutes | Drain and serve with vegetarian Worcestershire sauce or dipping sauce

ingredients: 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 sweet peppers (sliced), 2 medium onions (sliced), 2 tbsp fresh coriander leaves (chopped), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 4 medium potatoes (peeled and cut into large chunks), 1 1/2 cups water, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp lemon zest
instructions: Peel and chop the potatoes into large pieces | Saut? the peppers and onions in olive oil over medium heat for 10 minutes | Stir in the coriander and garlic and stir-fry for another 3 minutes | Add the potatoes, water, salt, cayenne, cumin, and lemon zest ? bring to a boil | Cover and cook over medium heat for 40 minutes until the potatoes are tender but still firm ? add more water if needed | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 2 shallots (minced), 1/2 cup vodka, 1 cup chicken stock, 1 can (400g) crushed tomatoes, 1/2 tsp coarse salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 400g penne pasta, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 1/4 cup fresh basil (torn)
instructions: Heat a large skillet over moderate heat ? add the oil, butter, garlic, and shallots | Gently saut? the shallots for 3-5 minutes | Add the vodka and reduce by half, about 2-3 minutes | Add the chicken stock and tomatoes ? bring to a bubble and reduce heat to simmer ? season with salt and pepper | While the sauce simmers, cook the pasta until al dente | Stir the cream into the sauce ? when it returns to a bubble, remove from heat | Drain the pasta and toss with the sauce and basil | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1 tbsp ground flax seeds mixed with 3 tbsp water, 3 tbsp yogurt or kefir, 100g dark chocolate (melted), 1/2 cup frozen raspberries (thawed), 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup whole wheat flour, 1 tsp baking powder
instructions: Mix the ground flax seeds and water ? let stand for 2-3 minutes, then blend with the raspberries and yogurt | Melt the chocolate in a double boiler or microwave | Cream the butter and both sugars together | Add the flax-raspberry mixture a bit at a time, beating well after each addition, then beat in the melted chocolate | Combine the flours and baking powder ? gradually add to the creamed mixture | Drop by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheets | Bake at 375?F (190?C) for 10-12 minutes until the edges begin to brown | Cool on wire racks

ingredients: 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup oatmeal, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp salt, 3/4 cup whole milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 tbsp molasses, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice added to 1/4 cup heavy cream (let sit 2 minutes), 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup dried apricots (chopped), 1/4 cup walnuts (chopped), butter for griddle, maple syrup for serving
instructions: Mix the dry ingredients together thoroughly | Add the lemon juice to the cream and let sit for 2 minutes | Beat the eggs into the milk, then combine with the cream mixture, molasses, and vanilla | Toss the apricots and walnuts with the dry mix | Preheat a lightly greased griddle to medium to medium-high | Pour the liquid mixture into the dry ingredients and stir just until combined ? do not overmix | Ladle the batter onto the griddle to form 4-inch pancakes ? flip when bubbles appear all over the surface | Cook until done in the centre, adjusting the heat as needed | Thin the batter with a little extra milk if it becomes too thick | Serve warm with maple syrup

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups warm water, 1 tbsp instant yeast, 2 tbsp honey, 1/2 cup evaporated milk, 1 tsp salt, 2 cups whole wheat flour, 1 1/2 cups white flour, 2 tbsp vegetable oil
instructions: Grease 2 empty 28-oz cans well and remove the labels | Combine the warm water, honey, oil, and evaporated milk | Stir together the flours, salt, and instant yeast ? add the dry ingredients 1 cup at a time to the liquid, beating well after each addition | Divide the dough evenly between the two greased cans | Cover each can with greased plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until the dough rises above the lip of the can | Remove the plastic wrap and bake at 350?F (175?C) for 50-60 minutes until the loaf sounds hollow when tapped | Cool in the cans for 10 minutes ? loosen the crust with a sharp knife, slide out the loaves, and cool on a rack

recipe_name: Baked Eggs with Ham and Cheese
ingredients: 8 slices deli ham, 1 cup Monterey Jack and cheddar cheese blend (shredded), 4 large eggs, 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream, 2 tbsp Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/4 tsp paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and spray two 8-oz baking dishes with cooking spray | Line each dish with half the ham pieces | Divide the cheese blend between the dishes | In a small bowl, lightly beat the eggs with the whipping cream | Pour the egg mixture over the cheese, dividing equally | Top with Parmesan and paprika | Bake for 25 minutes until the eggs are firm to the touch | Serve immediately

ingredients: 2 cups granola cereal, 1/2 cup dried cherries, 1/2 cup mini marshmallows, 1/4 cup chocolate chips (optional), 1/4 cup nuts (optional)
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well | Store in an airtight container | Enjoy as a snack

ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 200g Italian sausage (casing removed), 1/2 cup provolone cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded), 1/4 cup Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese (grated), 1/4 cup Romano cheese (grated), 1/4 cup dry white wine, 1 cup half-and-half, pasta for serving
instructions: Heat the butter and oil in a large skillet | Add the onion and cook until slightly translucent | Add the sausage and cook until browned | Add the garlic, parsley, basil, and oregano ? cook until fragrant and light brown | Remove the meat mixture with a slotted spoon and drain | Deglaze the pan with the white wine and cook until the alcohol smell is gone | Add the half-and-half and bring to a simmer | Add all the cheeses and stir until melted and the sauce is thick | Return the meat to the sauce and season to taste | Adjust the thickness with more cheese, a little flour, or extra cream | Serve over pasta

recipe_name: Asparagus Tart with Dill Polenta Crust
ingredients: For crust: 3 cups chicken or vegetable stock, 1 cup yellow cornmeal, 2 tbsp fresh dill (chopped), 1/2 tsp fresh ground pepper. For filling: 200g asparagus spears (cut into 2-inch pieces and blanched), 1 roasted red pepper (cut into strips), 3 large eggs, 1/2 cup low-fat milk, 1/4 cup onion (diced), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground pepper, 1/2 cup fontina or Swiss cheese (shredded), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated)
instructions: Make the crust: bring the stock to a boil and slowly whisk in the cornmeal | Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring frequently at first, then every few minutes ? always stir in the same direction | When the polenta pulls away from the sides of the pot, stir in the dill and pepper | Spread evenly in a pie pan | Blanch the asparagus for 3 minutes and set aside | Whisk together the eggs, milk, onion, salt, and pepper | Arrange the roasted pepper strips and asparagus in the crust and top with the cheeses | Pour the egg mixture over everything | Bake at 375?F (190?C) for 45 minutes until set | Let cool for 5 minutes before slicing

ingredients: 4-5 McIntosh apples (peeled, cored, and sliced), 1 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 tbsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1 large egg, pinch of salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Fill a pie plate 2/3 full with the apple slices | Sprinkle 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon over the apples | Mix the butter, sugar, flour, egg, and salt together in a bowl ? pour over the apples and gently spread to cover | Bake for 45 minutes until golden brown | Serve warm

ingredients: 2 red onions (cut into wedges), 2 medium zucchini (cubed), 2 bell peppers (chunked), 4 cloves garlic (smashed, divided), 1 small butternut squash (peeled and cubed), 2 tbsp olive oil, 4 ripe tomatoes (quartered), 2 sprigs fresh thyme, salt and black pepper. For topping: 3 cloves garlic, 50g cheddar cheese (cubed), 2 slices bread (torn)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Place all the vegetables (except 3 garlic cloves and the cheese) in a large deep roasting tin with the oil and thyme ? toss to coat | Roast for about 40 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften and turn golden, stirring occasionally | Pulse the reserved garlic, cheese, and bread in a food processor until they form rough breadcrumbs | Season the vegetables and sprinkle the crumbs over the top | Return to the oven for a further 15 minutes until the crumbs are golden and crispy

ingredients: 1 head broccoli (florets cut small, stems peeled and sliced), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp curry powder, 1 medium onion (diced), 4 cups chicken broth, 2 medium potatoes (diced), 2 carrots (sliced), 2 cups whole milk, 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese (shredded)
instructions: Trim the florets from the broccoli and cut into small pieces ? discard tough stem ends, peel the remaining stems, and slice thinly | Melt the butter in a 6-8 quart pot and saut? the curry powder and onion for 5 minutes | Add the broth, potatoes, broccoli stems, and carrots ? cover and simmer until the potatoes mash easily, about 30 minutes | Pur?e about half the soup in a blender until smooth ? return to the pot | Bring to a boil and add the broccoli florets and milk | Simmer uncovered until the florets are tender | Stir in the cheese a little at a time until melted | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 carrot (diced), 500g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 4 cups chicken broth, 1 bay leaf, 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water, 2 tbsp dry sherry, 1/4 cup heavy cream
instructions: Melt the butter with the oil in a medium saucepan | Saut? the onion, garlic, and carrot for 5 minutes until softened | Stir in the mushrooms and saut? for a few minutes | Add the chicken broth, bay leaf, thyme, salt, and pepper ? bring to a boil | Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes | Discard the bay leaf and stir in the cornstarch mixture | Using a hand blender, partially pur?e the soup, leaving some chunks | Just before serving, reheat until very hot ? stir in the sherry and cream and simmer for 2 minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: 500g fresh eel (cleaned and cut into slices), 3 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 tbsp fresh ginger (minced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 red chili (minced), 1 tbsp fermented bean curd (nam yuey), 1 celery stalk (sliced), 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sugar, 1/4 cup chicken stock, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1/4 tsp white pepper
instructions: Clean, rinse, and cut the eel into slices | Heat the oil in a wok and fry the eel until dry and crispy ? remove and drain, reserving 3 tablespoons of the oil | Reheat the reserved oil and stir-fry the ginger, garlic, chili, and fermented bean curd for about 2 minutes to flavour the oil | Add the eel, celery, soy sauce, and sugar ? continue to stir-fry | When the ingredients are well mixed, add the stock and boil until there is very little liquid left | Add the vinegar and mix well ? remove from heat | Sprinkle with white pepper and serve immediately

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 500g stewing beef (cubed), 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp ground cloves, 1/2 tsp ground black pepper, 1 bay leaf, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 4 cups beef stock, 1 can (400g) chickpeas (drained), 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 2 tbsp fresh coriander (chopped), black olives and coriander leaves for garnish
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan or stockpot ? add the onion and garlic and cook for 5 minutes until softened | Add the meat in batches and cook over high heat until browned on all sides | Add the cumin, cloves, pepper, and bay leaf ? cook until fragrant | Add the tomato paste and cook for about 2 minutes, stirring constantly | Add the stock, stir well, and bring to a boil | Add the chickpeas, tomatoes, and chopped coriander ? stir, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours until the meat is tender, stirring occasionally | Serve garnished with coriander leaves and black olives

ingredients: 2 cups cooked couscous (cooled), 2 cups fresh spinach (chopped), 1/4 cup red onion (diced), 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese, 3 tbsp canola oil, 1 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 tbsp white wine vinegar
instructions: Prepare the couscous according to package directions ? fluff and cool | Chop the spinach and dice the onion | Add the vegetables and feta to the cooled couscous | Whisk together the oil, sugar, salt, and vinegar to make a vinaigrette | Gradually add the dressing to the salad, tossing until evenly coated | Serve at room temperature

ingredients: 4 beef tenderloin steaks (about 150g each), 3 tbsp unsalted butter (divided), 2 shallots (minced), 1 cup red wine, 1 bay leaf, 1 sprig fresh thyme, 200g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 1 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup beef broth, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Pan-broil the steaks in 1 tablespoon butter until a little underdone ? keep warm | In the same pan, saut? the shallots | Add the wine, bay leaf, and thyme ? simmer until reduced to about 1/4 cup | Remove the bay leaf and strain the sauce through a sieve, pressing the shallots through ? reserve | Saut? the mushrooms in the remaining 2 tablespoons butter | Stir in the flour until smooth, then add the broth ? cook and stir until boiling and thickened | Add the reserved wine mixture and season with salt and pepper | Serve the sauce over the steaks

ingredients: 500g squash (peeled and cubed), 2 medium potatoes (peeled and cubed), 2 carrots (peeled and sliced), 1 leek (cleaned and sliced, some reserved for garnish), 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp salt, 1 litre water
instructions: Bring 1 litre of water to a boil in a saucepan | Add the cubed squash, potatoes, carrots, and sliced leek | Add the olive oil and salt | Cover and cook for 25 minutes on medium heat | Remove from heat and blend with a hand blender until smooth and creamy | Serve in bowls garnished with fine strips of leek

ingredients: 2 unbaked 9-inch pie shells, 250g breakfast sausage (browned and crumbled), 1 cup mozzarella cheese (shredded), 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 4 large eggs, 1 cup whole milk, biscuits and fresh fruit for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Divide the browned sausage between the two pie shells | Combine the cheeses and divide between the pie shells | Whisk together the milk and eggs ? pour half over each pie | Bake for approximately 30 minutes until the top is browned and the eggs are set | Serve warm with biscuits and fresh fruit

ingredients: 1 medium onion (diced), 2 green onions (sliced), 200g fresh mushrooms (sliced), 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 red bell pepper (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 5 cups bread cubes, 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 6 large eggs, 2 cups whole milk, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, dash of hot sauce
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet and saut? the onions and mushrooms until tender | Add the bell peppers and cook for 10 minutes until the liquid evaporates | Place 2 1/2 cups bread cubes in a greased 11 x 7-inch baking dish | Top with half the mushroom mixture and half the cheeses ? repeat the layers | Whisk together the eggs, milk, mustard, salt, pepper, and hot sauce ? pour over the strata | Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight | Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes while preheating the oven to 350?F (175?C) | Bake for 45 minutes until set | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 can refrigerated crescent rolls, 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/2 cup light sour cream, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 cup broccoli florets (chopped), 1/2 cup cauliflower florets (chopped), 1/4 cup black olives (sliced), 1/4 cup carrots (grated)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Unroll the crescent rolls and press the seams together on a cookie sheet ? bake for 8-10 minutes until light brown | Soften the cream cheese in the microwave, then mix with the sour cream and garlic powder | Spread onto the cooled crust | Chop or grate the vegetables and scatter over the top | Cut into bite-size pieces and serve
