ingredients: 4 black tea bags, 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 cup prepared lemonade, 1 cup apricot nectar, 1/2 tsp almond extract, 5 cups cold water, ice and fresh mint sprigs for serving
instructions: Place the tea bags and mint in a glass pitcher and pour in 2 cups cold water | Bring a kettle with 3 cups water to a rolling boil ? pour over the tea bags and cover the pitcher | Steep for 10-15 minutes, then remove the tea bags and mint leaves | Add the sugar and stir until dissolved | Stir in the lemonade, apricot nectar, almond extract, and 3 more cups cold water | Serve over ice garnished with a fresh mint sprig

ingredients: 2 ready-made pizza bases, 1 cup Bolognese meat sauce, 1 red bell pepper (sliced), 1/2 cup mushrooms (sliced), 2 cups mozzarella cheese (shredded)
instructions: Preheat oven to 200?C (400?F) | Place one pizza base on a tray ? spread with the meat sauce to within 1.25cm of the edge, then top with the bell pepper, mushrooms, and half the cheese | Place the second pizza base on top, pressing down slightly, and sprinkle with the remaining cheese | Bake for 20-30 minutes until the cheese is golden and the base is cooked through | Serve with a crisp tossed salad

ingredients: 6 slices bacon (cooked and diced), 1/2 green bell pepper (diced), 1/2 red bell pepper (diced), 2 Roma tomatoes (diced), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 3 green onions (sliced), 12 large eggs, 1 cup half-and-half, 2 cups diced breakfast potatoes, 1 1/2 cups shredded hash brown potatoes, 1 cup cheddar cheese (cubed), 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp mustard powder, 1/2 tsp paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish | Cook the bacon and dice once cooled | Whisk the eggs with the half-and-half ? stir in the salt, pepper, mustard powder, and paprika | Add both kinds of potatoes, the cheese cubes, and shredded cheese ? mix well | Reserve a small amount of the veggies and bacon for garnish ? add the remainder to the egg mixture | Pour into the prepared dish and top with the reserved bacon, veggies, and cheese | Bake for 50 minutes until the egg mixture is set in the centre, covering with foil halfway through | Cool slightly before serving

ingredients: 1 cup wheat berries (soaked overnight and cooked until tender), 2 Granny Smith apples (diced), 2 tbsp fresh mint (chopped), 2 green onions (sliced), 1/4 cup dried cranberries, 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp fresh orange juice, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1/2 tsp ground coriander, 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 cup crumbled feta (optional)
instructions: Cover the wheat berries with water and soak overnight | Drain and place in a large saucepan with 8 cups of fresh water ? bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer uncovered for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until tender | Drain and refrigerate until completely cooled | Combine the wheat berries with the apples, mint, shallot, and cranberries | Whisk together the oil, orange juice, vinegar, coriander, and cinnamon ? pour over the salad and stir to combine | Top with feta if using | Serve chilled or at room temperature

ingredients: 4 large pita breads (cut into triangles), 1 tsp yellow mustard seeds, 1 tsp caraway seeds, 1 tbsp sesame seeds, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 3 tbsp olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Toss the mustard seeds, caraway seeds, sesame seeds, pepper, and salt together in a small bowl | Arrange the pita triangles smooth-side down on a large baking sheet | Brush with olive oil and sprinkle with the seed mixture | Bake for about 10 minutes until crisp and golden | Cool completely | Best consumed on the day of baking

ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter (cubed), 3/4 cup buttermilk, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 ripe mangoes (peeled and diced). For topping: 1/3 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, whipped cream for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan | Combine the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, nutmeg, and salt ? cut in the butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs | Combine the buttermilk, eggs, and vanilla ? add to the flour mixture all at once and stir just until moistened | Fold in the diced mangoes | Spread in the prepared pan | Combine the sugar and cinnamon for the topping and sprinkle evenly over the batter | Bake for 40-45 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool slightly and serve with whipped cream

ingredients: 500g jumbo shrimp (butterflied), 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 2 large eggs (beaten), 3 tbsp canola oil, 3 cloves garlic (smashed), 1/4 cup dry white wine, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/4 tsp fine sea salt, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 2 tbsp cold unsalted butter, 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), lemon wedges for serving
instructions: Place the flour and beaten eggs in two separate shallow bowls | Heat the oil in a 12-inch saut? pan over medium-high heat | Dredge each shrimp in flour, shaking off the excess, then dip in the egg wash | Place the shrimp butterflied-side down in the hot oil and cook undisturbed for 3 minutes until pale golden | Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute more | Drain off all but about 1 teaspoon of the oil | Add the white wine, lemon juice, and salt ? bring to a boil and cook for 1 minute | Transfer the shrimp to heated plates | Increase heat to high, whisk in the mustard, and simmer the sauce until reduced by two-thirds, about 2 minutes | Remove from heat and swirl in the cold butter until the sauce comes together | Discard the garlic, spoon the sauce over the shrimp, and sprinkle parsley around the edges | Serve with lemon wedges

recipe_name: Hot Stuffed Banana Peppers with Turkey
ingredients: 8 banana peppers (tops cut off, halved, and seeded), 250g ground turkey, 1/2 medium onion (diced and saut?ed), 2 cloves garlic (minced and saut?ed), 1 tbsp fresh sage (chopped), 1/4 cup breadcrumbs, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 tbsp olive oil, marinara sauce for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Cut the tops off the peppers, remove the seeds, and slice them in half lengthwise ? rub each with olive oil (wear gloves when handling) | Combine the turkey, sage, breadcrumbs, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl | Saut? the onion until softened, about 4-5 minutes, then add the garlic for 1 minute ? add to the turkey mixture and mix well | Stuff each pepper half with the mixture and place in a baking dish | Cover and bake for 45 minutes | Serve with marinara sauce

ingredients: For cake: 4 large eggs, 1 cup cashews (chopped), 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple (undrained). For frosting: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1 1/2 cups confectioners sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 13 x 9-inch pan | Combine the eggs, cashews, sugar, flour, baking soda, and pineapple in a large bowl ? mix well | Pour into the prepared pan | Bake for 40-45 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean ? cool completely | Make the frosting: beat the butter and cream cheese together until smooth ? gradually beat in the confectioners sugar and vanilla | Frost the cooled cake | Keep refrigerated

ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 cup apple juice, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Season the pork chops with salt and pepper | Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat | Brown the chops on both sides | Pour the apple juice over the top and simmer gently until the juice has evaporated and the sauce becomes thick, sticky, and browned ? stir constantly at the end | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4 cups chicken broth, 1 tbsp sriracha sauce, 1 celery stalk (diced), 1 carrot (diced), 1 stalk lemongrass (chopped), 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp sugar, 200g medium shrimp (peeled), 1 cup cooked rice, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 2 tbsp fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Put the chicken broth, sriracha, celery, and carrot in a medium saucepan and bring to a simmer | Add the lemongrass, fish sauce, and sugar ? simmer for another 5 minutes | Stir in the shrimp and rice ? simmer just until the shrimp are pink and opaque, about 2-3 minutes | Remove from heat and stir in the lime juice and cilantro | Ladle into bowls and serve immediately

ingredients: 1/2 cup dried split peas (rinsed), 2 cups vegetable broth, 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 cup frozen peas, 200g orzo pasta (cooked and cooled), 2 green onions (sliced), 2 tbsp fresh mint (chopped), 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp lemon zest, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, butter lettuce leaves for serving, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Sort through the split peas and rinse | Bring the broth to a boil, add the split peas and thyme ? reduce heat, cover, and simmer until tender, about 25 minutes ? drain | Transfer to a large bowl and gently mix in the frozen peas ? let cool | Cook the orzo until just tender, drain, rinse with cold water, and drain well | Add the orzo to the peas along with the onions and mint ? mix gently | Whisk together the oil, lemon zest, and lemon juice ? pour over the salad and mix gently | Serve on lettuce-lined plates garnished with mint and thyme sprigs

recipe_name: Cauliflower and Sweet Potato Curry Soup
ingredients: 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 tbsp curry powder, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1 small head cauliflower (cut into florets), 2 medium sweet potatoes (peeled and cubed), 4 cups vegetable stock, 1 tbsp honey, low-fat sour cream and fresh cilantro for garnish
instructions: Spray a large saucepan with cooking spray and heat the oil | Saut? the garlic and onion until softened, about 5 minutes | Add the curry powder, cinnamon, salt, pepper, cauliflower, stock, sweet potatoes, and honey ? bring to a boil | Cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 25 minutes until the potatoes are tender | Transfer to a blender or food processor and pur?e until creamy and smooth | Return to the saucepan and thin with more stock if desired | Ladle into bowls and garnish with a dollop of sour cream and cilantro

ingredients: 4 slices bacon (fried crisp and crumbled), 3 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp Tabasco sauce, 2 avocados (diced), 2 ripe tomatoes (diced), 1 shallot (minced), salad greens for serving
instructions: Fry the bacon until crisp ? drain and set aside | Whisk together the oil, vinegar, salt, pepper, and Tabasco in a medium bowl | Add the avocados, tomatoes, shallots, and crumbled bacon ? toss gently | Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours | To serve, place salad greens on plates and use a slotted spoon to add the salad on top

ingredients: 4 thick slices bread (toasted on both sides), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese (grated), 1/4 cup ale or beer, 1 tsp English mustard, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Toast the bread on both sides and set aside | Melt the butter in a heavy saucepan over low heat | Add the cheese and ale, stirring constantly | Add the mustard, salt, and pepper | Spread the mixture on the toast and place under the broiler until browned and bubbling | Serve immediately

ingredients: 6 chicken sausages, 1 carrot (diced and boiled), 1 potato (diced and boiled), 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp mango chutney, 1 tbsp curry powder, 1/2 cup mango nectar, 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp nectar, 1 ripe mango (sliced), salt to taste, steamed rice for serving
instructions: Cook the sausages in a large frying pan over medium heat ? remove and set aside | Boil the carrot and potato until just soft ? drain and set aside | Wipe out the pan and saut? the onion and garlic in oil until the onion is translucent | Stir in the nectar, curry powder, and chutney | Mix the cornstarch with the 2 tablespoons of nectar until smooth ? stir into the curry mixture and bring to a boil, stirring, until thickened | Lower the temperature to a simmer | Slice the sausages and add to the curry along with the potato and carrot ? stir to combine and add salt to taste | Heat through, then stir in the sliced mango just before serving | Serve with rice

ingredients: 2 cups fresh or frozen cranberries (coarsely chopped), 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 cup eggnog, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted), 2 large eggs, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract. For streusel: 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp cold unsalted butter, 1/4 cup pecans (chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) and grease a muffin tin | Mix the cranberries with 2 tablespoons sugar and set aside | Combine the dry ingredients in a bowl | In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggnog, melted butter, eggs, and vanilla ? add to the dry ingredients without overmixing | Fold in the sugared cranberries and drop into the prepared muffin cups | Make the streusel: combine the flour and sugar, cut in the butter until crumbly, then mix in the pecans | Sprinkle over the tops of the muffins | Bake for 15-20 minutes just until the tops are set ? do not overbake

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1 cup all-purpose flour, 2 large eggs, 2 tbsp lemon zest, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 tsp sea salt. For glaze: 1/2 cup icing sugar, 1 tbsp lemon zest, 2-3 tbsp fresh lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease an 8 x 8-inch baking dish | Beat the flour, sugar, salt, and softened butter until combined | In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, lemon zest, and lemon juice ? pour into the flour mixture and beat for 2 minutes until smooth and creamy | Pour into the prepared dish and bake for 23-25 minutes until the edges turn golden | Cool completely before glazing | Make the glaze: whisk together the icing sugar, lemon zest, and juice until smooth ? spread over the cooled brownies | Let the glaze set, then cut into bars

ingredients: 60ml white rum, 15ml maraschino liqueur, 45ml fresh lime juice, 45ml fresh grapefruit juice, crushed ice
instructions: Squeeze the lime juice into a cocktail shaker | Add the rum, maraschino liqueur, grapefruit juice, and crushed ice | Shake briefly and strain into a frosted cocktail glass | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 large eggplant (cubed), 1 medium onion (sliced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/4 cup dry white wine, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 2 tbsp tapenade, 1 tsp dried basil, 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, salt and black pepper, 3 tbsp olive oil, 200g angel hair pasta, Parmesan or crumbled feta for serving
instructions: Slice the eggplant into 1-inch slices, salt, and set aside to drain | Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil for the pasta | Pat the eggplant dry and cook in olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it starts to brown | Add the sliced onion and cook for 1 minute | Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds | Pour in the wine and reduce by half | Add the tapenade, tomatoes, basil, and red pepper ? season with salt and pepper | Cook the angel hair pasta while the sauce simmers | Serve the sauce over the pasta topped with Parmesan or crumbled feta

ingredients: For crust: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter (cubed), 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 3-4 tbsp cold water. For filling: 2 apples (sliced), 1 pear (sliced), 2 nectarines (sliced), 2 plums (sliced), 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground ginger, 3 tbsp granulated sugar, 2 tbsp dry breadcrumbs. For topping: 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup hazelnuts (chopped), 1/4 cup cold unsalted butter (cubed)
instructions: Preheat oven to 200?C (400?F) | Make the crust: cut the flour and butter together until crumbly, add the sugar and water, and quickly mix into a dough ? wrap in cling film and refrigerate for 30 minutes | Roll out the dough and line a 24cm pie dish | Make the topping: cut together all the topping ingredients until crumbly | Prepare the filling: toss the sliced fruit with lemon juice, then mix with the cinnamon, ginger, and sugar | Sprinkle some of the breadcrumbs over the dough and layer the fruit and spice mixture in the dish | Sprinkle the topping evenly over the fruit | Bake for 30 minutes until the fruit is tender and the topping is golden | Serve warm with whipped cream or vanilla sauce

ingredients: 500g beef (with bone), 4 cups nonfat beef broth, 2 cups water, 2 celery stalks (diced), 1 carrot (diced), 1 leek (sliced), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 4 whole black peppercorns, 2 cups fresh spinach (cut into 1/2-inch ribbons), 2 medium potatoes (cubed), 1 cup sorrel (chopped), 1 tsp sugar, salt to taste, sour cream for serving
instructions: Place the meat in a deep soup pot with the broth and water | Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer, skimming off the foam until the liquid is clear, about 20 minutes | Add the celery, carrot, leek, parsley, and peppercorns ? cover and simmer for 90 minutes | Add the spinach, potatoes, sorrel, and sugar ? cover and simmer until the potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes | Season to taste with salt | To serve, ladle the hot soup into bowls and top with a dollop of sour cream

ingredients: 2 cups cooked chicken (diced), 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium yellow onion (diced), 2 tbsp curry powder, 1/2 cup plain yogurt, 1/4 cup heavy cream, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 cup fresh cilantro (chopped), steamed basmati rice for serving
instructions: Heat the oil in a pan and cook the onion over medium-low heat for 7 minutes | Sprinkle with the curry powder, stir, and cook for 1 minute | Add the yogurt and cream ? cook for 3 minutes | Stir in the chicken, tomatoes, salt, and cilantro ? cook until heated through | Serve over hot basmati rice

ingredients: 1/2 cup brown sugar, 2 tbsp molasses, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 2 large eggs, 1 1/2 cups rolled oats, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup chocolate chips, 1/2 cup nuts (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 15 x 10 or 13 x 9-inch pan | Beat the brown sugar and shortening until light and fluffy | Add the molasses, vanilla, and eggs ? blend well | Stir in the oats, flour, baking soda, and salt ? blend well | Stir in the nuts and chocolate chips | Spread in the prepared pan | Bake for 20-25 minutes until light golden brown and the centre is set | Cool slightly and cut into bars

ingredients: 4 cups romaine lettuce (chopped), 2 cooked chicken breasts (sliced), 1/2 cup crumbled Gorgonzola cheese, 1/4 cup dried cranberries, 1/4 cup walnuts (chopped), 1/4 cup raspberry vinaigrette
instructions: Chop the lettuce and place in a large bowl | Add the Gorgonzola, cranberries, walnuts, and raspberry vinaigrette ? toss until coated | Chill for about 20 minutes before serving

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef, 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1/4 cup blue cheese (crumbled), 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/2 cup Bisquick baking mix, 1/2 cup milk, 2 large eggs, 1/4 cup French-fried onions
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) and spray 12 muffin cups with cooking spray | Cook the beef and onion over medium-high heat for 5-7 minutes until browned ? drain and cool for 5 minutes, then stir in the blue cheese and Worcestershire | Stir together the baking mix, milk, and eggs until blended | Spoon 1 scant tablespoon of batter into each muffin cup, top with about 1/4 cup burger mixture, then cover with 1 tablespoon batter | Bake for 25-30 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | After 10 minutes of baking, sprinkle French-fried onions on top of each muffin ? close the oven and finish baking | Cool for 5 minutes before removing from the pan

ingredients: 1 cup brown rice, 2 cups water, 1/4 tsp salt, 3/4 cup milk, 2 tbsp dry milk powder, 2 tbsp honey, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground allspice, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1 tbsp orange zest, 1/4 cup raisins, orange slices for garnish
instructions: Combine the rice, water, and salt in a saucepan ? bring to a boil, stir, cover, and reduce to a simmer | Simmer for 35-40 minutes until the rice is cooked | Add enough milk to cover the rice | Stir in the dry milk powder, honey, cinnamon, allspice, nutmeg, orange zest, and raisins | Cook over medium heat until heated through | Serve garnished with orange slices

ingredients: 500g large prawns (shelled and deveined, shells reserved), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 4 cups hot water, 1 tsp salt, 2 stalks lemongrass (bruised), 1 tsp lemon zest, 2 kaffir lime leaves, 2 whole red chilies, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 3 tbsp fresh lemon juice, fresh coriander leaves and spring onions for garnish
instructions: Shell and devein the prawns, reserving the heads and shells ? wash well and drain | Heat the oil in a saucepan and fry the prawn heads and shells until they turn pink | Add the hot water, salt, lemongrass, lemon zest, lime leaves, and whole chilies ? bring to a boil, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes | Add the fish sauce and lemon juice to taste ? the soup should have a pronounced sour flavour | Serve in a large tureen or individual bowls, sprinkled with sliced chili, coriander leaves, and spring onions

ingredients: 8 cups crusty bread cubes, 6 tbsp olive oil (divided), 1 cup Parmesan cheese (grated, divided), 1/4 cup unsalted butter, 2 red onions (diced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 2 red bell peppers (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp fresh rosemary (chopped), 1 tsp dried oregano, 1/4 cup pine nuts, 3/4 cup fresh basil (chopped, divided), 2 large eggs (beaten), 1-2 cups low-sodium chicken broth, salt and black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) and spray 2 baking sheets with nonstick spray | Toss half the bread cubes with 3 tablespoons oil and 1/2 cup Parmesan and spread on one sheet ? repeat with the remaining bread | Bake until golden, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes ? cool and transfer to a large bowl | Melt the butter with the remaining 2 tablespoons oil in a large pot ? saut? the onions, celery, and bell peppers until beginning to brown, about 15 minutes | Add the garlic, rosemary, and oregano ? stir for 1 minute | Add the pine nuts and stir for 2 minutes ? transfer to the bowl with the bread | Stir in 1/2 cup basil and the remaining 1/2 cup Parmesan ? season generously with salt and pepper ? mix in the beaten eggs | Add enough broth to moisten as desired | Transfer to a buttered baking dish, cover with buttered foil, and bake at 350?F (175?C) for 40 minutes ? uncover and bake for 20 minutes more until the top is crisp and golden | Sprinkle with the remaining basil and serve

ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 tbsp gram flour, 2 tbsp plain yogurt, 1/2 cup water (approximately), pinch of baking soda, ghee or oil for deep frying. For syrup: 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup water, few saffron threads
instructions: Make the batter: combine the flour, gram flour, yogurt, and water in a mixing bowl ? whisk until smooth with no lumps, achieving a ribbon consistency (when dropped from a spoon, the batter should fall like a ribbon) ? mix for 5-7 minutes | Add a pinch of baking soda | Pour the batter into a squeeze bottle or piping bag fitted with a small round tip | Make the syrup: heat the sugar and water until dissolved, add saffron, and keep warm | Heat the ghee or oil in a frying pan over low-medium heat | Squeeze the batter into the hot oil in concentric circles to form the jalebis | Fry until lightly golden on both sides | Drain excess oil and immediately drop into the warm syrup ? toss to coat well, then drain excess syrup | Serve hot or warm

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 carrots (diced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 200g white mushrooms (sliced), 1 can (400g) crushed tomatoes, 3/4 cup dried lentils, 1/2 cup pearl barley, 6 cups water, 2 vegetable bouillon cubes, 2 cups fresh spinach, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat ? saut? the garlic, Italian seasoning, carrots, celery, onion, and mushrooms for a few minutes until they start to soften | Add the water, bouillon, lentils, tomatoes, spinach, and barley | Increase heat to high until the water boils | Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 1-2 hours until the lentils are cooked through | Pur?e the soup in batches or use a hand blender for a smoother consistency | Serve hot

recipe_name: Grilled Steak with Rosemary Mustard Butter
ingredients: 2 sirloin or ribeye steaks (about 200g each), 4 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 1 tbsp fresh rosemary (chopped), 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, jacket potatoes and salad for serving
instructions: Make the compound butter: beat the softened butter until light and fluffy | Mix in the rosemary, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, and black pepper | Spoon the butter onto a piece of parchment paper and roll into a log shape ? twist the ends to seal | Refrigerate for at least 1 hour until firm (keeps for several days or can be frozen) | Grill the steaks to your liking and let rest for 2-3 minutes | Slice the butter into thick rounds and place one on top of each grilled steak | Serve with jacket potatoes and a fresh garden salad

ingredients: 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 1/2 cup warm milk, 2 tbsp vegetable shortening, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, vegetable oil for deep frying
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in the warm milk and let stand for 10 minutes until foamy | Stir in the shortening | Gradually add the flour, sugar, and salt ? mix until smooth | Cover with a damp cloth or plastic wrap and let rise until doubled, about 2 hours | Roll the dough out on a floured board into a rectangle 1/4-inch thick | Heat the oil in a deep fryer or large skillet to 375?F (190?C) | Cut the dough with a biscuit cutter and drop a few at a time into the hot oil | Fry until puffed and golden on both sides | Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels | Can be reheated in a 200?F oven for 5-10 minutes

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 2 cups water, zest of 2 lemons, 2 tbsp fresh thyme leaves, 3/4 cup fresh lemon juice (about 4-6 lemons), 1 large egg white (beaten, optional)
instructions: Bring the sugar, water, and lemon zest to a boil in a heavy saucepan ? boil briskly for 5 minutes without stirring until the sugar dissolves | Reduce heat to a simmer, stir well, and simmer for 5 minutes longer | Remove from heat, add the thyme leaves, cover, and steep for 1 hour | Strain through a fine-mesh sieve, discarding the zest and thyme ? stir in the lemon juice | Cover and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled | Transfer to an ice cream maker and freeze according to the manufacturer's instructions | For a lighter texture, add the beaten egg white after the first hour of freezing | Scoop into glasses and serve immediately

ingredients: For base: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (cold, cubed), 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 cup caster sugar, 2 large egg yolks, 2-3 tbsp milk, apricot or raspberry jam for spreading. For meringue: 2 large egg whites, 2 tbsp caster sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) and grease a shallow baking dish | Sift the flour and baking powder together and rub in the cold butter until crumbly | Add the cinnamon and sugar, then the egg yolks and enough milk to bind to a fairly stiff batter | Turn into the prepared dish and bake for about 20 minutes | Cool and spread with jam | Make the meringue: beat the egg whites until stiff, fold in the sugar, and beat again until shiny | Pile on top of the base and return to a cooler oven (325?F / 160?C) to set until the peaks are tipped with gold | Serve warm or at room temperature

ingredients: 4 catfish fillets (about 150g each), 2 large eggs, 2 tbsp milk, 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp dried parsley, cooking spray, lemon wedges for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) | Whisk together the eggs and milk in a bowl | Combine the cornmeal, Parmesan, flour, salt, basil, and parsley on a piece of wax paper | Spray a glass baking dish with cooking spray | Rinse the catfish and pat very dry with paper towels | Dip each fillet in the egg mixture, then dredge lightly in the breading | Place in the prepared dish and refrigerate for 10 minutes | Bake for 10-12 minutes per side until golden and the fish flakes easily | Serve with lemon wedges

ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 500g Italian sausage (casing removed), 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 2 cans (400g each) black beans (drained and rinsed), 2 cups chicken broth, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, sour cream and shredded mozzarella for serving
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat | Add the garlic and cook until fragrant | Add the sausage and brown, breaking it apart | Stir in the tomatoes, beans, and broth | Add the cumin, paprika, chili powder, and oregano ? bring to a boil, stirring occasionally | Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 30 minutes | Stir in sour cream and shredded cheese before serving

ingredients: 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 2 tbsp mayonnaise or salad dressing, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple (drained), 1/2 cup walnuts (chopped), 1 banana (sliced), 1 cup heavy cream (whipped), 1 can (400g) jellied cranberry sauce (cut into chunks)
instructions: Beat the cream cheese, salad dressing, lemon juice, and salt until smooth | Stir in the pineapple, walnuts, and banana | Whip the cream and fold into the mixture | Lightly fold in the cranberry chunks | Line a 9 x 5-inch pan with wax paper, including the sides | Turn the mixture into the pan and freeze until firm | Slice and serve frozen

ingredients: 200g cooked ham (cut into cubes), 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1/4 tsp onion powder, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, pinch of ground cloves, 1 tbsp prepared yellow mustard, 2 tbsp ketchup, 2 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tbsp sweet pickle relish, crackers or bread for serving
instructions: Place the ham cubes in a food processor and pulse until finely chopped or pur?ed ? transfer to a bowl | Process the cream cheese, onion powder, garlic powder, cloves, mustard, and ketchup until well mixed | Add the ham back to the processor and mix until well combined | Transfer to a bowl and stir in the mayonnaise and sweet relish | Taste and adjust the seasoning | Chill for at least 1 hour for the flavours to blend | Serve with crackers or bread

ingredients: 4 crispy tostada shells, 1 cup refried beans, 1 cup lettuce (shredded), 1/2 cup diced tomato, 1/2 cup crumbled queso fresco, salsa for serving
instructions: Warm the tostada shells according to package directions | Spread the refried beans on each shell | Top with shredded lettuce, diced tomato, and crumbled queso fresco | Serve warm with salsa on the side

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 large egg (beaten), 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup self-rising flour, 24 macadamia nuts (for topping)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat until golden brown ? cool but do not let it set | Beat in the sugar, then the beaten egg and vanilla | Work in the flour until a dough forms | Roll the dough into walnut-sized balls and place on a baking tray, allowing plenty of room to spread | Press a macadamia nut on top of each biscuit | Bake for 10-15 minutes until golden | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: 200g extra sharp cheddar cheese (grated), 2 roasted red peppers (drained and finely chopped), 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp prepared horseradish, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, crackers or bread for serving
instructions: Rinse, drain, pat dry, and finely chop the roasted red peppers | Stir all ingredients together in a bowl until well combined | Serve immediately or refrigerate until needed | Serve with crackers or bread

ingredients: 4 cups frozen diced potatoes (thawed), 2 cups cooked ham (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 1 can (400g) cream of celery soup, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1 cup shredded cheese, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Combine the two soups (undiluted) with the sour cream in a large mixing bowl ? mix well | Stir in the ham, onion, and potatoes until combined | Transfer to a greased casserole dish | Bake for 25 minutes | Sprinkle the cheese over the top and bake 5 more minutes until melted | Let cool for 5 minutes before serving

ingredients: 3 cups fresh strawberries (hulled and pur?ed), 2 large eggs, 1 1/4 cups granulated sugar, 2 cups half-and-half, 1/4 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Wash, hull, and pur?e the strawberries | In a large bowl, beat the eggs until thick and lemon-coloured | Beat in the sugar, half-and-half, vanilla, and heavy cream | Stir in the strawberry pur?e | Chill the mixture in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour | Freeze in an ice cream maker according to the manufacturer's directions (about 30 minutes) | Transfer to a freezer-safe container and freeze until firm

ingredients: 1 cup prepared mincemeat, 1 cup water, 1 package (85g) cherry gelatin, 3 cups water (for gelatin), 1/2 cup English walnuts (chopped)
instructions: Break the mincemeat into small pieces and cover with 1 cup of water in a saucepan | Bring to a boil and boil for 1 minute ? cool | Prepare the gelatin using 3 cups water according to package directions | When the gelatin is slightly thickened, stir in the mincemeat mixture and the chopped walnuts | Pour into a mould or serving dish | Refrigerate until set

ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup confectioners sugar, 1/2 cup vegetable oil, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 3 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp cream of tartar
instructions: Cream together the butter, oil, and both sugars | Add the eggs and vanilla ? beat well | Whisk together the flour, baking soda, salt, and cream of tartar | Add the dry ingredients to the wet and mix just until combined | Form into a disc, wrap tightly in plastic, and refrigerate overnight | Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Roll the dough out to about 1/4-inch thickness on a lightly floured surface | Cut into desired shapes and place on ungreased baking sheets | Bake for 10-12 minutes until the edges are lightly golden | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: 200g sausage meat (cooked and crumbled), 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese (shredded), 1/4 cup black olives (sliced), 3 tbsp ranch salad dressing, 1/4 cup red bell pepper (diced), 12 wonton wrappers, cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and lightly oil a mini muffin tin | Combine the cooked sausage with the cheeses, ranch dressing, olives, and red pepper | Press a wonton wrapper into each muffin cup, leaving the corners sticking up | Brush the wrappers lightly with oil and bake for 5 minutes until golden | Remove the wrappers from the tin and place on a baking sheet | Fill each with the sausage-cheese mixture | Bake for 5 minutes until the cheese is bubbly and brown | Serve hot

ingredients: 200g dark chocolate (chopped), 1/2 cup heavy cream, 2 tbsp sugar substitute, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 tbsp raisins, 1 tsp orange zest, unsweetened cocoa powder for dredging
instructions: Place the chocolate in a large bowl | Bring the cream, sugar substitute, butter, raisins, and orange zest to a boil in a medium pan | Slowly pour over the chocolate and stir until smooth | Refrigerate for 2-3 hours until firm | Shape the mixture into small balls | Dredge each truffle in cocoa powder | Store in the refrigerator

ingredients: 500g lean ground beef (browned), 2 ripe tomatoes (diced), 1 sweet onion (diced), 1/2 green bell pepper (diced), 1/2 yellow bell pepper (diced), 4 cups lettuce (shredded), 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese (grated), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 can (400g) tomato soup, 1/2 cup half-and-half cream, salt and black pepper, toasted bread slices for serving
instructions: Brown the ground beef and place in a serving bowl | Dice the tomatoes, onion, peppers, and lettuce ? place in separate serving bowls ? grate the cheese into another bowl | Heat the tomato soup with the half-and-half, minced garlic, salt, and pepper ? simmer on low for 20 minutes, stirring often | Toast two slices of bread per person | To serve: place the toast on each plate, let each person add toppings with cheese last, and ladle the hot sauce over the top | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4 oz dried red chilies (soaked in warm water for 45 minutes, drained, stems and seeds removed), 4 cloves garlic, 2 tbsp water, 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil (plus extra for storage), 1/2 tsp caraway seeds, 1/2 tsp ground coriander, 1/2 tsp salt
instructions: Soak the dried chilies in warm water for 45 minutes to 1 hour until softened ? drain, remove stems and seeds | Place the chilies in a blender with the garlic, water, and olive oil ? process until smooth, scraping down the sides occasionally | Transfer to a bowl and stir in the caraway, coriander, and salt | Store in a jar and top off with a layer of olive oil to cover the surface ? always top off with oil after each use to prevent spoiling | Makes about 1 cup

ingredients: 400g fettuccine pasta, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened, divided), 1 cup heavy cream, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 cup Parmesan cheese (grated)
instructions: Cook the fettuccine according to package directions until al dente | In a large warmed serving bowl, place half the softened butter with the cream, parsley, basil, and salt ? mix well | Drain the pasta and quickly add to the cream mixture | Add the remaining butter and the Parmesan cheese ? stir lightly until the noodles are well coated | Serve immediately

ingredients: 2 round sesame seed pita breads (halved), 4 oz cream cheese (softened), 2 tbsp unsalted butter (softened), 2 tbsp apricot jam, 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Cut the pita breads in half | Spread cream cheese inside each half | Top each with a little butter, apricot jam, and a small dash of cinnamon | Place on a baking sheet and bake until crispy, about 10-12 minutes | Serve warm

ingredients: 2 cups cooked chicken (diced), 1 cup cooked white rice, 1 cup green beans (diced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 cup water chestnuts (sliced), 1/4 cup pimientos (diced), 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/4 tsp ground cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1/2 tsp salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Melt the butter in a heavy skillet and saut? the onion and garlic until soft, about 15-20 minutes | In a large bowl, combine all the remaining ingredients with the saut?ed onion and garlic | Pour into a greased 3-quart casserole dish | Bake for 20-25 minutes until bubbly | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 cups cooked ham (diced), 1 cup sauerkraut (drained and chopped), 1 cup Swiss cheese (cubed), 1 tbsp granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp caraway seeds, 1/2 tsp dried dill weed, 1/3 cup mayonnaise, 1 tbsp prepared mustard, bread or crackers for serving
instructions: Thoroughly mix all ingredients together in a mixing bowl | Chill for at least 30 minutes or serve right away | Serve on bread or with crackers

ingredients: For crust: 2 cups graham cracker crumbs, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2/3 cup unsalted butter (melted). For filling: 16 oz cream cheese (softened), 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix, 2 cups whipped topping, 1 cup heavy whipping cream (whipped), fresh fruit or pie filling for topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease two 9 x 13-inch pans | Mix the graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and melted butter ? divide between the pans and press into an even layer ? bake for 10-15 minutes ? cool | Beat the cream cheese, sugar, and instant pudding powder until very fluffy | Whip the whipped topping until soft peaks form ? set aside | Whip the whipping cream to stiff peaks in another bowl | Fold all three mixtures together until well combined | Pour onto the cooled crusts and chill until set | Top with fresh fruit or pie filling before serving | Freezes well without toppings

ingredients: 1.5 kg beef brisket, 3 cups red wine (divided), 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 3 tsp garlic (minced, divided), 1 tsp white pepper, 1 tsp paprika, 1 bay leaf, 3 tbsp vegetable oil (divided), 2 medium onions (diced), 2 carrots (diced), 1 packet onion soup mix, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 tsp salt, 1 cup beer, 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 1/2 cup ketchup, 1 cup beef broth
instructions: Place the brisket in a sealed plastic bag with 2 cups of wine, Worcestershire sauce, 1 tsp garlic, white pepper, paprika, and the bay leaf ? marinate overnight | Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large Dutch oven and saut? the onions and carrots until softened ? remove and set aside | Drain the marinade and reserve ? pat the onion soup mix, flour, and salt onto the meat | Heat the remaining oil and brown the meat on all sides | Add the remaining wine, beer, mushroom soup, ketchup, broth, remaining garlic, reserved marinade, and cooked vegetables ? the meat should be covered by the liquid | Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 1 hour | Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) | Place the covered pot in the oven for 3-4 hours until very tender | Cool slightly, remove the meat, and slice ? return to the gravy and refrigerate overnight | Skim the fat and reheat in the oven at 325?F until piping hot | Serve with mashed potatoes or noodle pudding

recipe_name: Plum Tomatoes and Artichokes with Penne
ingredients: 1 can (400g) artichoke hearts (drained, oil reserved), 3 tbsp artichoke oil marinade, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 6 plum tomatoes (diced), 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1/2 tsp dried basil, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, black pepper, 2 tbsp fresh flat-leaf parsley (chopped), 400g penne pasta (cooked)
instructions: Drain the artichokes, reserving the oil, and halve them lengthwise | Heat 3 tablespoons of the artichoke oil in a heavy pot ? add the onion and stir over low heat for 10 minutes, adding the garlic during the last 2 minutes | Stir in the tomatoes, tomato paste, basil, oregano, and red pepper flakes ? season with pepper | Simmer uncovered for 45 minutes | Add the artichoke hearts and simmer for 20 minutes more | Stir in the parsley and adjust the seasoning | Serve in shallow bowls over cooked penne

ingredients: 3 apples (peeled and sliced), 2 cups fresh blackberries, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 tsp all-purpose flour. For topping: 1 cup granulated sugar, 3/4 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter (cubed)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) and spray an 11 x 17-inch baking dish | Combine the blackberries, apples, 1/2 cup sugar, and 2 teaspoons flour in a large bowl ? toss to coat | Pour into the prepared dish | Combine the 1 cup sugar and 3/4 cup flour ? cut in the cold butter until the mixture is crumbly | Sprinkle the crumbs over the fruit | Bake for 35 minutes until golden and the apples are tender | Serve warm

ingredients: 30ml cherry brandy, 30ml advocaat liqueur, 30ml heavy cream, 120ml lemonade, ice cubes
instructions: Pour the cherry brandy, advocaat, and cream into a highball glass filled with ice | Top with lemonade and stir gently | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts (cooked and shredded), 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes with green chilies, 1 can (200g) diced green chilies, 1 can (400g) enchilada sauce (divided), 1 can (400g) black beans (rinsed), 1 cup shredded cheese (divided), 8 corn tortillas, 1/4 cup black olives (sliced), 2 green onions (sliced), sour cream for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Cook and shred the chicken ? place in a skillet with the tomatoes, green chilies, and half the enchilada sauce ? cover and simmer for 30 minutes to 1 hour | Mix the rinsed beans and a handful of cheese into the meat mixture | Pour a little enchilada sauce into the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish | Layer tortillas, meat mixture, more sauce ? repeat, ending with tortillas, sauce, and a good layer of cheese | Top with sliced olives and green onions | Bake for about 30 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly | Cool for 5 minutes and serve with sour cream

ingredients: 500g kielbasa (sliced), 1 medium yellow onion (diced), 1/2 cup cocktail sauce, 2 cans (400g each) baked beans, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat the sliced kielbasa in a skillet over medium-high heat until golden brown on both sides | Add the onion and cook for 3 minutes | Stir in the cocktail sauce, beans, salt, and pepper | Cover and simmer on medium-low heat for 20-30 minutes | Serve hot

ingredients: For pastry: 3 large eggs (separated), 1/4 tsp cream of tartar, 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 cup ricotta cheese, 2 tbsp sugar substitute. For filling: 2 oz cream cheese (softened), 1 tbsp sugar substitute, 1/4 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 large egg yolk
instructions: Preheat oven to 300?F (150?C) | Separate the eggs, saving 1/2 yolk for the filling | Whip the egg whites with cream of tartar until very stiff | In a separate bowl, mix the yolks, cinnamon, ricotta, and sugar substitute until smooth | Fold the yolk mixture into the beaten whites until well combined | Portion into 6 mounds on a buttered or oiled baking sheet ? make an indentation in the top of each | Make the filling: soften the cream cheese and stir in the remaining ingredients until smooth | Spoon the filling into the indentations | Bake for 30-40 minutes until golden | Cool and store covered in the refrigerator

ingredients: 1 cup instant white rice, 1 cup warm water, 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, 1 can (400g) artichoke hearts (drained), 2 Roma tomatoes (diced), 3 tbsp Italian dressing, 2 tbsp pesto sauce, heavy-duty aluminum foil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) | Mix the rice and water ? spoon onto the centres of 6 large sheets of heavy-duty foil | Top with the chicken, artichokes, and tomatoes ? drizzle with the combined dressing and pesto | Bring up the foil sides and double-fold the top and ends to seal, leaving room for heat circulation | Place the packets in a 15 x 10-inch pan | Bake for 30-35 minutes until the chicken reaches 165?F (74?C) | Let stand for 5 minutes, then cut slits in the foil to release steam before opening | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter, 1/2 cup honey, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tsp ground cardamom, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1 tsp lemon zest, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 4 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: In a saucepan over low heat, melt together the sugar, butter, and honey ? let cool | Mix together the eggs, vanilla, baking soda, and spices ? gradually add to the cooled honey mixture | Slowly add the flour until well blended | Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheets about 2 inches apart | Bake at 350?F (180?C) for 12-15 minutes until golden | Cool on wire racks

ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 1/2 cup sour cream, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 2 green onions with tops (sliced), 1 tbsp tarragon vinegar, 1 tbsp white wine vinegar, 1/4 tsp garlic salt, 1/4 tsp ground pepper, milk for thinning if needed
instructions: Stir together all ingredients in a medium bowl until well combined | Cover and chill if not using immediately | Thin with a little milk if the dressing is too thick | Serve over salad greens

ingredients: 2 cups walnuts (toasted and chopped), 1/4 cup honey, 1/4 cup dried pears (chopped), 1/2 tsp herbes de Provence, 1/2 tsp ground coriander, 1 tsp orange zest, 1 tbsp fresh orange juice, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/4 tsp coarse salt, sliced baguette and goat cheese for serving
instructions: Preheat the broiler | Coarsely chop 1 cup of the walnuts and finely chop the remaining cup | Combine all nuts with the honey, pears, herbes de Provence, coriander, orange zest, juices, and salt ? beat vigorously until combined | Place the baguette slices on a baking sheet and top each with a piece of goat cheese | Broil just until the cheese is melted, watching closely | Top each slice with a spoonful of the honey walnut spread and serve immediately

ingredients: 400g cavatappi pasta, 1 cup heavy whipping cream, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 medium onion (diced), 100g mushrooms (sliced), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 100g capicolla ham (diced), 2 tbsp fresh basil (torn), salt and black pepper, 1/2 cup fresh pea pods, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated)
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions | Meanwhile, in a large pot, heat the cream and add the garlic, onion, and mushrooms ? cook for 3 minutes, stirring constantly | Stir in the butter, ham, and basil ? continue stirring until the butter melts | Add the hot drained pasta and season with salt and pepper | Mix in the pea pods | Stir in the Parmesan cheese until well combined | Serve immediately when the sauce reaches a medium-thin consistency

ingredients: 2 cups fresh pineapple chunks, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 8 fresh mint leaves, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 cup club soda, sugar for rimming glasses, ice cubes, mint sprigs for garnish
instructions: Place the pineapple, lime juice, mint, and sugar in a blender ? blend on high for 30 seconds to 1 minute until frothy | Pour into a tall pitcher and add the club soda ? stir once or twice to combine | Rim the glasses with sugar and fill with ice | Pour the agua fresca into the glasses and garnish each with a mint sprig | Serve immediately

ingredients: 3 large egg whites, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup graham cracker crumbs, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1 cup pecans (chopped), 1/2 tsp baking powder, whipped cream for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and generously butter a 9-inch pie pan | Beat the egg whites and vanilla together | Stir in the graham cracker crumbs, sugar, pecans, and baking powder ? mix well | Pour into the prepared pan | Bake for 25-30 minutes without overcooking | Cool completely | Top with whipped cream and refrigerate until ready to serve | Freezes well without the cream

ingredients: 2 cans (400g each) chickpeas (drained), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 red onion (diced and saut?ed), 1/4 cup fresh parsley (chopped), 2 green onions (sliced), juice of 1 lemon, 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese, 3 tbsp olive oil, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Saut? the red onion and garlic in a little olive oil for a few minutes ? remove from heat and cool | Drain the chickpeas | Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and toss well | Serve at room temperature or chilled

ingredients: 2 sirloin steaks (about 200g each), 1 clove garlic (halved). For sauce: 1/4 cup dry white wine, 2 tbsp tarragon vinegar, 1 tbsp fresh tarragon (chopped), 1 shallot (minced), 1/4 tsp ground pepper, 2 large egg yolks, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted and sizzling hot)
instructions: Rub both sides of the steaks with the cut garlic clove | Grill the steaks to your preference ? let rest for 5 minutes | Slice thinly and arrange on plates | Make the sauce: bring the wine, vinegar, tarragon, shallot, and pepper to a boil ? boil rapidly until reduced to 2 tablespoons ? remove from heat | In a food processor, combine the egg yolks, salt, and the reduced vinegar mixture ? process for 2 seconds | With the processor running, slowly drizzle in the sizzling hot butter in a thin steady stream until the sauce is thick and blended | Serve warm over the sliced steak

ingredients: 500g ground beef, 1 medium onion (diced), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 cup uncooked long-grain rice, 1 can (400g) condensed tomato soup, 1/2 cup water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Mix the ground beef, onion, salt, pepper, and uncooked rice together | Form into 1 1/2-inch balls and arrange in a baking dish | Mix the soup and water together and pour over the meatballs | Cover and bake for 1 hour until the rice is tender | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 large head romaine lettuce (washed and torn), 1 clove garlic (minced), 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp fresh cracked black pepper, 1 large raw egg (or pasteurized), 1/4 cup olive oil, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/2 cup croutons, 1/4 cup Romano cheese (grated), 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated)
instructions: Wash the lettuce and tear into bite-size pieces | Whisk together the garlic, Dijon mustard, salt, pepper, egg, olive oil, and lemon juice until emulsified | Let the dressing sit at room temperature for at least 1 hour | Toss the lettuce with the cheeses and croutons | Toss well with the dressing and serve immediately

ingredients: For meatballs: 500g ground beef, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 cup onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 large egg, 1/4 cup breadcrumbs. For sauce: 1 can (400g) cranberry sauce, 1/2 cup ketchup, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice
instructions: Combine all meatball ingredients and form into 25 small balls | Combine all sauce ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil for a few minutes | Add the meatballs and reduce heat | Cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until the meatballs are cooked through | Serve hot

ingredients: For crust: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup powdered sugar, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (melted). For filling: 1 large egg, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 cup shredded coconut, 1/4 cup almonds (chopped). For topping: 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips, 2 tsp unsalted butter
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) | Combine the crust ingredients in an 8 x 8-inch pan ? press firmly into the bottom | Bake for 10 minutes | Beat together the egg, sugar, flour, salt, and vanilla ? stir in the coconut and almonds | Spread evenly over the baked crust | Bake for another 20 minutes ? remove and cool | Melt the chocolate chips and butter together until smooth ? spread over the cooled bars | Refrigerate until the chocolate is firm, then cut into squares

ingredients: 2 cups sorghum syrup, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1 tbsp white vinegar, 1/2 tsp baking soda, corn starch for cutting
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the baking soda in a heavy saucepan | Cook slowly until the syrup forms a hard ball when dropped in cold water, stirring occasionally | Just before removing from the heat, stir in the baking soda | Pour into buttered pans | When cool enough to handle, butter your hands lightly and pull the taffy until light and firm | Shape into sticks and cut into pieces with kitchen shears dipped in corn starch | Wrap individually in wax paper

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened), 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter, 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1 cup whole milk, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 100g dark chocolate (melted)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan | Cream together the butter, peanut butter, and sugar until light and smooth | Add the eggs ? blend well | Pour in the milk and blend | Slowly add the flour, melted chocolate, baking powder, baking soda, and salt ? mix until combined | Pour the batter into the prepared pan | Bake for 50-60 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool in the pan for 20 minutes before inverting | Serve warm or cooled

ingredients: 6 chicken thighs (bone-in, skin-on), 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (divided), 1 sweet onion (diced), 2 shallots (minced), 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 serrano chili (minced), 1 tbsp garam masala, 1 tbsp curry powder, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground turmeric, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1/2 cup fresh cilantro (chopped, divided), 1 1/2 cups low-sodium chicken broth, 1/2 cup sour cream or full-fat yogurt, salt and black pepper, cauliflower rice for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Season the chicken generously with salt and pepper | Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over high heat ? add the chicken skin-side down and sear until deeply golden on both sides, about 4 minutes per side ? remove and set aside | Drain all but 1 tablespoon fat and lower heat to medium-high ? add 1 tablespoon butter, onion, shallots, ginger, garlic, and chili ? season and saut? until softened, about 5 minutes | Make a well in the centre, add the remaining butter, and stir in the garam masala, curry powder, cinnamon, turmeric, tomato paste, and half the cilantro ? cook for 30 seconds until fragrant | Add the chicken broth, scraping the bottom of the pan to deglaze ? bring to a boil | Return the chicken to the pan skin-side up and transfer to the oven ? cook for about 50 minutes until the sauce is reduced and the chicken is tender | Return to the stovetop and remove the chicken to plates | Whisk the sour cream into the sauce over medium heat ? season and stir in the remaining cilantro | Spoon the sauce around the chicken and serve with cauliflower rice

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 cup mashed potatoes, 1 cup grated raw potatoes, 2 large eggs (beaten), 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 veal breast (about 1.5 kg, with pocket cut)
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat ? saut? the onion, celery, and garlic until soft, 5-10 minutes | Stir in the mashed and grated potatoes and the breadcrumbs | Remove from heat and stir in the beaten eggs, salt, and pepper ? let cool | Stuff the mixture into the pocket of the veal breast ? secure with skewers or twine | Roast at 350?F (175?C) for about 1 1/2 hours until the veal is tender | Slice and serve

ingredients: For crust: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup powdered sugar, 3/4 cup cold unsalted butter (cubed). For filling: 3 large eggs, 1 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 3 cups fresh rhubarb (diced)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Mix the crust ingredients together until crumbly and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan | Bake for 10-12 minutes ? remove and reduce the oven to 350?F (175?C) | Beat the eggs, then gradually whisk in the sugar ? stir in the rhubarb and flour | Pour the filling over the crust | Bake for an additional 35-45 minutes until set | Cool completely and cut into squares

ingredients: For paste: 3 shallots, 1-inch piece galangal (chopped), 1 tsp ground turmeric, 1/2 tsp fennel seeds, 1 tsp ground coriander, 2 tbsp curry paste, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 3 cloves garlic, 1 tsp sugar. For curry: 500g firm white fish fillets, 200g prawns, 2 tbsp vegetable oil (divided), 1 can (400ml) coconut milk, 1/2 cup coconut cream, 4 kaffir lime leaves, shredded coconut for garnish, jasmine rice or cauliflower rice for serving
instructions: Blend all the spice paste ingredients together until smooth | Heat half the oil in a large frying pan and cook the paste over medium heat until fragrant, stirring constantly | Add the coconut milk and cream ? bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 15 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly | Heat the remaining oil in another pan and cook the fish and prawns for about 10 minutes until cooked through | To serve: ladle the curry sauce into bowls, arrange the fish and prawns on top, drizzle with more sauce, and garnish with shredded coconut and lime leaves | Serve with jasmine rice or cauliflower rice

ingredients: 1/2 cup water, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 carrots (sliced), 100g mushrooms (quartered), 1 red bell pepper (chopped), 1 green bell pepper (chopped), 4 ripe tomatoes (diced), 2 medium zucchini (chopped), 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp chili sauce, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1 medium onion (cut into rings)
instructions: Chop all the vegetables into bite-sized or slightly larger pieces ? cut the onion into rings for better texture | Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan ? add the onion and garlic and cook until slightly browned | Add the carrots, cover, and simmer for about 5 minutes ? add about half a glass of water if needed | Add the bell peppers, mushrooms, zucchini, canned tomatoes, and chili sauce | Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes until all the vegetables are cooked and the sauce has reduced slightly | Add the fresh tomatoes during the last 2-3 minutes | Season with salt and pepper and serve as a side dish

ingredients: 4 cod fillets (about 150g each), 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves, 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, 2 tbsp fresh mint leaves, 2 green onions, 3 cloves garlic, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground pepper, 1 tsp lime zest, 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Make the herb paste: process the cilantro, parsley, mint, green onions, garlic, salt, pepper, lime zest, lime juice, and olive oil in a food processor until a fairly smooth pur?e forms | Transfer to a glass or stainless-steel bowl | Remove any bones from the fish and cut into 4 equal pieces ? toss with the herb paste until evenly coated | Cover loosely with plastic wrap and let sit at room temperature for 15-30 minutes | Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) | Arrange the fish in a single layer in a shallow baking dish ? spoon any remaining herb paste over the top | Bake for roughly 10 minutes per inch of fish thickness until just opaque | Serve immediately

ingredients: 500g boneless skinless chicken breasts (cooked and diced), 8 flour tortillas (torn into pieces), 1/2 green bell pepper (diced), 1/2 medium onion (diced), 1/2 cup salsa, 1/2 cup whole milk, 1 can (400g) cream of chicken soup, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1 cup Monterey Jack cheese (shredded)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Mix together the green pepper, onion, salsa, and milk | Place the torn tortilla pieces in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish | Top with the diced chicken | Spoon the pepper mixture over the chicken, followed by the cream of chicken soup, and then the shredded cheeses | Bake for 1 hour until bubbly and golden | Serve hot

ingredients: 200g smoked salmon, 1/4 cup unsalted butter (softened), 4 oz cream cheese (softened), 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 2 green onions (sliced), 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor and blend until smooth | Transfer to a decorative dish | Cover and refrigerate until chilled | Serve with crackers or toast points

recipe_name: Anything Goes Fruit and Nut Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup non-dairy milk substitute, 1 ripe banana, 1 tbsp maple syrup, 1 tsp flax seed oil, 1/2 cup mixed frozen fruit, 2 tbsp nuts or seeds
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender or food processor | Blend on high until smooth | Add more milk if a thinner consistency is desired | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4 lamb shanks, 2 tbsp vegetable oil (divided), 2 medium onions (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp fresh ginger (grated), 1 tsp ground cardamom, 2 tbsp curry paste, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 1 can (400ml) coconut milk, 1 cup beef stock, fresh coriander leaves for garnish
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large saucepan ? add the lamb shanks and brown in batches ? remove to a plate | Heat the remaining oil and add the onions ? cook until soft | Stir in the garlic and ginger ? cook for 1 minute, then add the cardamom and curry paste ? cook for another minute | Add the tomatoes, coconut milk, and stock ? stir to combine | Return the shanks to the saucepan, bring to a simmer, then cover | Cook gently for about 2 hours until the lamb is tender | Serve garnished with fresh coriander

ingredients: 1 large egg, 1 cup buttermilk, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/3 cup vegetable shortening (melted), 1 cup rolled oats, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 400?F (200?C) and grease 12 muffin cups | Beat the egg and add the buttermilk, brown sugar, and melted shortening | Mix in the oats, flour, baking powder, salt, and baking soda ? stir gently just until the flour is moistened (the batter will be lumpy) | Fill the muffin cups 2/3 full | Bake for 20-25 minutes until light brown | Cool on a wire rack

ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 3 tbsp granulated sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 large eggs, 3 tbsp canola oil, 1 cup whole milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract, butter for cooking, maple syrup for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt | In another bowl, whisk together the eggs, oil, milk, and vanilla | Add the liquid to the dry mixture and whisk ? do not overmix (the batter should be lumpy) | Heat a heavy griddle or frying pan greased with a little butter over medium heat | Pour about 1/4 cup of batter per pancake onto the hot surface | When bubbles appear on the surface and begin to break, flip and cook the other side until golden | Serve with maple syrup

ingredients: For base: 1 box brownie mix (plus eggs, oil, and water as directed), 1/2 cup chocolate chips. For mousse: 2 tbsp water, 1 tbsp unflavored gelatin, 1 can (400g) jellied cranberry sauce, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp orange zest, 1 cup heavy whipping cream, red food colouring (optional). For sauce: 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1 tbsp cornstarch, 1 cup frozen cranberry juice concentrate
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and wrap foil around the bottom of a 10-inch springform pan | Make the brownie base according to package directions, folding in the chocolate chips ? bake for 35-40 minutes until the base pulls away from the sides ? cool completely | For the mousse: sprinkle the gelatin over 2 tablespoons water and let soften for 1 minute ? add the cranberry sauce and sugar and heat to a rolling boil, stirring frequently until the gelatin dissolves ? stir in the orange zest | Cool for 20 minutes at room temperature, then refrigerate for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, stirring every 30 minutes, until slightly thickened | Whip the cream to stiff peaks and fold into the cranberry mixture ? spoon over the cooled brownie base and refrigerate for about 2 hours until set | Make the sauce: combine the sugar and cornstarch, stir in the cranberry juice concentrate, and bring to a boil ? cook for 4-5 minutes until slightly thickened ? cool and refrigerate | Serve the torte with the sauce spooned over each slice

ingredients: 1 box spice cake mix, 2 cans (400g each) apple pie filling, 3 large eggs, 1/2 cup caramel topping (warmed)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) and grease a Bundt pan | Mix the dry cake mix, apple pie filling, and eggs together until well combined | Pour into the prepared pan | Bake for 40-50 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean | Cool for 10 minutes and invert onto a serving plate | Warm the caramel topping and pour over the cake before serving

ingredients: 400g spaghetti, 3 cloves garlic, 1 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley leaves, 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil (plus 3 tbsp for pan), salt and black pepper, 1/4 cup pine nuts, 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, 1 tsp lemon zest, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/2 cup Pecorino cheese (grated), 2 plum tomatoes (diced)
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente ? drain | Make the parsley pesto: place the garlic and parsley in a food processor with some salt and pepper ? pulse until roughly chopped | With the machine running, pour in 1/3 to 1/2 cup olive oil until a thick smooth paste forms ? set aside | Heat 3 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat ? add the pine nuts and toast lightly | Add the breadcrumbs and toast until golden, about 2-3 minutes | Add the pesto and cook for 2-3 minutes to cook out the raw garlic taste | Add the lemon zest and juice and season with pepper | Add the drained spaghetti and Pecorino to the skillet and toss to combine | Serve topped with the diced tomatoes

ingredients: 300g shell macaroni (cooked and drained), 2 cups cooked chicken (diced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 1/4 cup onion (diced), 1/2 green bell pepper (diced), 2 tbsp sweet pickle relish, 1/4 cup sliced black olives, 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 1 tbsp prepared mustard, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Cook the macaroni according to package directions ? rinse with cold water and drain | In a large bowl, combine the macaroni, chicken, celery, onion, bell pepper, pickles, and olives | In a small bowl, stir together the mayonnaise and mustard | Add to the macaroni mixture and toss to coat | Season with salt and pepper | Cover and refrigerate for 3-4 hours before serving

ingredients: 4 large eggs, 1 cup caster sugar, 1 cup plain flour, 2 ripe bananas (mashed), 1 tsp fresh lemon juice, icing sugar for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 190?C (375?F) and grease a deep 20cm cake tin ? line the base with parchment paper | Whisk the eggs and sugar together until thick enough to hold its shape when the whisk is lifted | Fold in the flour | Gently fold in the mashed bananas and lemon juice | Pour into the prepared tin and level the top | Bake for 20-25 minutes until the cake springs back when lightly pressed in the centre | Turn out onto a wire rack, peel off the paper, and cool | Dust with icing sugar before serving

ingredients: For crust: 200g digestive biscuits (crushed), 1/3 cup unsalted butter (melted). For filling: 1 tbsp gelatin powder, 2 tbsp water, 8 oz cream cheese (softened), 1 tsp vanilla extract, zest and juice of 1 lemon, 3 ripe peaches (diced). For topping: 1 package lemon jelly crystals, 1 cup hot water, 1/2 cup cold water
instructions: Line a 12-inch rectangular tray with foil | Mix the biscuit crumbs with the melted butter ? press firmly into the tray and refrigerate for about 1 hour | Dissolve the gelatin in 2 tablespoons water over low heat ? set aside to cool | Whisk the cream cheese, vanilla, lemon zest, and lemon juice until smooth ? blend in the cooled gelatin | Gently fold in the diced peaches | Spoon the cheese mixture onto the chilled crust ? top with the remaining peaches and chill for about 2 hours | Dissolve the jelly crystals in hot water, add the cold water, and cool | Pour the cooled jelly over the cheesecake and refrigerate for another 3 hours | Use the foil to lift the cake out and slice

ingredients: 1/2 cup reduced-fat sour cream, 1 package sugar-free instant vanilla pudding mix, 1/4 cup nonfat milk, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp lemon zest, fresh fruit for dipping
instructions: Whisk together the sour cream, pudding mix, milk, lemon juice, and lemon zest in a bowl until smooth | Serve immediately with fresh fruit or refrigerate until needed

ingredients: 4 puff pastry shells (baked), 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 2 celery stalks (diced), 2 carrots (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 1 bay leaf, 1 red bell pepper (diced), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 cups chicken broth, 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts (cubed), 1/2 cup heavy cream, 1/4 cup half-and-half, 200g asparagus spears (cut into pieces), 1/2 cup frozen green peas, salt and black pepper
instructions: Bake the pastry shells according to package directions until very golden brown | While they bake, heat the olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium to medium-high heat ? stir in the celery, carrots, onion, and bay leaf ? season and cook for 5 minutes | Add the bell pepper and cook for 2 minutes | Push the vegetables to the side, add the butter, and melt ? whisk in the flour and cook for 1 minute | Whisk in the chicken broth, add the chicken, and bring to a boil ? reduce heat and simmer for 8 minutes | Stir in the cream and bring just to a boil, then stir in the asparagus and peas ? cook for 2 minutes | Season to taste | Fill the pastry shells with the chicken mixture and serve

ingredients: 4 pork steaks, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp accent seasoning (MSG), 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 tbsp vegetable oil. For sauce: 1/2 cup ketchup, 2 tbsp white vinegar, 1 tbsp cider vinegar, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp accent seasoning, 1 medium onion (diced)
instructions: Brown the pork steaks lightly in a skillet coated with vegetable oil | Mix the salt, pepper, and accent seasoning and coat both sides of the steaks ? place in a 6-quart slow cooker | Combine all the sauce ingredients and add to the slow cooker | Cook on low for 8-9 hours | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 leek (green tops reserved and tied with herb sprigs), 2 carrots (chopped), 2 celery stalks (chopped), 2 yellow onions (quartered), 4 cloves garlic (smashed), 4 sprigs fresh parsley, 2 sprigs fresh thyme, 1 sprig fresh tarragon, 1 bay leaf, 3 litres water, 1 tsp whole peppercorns, salt to taste
instructions: Stuff the herb sprigs into the reserved green leek tops and tie off | In a large stock pot, add all the ingredients except the pepper and salt | Heat over medium heat and bring to a simmer ? reduce to medium-low | Simmer for 30 minutes, skimming off any foam | Add the peppercorns and simmer partially covered for 90 minutes | Line a colander with 2 layers of damp cheesecloth and strain into a large bowl ? discard the vegetables | Season with salt to taste | Keeps in the freezer for up to 6 months

ingredients: 400g spiral pasta (cooked and cooled), 1/2 cup light sour cream, 1/4 cup mayonnaise, 1 packet taco seasoning, 1/2 cup salsa, 1 can (400g) black beans (drained), 1 cup frozen corn (thawed), 1/4 cup sliced black olives, 1 cup shredded cheese, shredded lettuce and tortilla chips for serving
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions ? drain and rinse with cold water | Mix together the sour cream, mayonnaise, taco seasoning, and salsa in a medium bowl | Combine the pasta, corn, black beans, and olives in a large bowl | Add the shredded cheese about 30 minutes before serving | Pour the sauce over and stir until well coated | Serve topped with shredded lettuce and crushed tortilla chips

ingredients: 2 cups cooked turkey (diced), 1 cup fresh spinach (chopped), 1 cup shredded cheese, 1 cup pizza sauce (divided), 1 package refrigerated pizza dough, 2 tbsp milk, 2 tbsp Parmesan or Romano cheese (grated)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Combine the turkey, spinach, shredded cheese, and 1/2 cup pizza sauce in a large bowl | Roll the pizza dough out to a 12 x 12-inch square and cut into 4 equal squares | Place about 1/2 cup of the turkey mixture onto half of each square ? moisten the edges with water, fold over, and seal with a fork | Prick the tops with a fork, brush with milk, and sprinkle with Parmesan | Bake on a greased baking sheet for about 18 minutes until golden brown | Serve with the remaining pizza sauce

ingredients: For filling: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts (roasted and cubed), 3 cups chicken stock, 2 chicken bouillon cubes, 1/2 cup unsalted butter, 2 yellow onions (diced), 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 2 carrots (diced), 1 cup frozen peas, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), salt and black pepper. For pastry: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 cup vegetable shortening, 2 tbsp cold unsalted butter, 1/2 cup ice water, 1 egg beaten with 1 tbsp water, flaked sea salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Rub the chicken breasts with olive oil, season, and roast for 35-40 minutes until cooked through ? cool, then cube | Dissolve the bouillon in the hot stock | Melt the butter in a large pot and saut? the onions until translucent ? add the flour and cook for 2 minutes | Whisk in the hot stock and simmer until thick ? add the cream, chicken, carrots, peas, and parsley ? season well | Make the pastry: combine the flour, salt, and baking powder ? cut in the shortening and butter until pea-sized ? add just enough ice water to bring the dough together | Chill for 30 minutes | Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Divide the filling among 4 ovenproof bowls | Roll out the pastry and cut into 8-inch circles | Brush the edges of the bowls with egg wash, top with pastry, crimp the edges, and brush the tops with egg wash ? cut 3 slits in each | Bake for 1 hour until golden and bubbling

recipe_name: Crock Pot Pork Stroganoff with Leeks
ingredients: 500g pork tenderloin (cubed), 1 tsp garlic powder, salt and black pepper, 1 leek (sliced), 200g mushrooms (sliced), 1 can (400g) cream of mushroom soup, 1/2 cup nonfat sour cream, steamed rice or egg noodles for serving
instructions: Place the pork cubes in a crock pot and season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper | Add the leeks, mushrooms, and cream of mushroom soup | Cook on low for 8 hours | Turn off the crock pot and stir in the sour cream | Serve over rice or egg noodles

ingredients: 500g ground beef, 1 tbsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 4 hamburger buns, lettuce, tomato, and condiments for serving
instructions: Combine the ground beef, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, and cheese ? shape into 6 patties | Grill over hot coals or in a skillet until cooked to your desired doneness | Serve on hamburger buns with your favourite toppings

ingredients: 1 can refrigerated crescent rolls, 1 box frozen chopped spinach (thawed and squeezed dry), 3 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 medium onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 large egg, 1 cup ricotta cheese, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/4 cup breadcrumbs, salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375?F (190?C) | Press the crescent roll dough into a pie plate, sealing the seams | Saut? the onion and garlic in butter until softened | Combine the spinach, onion mixture, ricotta, Parmesan, breadcrumbs, and egg ? mix well | Spoon the filling into the crust | Bake for 35-45 minutes until set and golden | Let cool for 5 minutes before slicing

ingredients: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 1 tbsp unsalted butter, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 red onion (diced), 1 box frozen spinach (thawed and squeezed dry), 1 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese, 500g ground chicken or turkey, 1 tsp grill seasoning, 4 burger buns, lettuce, tomatoes, olives, and red onion for serving
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat ? add the olive oil and butter | When the butter melts, add the garlic and red onion and cook for 5 minutes ? transfer to a bowl to cool | Wring the spinach completely dry and add to the cooled onion mixture with the oregano, feta, ground chicken, grill seasoning, and a drizzle of olive oil | Mix and form into 4 patties about 1-inch thick | Increase the heat to medium-high and cook the patties for 6 minutes on each side | Serve on buns topped with lettuce, tomatoes, olives, and red onion

ingredients: 1 baguette (cut into portions and halved), 1 clove garlic (halved), 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, salt and black pepper, 2 hard-boiled eggs (sliced), 1 can (200g) tuna in olive oil, 2 ripe tomatoes (sliced), 1/4 cup black olives, 1/4 red onion (diced), cos lettuce leaves, 1 tbsp white wine vinegar
