instructions: Cut the baguette into even portions and halve lengthwise ? scoop out some of the bread filling | Rub the inside of both halves with garlic and drizzle generously with olive oil ? season well | Pack in the egg slices, tuna, tomatoes, olives, red onion, and lettuce leaves | Drizzle with more oil and a little white wine vinegar | Close the sandwich, wrap snugly in foil, and place on a flat surface ? weigh down with heavy books for 1-2 hours | Remove the foil and wrap a band of paper around each portion ? tie with kitchen string | Serve at room temperature

ingredients: 1 bottle dry white wine, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 2 oranges (sliced), 1 lemon (sliced), 1 lime (sliced), 1 cup mixed fresh fruit, ice for serving
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a large pitcher | Allow to marinate in the refrigerator for at least 24 hours, preferably 48 | Serve over ice

ingredients: For dough: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (melted), 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp orange flower water. For filling: 1 cup almond paste, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 tsp orange flower water, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, granulated sugar for sprinkling
instructions: Make the filling: mix the sugar into the almond paste ? add the orange flower water and cinnamon and blend into a smooth paste | Make the dough: combine the melted butter with the flour and orange flower water ? knead into a soft dough (do not add water unless absolutely necessary) | Form the dough into 1 1/2 to 2-inch balls | Make a depression in the centre of each and fill with the almond paste | Place on a greased baking sheet and bake at 375?F (190?C) for 30 minutes until nicely browned | Sprinkle with granulated sugar and cool on a wire rack

ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter (divided), 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 cups chicken or vegetable stock, 1 cup heavy cream, 1 medium onion (diced), 1 carrot (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 2 jalape?os (minced), 1/2 cup Swiss cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), salt to taste
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large saucepan ? whisk in the flour and cook for 3 minutes | Whisk in the stock and cream ? bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until thickened, about 10 minutes | Meanwhile, melt the remaining 1 tablespoon butter in a small skillet ? saut? the onion, carrot, and green pepper until soft, about 8 minutes ? stir in the jalape?os | Add both cheeses to the cream mixture and stir until melted | Stir in the vegetables and season with salt | Serve hot

ingredients: 3 tbsp currant jelly, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp water, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 clove garlic (minced), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients except the salt and pepper until well combined | Season to taste with salt and pepper | Serve over your favourite salad greens

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts (diced), 2 medium zucchini (diced), 1 medium onion (diced), 2 carrots (diced), 1 can (400g) Italian-style diced tomatoes, 4 cups chicken broth, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot and cook the diced chicken for 5-10 minutes until done | Add the zucchini, onion, carrots, and undrained tomatoes ? mix well | Pour in the chicken broth | Simmer for about 30 minutes | Season generously with salt and pepper | Serve hot

ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts (sliced), cooking spray, 2 cups mixed stir-fry vegetables, 1/4 cup chicken broth, 2 tbsp teriyaki sauce, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium heat | Add the chicken and cook, stirring constantly, until browned | Add the vegetables and stir-fry until barely tender, 2-3 minutes | Add the broth, teriyaki sauce, salt, and pepper ? stir-fry until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender-crisp, about 3 minutes longer | Serve immediately

ingredients: 8 lamb rib chops, 1 cup plain yogurt, 2 tbsp fresh mint (chopped), 1 clove garlic (minced), pinch of cayenne pepper, 1 tsp herbes de Provence, sea salt and fresh ground black pepper, 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Stir together the yogurt, mint, garlic, and cayenne ? set aside | Pat the lamb chops dry and season with herbes de Provence, salt, and pepper | Heat the oil in a 12-inch cast iron skillet over medium-high heat until hot but not smoking ? add the chops and cook for 3 minutes per side for medium-rare | Serve topped with the yogurt-mint sauce

ingredients: For dressing: 2 tbsp fresh lime juice, 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), 3 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 1/4 tsp Mexican oregano, 1 clove garlic (minced). For salad: 1 head romaine lettuce (shredded), 1 cup cherry tomatoes (halved), 2 cups cooked chicken (sliced), 1 can (400g) black beans (drained), 1 cucumber (diced), 1 cup corn kernels, 1 avocado (sliced and treated with lime juice), 1/2 cup crumbled cotija cheese, 4 slices bacon (cooked and crumbled)
instructions: Make the dressing: whisk together all the dressing ingredients and set aside | Prepare the avocado and drizzle with lime juice | Place the shredded lettuce in a large serving bowl ? arrange the cheese, chicken, beans, and vegetables in rows over the lettuce | Just before serving, toss the salad with the dressing | Place the avocado slices around the rim | Garnish with lime slices and cilantro sprigs | Serve immediately

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, 1/4 cup honey, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tbsp olive oil, steamed rice and vegetables for serving
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the honey, soy sauce, and garlic | Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat | Season the chicken with pepper and cook for 5-6 minutes per side until golden | Pour the honey garlic sauce over the chicken and cook for 2-3 minutes until the sauce thickens and glazes the chicken | Serve over steamed rice with vegetables

ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts (pocket cut into each), 4 slices mozzarella cheese, 4 slices prosciutto, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 can (400g) condensed cream of chicken soup, 1/2 cup orange juice, 1 tbsp fresh sage (chopped), 1 can (300g) mandarin orange segments (drained)
instructions: Cut a lengthwise pocket in each chicken breast and stuff with a slice of mozzarella and a slice of prosciutto | Heat the oil in a skillet and brown the chicken on both sides | Add the soup, orange juice, and sage ? bring to a boil | Cover and cook for about 5 minutes until the chicken is done | Add the mandarin orange segments, heat through, and serve

ingredients: 500g cooked roast beef (sliced), 200g mushrooms (sliced), 1 cup sour cream, 1 medium onion (diced), 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, egg noodles, rice, or mashed potatoes for serving
instructions: Place all ingredients in a crock pot and cook on high, stirring occasionally, until the roast is very tender and pulling apart | Reduce to low and keep warm until ready to serve | Serve over egg noodles, rice, or mashed potatoes

ingredients: 1/2 cup reduced-fat sour cream, 2 tbsp fresh dill (chopped), 1 tbsp prepared horseradish, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp fresh ground black pepper, 2 green onions (sliced)
instructions: Combine the sour cream, dill, horseradish, salt, pepper, and green onions in a small bowl | Cover and refrigerate for up to 3 days | Serve with fish, roast beef, or vegetables

ingredients: 4 cups vegetable stock, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 2 carrots (diced), 1 cup shredded cabbage, 1/2 cup dried split peas, 1/4 cup pearl barley, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: In a large pot, combine the stock, tomatoes, carrots, cabbage, split peas, barley, and garlic | Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until the barley and split peas are tender | Stir in the parsley just before serving

ingredients: 3/4 tsp granulated sugar, 3 fresh mint sprigs, 3/4 oz fresh lime juice, 2 oz vodka, splash of cranberry juice, champagne to top, fresh raspberries and mint sprig for garnish
instructions: For each drink, add the sugar, mint sprigs, and lime juice to a cocktail shaker | Muddle gently | Add ice, vodka, and a splash of cranberry juice ? shake vigorously | Strain into a champagne flute | Top with champagne and garnish with a few raspberries and a mint sprig

ingredients: 4 chicken cutlets, 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 2 tbsp water, 1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes, 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (shredded), 1 yellow bell pepper (julienned), 1 tsp Italian seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Mix the olive oil and water for the marinade | Layer a few pepper slices in the centre of each cutlet, add about 1 tablespoon feta and a few sun-dried tomatoes, and roll up ? place seam-side down in an 8 x 8-inch casserole dish | Toss the remaining pepper slices in the marinade and scatter around the chicken | Sprinkle with Parmesan and Italian seasoning | Bake for 35 minutes and serve

ingredients: 400g penne pasta, 1 can (354ml) skim evaporated milk, 1/2 cup skim milk, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 tsp vegetable bouillon powder, 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (cubed), 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp fresh coarse ground black pepper, 1 fresh tomato (diced), 1/4 cup canned crabmeat (optional), 1/4 cup low-fat Parmesan cheese (grated), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped)
instructions: Whisk both milks into the flour in a large non-stick frying pan until smooth ? add the garlic and bouillon powder | Heat and stir on medium-low until boiling and thickened ? keep warm | Saut? the chicken in olive oil in another pan for 5 minutes until slightly browned ? sprinkle with cayenne and pepper | Add the tomato and crabmeat ? toss until hot ? stir into the milk mixture | Cook the penne in boiling salted water until just tender ? drain | Pour the sauce over the pasta and toss to coat | Sprinkle with Parmesan and parsley

ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts (sliced), 2 tbsp soy sauce (divided), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 200g vermicelli noodles (cooked), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 2 cups green cabbage (shredded), 2 green onions with tops (sliced), 1 carrot (julienned), 2 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp chili oil
instructions: Cook the vermicelli according to package directions ? drain, rinse with cold water, and drain well | Coat the chicken with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and the garlic | Heat a large nonstick frying pan over high heat ? add the oil and coat the pan | Add the chicken and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until lightly browned and cooked through | Add the cabbage, green onions, and carrot ? cook and stir for 30 seconds | Add the noodles, oyster sauce, and the remaining 1 tablespoon soy sauce ? cook and stir for 2 minutes until hot | Remove from heat and mix in the chili oil | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 can (300g) mandarin orange segments (drained), 1 can (400g) crushed pineapple (drained), 2 cups green cabbage (shredded), 1 carrot (grated), 1/4 cup sunflower seeds, 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1/4 tsp salt, pinch of cayenne pepper
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the oranges, pineapple, cabbage, carrot, and sunflower seeds ? mix lightly | In a small bowl, stir together the mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt, and cayenne | Pour over the salad mixture and toss to coat | Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour until well chilled

ingredients: 1 cup shelled edamame, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 2 shallots (minced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 1/2 cups Arborio rice, 3 cups low-sodium chicken broth, 1 cup lager beer, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), salt and black pepper
instructions: Bring a small saucepan of salted water to a boil ? add the edamame and cook until tender, about 5 minutes ? drain | Melt the butter in the olive oil in a large saucepan ? add the shallots and garlic and cook until softened, about 3 minutes | Add the rice and cook, stirring, until slightly translucent, about 2 minutes | Mix the broth with the beer and season generously | Add 1 cup of the broth mixture to the rice and cook, stirring constantly, until nearly absorbed ? continue adding broth 1 cup at a time, stirring until absorbed | The rice is done when al dente, about 17 minutes total | Stir in the edamame and Parmesan until the cheese is melted | Season and serve immediately

ingredients: 1 medium onion (sliced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 spring onions (sliced), 1 carrot (julienned), 1 cup broccoli florets, 1 baby bok choy (chopped), 1 zucchini (sliced), 100g button mushrooms (halved), 1 red bell pepper (sliced), 2 tbsp plum sauce, 1 tsp Vegemite or miso paste, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water, 1/2 cup unsalted dry roasted cashews, 2 tbsp vegetable oil
instructions: Heat a wok or frying pan and add the oil ? stir-fry the onion, garlic, and all the vegetables for about 5 minutes until tender | Stir in the combined plum sauce, Vegemite, sesame oil, cornstarch mixture, and water ? cook for a further minute until slightly thickened | Serve immediately sprinkled with cashews

ingredients: For pastry: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter (cubed), 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 3-4 tbsp cold water. For filling: 3 large egg yolks, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 cup heavy cream, 1 tsp vanilla extract, extra sugar for topping
instructions: Make the pastry: cut the butter into the flour and sugar ? add just enough water to form a dough ? wrap and refrigerate | Roll out the dough and cut into circles ? line small tart tins | Blind bake at 375?F (190?C) for 15 minutes ? cool | Whisk the egg yolks and sugar until pale | Heat the cream and vanilla until just simmering ? gradually whisk into the egg mixture | Pour the filling into the shells and bake at 325?F (160?C) until just set ? refrigerate overnight | Before serving, sprinkle with sugar and place under the broiler for 2 minutes until caramelized

ingredients: 4 large potatoes (thinly sliced), 4 slices bacon (diced), 1 yellow onion (thinly sliced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 cup thickened cream, 1 tsp paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 180?C (350?F) | Thinly slice the potatoes, bacon, and onion | Layer the potato, bacon, onion, and garlic in a casserole dish in 3-4 layers | Pour the cream over the layers | Sprinkle paprika on top | Bake for about 1 hour until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 can (400g) cream of chicken soup, 1 cup whole milk, 1/2 cup frozen mixed vegetables, 1 cup cooked chicken (diced), 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp salt, 1 can refrigerated biscuits
instructions: Preheat the oven according to the biscuit package directions | In a pot over medium heat, combine the soup, milk, vegetables, chicken, thyme, pepper, and salt | Cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens, about 10 minutes | Bake the biscuits according to the package directions | Split the biscuits and top the bottom halves with the chicken mixture ? cover with the biscuit tops | Serve immediately

ingredients: 1 cup uncooked white rice, 2 cups boiling water, 1 cup whole milk, 4 slices American cheese (torn), 1 small onion (diced), 2 large eggs (beaten), 1/2 tsp salt, 2 cups broccoli florets (cooked and drained)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Combine all ingredients in a large greased baking dish ? stir well | Bake for 1 hour until set and golden on top | Serve hot

ingredients: 1 cup dried lentils (rinsed), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 celery stalks (diced), 2 carrots (diced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 250g ground beef, 2 cups chicken broth, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tbsp cider vinegar, 1 cup uncooked white rice (cooked separately)
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions | Add the lentils to about 1 quart of boiling water and simmer for 20 minutes ? drain in a colander | In the same pot, melt the butter and brown the ground beef | Add the broth, celery, carrots, and garlic ? boil for 10 minutes | Return the lentils to the pot with the salt, sugar, cumin, and pepper | Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes | Stir in the cider vinegar just before serving | Serve over the cooked rice

ingredients: 1 cup quinoa (thoroughly rinsed), 4 cups water, 1 tbsp canola oil, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp red chili powder
instructions: Bring 4 cups of water to a boil | While it heats, thoroughly rinse the quinoa in a large bowl of cold water, swishing with a whisk for 1-2 minutes to remove the bitter saponin coating ? drain and rinse again | Lower the heat and add the oil, salt, pepper, cinnamon, and chili powder to the water ? whisk to dissolve | Add the rinsed quinoa, loosely cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes until the quinoa is tender and the water is absorbed | Fluff with a fork and serve

ingredients: 500g beef tips or stew meat, 1 can (400g) condensed cream of mushroom soup, 1 packet dry onion soup mix, 1 can (200g) sliced mushrooms (undrained), egg noodles or rice for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 300?F (150?C) | Combine the beef tips, undiluted mushroom soup, undiluted onion soup mix, and undrained mushrooms in a bowl ? mix well | Spoon into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish | Bake uncovered for 2-3 hours until the beef is tender | Serve over egg noodles or rice

recipe_name: Healthy Mac and Cheese with B?chamel-Cheddar Sauce
ingredients: 400g whole wheat elbow macaroni, 1 can (354ml) evaporated milk, 3 tbsp all-purpose flour, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese (shredded), 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/2 tsp dry mustard, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper. For topping: 2 slices bread (pulsed into crumbs), 1 tbsp melted butter, 1/4 cup sharp cheddar cheese (shredded), pinch of cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Cook the macaroni in boiling water until al dente ? reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain and rinse with cold water | In the same pot, melt the butter and whisk in the flour until a light beige paste forms | Slowly whisk in the evaporated milk and simmer for 3-4 minutes until thickened | Stir in the nutmeg, mustard, and salt | Remove from heat and stir in the cheeses and reserved pasta water until melted | Return the macaroni to the pot and stir to coat | Pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish | Make the topping: pulse the bread with melted butter to form crumbs ? mix with the cheese and cayenne | Sprinkle over the macaroni | Bake for 25 minutes until the top is golden | Let rest for 10 minutes before serving

ingredients: 4 halibut steaks (cooked and flaked), 2 ripe tomatoes (diced), 1 cup cauliflower florets (blanched), 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1/4 cup stuffed green olives (sliced), 3 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1/4 cup olive oil, 2 hard-boiled eggs (sliced), fresh spinach for serving
instructions: Gently toss the fish and vegetables together | In a small bowl, whisk together the vinegar, garlic, parsley, salt, and pepper ? slowly whisk in the olive oil | Pour the vinaigrette over the salad and toss gently | Serve on a bed of fresh spinach and top with the egg slices

ingredients: 4 red chilies (seeded), 4 cloves garlic, 2 tbsp fresh rosemary, 1 tsp black pepper, 1/4 cup vodka, 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, 1/2 cup olive oil, 1 tbsp dried oregano
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor or blender and process until liquified | Poke the chicken pieces 4-5 times each with a fork and lay in a casserole dish | Pour the marinade over the chicken, cover with cling wrap, and marinate for 8-12 hours, turning at least once | Grill the chicken, pouring extra marinade over it only when first placed on the grill ? not within 20 minutes of removing | Also works well for raw shrimp

ingredients: 500g ground beef, 1 medium onion (diced), 2 cups tomato sauce, 1 can (400g) diced tomatoes, 2 tbsp pimientos (diced), 400g spaghetti (cooked), 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1 cup Monterey Jack cheese (shredded)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Brown the ground beef in a large skillet ? drain the fat | Saut? the onion until soft | Combine the meat with the tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, onion, and pimientos ? simmer for 20 minutes | Cover the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan with some sauce | Layer half the pasta and half the cheeses ? repeat the layers, ending with sauce on top | Bake for 30 minutes | Top with the remaining cheese and bake for about 5 more minutes until melted | Serve hot

ingredients: 1.5 kg beef short ribs, 3 tsp kosher salt, 1 tsp black pepper, 4 cloves garlic, 2 jalape?o peppers, 1 medium onion (quartered), 1 can (400g) chopped tomatoes, 1/4 cup cilantro stems, 1 tsp dried oregano, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp chili powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp ground coriander, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 cup lager beer, 1 bag corn tortilla chips, 2 cups cheddar cheese (shredded), 2 avocados (mashed with lime juice and salt), salsa, sour cream, and fresh cilantro for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 325?F (160?C) | Season the short ribs with 3 teaspoons salt and pepper | Char the garlic, jalape?os, and onion in a dry Dutch oven over high heat for about 10 minutes | Transfer to a blender with the tomatoes, cilantro stems, oregano, and 1 teaspoon salt ? pur?e until smooth | Heat the olive oil in the Dutch oven and sear the short ribs in batches until well browned, about 20 minutes | Stir in the chili powder, cumin, and coriander ? cook for 30 seconds | Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes | Add the tomato pur?e and beer ? bring to a simmer | Return the ribs to the pot, cover, and bake for 1 1/2 hours | Uncover and bake 30-45 minutes more until fork-tender | Shred the meat and discard the bones ? simmer the sauce if needed to thicken | Spread the chips on a baking sheet, top with the meat, sauce, and cheese ? broil until melted | Serve with mashed avocado, salsa, sour cream, and cilantro

recipe_name: Saut?ed Sausage with Sauerkraut and Sweet Peas
ingredients: 300g garlic sausage (sliced), 1 jar sauerkraut (drained), 1 can (400g) sweet peas (with liquid)
instructions: Heat a heavy 12-inch skillet until hot | Add the sliced sausage and cook, stirring frequently, until browned and cooked through, about 6-8 minutes | Add the sweet peas with their liquid, stirring to loosen the brown bits on the bottom | The liquid will reduce by about two-thirds within a couple of minutes | Add the sauerkraut and cook, stirring, until heated through, about 2-3 minutes | Serve immediately

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 medium onions (diced), 1 leek (sliced, 2/3 for soup and 1/3 reserved for garnish), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 tsp ground allspice, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 tbsp honey, 500g pumpkin (peeled and cubed), 4 cups vegetable or chicken stock, salt and black pepper, plain yogurt for serving
instructions: Heat the oil in a saucepan over low heat ? stir in the onions, 2/3 of the leek, and the garlic ? cover and sweat until translucent | Stir in the allspice, cinnamon, honey, and pumpkin ? cover and sweat for another couple of minutes | Pour in the stock, raise the heat, and bring to a boil | Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 30-40 minutes until the pumpkin is soft | Pur?e in a blender, return to the pan, and reheat ? season with salt and pepper | Saut? the remaining leek slices | Ladle the soup into bowls, swirl in a heaping tablespoon of yogurt, and top with the saut?ed leeks

ingredients: 90ml sake, 30ml vodka, ice cubes, cucumber slice or lemon twist for garnish
instructions: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice | Add the sake and vodka | Shake vigorously until frosty cold | Strain into a chilled martini glass | Garnish with a cucumber slice or lemon twist

ingredients: 1 medium onion (diced), 1 green bell pepper (diced), 2 celery stalks (diced), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 3 cups water, 1 cup dried lentils, 1 cup cooked rice, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 packet taco seasoning, 1 tbsp chili powder, 1 cup crushed tortilla chips, 1 cup cheddar cheese (shredded), 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese (shredded)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Saut? the onion, green pepper, and celery in oil for 5 minutes | Add the water and bring to a boil | Stir in the lentils, cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 40 minutes without draining | Transfer to a large bowl and stir in the cooked rice, tomato paste, taco seasoning, and chili powder | Pour into a greased casserole dish and bake uncovered for 20 minutes | Sprinkle the tortilla chips and cheeses on top and bake for another 5 minutes until the cheese melts | Serve hot

ingredients: 500g rock shrimp (peeled), 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 2 large eggs (beaten), 1 cup panko breadcrumbs, vegetable oil for deep frying. For sauce: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 2 tbsp chili sauce, 2 tbsp tequila, juice of 1 lime
instructions: Set up a breading station with three shallow dishes: flour, beaten eggs, and panko | Dredge each shrimp in flour, then egg, then panko ? set aside | Heat oil in a deep fryer or heavy saucepan to 325?F (160?C) | Fry the shrimp in batches until golden brown ? drain on paper towels | Make the sauce: melt the butter in a saut? pan over medium heat, add the chili sauce, and simmer until bubbling | Add the tequila and carefully flamb? until the sauce thickens slightly | Remove from heat and squeeze in the lime juice | Serve the shrimp with the sauce

ingredients: For vinaigrette: 1/4 cup canola oil, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground cumin. For salad: 2 cups chicken broth, 1 1/2 cups couscous, 1/4 cup dried cranberries, 1/4 cup dried currants, 2 shallots (minced), 3 tbsp white wine vinegar, 3 green onions (sliced), 1 can (400g) garbanzo beans (drained), 2 tbsp fresh mint (chopped), salt and black pepper
instructions: Make the vinaigrette: bring the oil, cinnamon, and cumin to a boil in a small saucepan ? remove from heat and cool | Whisk in the shallot and vinegar | Bring the broth to a boil in a medium saucepan ? stir in the couscous and cranberries, cover, and remove from heat ? let stand for 5 minutes | Transfer the couscous to a bowl and fluff with a fork ? cool | Pour the vinaigrette over the couscous and toss | Stir in the green onions, garbanzo beans, and mint | Season with salt and pepper | Serve chilled or at room temperature

ingredients: 4 cups apple cider, 2 cups apple juice, 1 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 cinnamon sticks, 1 cup Everclear or grain alcohol, 1/2 cup whipped cream vodka
instructions: Pour the apple cider and apple juice into a large pot and heat over medium-high heat | Stir in both sugars and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally ? add the cinnamon sticks during the last 5 minutes | Remove from heat and allow to cool completely | Stir in the Everclear and whipped cream vodka | Remove the cinnamon sticks and transfer to a pitcher or beverage container | Refrigerate before serving

ingredients: 1 cup long-grain rice, 2 cups chicken broth (divided), 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 1 carrot (diced), 1 medium zucchini (diced), 1/4 cup dry white wine, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese (grated), 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the rice and 1 1/2 cups broth ? bring to a boil, stir, cover, and simmer for about 15 minutes ? set aside | Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat ? saut? the carrot and zucchini for 2-3 minutes until just softened | Add the wine and cook for 2 minutes ? keep warm | Add the remaining 1/2 cup broth to the rice and stir over medium-high heat until absorbed | Stir in the cooked vegetables, Parmesan, and pepper | Serve immediately

ingredients: 6 large hard-boiled eggs (halved, yolks removed), 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1/2 tsp ground mustard, 1/4 tsp seasoned salt, 1/4 tsp ground cumin, 1/4 tsp chili powder, pinch of cayenne pepper, paprika, fresh chives or green onion for garnish
instructions: Place the egg yolks in a small bowl and mash with a fork | Stir in the mayonnaise, dry mustard, seasoned salt, cumin, chili powder, and cayenne until smooth and creamy | Spoon or pipe the yolk mixture into the egg white halves | Sprinkle lightly with paprika and garnish with chives or chopped green onion | Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve

ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil (divided), 2 scallions (sliced), 2 cups frozen sweet peas (thawed), 1/4 cup dry white wine, 2 cups fresh spinach, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (divided), salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large saut? pan over medium heat ? add the scallions and saut? for about 2 minutes | Add the remaining oil and 1 teaspoon butter | Add the peas and cook for a few minutes | Add the wine and bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer | Add the spinach and cook until wilted | Stir in the remaining butter and season to taste

ingredients: 1 kg fresh strawberries (hulled), 3 cups granulated sugar, 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice
instructions: Wash and hull the strawberries ? leave them whole | Place the berries in a large pot and cook slowly until they begin to soften ? mash with a potato masher | Add the warmed sugar and lemon juice ? return slowly to a boil, then boil rapidly until the mixture sets, about 20 minutes | Test for doneness on a chilled plate | Ladle into sterilised jars and seal

recipe_name: Molten Chocolate Cakes with Sugar-Coated Raspberries
ingredients: 100g unsalted butter, 100g dark chocolate (chopped), 2 large eggs, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, pinch of salt, 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, 1 cup fresh raspberries, 2 tbsp granulated sugar (for coating)
instructions: Melt the butter and chocolate together in a heatproof bowl over simmering water ? remove from heat | Beat the eggs, sugar, and salt with a hand mixer until the sugar dissolves ? beat into the chocolate mixture until smooth | Beat in the flour until just combined (batter can be made a day ahead) | Preheat oven to 450?F (230?C) and line a muffin tin with 8 extra-large muffin papers ? spray with cooking spray | Divide the batter among the cups | Bake for 8-10 minutes until puffed but the centres are not set | Carefully lift the cakes from the tin, pull the papers away, and transfer to plates | Roll the raspberries in sugar | Top each cake with sugared raspberries and serve immediately

ingredients: 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/4 cup cider vinegar, 2 tbsp Creole mustard, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tsp dried thyme, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1/2 tsp dried coriander, 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan and cook over medium heat until the sugar dissolves and the mixture reaches 220?F (104?C), about 5 minutes | Strain and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper | Use as a glaze for grilled meats

recipe_name: Roasted Pineapple with Pistachio Ice Cream
ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, 4 fresh pineapple rings, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 cinnamon stick, 1 star anise, 1 vanilla bean (split), 3 tbsp dark rum (divided), juice of 1/2 lemon, 4 scoops pistachio ice cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350?F (175?C) | Heat a large ovenproof saut? pan over medium heat and melt the butter | Arrange the pineapple in the pan and sprinkle with brown sugar ? lightly brown on both sides | Remove from heat and add the cinnamon stick, star anise, vanilla bean, and half the rum | Transfer to the oven and roast for 15 minutes, turning the pineapple halfway | When soft and caramelized, stir in the remaining rum and return to the oven for 2 minutes | Cool slightly | To serve, place a pineapple slice on each plate with a scoop of pistachio ice cream ? drizzle with the pan juices and a squeeze of lemon

ingredients: 2 cloves garlic (minced), 2 tbsp onion (finely diced), 3 ripe avocados, 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), juice of 1 lime, 1/2 tsp sea salt, 1/4 cup crumbled cotija cheese, 2 tbsp toasted pepitas (pumpkin seeds)
instructions: Finely chop the garlic, onion, and cilantro | Mash the avocados to your desired consistency | Stir in the lime juice and sea salt | Top with the crumbled cotija cheese and toasted pepitas | Serve immediately with tortilla chips

ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter, 1 cup granulated sugar, 3 large eggs (beaten), 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice, 1 tbsp lemon zest
instructions: In the top of a double boiler, melt the butter | Stir in the sugar, eggs, lemon juice, and lemon zest | Cook over simmering water for about 1 hour, stirring occasionally, until thickened | Turn off the heat, cover with a lid, and allow to cool | Store covered in the refrigerator for up to 3 weeks | Serve on scones, toast, or as a cake filling

recipe_name: Chicken with Green Olives/Oranges and Sherry
ingredients: 1 whole chicken (cut into pieces), 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 shallots (minced), 3 cloves garlic (minced), 1/2 cup medium sherry, 1/2 cup reduced-sodium chicken broth, 1 orange (cut into wedges), 1/2 cup green olives in brine, 1 tbsp honey, salt and black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 425?F (220?C) | Heat the oil in a large ovenproof skillet over high heat | Season the chicken with salt and pepper and cook until the skin is crisp and golden, about 6 minutes per side ? transfer to a plate | Reduce heat to medium-high and drain all but 2 tablespoons of the drippings | Add the shallots and stir until soft, about 2 minutes ? add the garlic, then the sherry | Boil until reduced by half, scraping up the brown bits | Return the chicken skin-side up to the skillet and scatter the orange wedges and olives among the pieces | Transfer to the oven and braise uncovered for about 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through | Transfer the chicken to a platter | Bring the sauce to a boil, stir in the honey, and boil until thickened ? season and pour over the chicken

ingredients: 1/2 cup white vinegar, 3/4 cup vegetable oil, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp dried oregano
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a jar with a tight-fitting lid and shake well | Strain before serving if desired | Serve over salad greens

ingredients: 30ml Goldschl?ger cinnamon schnapps, 30ml peach schnapps, 30ml cranberry juice, ice cubes
instructions: In a cocktail shaker, combine the Goldschl?ger, peach schnapps, and cranberry juice with ice | Shake well and strain into shot glasses | The more peach schnapps you use, the sweeter it is

recipe_name: Coriander Steak with Warm Corn Salad
ingredients: 2 boneless beef top loin steaks, 2 tbsp ground coriander, 1/2 tsp cracked black pepper, 1 tsp salt (divided), 3 tbsp olive oil (divided), 1 red onion (diced), 2 cups fresh corn kernels, 2 tbsp fresh cilantro (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh lime juice, 1/2 tsp ground cumin
instructions: Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat until very hot ? brush with 1 tablespoon oil | Mix the coriander, pepper, and 1/2 teaspoon salt ? coat both sides of the steaks | Cook the steaks for about 8 minutes, turning once, for medium-rare or to your desired doneness | Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a saucepan over medium-high heat ? add the red onion and cook until very soft, about 5 minutes | Stir in the corn and heat through | Stir in the cilantro, lime juice, cumin, and remaining salt | Thinly slice the steaks and serve with the warm corn salad

ingredients: 3 cups all-purpose flour, 1 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp active dry yeast, 1 1/2 cups warm water, cornmeal for dusting
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, salt, and yeast ? stir in the warm water until a shaggy dough forms | Cover with plastic wrap and let rise at room temperature for 12-18 hours until the surface is dotted with bubbles | Turn the dough out onto a heavily floured surface and fold it over a few times ? shape into a rough ball | Place on a cornmeal-dusted piece of parchment paper, cover with a towel, and let rest for 1-2 hours | Place a Dutch oven in the oven and preheat to 450?F (230?C) for 30 minutes | Carefully transfer the dough into the hot pot, cover, and bake for 30 minutes | Uncover and bake for another 10-15 minutes until deeply golden | Cool on a wire rack before slicing

ingredients: 1 ripe mango (peeled and cubed), 1 cup plain yogurt, 1/2 cup cold milk, 2 tbsp honey or sugar, 1/4 tsp ground cardamom, ice cubes
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend on high until smooth and frothy | Taste and adjust the sweetness | Pour into glasses and serve immediately

ingredients: 500g chicken (ayam), 2 batang serai (lemongrass) bruised, 2 inch halia (ginger) sliced, 3 ulas bawang putih (garlic), 1 biji bawang besar (onion), 3 tbsp cili kisar (chili paste), 2 tbsp tomato puree, 1/2 cup air, garam, gula
instructions: Fry the chicken pieces until half cooked and set aside | Blend garlic, onion, and ginger into a paste | Saut? the blended paste and bruised serai (lemongrass) until fragrant | Add cili kisar and cook until oil separates (pecah minyak) | Add tomato puree, chicken, and water, then simmer | Season with salt and sugar to taste | Serve hot with rice.

ingredients: 1 kg chicken (ayam), 2 cups santan (coconut milk), 3 batang serai (lemongrass) smashed, 3 inch halia (ginger), 2 inch lengkuas (galangal), 3 inch kunyit hidup (turmeric), 10 tangkai cili kering (dried chillies), 5 ulas bawang merah (shallots), 3 tbsp kerisik (toasted coconut paste), daun limau purut (makrut lime leaves)
instructions: Blend chillies, shallots, ginger, galangal, and turmeric into a fine paste | In a large wok, combine chicken, blended paste, lemongrass (serai), and coconut milk (santan) | Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until the chicken is tender and the liquid reduces | Add kerisik and lime leaves | Continue to cook on low heat until the oil separates and the rendang turns a dark, rich brown | Serve with lemang or steamed rice.

ingredients: 1 whole chicken (cut into pieces), 3 batang serai (lemongrass), 2 inch halia (ginger), 4 ulas bawang putih (garlic), 1 biji bawang merah (shallot), 2 tbsp serbuk ketumbar (coriander powder), 1 tbsp serbuk jintan manis (fennel powder), 1 tbsp serbuk kunyit (turmeric powder), 2 tangkai daun kari (curry leaves), garam
instructions: Blend lemongrass, ginger, garlic, and shallots with a little water | Marinate the chicken pieces with the blended paste, coriander, fennel, turmeric, and salt for at least 2 hours | Heat deep frying oil | Add the chicken and curry leaves into the hot oil | Fry until golden brown, crispy, and fully cooked inside | Drain excess oil and serve hot.

recipe_name: Daging Masak Kicap (Beef in Soy Sauce)
ingredients: 500g daging (beef) sliced thinly, 2 inch halia (ginger) julienned, 3 ulas bawang putih (garlic) minced, 1 biji bawang besar (onion) sliced, 4 tbsp kicap manis (sweet soy sauce), 2 tbsp sos tiram (oyster sauce), 1 tangkai cili merah (red chilli), 1/2 cup air
instructions: Marinate the beef with 1 tbsp of soy sauce | Heat 2 tbsp of oil and quickly fry the beef until browned, set aside | In the same pan, saut? ginger and garlic until fragrant | Add onions and fry until translucent | Return beef to the pan, add sweet soy sauce, oyster sauce, and water | Simmer until the sauce thickens and beef is tender | Garnish with sliced red chilli.

ingredients: 300g chicken (ayam), 2 batang serai (lemongrass) bruised, 1 inch lengkuas (galangal) sliced, 4 helai daun limau purut (kaffir lime leaves), 3 biji cili padi (bird's eye chillies), 2 tbsp perencah tom yam (tom yam paste), 1/2 biji tomato, 1/2 biji bawang besar (onion), perahan limau nipis (lime juice)
instructions: Boil 3 cups of water in a pot | Add bruised lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, and bird's eye chillies | Add tom yam paste and stir well | Put in the chicken pieces and boil until tender | Add sliced onions and tomatoes, simmer for 2 minutes | Turn off the heat and stir in fresh lime juice | Adjust salt if necessary and serve hot.

ingredients: 500g chicken (ayam), 1 cup santan pekat (thick coconut milk), 2 batang serai (lemongrass) bruised, 1 inch kunyit hidup (fresh turmeric), 10 biji cili api (bird's eye chillies), 1 helai daun kunyit (turmeric leaf), asam keping, garam
instructions: Pound the fresh turmeric and cili api using a mortar and pestle until fine | Put the chicken, pounded ingredients, and bruised lemongrass into a pot and cook until chicken releases its juices | Pour in the coconut milk and lower the heat immediately | Add asam keping and the torn turmeric leaf | Stir constantly to prevent the coconut milk from curdling (pecah minyak) | Season with salt and simmer until chicken is fully cooked.

ingredients: 500g chicken (ayam), 2 biji ubi kentang (potatoes) quartered, 3 tbsp serbuk kari daging (meat curry powder), 1 cup santan (coconut milk), 2 batang serai (lemongrass), 2 inch halia (ginger), 3 ulas bawang merah (shallots), 2 ulas bawang putih (garlic), daun kari (curry leaves)
instructions: Blend shallots, garlic, and ginger | Mix the blended paste with curry powder to form a thick paste | Saut? the paste, curry leaves, and lemongrass in hot oil until fragrant and oil separates | Add chicken and potatoes, stirring to coat with the spices | Add a little water and let it boil until chicken and potatoes are tender | Pour in coconut milk, bring to a gentle simmer, season with salt, and serve.

ingredients: 1kg tulang lembu (beef bones with meat), 1 bungkus sup bunjut (spices sack), 2 batang serai (lemongrass), 2 inch halia (ginger) sliced, 3 biji bawang merah (shallots) sliced, 2 ulas bawang putih (garlic) sliced, daun sup (celery leaves), bawang goreng (fried shallots)
instructions: Boil the beef bones in a large pot of water for 2 hours until the meat is very tender (or use a pressure cooker for 45 minutes) | In a separate pan, saut? sliced shallots, garlic, and ginger until golden brown | Pour the saut?ed mixture and the sup bunjut into the beef broth | Add bruised lemongrass and simmer for 15 minutes | Season with salt and pepper | Garnish heavily with daun sup and bawang goreng before serving.

ingredients: 3 keping ikan tenggiri (mackerel slices), 15 tangkai cili kering (dried chillies), 4 biji bawang merah (shallots), 2 ulas bawang putih (garlic), 1 inch belacan (shrimp paste), 1/2 cup air asam jawa (tamarind juice), daun kesum (laksa leaves), bendi (okra), tomato
instructions: Blend dried chillies, shallots, garlic, and belacan into a fine paste | Heat oil and saut? the paste until fragrant and oil separates | Pour in tamarind juice and water, bring to a boil | Add the fish slices and daun kesum | Simmer until the fish is cooked | Add okra and tomatoes, cook for another 2 minutes | Season with salt and serve hot.

ingredients: 300g chicken breast (dada ayam), 3 inch halia (ginger) julienned, 3 ulas bawang putih (garlic) minced, 1 biji bawang besar (onion) sliced, 1 tbsp sos tiram (oyster sauce), 1 tsp minyak bijan (sesame oil), 1 tangkai daun bawang (spring onion)
instructions: Heat oil in a wok and saut? the julienned ginger and minced garlic until fragrant and slightly golden | Add the chicken pieces and stir-fry until they turn white and are nearly cooked | Add the oyster sauce, sesame oil, and sliced onions | Stir well and add a splash of water to create a light gravy | Cook for another 3 minutes | Garnish with chopped spring onions before serving.

ingredients: 3 cups nasi sejuk (leftover cold rice), 1/2 cup ikan bilis (anchovies), 3 ulas bawang putih (garlic), 4 biji bawang merah (shallots), 5 biji cili padi (bird's eye chillies), 1/2 inch belacan (shrimp paste), 1 genggam kangkung (water spinach), 1 biji telur (egg)
instructions: Fry half the anchovies until crispy and set aside | Pound garlic, shallots, bird's eye chillies, shrimp paste, and the remaining anchovies into a paste | Saut? the paste in hot oil until fragrant | Crack the egg into the wok and scramble it | Add the cold rice and stir-fry continuously over high heat | Add the kangkung and stir until slightly wilted | Serve hot with the crispy anchovies sprinkled on top.

ingredients: 1/2 ekor ayam (chicken), 1 bungkus nasi impit (compressed rice), 2 batang serai (lemongrass), 2 inch halia (ginger), 2 inch kunyit hidup (turmeric), 3 ulas bawang putih (garlic), 1 bunjut rempah soto (soto spices), taugeh (beansprouts), daun sup (celery leaves)
instructions: Blend garlic, ginger, and turmeric into a paste | Saut? the paste with lemongrass and soto spices until fragrant | Add chicken and water, boil until the chicken is cooked to make the broth | Remove the chicken, shred the meat, and set aside | Season the yellow broth with salt | Cut the compressed rice into cubes | Place rice, shredded chicken, and beansprouts in a bowl, then pour the hot broth over it | Garnish with daun sup and fried shallots.

ingredients: 500g laksa noodles, 500g ikan kembung (mackerel), 4 keping asam keping (tamarind slices), 1 bunga kantan (torch ginger flower), 1 ikat daun kesum (laksa leaves), 3 batang serai (lemongrass), 2 inch lengkuas (galangal), 10 biji cili kering (dried chillies), 1 inch belacan (shrimp paste), petis (shrimp paste sauce)
instructions: Boil the fish, remove the meat, and blend the bones with water to extract stock | Blend dried chillies, galangal, lemongrass, and belacan into a fine paste | In a large pot, combine the fish stock, blended paste, fish meat, tamarind slices, torch ginger flower, and laksa leaves | Boil the broth for at least 1 hour to develop the sour and spicy flavors | Blanch the laksa noodles | Pour the hot broth over the noodles and serve with a dollop of thick petis.

ingredients: 500g udang (prawns), 15 biji cili kering (dried chillies), 5 biji bawang merah (shallots), 3 ulas bawang putih (garlic), 1/2 inch belacan (shrimp paste), 1 biji bawang besar (onion) sliced thinly, 2 tbsp air asam jawa (tamarind juice), 1 tbsp gula melaka (palm sugar)
instructions: Clean prawns but leave the tails on | Blend dried chillies, shallots, garlic, and belacan into a smooth paste | Heat oil and fry the paste slowly until the oil separates (pecah minyak) | Add tamarind juice, palm sugar, and salt, cooking until the sambal deepens in color | Add the sliced onions and cook until soft | Finally, toss in the prawns and stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until they turn pink | Do not overcook. Serve with warm rice.

ingredients: 2 cups rice, 1 cup coconut milk, 1 1/2 cups water, 2 pandan leaves knotted, 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp sambal, 80g dried anchovies, 1/2 cup roasted peanuts, 1 cucumber sliced, 4 boiled eggs
instructions: Rinse the rice 3 to 4 times until the water is mostly clear, then drain well | Put rice, coconut milk, water, pandan leaves, and salt in a rice cooker or pot and stir once | Cook until the rice is tender, then let it rest covered for 10 minutes before fluffing | Fry the anchovies over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp, then drain on paper towels | Warm the sambal gently and prepare cucumber slices, peanuts, and boiled eggs | Serve a mound of coconut rice with sambal, anchovies, peanuts, cucumber, and halved eggs

ingredients: 3 cups cooked rice, 1/2 cup dried anchovies, 4 cloves garlic, 5 shallots, 6 bird's eye chilies, 1 cup kangkung, 1 egg, 1 tbsp sweet soy sauce, 2 tbsp cooking oil
instructions: Use cold cooked rice and break up any clumps with your fingers or a spoon | Pound or blend anchovies, garlic, shallots, and chilies into a coarse paste | Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat and fry the paste for 2 to 3 minutes until fragrant | Push the paste aside, crack in the egg, and scramble until just set | Add rice and sweet soy sauce, then stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes until the rice is hot and evenly coated | Add kangkung last and toss for 30 to 60 seconds until just wilted, then serve hot

ingredients: 2 cups rice, 1 cup glutinous rice, 1 1/2 cups coconut milk, 5 shallots sliced, 1 tsp halba, 2 cups fish curry, 1 tsp salt
instructions: Rinse both types of rice, then soak for at least 4 hours or overnight for better texture | Steam the drained rice for 20 minutes until partly cooked but still firm | Mix warm coconut milk with salt, sliced shallots, and halba, then fold it through the hot rice | Rest the rice for 10 minutes so it absorbs the coconut milk | Steam again for 15 to 20 minutes until fluffy and fully tender | Serve warm with fish curry spooned over or on the side

ingredients: 2 cups rice, 1/2 cup bunga telang extract, 1 cup mixed herbs sliced, 1/2 cup grated coconut toasted, 2 salted eggs, 1 cup fish crackers, 2 tbsp budu

ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, 3 tbsp ghee, 1 cup evaporated milk, 1/4 cup raisins, 1/4 cup cashews, 1 cinnamon stick, 3 cloves, 3 cardamom pods, 1 onion sliced
